summary: FESCO Group Co., Ltd. operates in the human resources service industry in China. The company offers human resources services, including personnel management, welfare services, business outsourcing, salary and benefits, recruitment and flexible employment, and consulting services to various organizations. It also provides vocational education, international education, international talent services, talent development consulting, human resources management consulting, legal consulting, background checks, and off-the-job placement solutions. The company was formerly known as Beijing Urban-Rural Commercial (Group)Co., Ltd. FESCO Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 1979 and is based in Beijing, China.

name: AVIC Aviation High-Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: AVIC Aviation High-Technology Co., Ltd. is a Chinese enterprise primarily engaged in the research, development, production, and sale of advanced aviation materials and specialized equipment. Its extensive product portfolio includes a diverse range of computer numerical control (CNC) machine tools, such as various milling machines (vertical, horizontal, gantry, and roll types), lathes (including inclined bed CNC models), and advanced machining centers. These sophisticated machines serve a wide array of industrial applications, spanning mold fabrication, automotive component production, wind and nuclear power generation, marine vessel construction, military and aerospace sectors, and educational purposes. Beyond core machining tools, AVIC also manufactures specialized equipment like rocker milling machines, straw briquetting machines, and biomass granulators. Additionally, the company provides design, manufacturing, and sales services for mechanical and electrical products and molds, alongside offering technical collaboration and expert consulting services. A significant part of its operations involves pioneering carbon materials manufacturing technology, targeting sectors like aviation, aerospace, and rail transportation. Furthermore, AVIC is active in the medical field, developing, producing, and distributing orthopedic implants, including artificial hips, knees, spines, and other surgical devices. It also specializes in advanced composite materials, crucial for civil aviation, automotive manufacturing, rail transport, as well as petroleum, electricity, and new energy industries. Its global footprint extends through product exports to various international markets, such as the United States, Brazil, Southeast Asia, India, the Middle East, and Africa. Established in 1988, the company is headquartered in Nantong, China. It operated as Tontec Technology Investment Group Co., Ltd. until May 2016, when it adopted its current name.

name: Inner Mongolia MengDian HuaNeng Thermal Power Corporation Limited
summary: Inner Mongolia MengDian HuaNeng Thermal Power Corporation Limited engages in electric power generation business. The company is based in Hohhot, China. Inner Mongolia MengDian HuaNeng Thermal Power Corporation Limited operates as a subsidiary of North United Power Corporation.
industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

name: Harbin Hatou Investment Co.,Ltd
summary: Harbin Hatou Investment Co.,Ltd. produces and supplies heat and electric power primarily in the People's Republic of China and the Russian Federation. The company operates through Power, Heat, Construction Materials, Real Estate, Forest Cutting, Chemicals, and Construction. It offers cement, network support, wood materials, and fertilizers. The company is also involved in electricity, heat supply, and steam business; and project installation activities. In addition, it engages in energy, mining, real estate, construction, technology, and agricultural investment businesses. The company was formerly known as Harbin Sui Bao Re Dian Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Harbin Hatou Investment Co.,Ltd. in November 2007. Harbin Hatou Investment Co.,Ltd. is headquartered in Harbin, the People's Republic of China. Harbin Hatou Investment Co.,Ltd. is a subsidiary of Harbin Investment Group Co., Ltd.

name: Baida Group Co.,Ltd
summary: Baida Group Co.,Ltd primarily operates department stores in China. It also operates Hangzhou Hotel; and provides commercial property management services. The company was founded in 1989 and is based in Hangzhou, China.

name: Star Lake Bioscience Co., Inc.Zhaoqing Guangdong
summary: Star Lake Bioscience Co., Inc. manufactures and sells pharmaceutical raw materials, and food and feed additives in China and internationally. The company offers guanosine that is used as an intermediate for food and pharmaceutical raw material; L-proline for use as an intermediate for synthesizing captopril and enalapril, and raw material for amino acid transfusion; adefovir dipivoxil tablets used to reduce the activity of HBV DNA polymerase and anti-virus by destroying Hepatitis B virus DNA; and L-threonine that is used in premixtures, and pig and poultry feed. It also provides disodium 5'-ribonucleotide to cure chronic hepatitis, muscular atrophy, and eye diseases; disodium 5-inosinate to cure leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and chronic and acute hepatitis; and inosine, which is used for the treatment of chronic hepatitis, heart disease, leukopenia or thrombocytopenia, central choroidoretinitis, etc. In addition, the company offers disodium 5'-guanylate for canned meat, ham, salted meat, etc. Further, it provides ribavirin, adenosine, adenine, memantine hydrochloride, arginine, D-ribose, fructose syrup, L-valine, L-threonine, L-lysine, etc. The company offers its products under the Star Lake and Yue Bao brands. Star Lake Bioscience Co., Inc. was founded in 1964 and is based in Zhaoqing, China.

name: Tonghua Dongbao Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
summary: Tonghua Dongbao Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. researches and develops, manufactures, and sells pharmaceutical products for the treatment of diabetes and cardiovascular-based diseases in China. The company operates through Pharmaceutical Industry and Building Materials Industry segments. It lead product portfolio includes insulin analogues, such as insulin glargine, Insulin aspart, insulin detemir, and insulin lispro; antidiabetic drug agonist products; oral hypoglycemic agents; and Zhen Nao Ning and Nao Xue Kang capsules, as well as Gan Shulin pens, blood glucose meters, and other medical devices. The company is also involved in developing Y-PEG of recombinant human interferon a 2b injection, which has been completed Phase III clinical stage to treat chronic hepatitis C (2,3 gene type) and chronic hepatitis B III; Y-PEG a recombinant human granulocyte colony-stimulating factor injection that is in Phase II clinical stage for the treatment of chemotherapy-induced neutropenia; Y-PEG injection of recombinant human growth hormone, which is in Phase II clinical stage to treat short stature and growth hormone deficiency; and Y-PEG of recombinant human interferon a 2a injection that is in Phase II clinical stage to treat chronic hepatitis B and hepatitis C. It offers building materials comprising plastic windows and sections; and other products. The company has a strategic alliance with Adocia. Tonghua Dongbao Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. was founded in 1985 and is based in Tonghua, China.

name: Guangdong Meiyan Jixiang Hydropower Co., Ltd.
summary: Guangdong Meiyan Jixiang Hydropower Co., Ltd. generates hydroelectric power in China. The company operates six hydropower stations with an installed capacity of 151,000 kilowatts. It also offers education services, as well as cement. The company was founded in 1993 and is based in Meizhou, China.
industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

name: Far East Smarter Energy Co., Ltd.
summary: Far East Smarter Energy Co., Ltd. provides smart energy and smart city services in China and internationally. It offers aluminum alloy conductors, optical fiber composite power cables, power cables for DC transmission systems, power cables for power transmission, low-smoke halogen-free thin-walled cables for EMUs, aluminum alloy conductor industrial cables, and other intelligent wire and cable products used in smart grid, green building, clean energy, high-end equipment, and smart transportation fields. The company also provides clean energy engineering, power engineering consulting, planning and design, and general contracting services; and ternary material lithium-ion batteries. In addition, it operates MMBao, an e-commerce platform for electrical and electronics industry; and Cableabc.com, a Website for electrical and electronics industry, as well as offers commodity trading services. The company was founded in 1990 and is based in Yixing, China. Far East Smarter Energy Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of Far East Holding Group Co., Ltd.

name: Sinopec Oilfield Service Corporation Class A
summary: Sinopec Oilfield Service Corp. engages in the provision of integrated oil and gas engineering and technical services. Its business segments include geophysics, drilling engineering, logging, downhole special operations, and construction. Its segments cover the whole industry chain process including exploration, drilling, completion, oil and gas production, and oil and gas collection to abandoned wells. It offers services involving geophysics, drilling engineering, wells measuring, downhole special operations, construction, ocean engineering, and reservoir integrated services. The company was founded on December 31, 1993 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.

name: Jonjee Hi-tech Industrial & Commercial Holding Co., Ltd.
summary: Jonjee Hi-tech Industrial & Commercial Holding Co., Ltd. produces and sells seasoning products in China and internationally. Its products include soy sauce, chicken distillate, oyster sauce, preserved bean curd, vinegar, and other seasoning products. The company also provides facilities and services, such as land, factory buildings, and staff dormitories with public facilities; inspection services for construction and safety control; registration for establishing enterprises; real estate management services in the parks; and public environment administration services, etc. In addition, it is involved in the manufacture and sale of precision forging parts of automobiles and motor eyelets; precision forging parts of automobile and motor eyelets; temperature pipe valves; and other machined products, as well as rental and sale of real estate properties. Further, the company produces batteries in various kinds, including rechargeable batteries and battery packs, which are be applied in power tools, R/C toys, emergency lighting, electrical home appliance, portable computers, and cellular and cordless phones. The company was formerly known as Zhongshan Torch Hi-tech Industrial & Commercial Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Jonjee Hi-tech Industrial & Commercial Holding Co., Ltd. in February 2001. Jonjee Hi-tech Industrial & Commercial Holding Co., Ltd. was founded in 1993 and is based in Zhongshan, China.

name: MeiHua Holdings Group Co.,Ltd
summary: MeiHua Holdings Group Co.,Ltd provides amino acid nutrition and health solutions. It offers food additives, including, sodium glutamate, natamycin, disodium inosinate, xanthan gum, pullulan, disodium 5'-ribonucleotide, and trehalose; condiments; amino acid for feed comprising valine, L-lysine sulphate and HCL, L-threonine, L-tryptophane, corn gluten meal for feedstuffs, corn husk powder, corn fiber feed, and boutique MSG residue; pharmaceutical amino acids, such as L-glutamine, L-leucine, L-isoleucine, L-valine, vernine, and adenosine; colloids; fertilizers, including soil conditioners; and capsules comprising enteric, cellulose, gelatin, and pullulan capsules. The company was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Langfang, China.

name: Tianjin Capital Environmental Protection Group Company Limited
summary: Tianjin Capital Environmental Protection Group Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the sewage treatment and construction of the sewage treatment plants in the People's Republic of China. The company operates through Processing of Sewage Water; Recycled Water; Pipeline Connection; Heating and Cooling Service; Sales of Tap Water; Sale of Environmental Protection Equipment; and All Other segments. It also provides toll collection and engineering consulting services; environment governance, technical consulting services, etc.; technical consulting for water recycling business; and energy saving and research, consulting and transfer, and property management services, as well as invests in construction projects. The company was founded in 1993 and is based in Tianjin, the People's Republic of China. Tianjin Capital Environmental Protection Group Company Limited is a subsidiary of Tianjin Municipal Investment Company Limited.

name: Dongfang Electric Corporation Limited
summary: Dongfang Electric Corporation Limited (DEC) is a prominent entity in the global energy sector, specializing in the design, development, production, and distribution of power generation equipment both within China and across international markets. Its operations are diversified across five distinct segments: Renewable Energy Equipment, Clean and Efficient Energy Equipment, Engineering and Trade, Modern Manufacturing Services Industry, and Emerging Growth Industry. DEC's comprehensive portfolio supports electricity generation from a wide array of sources, including wind, solar, hydropower, nuclear, gas, and thermal power. The company boasts substantial installed capacities for various equipment types, including 8,101 megawatts (MW) of hydro-generating units, 25,028 MW of steam turbine generators, 3,370 MW of wind power units, 23,929 MW of power station steam turbines, and 22,017 MW of power station boilers. Beyond manufacturing, Dongfang Electric also provides specialized engineering contracting and a range of services to energy operators globally. Established in 1993 and headquartered in Chengdu, People's Republic of China, the company underwent a name change in October 2007, transitioning from Dongfang Electric Machinery Co., Ltd. to its current designation. It operates as a subsidiary of Dongfang Electric Corporation.

name: Triumph New Energy Company Limited
summary: Triumph New Energy Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of float glass in China and internationally. The company operates through two segments, Information Display Glass and New Energy Glass. The Information Display Glass segment offers ultra-thin electronic glass substrates. The New Energy Glass segment produces photovoltaic original glass and its further processed products, such as glass for ultra-white high transparent cover plate and back plate glass for solar photovoltaic module. Triumph New Energy Company Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in Luoyang, the People's Republic of China.

name: CETC Chips Technology Inc.
summary: CETC Chips Technology Inc. is a company dedicated to the entire lifecycle of silicon-based analog semiconductor chips and their associated products. Its operations span from conceptual design and rigorous research and development to production, quality assurance testing, and global sales, serving markets both within the People's Republic of China and worldwide. The company's diverse product portfolio addresses various advanced technological sectors. Within the Internet of Things (IoT) domain, it provides a range of wireless communication solutions, including radio frequency (RF) amplifiers, switches, digital control attenuators, frequency synthesizers, and RF transceivers, alongside satellite navigation and short-range communication devices. For green energy applications, CETC Chips develops photovoltaic bypass switch circuits and comprehensive power management solutions. The security electronics sector benefits from their offerings, such as motor drive chips for surveillance systems, environmental monitoring circuits, and anti-counterfeit RFID tags and integrated systems. Furthermore, in automotive electronics, their contributions include satellite navigation System-on-Chip (SoC) solutions, Battery Management System (BMS) chips, high- and low-side electronic switches, half-bridge drivers, and LED driver ICs. Smart home technology is enhanced by their motor drive and electronic switch chip series, as well as intelligent electronic control units. In the realm of smart terminals, they contribute to the design of smart power supplies, wearable devices, and intelligent speaker products. The company, originally named CETC Acoustic-Optic-Electronic Technology Inc., adopted its current designation, CETC Chips Technology Inc., in October 2022. Established in 1875, CETC Chips Technology Inc. maintains its headquarters in Chongqing, People's Republic of China.

name: China Aerospace Times Electronics Co. Ltd.
summary: China Aerospace Times Electronics CO., LTD., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, produces and sells aerospace electronics, unmanned system equipment, and wire and cable products in China. The company offers military and civilian unmanned aerial vehicle systems, precision-guided weapon systems, and Internet of Things application systems; and system-level products, such as measurement and control communication systems, remote sensing information systems, and satellite applications. It also provides military and civilian inertial navigation products, satellite navigation products, telemetry and remote-control equipment, precision guidance and electronic countermeasure equipment, computer technology, software, hardware, and other professional equipment. In addition, the company offers military and civilian integrated circuits, sensors, relays, electrical connectors, microwave devices, and precision electromechanical products. Further, it engages in the technical development, production, sale, technology transfer, and consulting for aerospace technology applications and related products; and leasing of houses and equipment. China Aerospace Times Electronics CO., LTD. was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.

name: Chengdu B-ray Media Co.,Ltd.
summary: Chengdu B-ray Media Co.,Ltd. engages in the media operations business in China. It is also involved in the advertising, education, and printing businesses. In addition, the company engages in the operation of online games; and microfinance business. Chengdu B-ray Media Co.,Ltd. is based in Chengdu, China.

name: Jilin Yatai (Group) Co., Ltd.
summary: Jilin Yatai (Group) Co., Ltd. operates in building materials, real estate, pharmaceutical, finance, coal, and trade and business industries in China. The company mines for limestone and gravel aggregates; and processes, produces, and sells clinker, cement, premixed concrete, and other building materials. It also produces pharmaceutical health products and medicines, and medical equipment; and provides primary land consolidation, housing development, building construction, decoration, environmental engineering, property management, and heating services. In addition, the company offers financial investment services; provides banking services through 392 branches in Jilin province; and operates shopping malls, department stores, and hotels. Further, it engages in exploitation, production, and sale of coal. Jilin Yatai (Group) Co., Ltd. was founded in 1986 and is based in Changchun, China.

name: Shanghai Milkground Food Tech Co., Ltd
summary: Shanghai Milkground Food Tech Co., Ltd is a Chinese enterprise that specializes in the production and distribution of an extensive range of cheese and liquid milk products. The company serves a diverse clientele, including both individual consumers and industrial customers, across China. Its comprehensive product line features various cheese varieties such as ready-to-eat nutritional cheese sticks, adult shredded cheese sticks, children's growing cups, mozzarella, cheese slices, cream cheese, butter, and grilled cheese, in addition to milk and other related dairy items. These products are made available through multiple sales channels, including independent distributors, the company's proprietary e-commerce platforms, prominent shopping centers, and major supermarkets. Established in 1998, Shanghai Milkground Food Tech Co., Ltd maintains its primary operational base in Shanghai, China.

name: Yunnan Bowin Technology Industry Co.,Ltd
summary: Yunnan Bowin Technology Industry Co.,Ltd manufactures and distributes cement in China. The company's cement products include ordinary Portland cement and compound Portland cement. It is also involved in the foreign equity investment business. The company is based in Kunming, China.

name: Ningbo Shanshan Co.,Ltd.
summary: Ningbo Shanshan Co.,Ltd. provides apparels and lithium battery materials in China and internationally. The company provides lithium-ion battery materials; lithium battery cathode materials, such as lithium cobalt oxide products, multi-material series products, lithium manganese oxide products, and ternary precursors; lithium battery anode material products, including artificial and natural graphite, mesophase carbon microbeads, and composite graphite; silicon-based anode materials; and lithium battery electrolyte products, as well as lithium-ion battery and capacitor packs. It is also involved in the provision of energy management services, such as energy storage and photovoltaic services; construction of charging piles; operation of new energy vehicles; and design, research, and development of energy buses and special-purpose vehicles. In addition, the company engages in the financial leasing and venture capital businesses. The company was founded in 1992 and is based in Ningbo, China.

name: Hongfa Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Hongfa Technology Co., Ltd. manufactures and supplies relays, low-voltage devices, contactors, precise components, automatic production lines, etc. It offers a range of relays, including signal relays, automotive relays and modules, power relays, industrial relays, latching relays, solid-state relays and power modules, and hermetically-sealed relays, as well as relay sockets. The company's low-voltage devices comprise intelligent air circuit breakers, molded case circuit breakers, automatic transfer switching, and terminal circuit breakers. It serves customers worldwide. Hongfa Technology Co., Ltd. was formerly known as WuHan LiNuo Solar Energy Group Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Hongfa Technology Co., Ltd. in December 2012. The company was founded in 1984 and is based in Xiamen, China.

name: SDIC Power Holdings CO., LTD.
summary: SDIC Power Holdings CO., LTD. engages in the electricity business in China. It generates electricity with an installed capacity of 16.72 million kilowatts of hydropower; 11.765 million kilowatts of thermal power; and 808,500 kilowatts of wind and photovoltaic power. The company is based in Beijing, China.
industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

name: Inner Mongolia Yili Industrial Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Inner Mongolia Yili Industrial Group Co., Ltd. produces and sells dairy products in China and internationally. The company offers liquid milk, milk powder, yoghourt, ice cream, and cheese. Inner Mongolia Yili Industrial Group Co., Ltd. has strategic partnership with Sterilgarda Alimenti S.p.A for the development of dairy products. The company was founded in 1956 and is based in Hohhot, China.

name: Xinjiang Joinworld Co.,Ltd.
summary: Xinjiang Joinworld Co., Ltd. engages in the production and sale of aluminum and aluminum products in China and internationally. It also provides electronic aluminum foil, electrode foil, and other electronic component raw materials, as well as aluminum alloys. The company's aluminum is used in electronic aluminum foil, electronic conductive needle wire, alumina powder, aviation aluminum alloy, and target materials, as well as other fields of electronics, aerospace, and integrated circuits; electronic aluminum foil is used for the production of electrode foil; electrode foil is used for the production of aluminum electrolytic capacitors; and aluminum alloy is used in electronic consumer products, energy-saving wires, automobile engines, automobile decoration, architectural decoration and other electronics, electricity, transportation, and construction related field. In addition, the company manufactures and sells electronic materials. Xinjiang Joinworld Co., Ltd. was founded in 1958 and is based in Urumqi, China.

name: Nanjing Chemical Fibre Co.,Ltd
summary: Established in Nanjing, China, in 1964, Nanjing Chemical Fibre Co.,Ltd specializes in the production and sale of viscose fibers. These textile fibers, marketed under the Jinling brand, include both viscose filament and viscose staple varieties. In addition to its primary fiber business, the company diversifies its operations into water provision and pulp manufacturing. Nanjing Chemical Fibre's products are supplied across China and are also exported internationally to numerous regions, including South Korea, Japan, Vietnam, Europe, and the United States.

name: Harbin Churin Group Jointstock Co., Ltd.
summary: Harbin Churin Group Jointstock Co., Ltd. engages in the commodity retailing and house leasing businesses primarily in Harbin, Heilongjiang Province, China. The company operates department stores and food stores. It distributes commodities, such as general merchandise, cosmetics, apparels, shoes and hats, gold and silver accessories, clocks and watches, textile products, toys, cultural products, household electrical appliances, photographic equipment, glass products, cigarettes and wines, and others. It is also involved in the design, production, issuing, and agent business of advertisements. Harbin Churin Group Jointstock Co., Ltd. is based in Harbin, China.

name: Dasheng Times Cultural Investment Co., Ltd.
summary: Dasheng Times Cultural Investment Co., Ltd. engages in the game development, education, and film and television investment and production activities in China. The company was formerly known as Baocheng Investment Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Dasheng Times Cultural Investment Co., Ltd. in June 2016. Dasheng Times Cultural Investment Co., Ltd. was founded in 1990 and is based in Shenzhen, China.

name: Aecc Aviation Power Co.,Ltd
summary: AECC Aviation Power Co., Ltd develops, produces, and sells large and medium-sized military and civil aviation engines in the People's Republic of China. It also provides large-scale ship gas turbine power plant production and repair services. The company also offers non-aviation products, including solar power generation devices, industrial gas turbines, and energy saving and environmental protection devices. AECC Aviation Power Co., Ltd was formerly known as AVIC Aviation Engine Corporation PLC and changed its name to AECC Aviation Power Co., Ltd in March 2017. The company was founded in 1958 and is based in Xi'an, the People's Republic of China.

name: Guangzhou Guangri Stock Co.,Ltd.
summary: Guangzhou Guangri Stock Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells elevators and related parts in China. It offers elevators, escalators, and electrical equipment and parts; elevator guide rails; intelligent parking equipment; and subway platform screen doors, as well as logistics and distribution services. The company is based in Guangzhou, China. Guangzhou Guangri Stock Co.,Ltd. is a subsidiary of Guangzhou Guangri Group Co., Ltd.

name: Shanghai Zhangjiang Hi-Tech Park Development Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Zhangjiang Hi-Tech Park Development Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the investment, development, management, and operation of real estate properties in the People's Republic of China. The company also invests in municipal infrastructure facilities, commercial high-tech projects, communication and information, and biomedicine sectors. In addition, it involves in the equipment supply and installation, distribution of building materials, warehousing investment, and provision of consulting services. The company was founded in 1996 and is based in Shanghai, the People's Republic of China. Shanghai Zhangjiang Hi-Tech Park Development Co., Ltd. operates as an investment arm of Shanghai Zhangjiang (Group) Co., Ltd.

name: Lanhai Medical Investment Co., Ltd.
summary: Lanhai Medical Investment Co., Ltd. provides medical and health services. The company operates rehabilitation hospitals. It also offers financial insurance services; and industrial investment services. The company was formerly known as China Shipping Haisheng Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Lanhai Medical Investment Co., Ltd. in November 2016. Lanhai Medical Investment Co., Ltd. was founded in 1989 and is based in Shanghai, China.

name: Xiamen International Airport Co.,Ltd
summary: Xiamen International Airport Co.,Ltd engages in the airport operations in the China. The company's route network covers various cities in Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan connecting Southeast Asia, Northeast Asia, Europe, the United States, and Australia. It also provides air cargo terminal, office leasing, automobile, aviation, logistics, e-commerce, bidding agency, advertising media services, etc.; and resident units, including government and civil aviation stations. The company operates 40 airlines, including 25 domestic airlines and 15 overseas airlines. Its airport operates in 109 cities that include 83 domestic, 20 international, and 6 regional; and 182 domestic and international routes, which comprise 145 domestic routes, and 37 international and regional routes. The company was founded in 1983 and is based in Xiamen, China. Xiamen International Airport Co.,Ltd is a subsidiary of Xiamen Iport Group Co., Ltd.

name: Gome Telecom Equipment Co., Ltd.
summary: Gome Telecom Equipment Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of smart phones through retail stores and online channels. The company was formerly known as Sanlian Commercial Co., Ltd. Gome Telecom Equipment Co., Ltd. is based in Jinan, China.

name: China Yangtze Power Co., Ltd.
summary: China Yangtze Power Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in operation, management, consultation, investment, and financing of hydropower stations in the People's Republic of China. The company owns, operates, and manages hydropower generation assets in the Three Gorges, Gezhouba, Xiluodu, and Xiangjiaba with an installed capacity of 45,495 MW. It is also involved in production and distribution of power, electricity, and heat business; and provision of high-technology and software development services. The company was founded in 2002 and is based in Beijing, the People's Republic of China. China Yangtze Power Co.,Ltd. is a subsidiary of China Three Gorges Corporation.
industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

name: Jiangsu Financial Leasing Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu Financial Leasing Co., Ltd. is a prominent non-bank financial institution based in Nanjing, China, established in 1985. The company specializes in providing diverse financial leasing solutions across various sectors within China. Its extensive portfolio of services supports critical industries such as the energy sector, encompassing financing for photovoltaic, wind power, thermal power, and energy storage stations. Environmental protection also forms a significant focus, with leasing services directed towards air and sewage treatment, solid and hazardous waste management, industrial and building energy efficiency initiatives, as well as centralized cooling and heating systems, among other specialized environmental segments. Furthermore, Jiangsu Financial Leasing provides financial backing for high-end industrial machinery, information technology equipment, healthcare facilities, urban public services, and construction machinery. The company also offers dedicated automobile financing services. Known as Jiangsu Provincial Leasing Co., Ltd. until April 2003, it subsequently adopted its current name, Jiangsu Financial Leasing Co., Ltd.

name: Guizhou Gas Group Corporation Ltd.
summary: Based in Guiyang, China, Guizhou Gas Group Corporation Ltd. is a prominent Chinese enterprise in the gas sector. Since its founding in 1995, the company has been responsible for the construction, supply, and management of various critical gas facilities. These facilities include natural gas pipelines, urban gas transmission and distribution networks, liquefied natural gas (LNG) reception and storage stations, and gas fueling stations.

name: China Three Gorges Renewables (Group) Co.,Ltd.
summary: China Three Gorges Renewables (Group) Co.,Ltd. functions primarily as an electricity producer harnessing sustainable energy sources. Its operational scope encompasses the generation of power from wind, solar, and hydroelectric facilities. Beyond its core power production, the company also engages in strategic investments, handles project execution, and oversees the development and application of water resources. Furthermore, it extends technical advisory services. Originally operating under the name China Three Gorges New Energy (Group) Co., Ltd., the enterprise adopted its current identity, China Three Gorges Renewables (Group) Co.,Ltd., in June 2019. Founded in 1985, the firm maintains its corporate headquarters in Beijing, China.
industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

name: Caida Securities Co., Ltd.
summary: Operating from its headquarters in Shijiazhuang, China, Caida Securities Co., Ltd. is an investment bank established in 2002. The company offers a comprehensive suite of services, including the management of securities assets, providing margin financing and securities lending facilities, acting as an agent for the sale of securities investment funds, delivering financial advisory services pertinent to securities trading and investment, and distributing diverse financial products.

name: Wuxi Rural Commercial Bank Co.,Ltd
summary: Wuxi Rural Commercial Bank Co.,Ltd offers a comprehensive array of financial products and services tailored for both individual and corporate clients. Its diverse offerings include wealth management, investment funds, insurance coverage, efficient account administration, micro-lending solutions, foreign exchange operations, international trade finance, secure remittance services, and letters of credit, complemented by convenient card and digital banking platforms. The institution maintains a significant operational network, featuring one dedicated sales department, 55 sub-branches, and 57 full-service branch locations. Established in 2005, the bank's primary operations are based in Wuxi, China.

name: Huaan Securities Co., Ltd.
summary: Huaan Securities Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides securities brokerage, investment consulting, and other services in China. The company also offers investment banking services, including IPO, merger and acquisition, refinancing, and new board listing services; and asset management services. In addition, it provides financial services; and specializes in fixed income securities and related derivative products. The company was founded in 1991 and is based in Hefei, China.

name: China National Gold Group Gold Jewellery Co.,Ltd.
summary: China National Gold Group Gold Jewellery Co.,Ltd. is engaged in the manufacturing and retail of gold jewelry. The company utilizes a broad distribution network, comprising 30 dedicated brand service centers and around 2,000 specialized retail outlets, in addition to its online sales channels. Established in 2006, this enterprise maintains its primary office in Beijing, China.

name: Chongqing Gas Group Corporation Ltd.
summary: Chongqing Gas Group Corporation Ltd., headquartered in Chongqing, China, operates as a diversified energy enterprise offering a comprehensive array of gas-related services. These services encompass the design, production, installation, maintenance, sale, and management of gas systems, alongside expert technical consultation. The company also manages the entire pipeline network, overseeing gas storage, transportation, supply, distribution, and commercialization. Beyond these core operations, its portfolio extends to providing heating, cooling, and integrated heat and power solutions, fostering high-tech gas development, offering pipeline anti-corrosion treatments, and retailing gas appliances. Significantly, it serves approximately 5.12 million natural gas customers across 25 districts and counties within the Chongqing municipality.

name: Zhongtai Securities Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhongtai Securities Co., Ltd. operates as a securities brokerage company in China. It provides financial advisory, securities issuance and underwriting, mergers and acquisitions, asset restructuring, asset management, margin financing, securities lending, and investment consulting services, as well as acts as an agent for securities trading, financial products, and securities investment fund. The company is also involved in the credit, investment banking, wealth management, counter market, institutional sales transaction, self-operated, and research consulting businesses, as well as offers risk management; compliance management; and hosting, outsourcing, and institutional brokerage services. In addition, it operates Zhongtai Qifutong, a mobile Internet integrated service portal platform for Zhongtai securities. The company was formerly known as Qilu Securities Co., Ltd. Zhongtai Securities Co., Ltd. is based in Jinan, China.

name: Bank of Jiangsu Co., Ltd.
summary: Bank of Jiangsu Co., Ltd., established in 2006 and headquartered in Nanjing, China, functions as a comprehensive financial services provider throughout China. The institution strategically segments its operations into Corporate Banking, Retail Banking, and Treasury Business. For individual clients, the bank delivers a broad spectrum of retail services. These include private banking, various savings and investment products, wealth management solutions, personal loans, foreign exchange services, payment processing, consumer financing, and even acting as an agency for welfare and sports lotteries. Its corporate banking division caters to businesses, government bodies, and financial institutions with a robust suite of offerings. These encompass diverse deposit options (including time, call, structured, and current accounts), project financing, corporate wealth management, and an extensive array of trade finance facilities such as international remittances, export and import financing, and letter of credit services. The bank also engages in sophisticated financial market activities, including money market operations, fixed income investments, foreign exchange trading, and derivatives. Furthermore, it provides investment banking services like mergers and acquisitions, structured financing, bond market activities, and securitization, along with custody services. Beyond these core areas, Bank of Jiangsu offers various other financial solutions, including corporate loans, finance leasing, guarantees, settlement services, securities agency, and credit card facilities. It also handles repurchase transactions and debt instrument investments. Demonstrating a strong digital presence, the bank provides a wide array of internet banking options, including direct, mobile, personal and corporate online platforms, telephone banking, SMS services, and WeChat banking. The bank maintains a substantial physical presence with a network of 531 branches across the country, which comprises its head office, 17 main branches, one franchised institution, and 512 sub-branches. This extensive network enables it to serve a diverse client base, including individuals, corporations, government agencies, and other financial institutions.

name: Bank of Hangzhou Co., Ltd.
summary: Bank of Hangzhou Co., Ltd. provides various banking products and services to small and medium enterprises, and urban and rural residents in China. The company operates approximately 180 branches. Bank of Hangzhou Co., Ltd. was founded in 1996 and is based in Hangzhou, China.

name: Yongan Futures
summary: Yongan Futures Co.,Ltd., founded in 1992, was initially known as Zhejiang Yongan Futures Brokerage Co., Ltd. The company adopted its current name in September 2012. Headquartered in Hangzhou, China, this firm provides brokerage services for both commodity and financial futures, serving clients within China and internationally. Additionally, its offerings extend to wealth and asset management, the sale of funds, and futures investment consulting.

name: Bank of Xi'an Co.,Ltd.
summary: Bank of Xi'an Co.,Ltd., alongside its affiliated entities, delivers a comprehensive range of financial services across China, spanning corporate, retail, and capital market operations. Its business is structured into three main divisions. The Corporate Finance segment caters to businesses, government bodies, and financial institutions by offering services such as loans and credit, trade finance, deposit accounts, agency services, wealth management, financial advisory, and transaction-related support like remittances and guarantees. For individual customers, the Personal Financial Business segment provides personal loans, savings accounts, wealth management solutions, money transfer facilities, and bank card services. Lastly, the Treasury Business segment actively participates in the interbank market, conducting interbank lending and repurchase transactions, investing in and trading debt instruments, and managing trust and bespoke asset investments. The bank maintains a network of 179 branches. Founded in 1997 as Xi'an City Commercial Bank Co., Ltd., the institution rebranded to Bank of Xi'an Co.,Ltd. in January 2010 and is headquartered in Xi'an, China.

name: Snowsky Salt Industry Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Snowsky Salt Industry Group Co., Ltd. produces and sells salt and salt chemicals. The company offers daily, alkali, industrial, and cooking salt, as well as thenardite. It operates through 98 registered trademarks. The company was formerly known as Hunan Salt Industry Co., Ltd. The company was founded in 2011 and is based in Changsha, China. Snowsky Salt Industry Group Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of Hunan Province Light Industry & Salt Industry Group Co. Ltd.

name: Huadian New Energy Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Huadian New Energy Group Corporation Limited engages in the power generation business in China. It generates electricity through wind, solar, nuclear, storage, and hydrogen resources. The company was founded in 2009 and is based in Beijing, China.
industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

name: IKD Co., Ltd.
summary: Ikd Co., Ltd. researches, develops, produces, and sells auto high-precision aluminum die casting products for automobile industry in the United States, Europe, and Asia. The company offers wiper, filter, air condition, damper, steering, mirror, braking, engine lubrication, auto engine intake air control, auto transmission, engine electronic control, heuristic motor, and engine cooling systems, as well as oil pumps and cylinder blocks for auto parts suppliers. Ikd Co., Ltd. was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Ningbo, the People's Republic of China.

name: Guangxi Beitou Technology Company Limited
summary: Guangxi Beitou Technology Company Limited provides radio and television network services in China. The company offers television transmission services; digital TV value-added services, such as cable digital TV pay programs, high-definition digital TV and other services; and broadband two-way interactive services. It is also involved in construction and leasing of cable television network facilities, as well as provides information services such as 5G mobile communication services, broadband internet services, broadcasting and television network construction and operation, and dedicated data network services. In addition, the company engages in the telecommunications; private network business; smart broadcasting cloud; and big data businesses. The company was formerly known as Guangxi Radio and Television Information Network Corporation Limited and changed its name to Guangxi Beitou Technology Company Limited in January 2026. The company was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Nanning, China.

name: CNOOC Limited
summary: CNOOC Limited, an investment holding company, explores for, develops, produces, and sells crude oil and natural gas in offshore China, Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, Nigeria, Argentina, Indonesia, Uganda, Iraq, Brazil, Guyana, Russia, Australia, and internationally. The company operates through three segments: E&P, Trading Business, and Corporate. It produces offshore crude oil and natural gas primarily in Bohai, the Western South China Sea, the Eastern South China Sea, and the East China Sea in offshore China. The company also holds interests in various oil and gas assets in Asia, Africa, North America, South America, Oceania, and Europe. As of December 31, 2019, it had net proved reserves of approximately 5.18 billion barrels of oil equivalent. In addition, the company is involved in the issuance of bonds; sale and marketing of petroleum and natural gas; and surface exploration and sale of coalbed methane. The company was incorporated in 1999 and is based in Central, Hong Kong. CNOOC Limited is a subsidiary of China National Offshore Oil Corporation.

name: Chongqing Construction Engineering Group Corporation Limited
summary: Chongqing Construction Engineering Group Corporation Limited engages in construction activities in China. The company engages in the construction of buildings, roads, bridges, tunnels, and steel and electromechanical structures; and undertakes rail transit, design, and other businesses. It is also involved in manufacturing construction machinery; providing logistics and distribution, construction finance, and construction project investment management services; and franchising business. The company was formerly known as Chongqing Jiangong Group Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Chongqing Construction Engineering Group Corporation Limited in September 2010. The company was founded in 1998 and is based in Chongqing, China.

name: China Mobile Limited
summary: CHINA MOBILE LTD. is a telecommunications service provider in China. The company offers mobile voice and data services, broadband, and other related products and services. The company is based in Hong Kong.

name: Lihuayi Weiyuan Chemical Co., Ltd.
summary: Lihuayi Weiyuan Chemical Co., Ltd. is a Chinese enterprise specializing in the production and distribution of a diverse range of chemical products. The company manufactures and supplies various polymer materials and fine chemicals, notably including key compounds such as phenol, acetone, bisphenol A, polycarbonate, and isopropanol. Furthermore, Lihuayi Weiyuan provides industrial gases like liquid oxygen, argon, and nitrogen. Established in 2010, the firm operates from its headquarters located in Dongying, China.

name: China Suntien Green Energy Corporation Limited
summary: China Suntien Green Energy Corporation Limited, together with its subsidiaries, develops and utilizes clean energy in Mainland China. The company operates through three segments: Natural Gas, Wind/Solar Power, and Other. The Natural Gas segment sells natural gas and gas appliances, as well as provides construction and connection services for natural gas pipelines. The Wind/Solar Power segment engages in the development, management, and operation of wind farm and solar power plants; and generates and sells electric power for power grid companies. The Other segment engages in the property leasing business. As of December 31, 2020, the company owned 6 long-distance natural gas transmission pipelines, 18 high-pressure branch pipelines, 30 urban gas projects, 22 distribution stations, 18 gate stations, 7 compressed natural gas (CNG) primary filling stations, 7 CNG secondary filling stations, and 3 liquefied natural gas filling station. It also had wind power consolidated installed capacity of 5,471.95 megawatts (MW), as well as attributable installed capacity of 4,965.90 MW. It also engages in the provision of project investment, investment management, and technical development services; and investment and sale of solar energy appliances. The company was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in Shijiazhuang, the People's Republic of China.

name: Orient Securities Company Limited
summary: Orient Securities Company Limited operates as a securities company in China. It operates through Securities Sales and Trading, Investment Management, Brokerage and Securities Financing, and Investment Banking segments. The company engages in securities and futures brokerage, margin financing and securities lending, securities investment advisory, securities proprietary trading, asset management, agency sale of financial products, securities underwriting and sponsorship, and other business activities. It also provides cross-border financial, fund management, fixed income, margin trading and short selling, stock pledging, over-the-counter-market, agency sale, stock options, equity innovation, and asset securitization services, as well as research, PB, and foreign institutional investor services; and technology development. In addition, the company offers futures investment advisory, provision of corporate finance advisory services, equity and securities investment, investment management, bond and industrial investment, management consultancy, project investment, equity trading, and credit operation services. Orient Securities Company Limited was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Shanghai, China.

name: Jiangsu Broadcasting Cable Information Network Corporation Limited
summary: Headquartered in Nanjing, China, Jiangsu Broadcasting Cable Information Network Corporation Limited manages and operates extensive radio and television infrastructures across the country. The company's activities include transmitting radio and television signals, developing and overseeing enhanced digital television services, and providing high-speed data broadband access. It previously operated as a subsidiary of Jiangsu Guojin Group Information Network Investment Co., Ltd.

name: Bohai Automotive Systems CO., LTD.
summary: Bohai Automotive Systems Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells pistons in China and internationally. Its pistons are used in passenger and commercial, engineering, marine, agriculture, general motor, and other vehicles. The company was formerly known as Shandong Binzhou Bohai Piston Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Bohai Automotive Systems Co., Ltd. in October 2017. Bohai Automotive Systems Co., Ltd. is based in Binzhou, China.

name: Zhuzhou Smelter Group Co.,Ltd.
summary: Zhuzhou Smelter Group Co.,Ltd. produces and sells lead, zinc, and alloy products in China. The company offers lead, zinc, and silver ingots under the Torch brand. It is also involved in the recovery of copper, gold, silver, bismuth, cadmium, indium, tellurium, and other rare metals and sulfuric acid. The company is based in Zhuzhou, China.

name: SDIC Zhonglu Fruit Juice Co.,Ltd.
summary: SDIC Zhonglu Fruit Juice Co.,Ltd. produces and sells fruit and vegetable juices in China. The company offers apple, sweet potato, pear, cucumber, yawberry, fructose, and spices juice products. It also exports its products. The company was founded in 1991 and is based in Beijing, China.

name: Yueyang Forest & Paper Co., Ltd.
summary: Yueyang Forest & Paper Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells cultural, industrial, and packaging paper products in the People's Republic of China, Asia, and East Africa. Its products include offset printing papers, digital printing papers, copy papers, refined lightweight coated papers, lightweight coated papers, wood pulp and high white offset papers, light offset papers, industrial base papers, refined kraft papers, stretch papers bag papers, pigment finishing offset papers, high-grade color printing newspapers, color printing super-calendered papers, high-white industrial coated papers, electrostatic copy papers, tape base papers, carbon-free base papers, forest- papers, and carbon-free copy base papers. The company also offers garden engineering construction, landscape planning and design, green conservation, and ecological management services for municipal projects, urban parks, urban landscape projects, and other municipal and real estate projects. It serves publishers, magazines, large printing plants, paper products processing companies, paper products dealers, etc. The company also exports its products. Yueyang Forest & Paper Co., Ltd. was founded in 1958 and is headquartered in Yueyang, the People's Republic of China.

name: Fortune Ng Fung Food (Hebei) Co.,Ltd
summary: Fortune Ng Fung Food (Hebei) Co.,Ltd engages in beef cattle breeding and dairy farming businesses in China. The company is also involved in beef cattle slaughter and processing, milk production, food chain, and feed and organic fertilizer production businesses. Its principal products include live cattle, beef, lamb, meat and dairy products, dairy cows, fast food, and hot pot chain. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Sanhe, China.

name: Shandong Bohui Paper Industry Co., Ltd.
summary: Shandong Bohui Paper Industry Co., Ltd. researches, develops, produces, and sells paper products in China. It offers high-grade coated white cardboards for daily necessities packaging, cosmetic packaging, pharmaceutical packaging, handbags, composites, transfer printing, cigarette boxes, and box packaging, as well as offset, flexo, and gravure printing; and copper cards for use in book covers, magazine covers, greeting cards, packaging bags, desk calendars, calendars, etc. The company also provides kraftliner paper for high-grade electrical packaging, export product packaging, etc.; gypsum face paper for ordinary and special gypsum boards, and waterproof and fireproof gypsum boards; and double adhesive paper used in books, periodicals, textbooks, manuals, teaching materials, teaching aids, journals, etc. In addition, it offers lightweight paper for use in teaching materials, teaching aids, journals, magazines, society books, etc.; and writing paper, as well as paper pulp. Shandong Bohui Paper Industry Co., Ltd. was founded in 1944 and is based in Zibo, China.

name: Inner Mongolia First Machinery Group Co.,Ltd.
summary: Inner Mongolia First Machinery Group Co.,Ltd., a Chinese manufacturer established in 1984 and based in Baotou, produces a wide array of goods for both military and civilian applications. Its defense division is responsible for various military vehicles, including tanks and wheeled chariots, along with specialized equipment such as self-propelled lifting and defensive units, road maintenance vehicles, and comprehensive firefighting apparatus like fire trucks, rescue tanks, and other fire suppression gear, as well as antenna backframes. For the commercial market, the company offers diverse products, including railway rolling stock such as gondola cars, tankers, hopper cars, boxcars, and flat cars. They also manufacture energy-efficient motors and a variety of components for general vehicles, railway systems, and heavy trucks. Furthermore, their civilian offerings extend to heavy machinery, encompassing construction and petroleum equipment, bulldozers, snow clearing vehicles, and forestry vehicles. The company also engages in the international export of its products.

name: CNOOC Energy Technology & Services Limited
summary: CNOOC Energy Technology & Services Limited operates in the oil and gas industry in China. The company operates through four segments: Energy Technology Services; FPSO Production Technology Services; Energy Logistics Services; Safety, Environmental Protection and Energy Conservation. It offers energy technology services, such as engineering and technical, equipment operation and maintenance, pipeline technical, and data information services; FPSO production technology services; energy logistics services, including logistics, sales, and catering services; and oil spill emergency, safety and environmental protection technology, industrial water treatment, training services, coatings and industrial protection, catalyst, LNG cold energy utilization, and energy conservation and environmental monitoring services. The company is based in Beijing, China. CNOOC Energy Technology & Services Limited is a subsidiary of China National Offshore Oil Corporation.

name: Hunan Chendian International Development co.,ltd
summary: Hunan Chendian International Development co.,ltd engages in the power supply, urban water supply, and industrial gas production businesses primarily in China. It also provides small and medium-sized hydropower development, exchange, and information consulting services. The company was founded in 2000 and is based in Chenzhou, China.

name: Sinoma International Engineering Co.Ltd
summary: Sinoma International Engineering Co.Ltd engages in the engineering, equipment manufacture and supply, and other businesses in China and internationally. The company offers general contracting services, including engineering design, technology and equipment research and development, equipment manufacture and supply, civil construction, equipment installation and plant commissioning, and operation and maintenance services for the cement industry, as well as engineering construction and consultancy services. It also provides a range of equipment for cement production, such as rotary kilns, tube mills, pre-heaters, grate coolers, crushers, ball mills, de-ducting machines, separators, elevators, stackers, reclaimers, etc.; and environmental and photovoltaic engineering services. Sinoma International Engineering Co.Ltd was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.

name: Anhui Hengyuan Coal-Electricity Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Anhui Hengyuan Coal-Electricity Group Co., Ltd. engages in mining, processing, washing, and sale of coal in China. It offers lean coal, 1/3 coking coal, gas fat coal, anthracite coal, and coking coal, which are used in electric power, metallurgy, petrochemical, building materials, coking, blast furnace injection, civil use, etc. The company is based in Huaibei City, China.

name: Baosheng Science and Technology Innovation Co.,Ltd.
summary: Baosheng Science and Technology Innovation Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, produces and sells wire and cable products in China. It offers power, electrical equipment, and communication cables; and cable system. The company also provides control and instrumentation cables, high-frequency data and network cables, signal cables, magnet wires overhead lines, building wires, precision conductors, and polymers. Its products are used in various high-end equipment fields, including aerospace, nuclear power, marine engineering, shipbuilding, military, superconducting, intelligent equipment, high-speed rail locomotives, etc. In addition, the company offers EPC project general contracting services for electrical engineering design and installation, intelligent equipment, and photovoltaic power station construction. It has operations in Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan. The company also exports its products to approximately 40 countries and regions, including Southeast Asia, the Middle East, South America, Europe, Australia, etc. Baosheng Science and Technology Innovation Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1985 and is based in Yangzhou, China.

name: Hunan New Wellful Co.,Ltd.
summary: Hunan New Wellful Co.,Ltd. primarily engages in the breeding and supplying of pigs. It is also involved in feed, raw material trade, slaughter, cold chain logistics, pig trading, cold meat processing and sale, and breeding equipment businesses. The company offers its products under the U fresh and Chenfeng brand names in China, Hong Kong, and Macau. Hunan New Wellful Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Changsha, China.

name: Jianmin Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Jianmin Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells Chinese medicines in China. It offers pediatric drugs under the Jianmin, Longmu, and Yekaitai brands. The company is based in Wuhan, China.

name: China Film Co.,Ltd.
summary: China Film Co.,Ltd. operates as a significant entity within the global entertainment industry, specializing in the entire lifecycle of cinematic and television productions, from initial creation and worldwide distribution to strategic marketing and ongoing support services. Beyond its core content activities, the company also engages in the manufacturing, sale, and rental of specialized equipment and vehicles for film and television. It offers a comprehensive array of ancillary services, including set design, post-production for film and TV projects, technical consulting, development of new media formats, film processing, talent representation, advertising solutions, and international trade operations. Furthermore, China Film Co.,Ltd. holds investments in, operates, and manages motion picture theaters, and is involved in the retail of lottery tickets. Established in Beijing, China, in 2010, the company functions as a subsidiary of the prominent China Film Group Corporation.

name: Sichuan Guangan AAAPublic Co.,Ltd
summary: Sichuan Guangan AAAPublic Co.,Ltd operates in the electricity, gas, and water businesses in China. The company generates and supplies hydroelectric power; and supplies natural gas, electricity, and drinking water. The company operates 12 waterworks and 1 sewage treatment plant; and 13 hydropower stations with an installed capacity of 491,200 kilowatts, as well as 11 110kV and 23 35kV substations, and 35kV switch stations. It also operates 8 gas storage and distribution stations, including 5 LNG storage and distribution stations; 13 gas distribution stations; 12 pressure regulating stations; 4 CNG filling stations; and 1 desulfurization station. The company was founded in 2002 and is based in Guang'an, China.

name: BGRIMM Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: BGRIMM Technology Co., Ltd. researches, develops, produces, and sells mining equipment in the People's Republic of China and internationally. The company also develops, produces, and sells magnetic materials and devices. It offers permanent ferrite magnetic powders, rare earth permanent magnets, injection pellets, magnetic devices, and soft magnetic and absorbing materials for the use in automobiles, computers, home appliances, electric toys, electric tools, electro-acoustic devices, etc. The company was formerly known as BGRIMM Magnetic Materials & Technology Co., Ltd. and changed its name to BGRIMM Technology Co., Ltd. in June 2016. BGRIMM Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2000 and is based in Beijing, the People's Republic of China.

name: Jiangsu Soho High Hope Group Corporation Class A
summary: Jiangsu High Hope International Group Corporation is a diversified conglomerate operating across various sectors, both domestically in China and on an international scale. Its comprehensive business activities span trade, real estate development, strategic investment, logistics solutions, manufacturing, and general services. The company operates an integrated cold-chain logistics network, which seamlessly combines warehousing, transportation, processing, display, and commercial trading functions. It also manages a significant healthcare supply chain. Furthermore, the group specializes in the import and export of a wide array of goods, such as textiles and apparel, pulp and paper products, wood panels, as well as marine vessels and electromechanical equipment. Beyond its core trade and logistics, Jiangsu High Hope actively participates in industrial investments, supply chain financing, and financial asset management. Its real estate division is responsible for developing diverse property ventures, including residential villas, condominiums, and various commercial projects. The company markets its diverse portfolio of products and services through a range of recognized brands, including High Hope, SKYRUN, Forecast Spring, Gold Plum, JSTEX, Ashare, JSLTOYS, Friendly, Swallow Brand, Tiger, and Giraffe. Established in 1996, Jiangsu High Hope International Group Corporation is headquartered in Nanjing, China, and operates as a subsidiary of Jiangsu Suhui Asset Management Co. Ltd.

name: Ningbo Energy Group Co.,Ltd.
summary: Ningbo Energy Group Co.,Ltd., together with its various subsidiary companies, is a prominent player in China's cogeneration industry. Its operations include a diverse range of power generation facilities, such as coal-fired plants, hybrid coal-and-gas-fired thermal power stations, and renewable energy installations. Beyond power production, the company delivers consultation services and production for electricity, heat, and ash, and is a key provider of heat supply. It is also actively involved in the construction and management of electric vehicle charging points and other critical urban energy infrastructure. Additionally, the group's business interests span new energy initiatives, investment management, equity ventures, trading of bulk commodities and energy products, financial leasing, and waterway logistics. Established in 1994 and based in Ningbo, China, the company operated as NINGBO THERMAL POWER CO.,LTD. until its official name change in December 2020.

name: Whirlpool China Co., Ltd.
summary: As of April 29, 2021, operates as a subsidiary of Guangdong Galanz Household Appliances Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

name: Shaanxi Construction Machinery Co.,Ltd
summary: Established in 1954 with its headquarters in Xi'an, China, Shaanxi Construction Machinery Co., Ltd. operates both domestically and internationally. The company focuses on the research, development, and production of a diverse range of machinery, as well as providing leasing services for its equipment. Its product offerings encompass road construction equipment, such as pavers, milling planers, and steady mixers, alongside pile-driving machinery, various construction machinery including tower cranes, and structural steel elements for construction. Furthermore, the company extends its operations to include the rental, installation, dismantling, and ongoing maintenance of engineering machinery and equipment. It also delivers engineering construction solutions, remanufacturing services, sales of spare parts, technical consultation, and the processing and distribution of road surface materials.

name: Huaibei Mining Holdings Co.,Ltd.
summary: Huaibei Mining Co., Ltd. primarily engages in coal mining, washing, processing, sales, and storage business. It also offers coal chemical products, including coking coal; and sells chemical raw materials. The company is based in Huaibei, China.

name: Zhewen Interactive Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhewen Interactive Group Co., Ltd. engages in the infrastructure construction, financial service, digital marketing, real estate development, and semiconductor businesses in China. The company invests in, constructs, manages, and operates various infrastructure projects. It offers general contracting services for municipal utilities and highway projects; water conservancy and hydroplant projects; railway engineering projects; bridge, road base, and pavement engineering projects; landscaping projects; transportation safety facilities; and power and electromechanical engineering projects. The company also provides financial support services, such as microcredit, finance lease, industrial fund, commercial banking, trade finance, etc. for companies; and operates nine digital marketing brands that offer brand management, creative planning, online marketing, offline implementation, advertising agency, online promotion, and other services. In addition, it develops various real estate projects in Dongying, Qingdao, Yantai, and Binzhou; and imports and exports various kinds of bulk stocks. Further, the company researches, develops, produces, and sells power semiconductor devices, chips, and modules, including IGBT, FRD, and MOSFET that are used in induction cookers, small power frequency converters, inverter welding machines, brushless motor controls, UPS, and other products. Additionally, it produces acrylamide, a biochemical using the microbiological method. The company was formerly known as Keda Group Co., Ltd. Zhewen Interactive Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Dongying, China.

name: Zhejiang Hangmin Co.,Ltd
summary: Zhejiang Hangmin Co., Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, produces and sells textiles in China. The company also engages in the printing and dyeing of related raw materials; thermoelectric production; shipping; and weaving, logistics, and sewage treatment activities. In addition, it offers non-woven fabrics, fiber blended fabrics, facsimile fabrics, printed fabrics, etc. The company exports its products to Southeast Asia, the Middle East, North America, the European Union, Hong Kong, Macao, and internationally. Zhejiang Hangmin Co., Ltd was founded in 1998 and is based in Hangzhou, China.

name: Chifeng Jilong Gold Mining Co.,Ltd.
summary: The company's main business is gold, non-ferrous metal mining and selection and comprehensive resource recycling business, which is mainly carried out through its subsidiaries. Subsidiaries Geelong Mining, Huatai Mining, and Wulong Gold are engaged in gold mining and dressing business; subsidiary Hanfeng Mining is engaged in zinc, lead, copper, and molybdenum mining and dressing business; Vientiane Mining in Laos is currently mainly engaged in copper mining and smelting, and has The production of the gold mine will be restarted in May 2020; Xiongfeng Environmental Protection and Guangyuan Technology are both in the comprehensive resource recycling industry, Xiongfeng Environmental Protection is engaged in the comprehensive recycling and utilization of non-ferrous metal resources, and Guangyuan Technology is engaged in the processing of waste electrical and electronic products. The company has established a development strategy of "focusing on mining and focusing on gold mining business" to stabilize the main gold mining business and intends to divest non-mining business.

name: Ningxia Baofeng Energy Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Ningxia Baofeng Energy Group Co., Ltd. produces and sells coal chemicals which includes tar, thiamine, and benzol. The company also mines and produces coal products and other chemical products, which include methanol and olefin. It offers real estate sales. Ningxia Baofeng Energy Group Co., Ltd. was formerly known as Ningxia Baofeng Energy Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Ningxia Baofeng Energy Group Co., Ltd. in January 2014. The company was founded in 2005 and is based in Yinchuan, China.

name: Anhui Sun Create Electronics Co., Ltd
summary: Anhui Sun Create Electronics Co., Ltd engages in the research and development, design, manufacture, and marketing of radar and security systems in China and internationally. The company offers meteorological radar systems, such as weather surveillance and security systems; and air traffic management systems comprising doppler weather radars, wind profilers, ATC radars, etc. It also provides urban security systems, including VIP protection, low altitude surveillance, ground surveillance, communication, and decision-making and command systems; and photovoltaic products, as well as miniature perimeter monitoring radar system. The company was founded in 2000 and is based in Hefei, China.

name: Guizhou Wire Rope Incorporated Company
summary: Guizhou Wire Rope Incorporated Company produces, processes, and sells steel wire ropes and strands, and related materials and equipment primarily in China. The company offers single strand, four strand, multi-layer strand, shaped strand, compacted, point and line contact, parallel twisted, oil, diameter, sealed, balanced, fishing, elevator, aviation, and handling wire ropes, as well as steel wire ropes for conveyor belts. It also provides steel wires; PC Strands, including galvanized, pre-stressed concrete, and un-bonded pre-stressed steel strands; and wire rope sling - insert buckles, joint less splicing rigging, aluminum alloy pressed joints, two-legged and Limb rigging, hot and cold castings. The company offers its products under the Dragon brand name. It also exports its products to the United States, Britain, Canada, Denmark, the Netherlands, Singapore, and other countries. The company was founded in 2000 and is based in Zunyi, China.

name: Mayinglong Pharmaceutical Group Co., LTD.
summary: Mayinglong Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture, wholesale, and retail of pharmaceutical products primarily in China. It offers hemorrhoid, gynecological, cough, skin, cosmeceutical, and other products, as well as drugstore and merchants varieties. The company provides its products in various dosage forms comprising ointments, suppositories, tablets, lotions and granules, and creams. It also operates hospitals. Mayinglong Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 1582 and is based in Wuhan, China.

name: China Southern Power Grid Energy Storage Co., Ltd.
summary: Yunnan Wenshan Electric Power Co.,Ltd specializes in the generation and distribution of hydroelectric power. With an approximate capacity of 110,000 kilowatts, it provides electricity supply services throughout Wenshan Prefecture, including the regions of Neiwenshan, Yanshan, Qiubei, Funing, and Xichou. The company also extends its expertise to power grid planning and construction. Established in 1997, its operations are based in Wenshan, China.

name: Guizhou Broadcasting & TV Information Network Co., Ltd.
summary: Guizhou BC&TV Information Network CO.,LTD operates and constructs radio and television network in China. The company is involved in cable TV network construction; and broadband network, smart radio, radio and television 5G, and cultural tourism and technology business businesses. It also provides cable TV program live audio-visual, program content landing transmission, network installation and daily management and maintenance, radio and television audio-visual, and program content transmission services. The company was founded in 2008 and is based in Guiyang, China.

name: Kailuan Energy Chemical Co.,Ltd.
summary: Kailuan Energy Chemical Co.,Ltd. engages in coal, coal chemical, and other businesses. It engages in coal mining, raw coal washing, and processing; and coking and coal chemical product production and sales activities. The company was formerly known as Kailuan Coal Co., Ltd. Kailuan Energy Chemical Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2001 and is based in Tangshan, China.

name: Jointown Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Jointown Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd. engages in the wholesale, logistics, and pharmaceutical e-commerce activities specializing in Chinese herbal medicines, Chinese patent medicines, chemical raw materials, chemical preparations, antibiotics, biochemicals, biological products, and second class psychoactive drugs. It serves drug manufacturers, drug distributors, retailers, medical institutions, and government procurement groups. Jointown Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 1999 and is based in Beijing, China.

name: China Merchants Securities Co., Ltd.
summary: Headquartered in Shenzhen, People's Republic of China, China Merchants Securities Co., Ltd. is a prominent financial services firm established in 1991. It delivers a comprehensive suite of investment and trading solutions to a diverse clientele, encompassing corporate entities, institutional investors, and individual clients across China. The company's operations are structured across four core divisions: Wealth Management and Institutional Business, Investment Banking, Investment Management, and Investment and Trading. Under its Wealth Management and Institutional Business arm, the firm offers strategic investment advice, personalized portfolio creation, product distribution, and asset allocation strategies. It also facilitates capital-based intermediary services, such as margin financing, securities lending, and stock repurchase agreements. Furthermore, this segment provides specialized services for institutional players like funds and insurance companies, including investment research, sales and trading support, and prime brokerage. The Investment Banking division specializes in a broad spectrum of services, from facilitating domestic and international equity and debt financing, to underwriting equity and bond issuances. It also handles structured financing arrangements, assists with Over-the-Counter (OTC) listings, advises on mergers and acquisitions (M&A), and provides general financial advisory expertise. Within Investment Management, the company provides diverse asset management solutions, including collective investment schemes, separately managed accounts, specialized asset management mandates, and comprehensive equity investment fund management. Finally, the Investment and Trading segment is actively involved in proprietary trading across various asset classes, such as equities, fixed-income instruments, commodities, foreign exchange, and alternative investments, including derivatives. This segment further provides Over-the-Counter (OTC) financial products, acts as a market maker, and offers insurance agency services.

name: TangShan Port Group Co.,Ltd
summary: TangShan Port Group Co.,Ltd invests, constructs, and operates Jingtang port in China. It provides loading, unloading, and stockpiling of bulk cargo, such as ore, coking coal, coal, steel, machinery and equipment, and fine steel products; port loading, unloading, and warehousing services for industrialized chemicals and oil products, sea-land transit transportation, and warehousing companies; and land anchoring, ship escorting, ship detachment, ship emergency rescue, sea pick-up personnel, and other services, as well as assists in and out of the ship to leave the dock. The company is also involved in the equipment maintenance, mechanical processing and manufacturing, ship repair, ship pollutant reception, and technical consulting activities; provision of services for ships, including ship food, materials, fresh water, ship fuel, marine lubricants, marine materials recycling, taxi services, etc.; import and export of bulk products; and port construction and container sale activities. In addition, it offers railway freight transportation services; trade liner services; foreign trade route development and other services; and operates trade ship agency, trade cargo agency, and housing information agency. Further, the company engages in residential and office building property management, sanitary cleaning, house leasing, boiler air conditioning management, canteen, and apartment management activities; and coal business. The company was formerly known as Jingtang Port Co., Ltd. and changed its name to TangShan Port Group Co.,Ltd in March 2008. TangShan Port Group Co.,Ltd was founded in 2002 and is based in Tangshan, China.

name: Jinneng Holding Shanxi Coal Industry Co.,ltd.
summary: Jinneng Holding Shanxi Coal Industry Co.,ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the mining, washing, processing, production, and sale of coal products in China. The company also exports its products. It serves various industries, including electric power, metallurgical, etc. The company was founded in 2001 and is based in Datong, China.

name: Gem-Year Industrial Co.,Ltd.
