The company operates its shopping malls under the Red Star Macalline brand name. As of December 31, 2020, it operated 92 Portfolio shopping malls and 273 managed shopping malls; 11 home furnishing shopping malls through strategic cooperation; and 476 home improvement material stores/industry streets. The company also engages in the leasing of floor areas to the tenants; retail sale of home furnishing merchandise, as well as provision of related decorating services; and sale of pre-paid cards. In addition, it offers Internet home decoration, Internet retail, and logistics and delivery services; joint marketing; and shopping mall design, construction, consultation, and home design and decoration services, as well as construction site coordination and supervision services. Further, the company provides site leasing management, warehouse logistics, asset and investment management, exhibition, financing, equipment leasing, and enterprise management services. The company was formerly known as Shanghai Red Star Macalline Home Living and Decorating Company Limited and changed its name to Red Star Macalline Group Corporation Ltd. in 2011. The company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Shanghai, the People's Republic of China. Red Star Macalline Group Corporation Ltd. is a subsidiary of Red Star Macalline Holding Group Company Limited.

name: Bank of Chengdu Co., Ltd.
summary: Bank of Chengdu Co., Ltd. operates as a commercial banking entity, delivering a diverse range of financial services and products across China. Its extensive offerings encompass deposit accounts and lending options tailored for both individual and corporate clients. Additionally, the bank provides personal finance advisory, trade finance solutions for supply chains, credit card issuance, surety services, foreign currency exchange, and various insurance products. The institution, which was originally known as Chengdu City Commercial Bank Co., Ltd., officially rebranded to Bank of Chengdu Co., Ltd. in August 2008. Established in 1996, the company maintains its headquarters in Chengdu, China.

name: PetroChina Co., Ltd.
summary: PetroChina Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in a range of petroleum related products, services, and activities in Mainland China and internationally. It operates through Exploration and Production, Refining and Chemicals, Marketing, and Natural Gas and Pipeline segments. The Exploration and Production segment engages in the exploration, development, production, and marketing of crude oil and natural gas. The Refining and Chemicals segment refines crude oil and petroleum products; and produces and markets primary petrochemical products, derivative petrochemical products, and other chemical products. The Marketing segment is involved in marketing of refined products and trading business. The Natural Gas and Pipeline segment engages in the transmission of natural gas, crude oil, and refined products; and sale of natural gas. As of December 31, 2020, the company had a total length of 31,151 km, including 22,555 km of natural gas pipelines, 7,190 km of crude oil pipelines, and 1,406 km of refined product pipelines. The company is also involved in the exploration, development, and production of oil sands and coalbed methane; trading of crude oil and petrochemical products; storage, chemical engineering, storage facilities, service station, and transportation facilities and related businesses; and production and sales of basic and derivative chemical, and other chemical products. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Beijing, the People's Republic of China. PetroChina Company Limited is a subsidiary of China National Petroleum Corporation.

name: China Science Publishing & Media Ltd.
summary: China Science Publishing & Media Ltd. engages in publishing of books and periodicals in China. It offers academic monographs, teaching materials, supplementary teaching materials, science books, and other books, as well as academic periodicals and magazine. The company also imports and exports books, periodicals, databases and other publications; sells digital products; and provides platform services and other knowledge service. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Beijing, China. China Science Publishing & Media Ltd. is a subsidiary of China Science Publishing & Media Group Ltd.

name: Jiangsu Zijin Rural Commercial Bank Co.,Ltd
summary: Jiangsu Zijin Rural Commercial Bank Co.,Ltd provides various banking products and services to personal and business customers. It offers deposits; loans; foreign currency deposits, international settlement, trade finance, and capital services; and financial industry and investment banking services. The company also offers debit and credit cards; and mobile and Internet banking services, as well as ATMs. It operates 1 business department, 3 branches, 7 first-level branches, 1 technology sub-branch, 119 second-level sub-branches, and 2 county sub-branches. Jiangsu Zijin Rural Commercial Bank Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Nanjing, China.

name: Flat Glass Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Flat Glass Group Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the production and sale of glass products in the People's Republic of China, rest of Asia, Europe, North America, and internationally. The company offers photovoltaic glass, float glass, architectural glass, household glass, and other types of related products. It is also involved in the extraction of a quartzite mine; investment, construction, operation, and maintenance of energy power plants; development of natural gas utilization technology; sale and installation of natural gas pipelines; and exporting of glass products. The company serves PV module manufacturers, glass processing manufacturers, glass wholesalers, furniture manufacturers and processing companies, furniture retailers, architectural contractors, architectural glass processing companies, and construction companies. Flat Glass Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Jiaxing, the People's Republic of China.

name: COSCO SHIPPING Development Co., Ltd.
summary: COSCO SHIPPING Development Co., Ltd. and its subsidiaries develop, make and sell containers across the United States, Asia, Europe and other markets. Segments are Container Manufacturing, Shipping Leasing, Container Leasing and Investment Management. Products include dry cargo, refrigerated and special containers, container houses and after-sales services.

name: China Energy Engineering Corporation Limited
summary: China Energy Engineering Corporation Limited (CEEC) supplies solutions and expertise for the energy, power and infrastructure sectors, inside China and worldwide, through five main divisions. Its Planning, Design and Advisory Services division handles engineering and design of power plants such as thermal, hydro and nuclear.

name: Yangtze Optical Fibre And Cable Joint Stock Limited Company
summary: Yangtze Optical Fibre And Cable Joint Stock Limited Company manufactures and sells optical fiber and cable products in the People's Republic of China and internationally. The company operates in two segments, Optical Fibres and Optical Fibre Preforms, and Optical Fibre Cables segments. It offers communication optical fibers, cable products, specialty fibers, integrated cabling products, optical distribution frames, optical transceivers, coaxial cables, and cable manufacturing equipment. The company also provides copper wire and related products; integrated wiring systems; germanium tetrachlorides for optical fibers; technical development consulting services for computer hardware and software and ancillary equipment; and vapor and chemical raw materials. In addition, it offers solutions to telecom operators, cloud and data centers, smart campus, railway transportation, education, power grids, and consumer electronics, as well as the government. Further, the company imports, exports, and sells submarine cables, optical cables, and other power cables and their accessories, as well as trades in raw materials; and installs cables, accessories, and systems related to various submarine projects. Additionally, it provides general contracting engineering; equity investment and related management consulting; optical communication research and promotion; and medical materials research services, as well as integrated services in communication, computer, intelligent building, weak current system, and software development. Yangtze Optical Fibre And Cable Joint Stock Limited Company was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Wuhan, the People's Republic of China.

name: China Merchants Energy Shipping Co., Ltd.
summary: China Merchants Energy Shipping Co., Ltd. delivers a wide array of energy and general maritime transportation services. Its business is segmented into four main areas: container shipping, oil tanker operations, bulk carrier services, and roll-on/roll-off (Ro-Ro) shipping. The company utilizes a diverse fleet for these activities, including crude oil tankers, dry bulk vessels, Ro-Ro ships, and liquefied natural gas (LNG) carriers. Established in 2004, the firm is headquartered in Shanghai, China.

name: Zhejiang Chint Electrics Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Chint Electrics Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, develops and sells low-voltage electrical products in China. It offers modular DIN rail products, molded case circuit breaker, air circuit breakers, contactors, thermal relays, starters, pilot devices, inverters and soft-starters, relays, LV capacitors, switch disconnectors, fuse-switch disconnectors, changeover switches, travel switches, universal changeover switches, and connection terminals, as well as low voltage VT, AVR, CT, and PT products. The company also provides power transformers, gas insulated switchgears, HV air-insulated switchgears, prefabricated substations, MV and LV switchgears, MV apparatus, power protection devices, HV and LV busways, surge arresters, capacitors, insulators, CT and PT products, and cables; monitoring, gas, and electricity meters; wall switches and LED lights; PV modules, grid-tied PV inverters, system products, and monitoring systems; and electronic parts, horns, and distributed control systems. In addition, it offers solar and metering solutions. The company was founded in 1984 and is based in Yueqing, China.

name: Zheshang Securities Co., Ltd.
summary: Zheshang Securities Co., Ltd., a securities company, provides investment and financing services in China. The company offers securities brokerage services, including wealth management, derivatives brokerage, capital intermediary, and investment advisory services; and securities asset management services, such as quantitative investment, private equity investment bank, equity investment, refining current managed, and public fund services. It also provides investment banking services comprising sponsored underwriting, fixed income, OTC market, and financial advisory services; FICC business, direct investment, self-employment equity investment, and financial derivative investment services; and futures brokerage, overseas business, wealth management, and risk management services. In addition, the company engages in the research on macro, bond, strategy, industry, corporate, and financial derivatives with research on growth stocks, Zhejiang plate research, large consumption research, and quantitative strategies; and provision of professional research and consulting services. It operates approximately 100 branches in 22 provinces. The company was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.

name: Liaoning Port Company Limited
summary: Liaoning Port Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides port and logistics services in Mainland China. The company offers oil/liquefied chemicals terminal and related logistics, and trading services for loading and discharging, storage, and transshipment of oil products and liquefied chemicals; and port management services. It also provides container terminal and related logistics services for loading and discharging, storage, and transshipment of containers; and various container logistics services, as well as leases terminals and sells properties. In addition, the company offers bulk and general cargo terminal and related logistics services for loading and discharging general cargo and ore, as well as trades in steel. Further, it provides bulk grains terminal, and related logistics and trading services for loading and discharging of grains and trades in unprocessed grains; passenger, roll-on and roll-off terminal, and related logistics services; and port value-added and related ancillary services, including tallying, tugging, transportation, power supply, information technology, and construction. Additionally, the company offers automobile terminal, and related logistics and trading services for loading and discharging automobile. Liaoning Port Co., Ltd. was formerly known as Dalian Port (PDA) Company Limited and changed its name to Liaoning Port Co., Ltd. in January 2021. Liaoning Port Co., Ltd. was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Dalian, the People's Republic of China.

name: China Galaxy Securities Co., Ltd.
summary: China Galaxy Securities Co., Ltd. provides various financial services in the People's Republic of China. Its Securities Brokerage segment offers securities dealing and broking; margin financing to margin clients; and securities lending services. The Company's Futures Brokerage segment is involved in futures dealing and broking, futures information consulting, and training activities. Its Proprietary Trading and Other Securities Trading Services segment engages in the trading of equities, bonds, funds, derivatives, and other financial products. The Company's Investment Banking segment provides corporate financial services, including equity and debt securities underwriting, and financial advisory services to institutional clients. Its Asset Management segment offers portfolio management, investment advisory, and transaction execution services. The Company's Private Equity and Alternative Investment segment makes equity investments in private companies. Its Overseas Business segment provides securities brokerage, futures brokerage, securities research, investment banking, margin financing, money lending, asset management, and insurance brokerage services in Hong Kong. The company serves various individual and institutional clients comprising multinational corporations, medium and small-sized enterprises, high-net-worth clients, and retail clients. It operates through a network of 36 branch offices and 493 securities branches. The company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Beijing, the People's Republic of China. China Galaxy Securities Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of China Galaxy Financial Holdings Company Limited.

name: Ningbo Haitian Precision Machinery Co., Ltd.
summary: Ningbo Haitian Precision Machinery Co., Ltd. provides various machine tools in China. It offers vertical machining centers, gantry machining centers, horizontal machining centers, CNC lathes, turning centers, and other product lines. The company's products are used in automotive, aerospace, rail transportation, mold manufacturing, marine diesel, engineering machinery, machinery manufacturing, and other industries. It also provides after-sales and machine overhaul services. The company is based in Ningbo, China.

name: Jangho Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Jangho Group Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells curtain wall products in worldwide. The company provides various services, including interior decoration, ophthalmology treatment, third-party testing, and community hospitals. It also offers its products and services under the Jangho, Sundart, Gang Yuan, Zeming, Steve Leung Designers, and Vision brands. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.

name: China Tourism Group Duty Free Corporation Limited
summary: China Tourism Group Duty Free Corporation Limited provides travel and tourism services in China. The company offers special interest and adventures tours, business forums or formulization inspection tours, governmental relation visiting tours, incentive and conference tours, educational training or study programs, science and technology exchange programs, VIP or application for special treatment, society exploration tours, and inbound and outbound tours. It also operates duty free shops, which provides imported commodities and domestic masterpieces with approximately 20 categories and 1,000 varieties. The company was formerly known as China International Travel Service Corporation Limited and changed its name to China Tourism Group Duty Free Corporation Limited in June 2020. The company was founded in 1954 and is based in Beijing, China. China Tourism Group Duty Free Corporation Limited operates as a subsidiary of China Tourism Group Co., Ltd.

name: Asian Star Anchor Chain Co., Ltd. Jiangsu
summary: Asian Star Anchor Chain Co., Ltd. Jiangsu, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells anchor chains, offshore mooring chains, and related accessories in the People's Republic of China. The company provides marine anchor chains and offshore mooring chains, which include stud and studless links; accessories, including kenter shackles, joining shackles, anchor swivel shackles, end shackles, swivels, and other fittings; and other products, such as chafe chains, buoy chains, and anchors. The company also exports its products worldwide. Asian Star Anchor Chain Co., Ltd. was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in Jingjiang, the People's Republic of China.

name: China Coal Energy Company Limited
summary: China Coal Energy Co., Ltd. is a large state-owned coal mining enterprise in China, engaged in the production and sale of coal products. The company also operates in related sectors such as coal chemical industry, coal mining equipment manufacturing, and coal mine construction. Its headquarters are located in Beijing, China.

name: Zijin Mining Group Company Limited
summary: Zijin Mining Group Company Limited engages in prospecting, exploration, and mining mineral resources in Mainland China. It primarily produces gold bullion; gold, copper, zinc, tungsten, lead, and iron ore concentrates; and copper cathodes, zinc bullion, sulphuric acid, copperplate, silver, iron, etc., as well as molybdenum, cobalt, tin, coal, platinum, and palladium. The company was formerly known as Fujian Zijin Mining Industry Company Limited and changed its name to Zijin Mining Group Company Limited in June 2004. Zijin Mining Group Company Limited was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in Longyan, the People's Republic of China.

name: Southern Publishing and Media Co.,Ltd.
summary: Southern Publishing and Media Co., Ltd. functions as a significant publishing enterprise across China. Its operations are organized into six distinct departments: Publishing, Distribution, Material Trading, Printing, Newspaper, and an "Others" category. The company's primary focus involves the creation and distribution of various forms of media, such as books, newspapers, and electronic audio-visual content. Beyond this, it is actively engaged in producing printed educational materials, including textbooks and teaching aids for primary and secondary schools, as well as a broad spectrum of general interest books. Its media endeavors also encompass digital and mobile publishing, retail sales, diverse distribution channels, and the trade of printing supplies, extending into cross-media projects and other associated publishing and media services. A substantial part of its business involves the procurement and sale of paper and raw materials vital for the publishing industry. This includes a wide array of products such as cultural and packaging papers, printing machinery, various consumables (e.g., inks, printing packaging materials, CD PC materials), and specialized chemicals like UV varnish, hot melt glue, and paper-making fungicides. Founded in Guangzhou, China, in 2008, the company was formerly recognized by the name Guangdong Southern Publishing and Media Ltd.

name: Founder Securities Co., Ltd.
summary: Founder Securities Co., Ltd., a prominent financial institution operating within the People's Republic of China, offers a comprehensive suite of securities-related services. Its dedicated wealth management division provides client-focused financial solutions, encompassing the brokerage of equities and futures, margin financing and securities lending, and access to a wide array of financial products. The company also furnishes expert investment consulting, strategic asset allocation, and bespoke planning for wealth preservation and growth, alongside facilitating stock pledges and options trading. Furthermore, its robust investment banking arm supports corporate clients by underwriting both equity and debt offerings, advising on mergers and acquisitions (M&A), assisting with listings on the New Third Board, and delivering specialized financial advisory services. Founder Securities' asset management capabilities extend to individual, corporate, and institutional clientele. The firm additionally engages in proprietary investment and trading activities and provides tailored research and consulting expertise, primarily for its institutional clients. Established in 1988, the company is headquartered in Changsha, PRC.

name: Beijing Jingyuntong Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing Jingyuntong Technology Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells photovoltaic (PV) and semiconductor equipment in China. The company's products include mono-crystal growers, multi-crystalline directional solidification growers, and float-zone furnace. It also provides PV material products, such as mono and multi crystal ingots and wafers, as well as PV and wind power generation stations, and honeycomb medium and low temperature SCR flue gas denitrification catalyst. Beijing Jingyuntong Technology Co., Ltd was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.

name: China Zheshang Bank Co., Ltd
summary: China Zheshang Bank Co., Ltd. provides a range of banking products and services in Mainland China. It operates through Corporate Banking, Retail Banking, and Treasury Business segments. The Corporate Banking segment offers a range of financial products and services, including corporate loans and advances, trade finance, deposit products, and other types of corporate intermediary services. The Retail Banking segment provides personal loans and advances, deposit products, bank cards business, and other types of personal intermediary services. The Treasury Business segment offers money market and repurchase transactions, debt instruments investments, financial derivatives business for proprietary trading or on behalf of customers, and financial products and services, as well as issues debt securities. The company serves individuals, corporations, government agencies, and financial institutions. As of December 31, 2020, the company had 270 branch outlets in 20 provinces and Hong Kong in China. China Zheshang Bank Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.

name: China Coal Xinji Energy Co.,Ltd
summary: China Coal Xinji Energy Co., Ltd. specializes in the extraction, processing, and commercialization of both bituminous and anthracite coal. Beyond its core mining ventures, the company's activities extend to thermal power generation, hospitality services (including hotels and catering), property administration, and the supply of electricity and heating. Headquartered in Huainan, China, the entity was previously named SDIC Xinji Energy Co., Ltd., adopting its current moniker in January 2017.

name: COSCO SHIPPING Holdings Co Ltd.
summary: COSCO SHIPPING Holdings Co., Ltd., an investment holding company, engages in the container shipping, container terminals, and other businesses in the United States, Europe, the Asia Pacific, Mainland China, and internationally. The company operates through Container Shipping Business, Container Terminal Business, and Corporate and Other Operations segments. It offers container transportation, container stack, cargo storage, freight forwarding and transportation, logistics, vessel chartering, marine, document, vessel management and manning, shipping lines, vessel owning, and other international sea transportation services, as well as operates shipping and liner agencies. The company also provides technology services and solutions; and designs and manufactures computer software. As of December 31, 2020, it operated a fleet of 536 container vessels with a total shipping capacity of 3,073,684 TEUs. The company was formerly known as China COSCO Holdings Company Limited and changed its name to COSCO SHIPPING Holdings Co., Ltd. in November 2016. COSCO SHIPPING Holdings Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Shanghai, the People's Republic of China.

name: Zhejiang Publishing & Media Co., Ltd.
summary: Operating within China, Zhejiang Publishing & Media Co., Ltd. specializes in various aspects of the media industry, encompassing publishing, distribution, and printing. The company produces a wide array of content, including books, newspapers, electronic publications, audio-visual products, and other media formats. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Hangzhou, China, the entity underwent a name change in September 2018, transitioning from its former designation, Zhejiang Publishing Media Co., Ltd. It functions as a subsidiary of the Zhejiang Publishing Group.

name: Jiangsu Phoenix Publishing & Media Corporation Limited
summary: Jiangsu Phoenix Publishing & Media Corporation Limited is a leading Chinese enterprise primarily engaged in the publication and widespread distribution of diverse content. Its core publishing activities include a full spectrum of educational resources, such as textbooks and supplementary teaching aids for both primary and secondary schools, alongside a broad selection of general interest books, as well as electronic and audio-visual products. The company also manages the distribution of these published materials and educational equipment. Beyond its foundational publishing and distribution work, the company's operations extend into various other business areas. These include the management of cultural and commercial real estate, the operation of a network of bookstores, and the deployment of diverse sales channels, encompassing e-commerce, direct sales, and other distribution methods. Additionally, Jiangsu Phoenix provides data-related IT services to governmental and corporate clients, offers artist management and associated services for the film and television industries, and develops a range of teaching software for early childhood, basic, vocational education, and virtual training applications. Its media ventures further involve the production and distribution of television series and films, complemented by the research, development, and sale of educational apps and mobile games, including acting as an agency for products from other mobile game companies. The company's extensive publishing catalog covers a vast array of subjects and genres, including art, architecture, design, audio-visual products, biographies, business and economics, children's literature, educational materials, fiction, poetry, practical guides, self-help, humanities, social sciences, non-fiction, and scientific, technical, and medical (STM) fields. Founded in 1953, Jiangsu Phoenix Publishing & Media Corporation Limited is headquartered in Nanjing, China.

name: JiShi Media Co., Ltd.
summary: JiShi Media Co., Ltd. engages in the radio and television (TV) business in China. The company offers radio and television transmission services, such as live channels, digital broadcasting, consulting, and program guide services; and digital TV value-added services, including paid channels, HD live channels, and interactive on-demand services, as well as interactive application services, such as online trading, TV lottery, TV communication, and family entertainment services. It also provides broadband two-way interactive services. The company is headquartered in Changchun, China.

name: Yonghui Superstores Co., Ltd.
summary: Yonghui Superstores Co., Ltd. operates a chain of supermarkets in China. The company was founded in 2001 and is based in Fuzhou, China.

name: China Construction Bank Corporation
summary: China Construction Bank Corporation serves individual and corporate clients in China and internationally with banking and financial services. Its segments are Corporate Banking, Personal Banking, Treasury Business and others, and it offers a range of deposit products, including foreign currency deposits.

name: China Publishing & Media Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: China Publishing & Media Holdings Co., Ltd. is primarily engaged in producing and distributing a wide array of media content across China. Its portfolio encompasses traditional books, audio-visual materials, and various forms of electronic and online publications. Beyond content creation, the company's activities extend to both print and digital publishing workflows, offering printing and duplication services, and facilitating copyright transactions. Additionally, it provides diverse information-related services. This enterprise was founded in 2011 and operates from its headquarters in Beijing, China.

name: Jiangsu Provincial Agricultural Reclamation and Development Co.,Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu Provincial Agricultural Reclamation and Development Co.,Ltd., an agricultural company, researches, develops, produces, processes, manages, and sells commodity grain and seeds in China. It is also involved in cultivation and production of rice. In addition, the company produces and sells fertilizers, pesticides, enzymes, bio-fertilizer products, and other biological products, as well as offers agricultural resources services to rural areas. The company was founded in 1956 and is based in Nanjing, China. Jiangsu Provincial Agricultural Reclamation and Development Co.,Ltd. is a subsidiary of Jiangsu Nongken Group Co.,Ltd.

name: Hubei Donper Electromechanical Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Hubei Donper Electromechanical Group Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells compressors and related components. Their products are used in refrigerators, air conditioners, and other cooling systems. The company is located in Hubei, China.

name: Jinduicheng Molybdenum Co., Ltd.
summary: Jinduicheng Molybdenum Co., Ltd. produces and sells molybdenum products worldwide. It offers molybdenum furnace products, including roasted molybdenum concentrate and concentrate blocks, molybdenum iron and concentrate blocks, and ferro molybdenum; and molybdenum chemical products, such as sodium molybdate, ammonium molybdate, pure molybdenum disulfide and oxide, and ammonium octamolybdate and heptamolybdate, as well as molybdenum trioxide, organic molybdenum, and others. The company also provides molybdenum metal products comprising molybdenum powders, slabs, rods, wires, wafers, crucibles, electrodes, mandrels, stirrers, components, moly stands, screws, nozzles, material boats, cakes, rings, orifices, etc.; spraying molybdenum wires; rolling molybdenum rods and plates; and welded molybdenum round targets, as well as nuts. In addition, it offers sulfur concentrate, sulfuric acid, and ferric sulfate powder. Its products are used in the areas of steel milling, petrochemical, mechanical manufacture, aerospace, electronics, lighting, etc. The company is headquartered in Xi'an, China. Jinduicheng Molybdenum Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of Jinduicheng Molybdenum Group Co., Ltd.

name: Bank of Chongqing Co., Ltd.
summary: Bank of Chongqing Co., Ltd. provides various banking and related financial services for corporate and individual customers in the People's Republic of China. It operates through three segments: Corporate Banking, Retail Banking, and Treasury. The company offers various deposit products and loans; inter-bank lending and borrowing, bonds investment, re-purchasing, and foreign currency transactions; and telephone, mobile, and online and direct banking services, as well as settlement services, financial leasing, and other services. As of December 31, 2020, it operated 145 sub-units, including a business department, a small enterprise loan center, four primary branches, 172 self-service banking centers, and 280 intelligent teller machines covering 38 districts and counties of Chongqing, as well as three provinces in western China. The company was formerly known as Commercial Bank of Chongqing Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Bank of Chongqing Co., Ltd. in August 2007. Bank of Chongqing Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Chongqing, the People's Republic of China.

name: China Automotive Engineering Research Institute Co., Ltd.
summary: China Automotive Engineering Research Institute Co., Ltd. (CAERI) operates as a multifaceted technical service and manufacturing enterprise within China's automotive industry. The company is actively engaged in developing automotive and related product technologies. Its extensive service offerings encompass research and development, comprehensive testing and evaluation, product certification, providing specialized software tools, supplying testing equipment, and delivering expert technical consulting for vehicles. Beyond its service capabilities, CAERI is also a manufacturer of various products, including specialized vehicles for logistics and sanitation, motorcycles, and general equipment. It also produces crucial components such as gas vehicle systems, as well as transmission and braking systems and other key parts for rail vehicles. The company's diverse activities further extend to engineering and modification services for compressed natural gas (CNG) vehicles. Additionally, CAERI deals in instruments and meters, general machinery, electronic components, chemical products, and steel. It also fosters academic exchanges and provides property rental services. Established in 1965 and based in Chongqing, China, the company underwent a name change in 2010, transitioning from China Automotive Engineering Research Institute Corporation to its current designation.

name: Shandong Linglong Tyre Co., Ltd.
summary: Shandong Linglong Tyre Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells tires in the People's Republic of China. The company offers passenger car, SUV, winter, truck and bus, and specialty tires. It also exports its products to approximately 180 countries and regions, such as Europe, the Middle East, the United States, Africa, and the Asia-Pacific. The company was founded in 1975 and is based in Zhaoyuan, the People's Republic of China.

name: Shanghai Baosteel Packaging Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Baosteel Packaging Co., Ltd. engages in can-making, iron printing, and EOE-making businesses. It provides steel cans for Coca Cola; and UV metal color coating and printing line services for food and beverage industries. The company is based in Shanghai, China. Shanghai Baosteel Packaging Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of Baosteel Metal Co., Ltd.

name: Hainan Mining Co., Ltd.
summary: Operating within China, Hainan Mining Co., Ltd. specializes in the extraction, processing, reclamation, and sale of iron ore. The company primarily furnishes steel manufacturers with its key products, which include lump ore, fine ore, and iron ore concentrate. Formerly recognized as Hainan Mining United Co., Ltd., the firm officially adopted its present name, Hainan Mining Co., Ltd., in August 2009. Established in 2007, its corporate headquarters are located in Shilu, China.

name: Nanjing Tanker Corporation Class A
summary: Nanjing Tanker Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the tanker transportation business in China and internationally. The company operates vessels and offers small and medium-sized liquid cargo transportation services for crude and refined oil, chemical, and gas. It also provides crew resource management, labor dispatch, and leasing services. The company was formerly known as Nanjing Water Transportation Industrial Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Nanjing Tanker Corporation in January 2008. Nanjing Tanker Corporation was founded in 1993 and is based in Nanjing, China.

name: China National Nuclear Power Co., Ltd.
summary: China National Nuclear Power Co., Ltd. invests in, develops, constructs, operates, and manages nuclear power projects in the People's Republic of China. The company also provides nuclear power project related technical and consultancy services. It operates 14 nuclear power units with an installed capacity of 11,512 MWe. The company is headquartered in Beijing, the People's Republic of China. China National Nuclear Power Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of China National Nuclear Corporation.
industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

name: Bank of China Limited
summary: Bank of China Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides banking and related financial services. It operates through six segments: Corporate Banking, Personal Banking, Treasury Operations, Investment Banking, Insurance, and Other Operations. The Corporate Banking segment offers current accounts, deposits, overdrafts, loans, trade-related products and other credit facilities, foreign exchange, derivatives, and wealth management products to corporate customers, government authorities, and financial institutions. The Personal Banking segment provides savings deposits, personal loans, credit and debit cards, payments and settlements, wealth management products, and funds and insurance agency services to retail customers. The Treasury Operations segment is involved in the foreign exchange transactions, customer-based interest rate and foreign exchange derivative transactions, money market transactions, proprietary trading, and asset and liability management. The Investment Banking segment offers debt and equity underwriting, financial advisory, stock brokerage, investment research and asset management, and private equity investment services, as well as sells and trades in securities. The Insurance segment underwrites general and life insurance products; and provides insurance agency services. As of December 31, 2020, the company operated approximately 11,550 institutions, including 10,991 institutions in Chinese mainland; and 559 institutions in Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan, and other countries. It is also involved in the aircraft leasing business. The company was founded in 1912 and is headquartered in Beijing, China. Bank of China Limited is a subsidiary of Central Huijin Investment Limited.

name: China Shipbuilding Industry Company Limited
summary: China Shipbuilding Industry Company Limited engages in the shipbuilding and ship support, ship equipment, ship repair, marine engineering equipment, energy transportation equipment, and other businesses in China. It offers low-to-medium speed diesel products, propulsion and transmission devices, diesel engine components, deck and cabin machineries, and oil and sewage treatment equipment, as well as engages in marine casting and forging activities. The company is also involved in the research and development, manufacture, modification, and repair of oil tankers, container ships, bulk carriers, special vessels, and various other ships. In addition, it engages in marine engineering activities comprising drilling platforms, drilling vessels, FPSOs, offshore special vessels, various offshore modules, offshore facilities, offshore supporting equipment, and marine engineering equipment. Further, the company offers ship-borne weapons and equipment, which include diesel engine and components, ship-borne weapons launchers, and navigation devices for ships; and communication equipment, military reinforcement computers, and transmission devices for military ships. Additionally, it produces equipment in the energy transportation fields, such as wind power gear boxes, paddles, wind power yaw devices, nuclear power emergency generators, nuclear power plant water treatment systems, rail equipment, subway equipment, urban light rail equipment, railway wagons, engineering special vehicles, special trucks, and other transportation equipment. The company is based in Kunming, China.

name: Nanjing Securities Co., Ltd.
summary: Nanjing Securities Co., Ltd., established in 1990, operates out of its primary location in Nanjing, China. The firm delivers a wide array of financial services, encompassing investment advisory and brokerage, capital raising through underwriting and sponsorship, and proprietary trading activities. It also specializes in managing client assets, offering credit trading options, facilitating transactions in over-the-counter markets, and dealing with financial derivatives. Additionally, the company is involved in internet-based financial solutions and other ancillary financial services.

name: Datang International Power Generation Co., Ltd.
summary: Datang International Power Generation Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in power generation and power plant development activities in the People's Republic of China. The company operates through Power and heat generation, Coal, and Other segments. It generates electricity through various sources, such as coal-fired, thermal, hydro, wind, nuclear, biomass, and solar. As of December 31, 2019, the company managed an installed capacity of approximately 68,278.10 MW. It also engages in heat supply; the import of power related fuel; coal mining and trading; silicon and aluminum smelting; production and sale of alumina; cargo shipping; sale of coal ash and integrated application of solid waste; power plant construction and operation; repair and testing of power equipment; research and development activities; and provision of power related technical services. The company was formerly known as Beijing Datang Power Generation Co., Ltd and changed its name to Datang International Power Generation Co, Ltd. in April 2004. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Beijing, the People's Republic of China. Datang International Power Generation Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of China Datang Corporation Limited.
industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

name: BBMG Corporation
summary: BBMG Corporation provides cement and building materials in Asia, Europe, Africa, and internationally. The company's Cement and Ready-Mixed Concrete segment manufactures and sells cement and concrete. Its Modern Building Materials and Commerce and Logistics segment produces furniture and woods, decorative and fitting materials, and wall body and insulation materials; and offers commerce and logistics services. The company's Property Development segment develops and sells housing properties. Its Property Investment and Management segment invests in properties; and provides management and security services to residential and commercial properties. The company offers mortars and crushed stones, slag fine powders, coatings and construction hardware, glass made spectacle lenses, glass wool products, wood based panels, resins, building materials, limestone and cement clinkers, refractory materials and ceramics, aerated concrete products, machinery equipment and accessories, wind power equipment, doors and windows, and sanitary ceramics; wholesales coal, building and metal materials, and metal and metallic minerals; and imports and exports bulk commodities. It provides project and furniture decoration, construction contracting and project management, accommodation and conference, hotel management, finance leasing, property consultancy, property rental, technology development, goods transportation and storage, waste disposal, finance and financing advisory, exhibition, and knitting processing services; offers loading, offloading, and handling services; provides building material testing services; and operates sports projects, as well as publishes concrete world magazine, and provides advertising design and production services. The company was founded in 2005 and is incorporated in Beijing, China.

name: China International Capital Corporation Limited
summary: China International Capital Corporation Limited provides financial services in Mainland China and internationally. The company operates through six segments: Investment Banking; Equities; Fixed Income, Commodities, and Currencies (FICC); Asset Management; Private Equity, and Wealth Management. The Investment Banking segment provides investment banking services, including equity financing, debt, and structured financing and financial advisory services. The Equity segment offers investment research, sales, trading, and products and cross-border services, including institutional trading and capital services, such as primary brokerage, over-the-counter derivatives, capital introduction, and market-making transactions. The FICC segment provides fixed-income products, such as interest rate, credit, and structured products, as well as on overseas exchange and commodities. The Asset Management segment engages in the social security and annuity investment management, institutional entrusted investment management, overseas asset management, retail and mutual fund businesses, etc. The Private Equity segment provides corporate equity funds, fund of funds, dollar funds, real estate funds, infrastructure funds, etc. The Wealth Management segment offers wealth transactional, capital, and product configuration services. The company serves domestic and overseas investors, and corporations and institutional clients, as well as retail clients, families, and corporate clients. China International Capital Corporation Limited was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Beijing, the People's Republic of China.

name: Guangxi Fenglin Wood Industry Group Co.,Ltd
summary: Guangxi Fenglin Wood Industry Group Co.,Ltd manufactures and sells engineering boards in China and internationally. It offers medium density fiber boards and particle boards primarily for use in furniture, doors, flooring, and car, as well as construction and decoration, and electronic industries. The company was founded in 2000 and is based in Nanning, China.

name: Bank of Guiyang Co.,Ltd.
summary: Bank of Guiyang Co., Ltd. provides various financial and banking products and services in China. It offers current savings products; and zero deposit, interest, notice, demand, time, notification, agreement, and treasury cash deposit products. The company also provides various loan products, such as working capital, fixed asset, business, real estate project development, inventory guarantee, mortgage, forest property pledge, consumer, structure, entrusted, trade, and home loans; credit cards; payment and account management services; and online and mobile banking services. In addition, it engages in investment banking, fund, consulting, bond underwriting, asset securitization, letter of credit and guarantee, and insurance agency businesses. The company was formerly known as Guiyang Commercial Bank and changed its name to Bank of Guiyang Co., Ltd. in 2012. Bank of Guiyang Co., Ltd. was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Guiyang, China.

name: China CITIC Bank Corporation Limited
summary: China CITIC Bank Corporation Limited provides banking services in China and internationally. It is organized into Corporate Banking, Personal Banking and Treasury Management divisions, offering deposit accounts, corporate and personal loans and other financial facilities including securities services.

name: Northern United Publishing & Media (Group) Company Limited Class A
summary: Northern United Publishing & Media (Group) Company Limited engages in the publication, distribution, and printing of textbooks, supplementary books, general books, and other publications in China. It is involved in the publishing and distribution of teaching materials and electronic audio-visual products; printing of publications, packaging and decoration products, bills, and labels; supply of materials; and publishing integration product development and operation business. The company also publishes books, periodicals, electronic audio-visual products, new media, and other media, as well as integrates traditional and digital publishing, online reading, e-commerce sales, and other businesses. The company was founded in 2006 and is based in Shenyang, China. Northern United Publishing & Media (Group) Company Limited operates as a subsidiary of Liaoning Publishing Group.

name: People.cn CO., LTD
summary: People.cn CO., LTD operates as an information exchange platform in China and internationally. The company publishes news to Internet users covering politics, economy, society, and culture in the form of text, picture, animation, audio and video, BBS, blog, microblog, podcast, talk bar, mobile phone, RSS, and Webcast 15 languages, including Chinese, Mongolian, Tibetan, Uygur, Kazakh, Korean, Yi, Zhuang, English, Japanese, French, Spanish, Russian, Arabic, and Korean. It operates in 200 countries and regions. The company was founded in 1997 and is based in Beijing, the People's Republic of China.

name: Zhejiang Aokang Shoes Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Aokang Shoes Co., Ltd. manufactures, sells, and retails shoes, clothes, leather goods, bags, and other products in China. The company offers its products under the Aokang, Kanglong, Beautiful beauty, and Red Firebird brands. The company was founded in 1988 and is based in Yongjia, China.

name: Epoxy Base Electronic Material Corporation Limited
summary: Epoxy Base Electronic Material Corporation Limited produces and sells electronic grade epoxy resins worldwide. The company offers wind blade and liquid type epoxy resins, and specialized and modified type epoxy resins, as well as specialized resins for copper clad laminate, powder coating, and can coating. It also provides professional technical after-sale services. The company was formerly known as Guangzhou Epoxy Base Electronic Material Corp. and changed its name to Epoxy Base Electronic Material Corporation Limited in March 2008. Epoxy Base Electronic Material Corporation Limited was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Guangzhou, China.

name: Shanghai Lonyer Fuels Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Lonyer Fuels Co., Ltd. trades in oil products in China. The company has an oil storage base with a total capacity of approximately 70,000 cubic meters, as well as five refined oil transportation vessels and refueling vessels for oil trading, maritime transportation, and water refueling. The company also engages in the non-ferrous metals trading business; and provision of cloud data infrastructure services. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.

name: Zhejiang Dragon Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Dragon Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of fine chemical products in China. The company provides cosmetics raw materials, special engineering materials, and other functional chemicals. The company was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China. Zhejiang Dragon Technology Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Zhejiang Dinglong New Materials Co., Ltd.

name: China Wafer Level CSP Co., Ltd.
summary: China Wafer Level CSP Co., Ltd. provides wafer level miniaturization technologies and processes for the electronics industry. It offers image sensor, biometric identification, and ambient light sensor chips, as well as medical electronic devices. The company also provides infrastructure solutions, including design, test, and logistics; design chain management; design for manufacturing; design for cost; full design and verification of WL, leadframe, laminate, etc.; electrical, thermal, and mechanical characterization; and quick turn prototype services. In addition, it offers assembly services, such as turnkey solutions for TSV, wire bond, and flip chip; high-volume manufacturing; wafer finishing and 2/3D assembly; wafer to wafer and die to wafer bonding; micro-joining; integrated and SMT passives; and FA and reliability testing services, including package and board level, bump reliability, underfill/EMC adhesion, drop and bend tests, solder joint reliability prediction, materials lab, and failure analysis. The company serves consumer, computing, communication, and medical markets. China Wafer Level CSP Co., Ltd. was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Suzhou, China.

name: Shanghai Lianming Machinery Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Lianming Machinery Co., Ltd. engages in the development and sale of auto parts to the automotive industry in China. It offers auto body parts, and automotive stampings and welding assembly parts. The company also provides supply chain management of third-party logistics services. The company was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.

name: Danyang SYNGEN Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Danyang SYNGEN Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. operates across a diverse range of fields, including the cultivation of horticultural products (flower seedlings), the provision of landscaping solutions, ecological restoration, and the development of facilities for tourism, cultural activities, and sports. The company provides comprehensive services, from initial design to project implementation and related support, for various urban, tourism, and greening initiatives throughout China.

name: Sleemon Healthy Sleep Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Xilinmen Furniture Co.,Ltd designs, develops, produces, and sells furniture products in China. The company offers mattresses, cabinets, bed stools, tables, TV cabinets, sofas, and soft beds for bedroom; sofas, tables, corner a few, and TV cabinets for living room; dining tables and chairs, sideboards, and wine cabinets for restaurants; desks, book chairs, and bookcases for study; and children's mattress, beds, desks, chairs, and bookcases. It also provides pillows, bedding kits, home decoration products, and table lamps. The company offers its products under the Hiro Gate, Frenchman, Erna, love times, BBR, Brano, and other brands. Xilinmen Furniture Co.,Ltd was founded in 1993 and is based in Shaoxing, China.

name: Shanghai Beite Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Beite Technology Co., Ltd. provides metal products for steering and shock absorber piston rod customers primarily in China. Its products include rack blanks, semi-finished racks, finished racks, finished valve sleeves, semi-finished input shafts, semi-finished worm shafts, pinion blanks, semi-finished pinions, piston rod blanks, semi-finished piston rods, and finished piston rods. The company is based in Shanghai, China.

name: Zhejiang Wansheng Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Wansheng Co., Ltd. produces and sells organic phosphorus based flame retardants, special amines, and cardanol derived curing agents and diluents in China. It offers flame retardants for rigid foam, flexible foam, and engineering plastic; and specialty amines, amine catalysts, curing agents/diluents, special solvents, and other products. The company was formerly known as Zhejiang Wansheng Chemicals Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Zhejiang Wansheng Co., Ltd. in 2010. Zhejiang Wansheng Co., Ltd. was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Linhai, China.

name: Hefei Metalforming Intelligent Manufacturing Co., Ltd.
summary: Hefei Metalforming Intelligent Manufacturing Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research and development, production, sale, and service of hydraulic and mechanical presses, and industrial automation and other intelligent forming equipment. The company provides process analysis, equipment selection, project management, investment budget, equipment installation, commissioning, trial production, customer staff training, procedures improvement, mold and automation auxiliary facilities, and transformation and overhaul equipment services, as well as supplies spare parts. Its products are used in various fields, such as automobile, aircraft, spacecraft, rocket, nuclear power, high-speed railway, etc. The company markets its products in approximately 30 provinces, municipalities, and autonomous regions in China; and exports its products to Europe, Asia, America, Africa, and Australia, as well as to approximately 30 other countries and regions. Hefei Metalforming Intelligent Manufacturing Co., Ltd. was founded in 1951 and is based in Hefei, China.

name: Shanghai Chuangli Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Chuangli Group Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, designs, develops, manufactures, sells, and services coal mining machinery, coal mine automation control systems, and mine electrical equipment. It offers drum type shearers, boring machines, cantilever roadheaders, and related spare parts. The company is based in Shanghai, China.

name: YAPP Automotive Systems Co., Ltd.
summary: YAPP Automotive Systems Co., Ltd. researches, develops, manufactures, and markets automotive fuel systems to auto manufacturer in China and internationally. It offers plastic fuel systems and emission control systems. The company is headquartered in Yangzhou, China.

name: Ningbo Techmation Co., Ltd.
summary: Ningbo Techmation Co., Ltd. offers industrial automation solutions to the plastic machinery industry in China and internationally. It provides industrial automation products, including plastic machine control systems, hydraulic servo energy saving systems, extension modules, and other auxiliary equipment; industrial software products comprising Internet of Things platform, intelligent maintenance systems, plastic manufacturing network management system software, and Linux-based Internet of Things products; and robot products and new energy products. The company was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Ningbo, China.

name: Wuxi New Hongtai Electrical Technology Co.,Ltd
summary: Wuxi New Hongtai Electrical Technology Co.,Ltd engages in the research, development, production, and sale of components of circuit breakers, low-voltage circuit breakers, and knife-melt switches in China. It offers BMC/SMC molded insulation products for circuit breakers, motors and electric motors, low-voltage circuit breakers, and knife-fused switches; and molding articles and materials. The company was founded in 2008 and is based in Wuxi, China.

name: ARTS Group Co., Ltd
summary: ARTS Group Co., Ltd., headquartered in Suzhou, China, is actively engaged in the complete lifecycle of engineering and construction ventures throughout the country. Their expertise spans design, material acquisition, construction, and operational management for a diverse portfolio of projects. The company's service offerings are comprehensive, encompassing project oversight and management, detailed engineering blueprints, investment and financial facilitation, and general contracting duties. They cater to numerous sectors, including commercial offices, hospitality establishments, cultural and athletic venues, educational facilities, industrial complexes, historical restoration efforts, healthcare institutions, and logistics centers. Additionally, they provide specialized landscape services. Established in 1995, the firm rebranded to ARTS Group Co., Ltd. in August 2015, having previously operated as Suzhou Industrial Park Design & Research Institute Co., Ltd.

name: China Design Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Operating within China, China Design Group Co., Ltd. specializes in delivering comprehensive engineering survey and design solutions. The company's extensive service portfolio covers a wide array of areas, including conceptualization and investigative design, railway network planning and infrastructure development, environmental protection measures, and end-to-end engineering general contracting with thorough inspection services. Furthermore, their offerings extend to integrated development, strategic planning and expert engineering consultation, robust research and development initiatives, quality assurance through testing and monitoring, meticulous project management, specialized construction activities, and ongoing post-completion support. Established in 1966, the organization was originally known as Jiangsu Province Communications Planning and Design Institute Limited Company until it officially adopted its current designation, China Design Group Co., Ltd., in July 2016. Its primary operational base is located in Nanjing, People's Republic of China.

name: Dawning Information Industry Co., Ltd.
summary: Dawning Information Industry Co., Ltd. provides high-performance computing, server, storage, cloud computing, and big data products in China and internationally. It offers rack, storage, and blade servers, as well as high-density servers; workstation products; disk array and cloud storage products; server cabinets and cooling solutions; high-performance computers; and cloud computing products. The company was founded in 1996 and is based in Beijing, China. Dawning Information Industry Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of Landsea Green Group Co., Ltd.

name: Apple Flavor & Fragrance Group Co.,Ltd.
summary: Apple Flavor & Fragrance Group Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells flavors, fragrances, and food additives in China. The company offers food flavors, including dairy, ice cream, beverage, confectionery, savory, bakery, and snack related flavors; and fragrances for use in personal care, oral care, home care, and candle and air care products, as well as in perfumes. It also manufactures synthetic aroma chemicals; and natural extracts and fermentation natural products, as well as food ingredients. The company was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.

name: Shandong Huapeng Glass Co.,Ltd.
summary: Shandong Huapeng Glass Co.,Ltd. researches and develops, produces, and sells various glassware products and glass bottles primarily in China. It offers ware products, including lead-free crystal glass products and molding goblets; fawles; and bottle products, such as food, wine, liquor, brandy, champagne, beverage, and olive oil bottles under the Shidao brand name. The company also exports its products to South Korea, Japan, the United States, Canada, Russia, and other countries. Shandong Huapeng Glass Co.,Ltd. is headquartered in Rongcheng, China.

name: Shanghai Xintonglian Packaging Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Xintonglian Packaging Co., Ltd. engages in the production and sale of packaging products in China and internationally. The company offers paper, wood, and plastic and cushioning packaging products. It also provides iron box packaging products, hollow board packaging boxes, stickers, desiccants, shockproof labels, shockwatch tilt displays, and single angle anti-tilts. In addition, the company offers inventory management and packaging services. The company was formerly known as Shanghai Xinliantong Packacing Materials Company and changed its name to Shanghai Xintonglian Packaging Co., Ltd. in June 2011. The company was founded in 1999 and is based in Shanghai, China.

name: Harbin VITI Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Harbin VITI Electronics Co., Ltd. researches, manufactures, and sells electronic products for cars and buses in China. It offers bus switch, bus slave, bus bridge, bus processor, bus management, bus door control, bus fuel data acquisition, and bus signal distribution modules, as well as vehicle remote wireless monitoring systems and tire pressure monitoring systems. The company also provides combination, bus, and bus digital color LCD instruments; recorder display and printing, recorder identification, and vehicle traveling data recorder display and print modules, as well as vehicle traveling data recorders; central processors; central electric boxes; and retarder power switches. In addition, it offers ECU control units, including LED trunk light control modules, retarder control units, speed controllers, wiper intermittent controllers, flash relays, water level alarm controllers, rocker switch light boxes, overvoltage protection controllers, retarder foot controllers, and engine stall delay relays. Further, the company provides sensor products comprising liquid level alarm switches, capacitive and resistive fuel level sensors, temperature sensors, odometer sensors, air pressure sensors, water level alarms, low air pressure alarms, electronic speed sensors, oil pressure alarm sensors, temperature alarm sensors, magnetic reed oil level sensors, and swing arm oil level sensors. Harbin VITI Electronics Co., Ltd. was founded in 2000 and is based in Harbin, China.

name: Beijing Dahao Technology Corp.,Ltd
summary: Beijing Dahao Technology Corp.,Ltd researches and develops, produces, and sells computer control systems for sewing and needle spinning machineries and equipment in China and internationally. The company was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.

name: Shida Shinghwa Advanced Material Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Shandong Shida Shenghua Chemical Group Company Limited engages in the production and sale of chemical products in China. Its products include methyl tert-butyl ether, propylene oxide, dimethyl carbonate, propylene carbonate, ethylene carbonate, ethyl methyl carbonate and other carbonate products, lithium hexafluorophosphate, and other products. Shandong Shida Shenghua Chemical Group Company Limited was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Dongying, China.

name: Qianhe Condiment and Food Co., Ltd.
summary: Qianhe Condiment and Food Co., Ltd. produces and sells various food products. It provides soy sauce, vinegar, cooking wine, and other condiments. The company was founded in 1996 and is based in Meishan, China.

name: Jiangsu Safety Group Co.,Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu Safety Group Co Ltd develops and manufactures elevator ropes for customers with different requirements and needs. Its products include wire rope for elevators, lifting Wire rope, steel wire rope, synthetic fiber sling belt rigging, and accessories. Its products are used in elevators, construction machinery, Hong Kong Port terminal, coal mine, marine engineering, shipbuilding, ocean fishing, logistics, and warehousing.

name: Shandong Swan CottonIndustrial Machinery Stock Co.,Ltd.
summary: Shandong Swan CottonIndustrial Machinery Stock Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, marketing, and sale of cotton processing equipment in China. The company offers saw gin, lint cleaner, saw delinter, hydraulic press, and three-mode series products; and seed cotton cleaners, automatic strapping systems for cotton bale, and harvesting machines. Shandong Swan CottonIndustrial Machinery Stock Co.,Ltd. is a subsidiary of Shandong Supply And Marketing Cooperative Association.

name: Shanghai Trendzone Holdings Group Co.,Ltd
summary: Shanghai Trendzone Holdings Group Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, provides integrated solutions across design, construction, production, and services in China and internationally. The company offers consulting; urban development and renewal solutions; one-stop headquarters technology park construction; innovation ecosystem planning; smart construction platform; green and sustainable development; full lifecycle management; and city information modeling (cim) platform integration. It also provides smart wellness and elderly care, smart living environment design and renovation; health monitoring and management system; personalized care; and smart health and wellness community construction, as well as high-end residences, affordable housing, cultural and artistic real estate, office real estate, real estate supporting the event, high-end hotels and commercial complexes, green buildings and senior living communities, intelligent exhibition center, shared communities and talent apartments, prefabricated interior space, educational real estate, medical real estate, and tourism real estate; and Villas. Shanghai Trendzone Holdings Group Co.,Ltd was founded in 1998 and is based in Shanghai, China.

name: Anhui Anfu Battery Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Anhui Anfu Battery Technology Co., Ltd., established in 1984 and based in Hefei, China, primarily dedicates its business to the production and distribution of batteries, with its operational focus predominantly within the Chinese market. The company adopted its current name in May 2022, having previously been recognized as Anhui Andeli Department Store Co., Ltd.

name: Delixi New Energy Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Delixi New Energy Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the lithium battery cutting equipment business in the People’s Republic of China and internationally. The company offers lithium battery cutting molds and precision structural parts. The company was formerly known as Delixi Xinjiang Transportation Co.,Ltd. Delixi New Energy Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2003 and is based in Urumqi, the People’s Republic of China.

name: Zhejiang Sanwei Rubber Item Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Sanwei Rubber Item Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells conveyor belt and V belt products for bulk materials and various industrial applications. The company offers EP, NN, steel cord, flame retardant, high temperature resistant, chevron, cold resistant, anti-tear conveyor steel cord, CFW, chemical resistant, single multi textile, oil resistant, pipe, and sensor conveyor belts. The company was formerly known as Sanmen County V Belt Factory and changed its name to Zhejiang Sanwei Rubber Item Co., Ltd. in August 1997. Zhejiang Sanwei Rubber Item Co., Ltd. was founded in 1990 and is based in Taizhou, China.

name: Jiangsu Changshu Automotive Trim Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu Changshu Automotive Trim Group Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells automotive interiors in China and internationally. The company was formerly known as Changshu Automotive Trim Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Jiangsu Changshu Automotive Trim Group Co., Ltd. In September 2020. The company was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Changshu, China.

name: Jiangsu Rutong Petro-Machinery Co., Ltd
summary: Jiangsu Rutong Petro-Machinery Co., Ltd researches, develops, manufactures and sells petroleum drilling tools and equipment for use in various oilfields primarily in China. The company offers hoisting tools, including elevator series, elevator/spiders, elevator links, hook blocks, and fill up and circulate tools; and make up and break out tools, such as manual, power casing, and power tubing tongs, as well as spinning wrenches. It also provides grip tools comprising rotary, pneumatic, and hydraulic slips, as well as pneumatic spiders; and bushings, bit breaker, and other tools. The company exports its products to North America, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, Central Asia, North Africa, and other regions. Jiangsu Rutong Petro-Machinery Co., Ltd was founded in 1958 and is based in Nantong, China.

name: Shanghai Carthane Co.,Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Carthane Co.,Ltd. researches, develops, manufactures, and sells suspension related PUR products in China. It offers suspension products comprising plastic parts, dust covers, polyurethane buffer bit blocks, lower spring cushions, spring sheaths, recovery buffer stoppers, and spring upper support products; and control products, such as pedal assemblies. The company also provides polyurethanes products, including high-bearing polyurethane rubber tires; polyurethane elastomer products; and elastic wear resistant materials and high-load wheels. It exports its products to North America, Europe, Japan, Korea, etc. The company is based in Shanghai, China.

name: Dongguan Huali industries Co., Ltd.
summary: Dongguan Huali industries Co., Ltd. researches and develops, produces, and sells decorative composite materials in China. The company's products include edge, shaped, and other decorative materials, as well as PVC and furniture edge banding materials for use in the edge sealing, surface decoration, and indoor decoration of panel furniture decoration. Dongguan Huali Industries Co., Ltd. was founded in 1995 and is based in Dongguan, China.

name: Weaver Network Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Weaver Network Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, sale, and service of collaborative management and mobile office software products in China. The company was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.

name: Hangzhou XZB Tech Co.,Ltd
summary: Hangzhou XZB Tech Co.,Ltd researches, develops, manufactures, and sells valve train systems and parts for the car industry. The company provides valve cotters, valve spring retainers, hydraulic lash adjusters and finger followers, push rods, and tappets for heavy duty diesel engines. It also offers precision cold forming components for power tool, household electrical appliance, aerospace, machinery, and other applications. The company was founded in 2002 and is based in Hangzhou, China. Hangzhou XZB Tech Co.,Ltd is a subsidiary of Hangzhou Zuofeng Investment Management Co., Ltd.

name: Jiangsu Maysta Chemical Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu Maysta Chemical Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of organosilicon surfactants in China and internationally. The company offers PU foam stabilizers for rigid foams, slab stock foams, HR foams, shoe soles, OCF, and rigid foam and HR foam cell openers; and PU catalysts for rigid and flexible foams. Its products are used in various sectors, such as home appliances, furniture, architecture, automobiles, etc. The company was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Nanjing, China. Jiangsu Maysta Chemical Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of Foshan Shunde District Demei Chemical Group Co., Ltd.

name: Nanjing Huamai Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Nanjing Huamai Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, design, manufacture, and sale of telecom distribution products and passive microwave products in China. The company offers fiber optic cables, FTTH solutions, MDAS systems, MDAS systems, smart home solutions, data center solutions, and other products. In addition, Nanjing Huamai Technology Co., Ltd. exports its products to approximately 50 countries and regions. The company was founded in 1998 and is based in Nanjing, China.

name: Guangzhou Restaurant Group Company Limited
summary: Guangzhou Restaurant Group Co.,Ltd. is a prominent hospitality company that manages and operates a network of dining establishments both within China and across international territories. Its diverse culinary offerings span a range of products, including traditional mooncakes, frozen items, cured meats (Lap Mei), biscuits, pastries, Western-style cakes, and convenient ready-to-eat meals. The company holds ownership of various restaurant brands, including prominent names like Guangzhou Restaurant, Tao Tao Ju, Likou Fu, Autumn Wind, and Liang Feng Yuan. In addition to these brands, it directly manages and operates 26 catering stores, which function under specific brand identities such as Guangzhou Restaurant, Tao Tao Ju, Tian Ji Pin, and Xingyue City. Established in 1935, the company's corporate headquarters are situated in Guangzhou, China.

name: Fuda Alloy Materials Co., Ltd.
summary: Fuda Alloy Materials Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, sale, technical consultation, and service of electrical contact materials. Its products include contact rivets, contact tips, powder metallurgy contact, brazing materials, silver alloy wires, profiles, contact assemblies, and other series. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Wenzhou, China.

name: Zhejiang Liming Intelligent Manufacturing Co.,Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Liming Intelligent Manufacturing Co., Ltd. is a producer and distributor specializing in automotive components. name: Zhongce Rubber
summary: Zhongce Rubber stands as a premier tire manufacturer in China, producing a diverse array of automotive and industrial tires. The company specializes in both radial and bias-ply tires, designed for an extensive range of uses including passenger cars, commercial trucks, public transportation buses, agricultural machinery, and various other niche applications.

name: Shijiazhuang Kelin Electric Co., Ltd.
summary: Shijiazhuang Kelin Electric Co., Ltd. designs, manufactures, and sells electrical power distribution and metering products in China. The company offers smart meters and metering infrastructure products; substation systems, power distribution monitoring products, switchgears, circuit breakers, and transformers; and electrical vehicle charging stations, line loss management products, fault location indicators, and simple meters. It also provides renewable energy products, such as photovoltaic information collection terminals and inverters. The company was founded in 2000 and is based in Shijiazhuang, China.

name: Chengdu Gas Group Corporation Ltd.
summary: Chengdu Gas Group Corporation Ltd. is a Chinese enterprise primarily engaged in the provision of urban gas services. As of December 31, 2020, the company managed an extensive operational footprint, which included a 7,155-kilometer pipeline network, three gas storage facilities, three gas filling stations, six gas distribution stations, seven gate stations, and 13,300 pressure regulation units. This infrastructure was utilized to serve approximately three million residential customers. Originally established in 1967, the firm was previously known as Chengdu Gas Company and maintains its corporate headquarters in Chengdu, China.

name: Zhe Jiang Taihua New Material Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhe Jiang Taihua New Material Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, spinning, weaving, dyeing, and finishing of environmental protection and health, outdoor sports, special protection, and other functional fabrics in China. It offers cool, antibacterial, hygroscopic and sweat releasing, recycled environment-friendly, nylon mechanical stretch, air textured, and dope dyed yarns. The company also exports its products worldwide. Zhe Jiang Taihua New Material Co., Ltd. was founded in 2001 and is based in Jiaxing, China.

name: DEPPON LOGISTICS Co., LTD.
summary: DEPPON LOGISTICS Co., LTD. operates as a logistics company in China, Korea, Japan, Thailand, Singapore, Malaysia, Vietnam, and internationally. The company was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.

summary: GuiZhou YongJi Printing CO.,LTD engages in packaging and printing business in China.
