The company was founded in 1997 and is based in Guiyang, China.

name: Perfect Group Corp., Ltd
summary: Perfect Group Corp., Ltd., a company based in Yangzhou, China, specializes in the production and distribution of a variety of personal care items. Primarily, it manufactures both manual and electric toothbrushes for the Chinese market. Additionally, its product portfolio encompasses complementary oral hygiene solutions such as toothpastes and other dental care accessories. Beyond oral care, the company also produces a diverse range of wipes, including those for medical, personal hygiene, and baby use, along with specialized shampoo caps. The enterprise was founded in 1991.

name: China Building Material Test & Certification Group Co., Ltd.
summary: China Building Material Test & Certification Group Co., Ltd. provides third-party test and certification services in the fields of building materials and construction engineering in China. The company offers inspection, certification, security, and instrument development services, as well as extended services. It serves building material production and circulation enterprises, construction engineering owners and contractors, solar photovoltaic production and application enterprises, carbon emission permits trade organizations, and government authorities, as well as consumers. The company is headquartered in Beijing, China.

name: MEGA P&C Advanced Materials (Shanghai) Company Limited
summary: MEGA P&C Advanced Materials (Shanghai) Company Limited manufacture and sells industrial coatings in China and internationally. name: Shenzhen Hopewind Electric Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Hopewind Electric Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, sale, and service of renewable energy and electric drive products. Shenzhen Hopewind Electric Co., Ltd. is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.

name: Nanjing Inform Storage Equipment (Group) Co., Ltd.
summary: Established in 1995 and headquartered in Nanjing, China, Nanjing Inform Storage Equipment (Group) Co., Ltd. is dedicated to developing and supplying an extensive array of storage solutions across the Chinese market. name: Hubei Zhenhua Chemical Co.,Ltd.
summary: Hubei Zhenhua Chemical Co.,Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and marketing of chromium salts in China. name: Beken Corporation

name: Hainan Haiqi Transportation Group Co.,Ltd.
summary: Hainan Haiqi Transportation Group Co.,Ltd. operates as a road transportation company in China. It offers passenger transport, logistics express delivery, taxi and tourist passenger transportation, car maintenance, and other services. The company was formerly known as Hainan Haiqi Transportation Group Limited. The company was founded in 1951 and is based in Haikou, China.

name: Hangzhou Heatwell Electric Heating Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Hangzhou Heatwell Electric Heating Technology Co., Ltd., founded in 2002 and headquartered in Hangzhou, China, is an enterprise dedicated to the research, development, production, and international sales of electric heating elements and associated components. The company's extensive product portfolio encompasses a wide array of heating solutions: Tubular heating elements are produced for numerous applications, including various small home appliances, washing machines, diverse water heater types (storage, instantaneous, solar), dishwashers, coffee machines, sanitary fixtures, steam generators, deep fryers, defrosting systems, finned air heaters, microwave and BBQ ovens, and cartridge heaters. summary: Ningbo Lehui International Engineering Equipment Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells beer brewing equipment, and provides turnkey solutions for green-field projects worldwide. summary: Sichuan Hebang Biotechnology Corporation Limited provides food, fertilizer, industrial mineral, and other products. name: Jiangyin Jianghua Microelectronics Materials Co., Ltd
summary: Jiangyin Jianghua Microelectronics Materials Co., Ltd manufactures and supplies ultra-pure wet electronic chemicals for microelectronics and optoelectronics in China and internationally. It offers ultra-clean high purity reagents and photoresist reagents for use in semiconductors, crystalline silicon solar PVs, and flat panel displays; and wet electronic chemicals for use in the manufacturing process of LEDs, silicon products, lithium batteries, magneto-optical products, etc. The company supplies its products to semiconductor companies, as well as crystalline silicon solar energy companies and large-size LCD manufacturers under the Jianghua brand name. name: Zhejiang Shengda Bio-Pharm Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Shengda Bio-Pharm Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of food and feed additives worldwide. The company offers vitamins, such as biotin and folic acid, etc.; biological fresh-keeping agents, including nisin and natamycin; and intermediate APIs. It also produces natural food preservatives. The company is based in Tiantai, China.

name: Xinjiang Torch Gas Co., Ltd
summary: Xinjiang Torch Gas Co., Ltd engages in the natural gas transmission and distribution activities in China. The company also provides sales and home installation services. It owns approximately 120 kilometers of long-distance pipeline and 1 CNG parent station, as well as offers CNG refueling services. The company was founded in 2003 and is based in Kashi, China.

name: Zhejiang Dafeng Industrial Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Dafeng Industrial Co., Ltd. operates in the smart stage, lighting, sound, decoration, seating, and construction fields. It provides stage machinery; lighting systems for theaters, concert halls, studios, TV broadcasts, stadiums, etc.; sound systems for the conferences, art performances, small and medium-sized musicals, TV variety shows, and art rehearsals, as well as for performances of operas and concerts; video systems; and safety control systems for various theaters, shows, studios, and stage machinery for a special performances. The company also offers acoustic decoration services for cultural centers, theaters, concert halls, radio and television centers, recording studios, gymnasiums, multi-purpose halls, and other places; architectural decoration services; and activity stands and public seats for TV studios, multi-purpose halls, stadiums, convention centers, lecture halls, and other places. In addition, it constructs cultural and sports projects; and offers rail vehicle interior products and seats. The company serves cultural and sports industry in China and internationally. Zhejiang Dafeng Industrial Co., Ltd. was founded in 1991 and is based in Yuyao, China.

name: BZS (Beijing) Technology Development Co., Ltd. Class A
summary: Specializing in intelligent logistics systems, RIAMB (Beijing) Technology Development Co., Ltd. provides end-to-end services from initial research and development through to manufacturing and full integration. The company places a particular emphasis on advanced automated three-dimensional warehouses. Its comprehensive offerings span conceptual planning, system architecture, tailored equipment production, development of control and software solutions, complete installation and setup, seamless system integration, and thorough client training. Founded in 1954, the enterprise operates from its headquarters in Beijing, China.

name: CIG ShangHai Co., Ltd.
summary: CIG ShangHai Co., Ltd. is a global enterprise specializing in the research, development, manufacturing, and distribution of diverse information and communication technology (ICT) solutions. Its comprehensive product line features a variety of wireless access network devices, such as indoor and outdoor access points (APs), outdoor Customer Premises Equipment (CPE), and compact 4G/5G cellular base stations. Additionally, the company offers wired access products, including XGS-PON single family units (SFUs), residential gateway units, small form-factor pluggable (SFP) modules, and multi-dwelling units (MDUs). Further extending its offerings, CIG ShangHai provides robust carrier-grade Ethernet switches, a range of home networking products, and optical components like light-emitting and detecting devices for communication systems. The company, established in 2006, is headquartered in Shanghai, China.

name: Zhejiang Tiancheng Controls Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Tiancheng Controls Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, sale, and service of automobile seats in China and internationally. The company's products include construction machinery seats, commercial vehicle seats, passenger car seats, aviation seats, and child safety seats. Zhejiang Tiancheng Controls Co., Ltd. was founded in 1992 and is based in Tiantai, China.

name: ShanDong Cynda Chemical Co.,Ltd
summary: ShanDong Cynda Chemical Co.,Ltd engages in the manufacture and sale of herbicides and fungicides in China and internationally. The company was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Jinan, China. ShanDong Cynda Chemical Co.,Ltd is a subsidiary of Shandong CYNDA (Group) Co., Ltd.

name: Gan & Lee Pharmaceuticals.
summary: Gan & Lee Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical enterprise primarily focused on the discovery, development, manufacturing, and marketing of insulin analogues within the Chinese market. Their diverse product portfolio encompasses injectable therapies such as Basalin (an insulin glargine), Prandilin (an insulin lispro), Prandilin 25 (another insulin lispro variant), Raplin (an insulin aspart), Raplin 30 (an insulin aspart 30 formulation), and Similin 30 (an insulin injection). Beyond diabetes treatments, the company also offers various medical devices. Established in 1998, Gan & Lee Pharmaceuticals maintains its corporate headquarters in Beijing, People's Republic of China. The organization underwent a name change in April 2005, transitioning from its former identity as Beijing Gan & Lee Biotechnology Co., Ltd.

name: JDM JingDaMachine(Ningbo)Co.Ltd
summary: JDM JingDaMachine(Ningbo)Co.Ltd manufactures and sells equipment for the heat exchange industry in the People's Republic of China and internationally. The company offers heat exchanger equipment, such as fin press lines; vertical, horizontal, portable, and mobile expander machines; CNC micro-shrinkage vertical tube; semi-auto and automatic hairpin, return, and CNC vertical coil benders; CNC three-dimensional pipe bender; and high speed servo long U pipe, insulating pipe cutting, return bender, coil straightening cutter, U bend and automatic cleaning, ring sizing and loading, drying and welding, and vacuum tank leak detection machines. It also provides press equipment, including single-point precision; closed four-point connecting rod; closed four-, double-, and single-point precision punch; transfer, high speed precision, and progressive die/blanking press; closed single and double crankshaft; motor stator and rotor; spindle rotor punch; and open double and single crankshaft servo, as well as automobile sheet metal. In addition, the company offers micro channel equipment comprising pipe making, core assembly, and fin machines; fin core installation units; and swing fin punch, as well as powder metallurgy equipment. Further, it provides composite press equipment. The company was formerly known as Ningdo JingDa Electromechanical Technology Co,Ltd. and changed its name to JDM JingDaMachine(Ningbo)Co.Ltd in 2011. JDM JingDaMachine(Ningbo)Co.Ltd was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Ningbo, the People's Republic of China.

name: ADD Industry (Zhejiang) Co. Ltd.
summary: ADD Industry (Zhejiang) Co. Ltd. operates within China, focusing on the manufacturing and distribution of shock absorbers designed for vehicle suspension systems. The company's diverse product range encompasses standard shock absorbers, strut cartridges, complete struts, strut assemblies, steering dampers, and cabin dampers. Founded in 1994, the firm's headquarters are located in Taizhou, China.

name: Wuxi Hongsheng Heat Exchanger Manufacturing Co., Ltd.
summary: Wuxi Hongsheng Heat Exchanger Manufacturing Co., Ltd. designs, develops, produces, and sells aluminum brazed heat exchangers and cooling modules in China. It produces brazed aluminum plate-fin heat exchangers for construction machinery, compressor, automotive, train, power generation, agricultural, off-highway, and hydraulic applications. The company also exports its products to approximately 20 countries, including the United States, Germany, Belgium, Italy, Japan, and Australia. Wuxi Hongsheng Heat Exchanger Manufacturing Co., Ltd. was founded in 2000 and is based in Wuxi, China.

name: Nanhua Futures Co., Ltd.
summary: Nanhua Futures Co., Ltd. operates a financial derivatives service platform worldwide. The company is involved in the commodity futures brokerage, financial futures brokerage, futures investment consulting, asset management business, and securities investment fund sales agency businesses. It also offers risk management services. The company was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.

name: Zhejiang Yuejian Intelligent Equipment Co.,Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Yuejian Intelligent Equipment Co.,Ltd. designs, develops, produces, and sells textile machinery in China. Its products include draw texturing machines, rapier looms, towel rapier looms, warp knitting machines, textile auxiliaries, and air covering machines. The company also exports its products to Vietnam, Thailand, Egypt, India, Pakistan, Nigeria, Kenya, and other countries. Zhejiang Yuejian Intelligent Equipment Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2000 and is based in Shaoxing, China.

name: Thinkingdom Media Group Ltd.
summary: Thinkingdom Media Group Ltd. engages in the planning, publication, and distribution of books and e-books in China. The company offers Chinese literature and children's books. It is also involved in the film and television planning; and books retail activities. The company was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.

name: Center International Group Co.,Ltd.
summary: Center International Group Co.,Ltd. is a Chinese enterprise dedicated to the research, development, and manufacturing of metal building cladding systems. The company also delivers integrated services for steel structures, covering engineering design, production, and construction. Its diverse project experience extends across numerous industrial sectors, including automotive, machinery, electrical and electronic, chemical and metallurgical, food and pharmaceutical, logistics, and power plants. Additionally, it undertakes projects for commercial office spaces and public buildings. Founded in 2001, the company operates from its headquarters in Beijing, China.

name: Changbai Mountain Tourism Co., Ltd.
summary: Changbai Mountain Tourism Co., Ltd. operates in the tourism industry in China. It engages in the tourist passenger transportation, hotel management, travel agency management, hot spring water development, scenic area management, and other activities. The company is based in Changbai, China.

name: Chongqing Chuanyi Automation Co., Ltd.
summary: Chongqing Chuanyi Automation Co., Ltd. provides industrial auto-control systems and devices, and engineering integration services in China. The company offers industrial automation instruments, such as temperature instruments, pressure/differential transmitters, flow meters, level meters, electric actuators, control and special valves, automatic control systems, and analyzer and systems. It also provides transportation and environmental products, including rail transportations and systems, distributed sewage treatment devices, and desulfurization and denitration products; and materials and components comprising metallic functional materials and sapphire and ruby materials. In addition, the company Industrial automation EPC, industrial automation operation and maintenance, valve maintenance and remanufacture, environmental EPC, and rail transit EPC services. It serves power, metallurgy, chemical, nuclear, light-& building material, rail transit, municipal engineering, and environmental industries. The company was formerly known as Chongqing Chuanyi Plant Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Chongqing Chuanyi Automation Co., Ltd. Chongqing Chuanyi Automation Co., Ltd. is based in Chongqing, China.

name: Xinjiang Winka Times Department Store Co.,Ltd.
summary: Xinjiang Winka Times Department Store Co.,Ltd. operates department stores in China. It also operates shopping centers and supermarkets. The company is based in Urumqi, China.

name: Hengdian Entertainment Co., Ltd.
summary: Hengdian Entertainment Co., Ltd. operates theatres in China. It operates 424 theaters with 2,653 screens. The company was founded in 2015 and is based in Dongyang, China. Hengdian Entertainment Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of Hengdian Group Holdings Limited.

name: Zhejiang Sunoren Solar Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Sunoren Solar Technology Co.,Ltd. engages in the photovoltaic industry in China. It develops solar power stations; produces solar modules; manufactures silicon wafers; and researches and develops in the field of photovoltaic manufacturing and distributed photovoltaic power plants. The company was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Haining, China.

name: Cashway Fintech Co.,Ltd.
summary: Cashway Fintech Co.,Ltd. provides financial electronic products and solutions worldwide. The company engages in the research and development, manufacture, marketing, operation, and monitoring of banking self-service equipment. It offers ATM, CRS, kiosk, and self-service machines; ATMC, ATMP, and ATMV software solutions; and equipment maintenance and outsource services. The company was founded in 2004 and is based in Tianjin, China.

name: Shanghai Runda Medical Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Runda Medical Technology Co., Ltd. provides integrated medical laboratory services in China. It offers platform supply, laboratory design/renovation, laboratory standardization, and information management system services; medical solutions to help healthcare professionals in the areas of biochemistry, diabetes, POCT, immunoassay analyzer, and molecular biology diagnosis; professional technical services; and logistic services. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.

name: Senci Electric Machinery Co.,Ltd.
summary: Senci Electric Machinery Co., Ltd. is engaged in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of gasoline generator sets and related components. The company's main products include digital inverter generator sets, conventional generator sets, and gasoline engines. They are based in China.

name: New East New Materials Co., Ltd
summary: Operating within China, New East New Materials Co., Ltd is a key manufacturer and provider of fundamental ingredients for the flexible packaging sector. The firm's comprehensive product range includes specialized inks for pharmaceutical and food flexible packaging, plastic flexible packaging solutions, advanced composite polyurethane adhesives, liquid photosensitive solder resist designed for printed circuit boards (PCBs), and diverse polymer shielding materials. Established in 1983, the enterprise maintains its primary corporate office in Taizhou, China.

name: Nanjing Kangni Mechanical & Electrical Co.,Ltd
summary: Nanjing Kangni Mechanical & Electrical Co.,Ltd engages in the research and development, manufacture, sale, and maintenance of railway vehicle door systems. The company offers mass transit vehicle doors, including electrically driven bi-parting and single-leaf sliding plug, electrically driven bi-parting external tightness and pocket sliding, manual sliding plug, manual pocket sliding, hinged, and external emergency front doors, as well as upturned hinged emergency front door/emergency stairs and rear end doors for cabs. It also provides main line vehicle doors, such as electrically controlled pneumatically driven pocket sliding and sliding plug, electrically controlled electrically driven sliding plug and sliding, manually operated sliding plug, manual operated hinged/sliding, inflatable sealing sliding plug, and manual sliding door/manually operated hinged door/manually operated swing doors. In addition, the company offers platform screen doors comprising full and half-height platform screen door systems for railway stations; and vehicle interior fittings that include partition of VIP rooms, central ceilings/ventilation grids, longitudinal transoms, partition walls/electrical cubicle covers of cab, side walls/side ceilings, side windows, and handrails and screens, as well as bus doors. Further, it provides power connectors and new energy products for automobile industry and precision machining equipment; and electrical, mechanism driving, door leaf, and operating parts, as well as after sales and maintenance services. The company has operations in China, France, Canada, Turkey, Singapore, Argentina, the United States, Saudi Arabia, Brazil, the United Kingdom, Germany, Austria, Italy, and Russia under the Kangni brand. Nanjing Kangni Mechanical & Electrical Co.,Ltd was founded in 2000 and is based in Nanjing, China.

name: Shanxi Huaxiang Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanxi Huaxiang Group Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells precision products, engineering products, resin sand products, and other products in China and internationally. It offers precision products, including auto parts, compressor castings, power fittings, railway parts, and pump valve pipe castings and other accessories; engineering products for use in logistics handling, construction machinery, aerial work platforms, port machinery, loading systems, agricultural parts, and drilling and foundation industries; resin sand products for use in industries, such as motors, fluid control, chassis transmission, air compressors, industrial robots, wind power, and mining machinery; and other products. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Linfen, China.

name: Jinneng Science & Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Jinneng Science & Technology Co., Ltd. is an energy-focused industrial company, produces and distributes fine chemical and coal chemical products in China. The company offers coke, carbon black, silica dioxide, technical naphthalene, pitch, para cresol, sorbic acid, and potassium sorbate, as well as methanol and pure benzene. Its products are used in various industrial applications, including tire manufacturing, as well as iron, steel, pharmaceutical, and food production. The company also exports its products to Europe, North America, and Asia. Jinneng Science & Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 1998 and is based in Dezhou, China.

name: Nantong Haixing Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Nantong Haixing Electronics Co., Ltd. manufacturers and sells of electrode foils for aluminum electrolytic capacitors in the People's Republic of China. Its products include medium and high voltage etched and formed foils; and low voltage etched and formed foils. The company was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in Nantong, the People's Republic of China.

name: Zhejiang Red Dragonfly Footwear Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Red Dragonfly Footwear Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells shoes for men, women, and children in China. It also offers accessories and shoe care products. The company sells its products under the Red Dragonfly brand name. It also offers its products online. Zhejiang Red Dragonfly Footwear Co., Ltd. was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Wenzhou, China.

name: Jiangsu Wanlin Modern Logistics Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu Wanlin Modern Logistics Co., Ltd. provides wood logistics and wood import agency services in China and internationally. The company offers wood agency procurement logistics services; shipping agency, customs clearance, inspection declaration, agency charter booking, insurance, freight forwarding services, etc.; port loading and unloading stockpiling logistics services; and warehousing and logistics services. It also provides wood processing and logistics services; professional logistic information services; and wood drying, material fumigation, and recycled process waste reuse services. The company was founded in 2011 and is based in Jingjiang, China.

name: Shenzhen Gongjin Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Gongjin Electronics Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of wideband communication terminal products in China and internationally. It offers PON access, 3G, and LTE terminal products; EOC access and other products; and wireless products, including enterprise Wi-Fi, SOHO router, Wi-Fi adapter, and 802.11ac products, as well as PLC, wired broadband, IP camera, power supply, and transceiver products. The company was founded in 1998 and is based in Shenzhen, China.

name: Shanghai Sinotec (Group) Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Sinotec (Group) Co., Ltd. engages in the development and production of automobile and turbocharger parts in China. The company offers bushings, turbine housings, turbocharger middle cases, turbine, and pull rods, as well as connecting and cover plate assemblies. It also provides import and export customs clearance, foreign exchange settlement, trade financing, logistics, export rebates, and other import and export services. The company also exports its products to North America and Europe. It serves automobile and turbocharger manufacturer companies. The company was formerly known as Shanghai Sinotec (Group) Co., Ltd. The company was founded in 2006 and is based in Shanghai, China.

name: Beijing Cuiwei Tower Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing Cuiwei Tower Co., Ltd. engages in the operation of department stores in China. It also operates contemporary malls, supermarkets, and restaurants, as well as provides entertainment and other services. The company is based in Beijing, China.

name: Jiangxi Jiangnan New Material Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangxi Jiangnan New Material Technology Co., Ltd. is an international enterprise focused on the innovation, production, and distribution of sophisticated copper-based materials. Their diverse product range includes copper anodes, high-purity oxygen-free copper, copper oxide, various copper chemicals, and even copper coinage. These essential materials cater to a wide array of industries, such as printed circuit board (PCB) manufacturing, surface finishing, general electronics, semiconductor fabrication, and plate production. The firm was established in 2007 and has its principal headquarters located in Yingtan City, China.

name: Sinoma Energy Conservation Ltd.
summary: Sinoma Energy Conservation Ltd. provides technical, engineering, and investment services in the fields of industrial energy conservation, building energy conservation, energy comprehensive management, and environmental protection services in China and internationally. It designs, constructs, finances, and operates waste heat power generation projects on build-operate-transfer basis. The company also undertakes energy management contracts; offers engineering, procurement, and construction services for waste heat power generation projects; provides engineering design and consultation services for waste heat power generation projects; and undertakes clean development mechanism projects. It serves cement, steel, metallurgy, chemical, and other industries. The company is based in Tianjin, China. Sinoma Energy Conservation Ltd. is a subsidiary of China National Building Material Group Co., Ltd.
industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

name: Joinn Laboratories (China) Co.,Ltd.
summary: Joinn Laboratories (China) Co., Ltd. provides preclinical and non-clinical services. It evaluates various drugs, including biologics, pharmaceutical chemicals, and plant medicines for indications, such as renal, metabolic, cardiology, hematology, COPD, ophthalmic, oncology, and immune-related diseases. The company's services include screening services, such as efficiency screening, bioavailability, ADME screening, and non-GLP toxicology studies; pre-clinical safety assessment comprising general toxicology, safety pharmacology, developmental and reproductive toxicology, genetic and ocular toxicology, clinical pathology, analytical and bioanalytical analysis, immunology, and biomarker assays; pharmacodynamics services; and services to evaluate and optimize the absorption, distribution, metabolism, and elimination (ADME), as well as pharmacokinetic properties of potential drugs from early discovery projects. Its services also comprise clinical trials; a range of safety assessment services for medical devices, chemicals, and agrochemicals; regulatory consulting services in the areas of pharmaceuticals, biologics, Chinese medicine, medical devices, veterinary medicines, and agrochemicals; and food animal evaluation services comprising candidate selection, efficacy, safety evaluation studies on animals' health products, animal remedies, and fodders. In addition, the company offers traditional animals, such as outbred rats, inbred strain mice, outbred mice, and immunodeficient mice. It serves pharmaceutical, medical device, chemical, biotechnology, and agricultural development companies, as well as regulatory and other government agencies. It serves pharmaceutical, medical device, chemical, biotechnology, and agricultural development companies. The company operates in China, Europe, North America, Southeast Asia, and Australia. The company was founded in 1995 and is based in Beijing, China.

name: CTS International Logistics Corporation Limited
summary: CTS International Logistics Corporation Limited operates as a leading freight forwarding enterprise, offering a comprehensive suite of logistical and trade-related supply chain solutions. The company provides its services to clients both within China and internationally. Its diverse offerings include air and sea cargo transportation, multimodal shipping options, specialized project logistics, supply chain trading services, warehousing facilities, and customs clearance assistance. Established in 1984, the firm maintains its principal headquarters in Shanghai, China, and functions as a subsidiary of China Chengtong Holdings Group Ltd.

name: Zhejiang Cfmoto Power Co.,Ltd
summary: Zhejiang Cfmoto Power Co.,Ltd develops, manufactures, and markets motorcycles, all-terrain vehicles, side-by-side utility vehicles, power sports engines, parts, gears, and apparel and accessories worldwide. The company was founded in 1989 and is based in Hangzhou, China.

name: Shanghai Hugong Electric Group Co.,Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Hugong Electric Group Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells welding and cutting equipment in China. The company offers welding machines, including Tek masters, stick welders, MIG/MAG welders, TIG welders, plasma cutters, submerged arc welders, and engine driven welders; laser cutting machines, such as fiber laser cutting machines and plate-pipe complexes; and plasma cutting machines comprising CNC flame and plasma cutting machines, and CNC pipe intersection cutting machines. It also provides robot integration equipment; white body welding production lines, welding fixtures, robotic workstations, non-standard special machines, and other automation equipment for automobile companies and auto parts manufacturers; and accessories and after-sales support services for welding and cutting equipment, as well as wholesales and retails welding machine products. The company also exports its products to 108 countries. Shanghai Hugong Electric Group Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1958 and is based in Shanghai, China.

name: Tanyuan Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Tanyuan Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development of high-heat graphite film and other related products for graphite heat dissipation in China. It offers single layer, multi-layer, and composite high thermal conductivity graphite films. The company is based in Changzhou, China.

name: Jiangsu Tianmu Lake Tourism Co.,Ltd
summary: Jiangsu Tianmu Lake Tourism Co.,Ltd. operates a tourism resort in China. Its resort has three sightseeing and leisure facilities with hotel and food facilities under the names of Tianmu Lake Landscape Park Scenic Spot, Tianmu Lake Nanshan Bamboo Sea Scenic Spot, and Tianmu Lake Yushui Hot Spring. The company is based in Liyang, China.

name: Beijing Vastdata Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing Vastdata Technology Co., Ltd. provides data technology services in China. It offers data storage and security, database and data management, data audit, database machine, cloud integration, and other related services, as well as database as a service cloud platform. The company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.

name: Shaanxi Kanghui Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
summary: Shaanxi Kanghui Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. researches, develops, produces, and sells pharmaceutical products in China. It offers gynecological, orthopedic, dermatology, diabetes, respiratory, urinary system, gastrointestinal liver and gallbladder, and other drugs in the form of tablets, capsules, granules, and oral liquids. The company is based in Xianyang, China.

name: Xinyaqiang Silicon Chemistry Co.,Ltd
summary: Xinyaqiang Silicon Chemistry Co.,Ltd manufactures and sells organic silicon methylsilane and phenyl products. It offers hexamethyldisiloxane, iodotrimethylsilane, chlorotrimethylsilane, hexamethyldisilane, diethoxydimethylsilane, dimethoxydimethylsilane, phenyltrichlorosilane, dichlorodiphenylsilane, dichlorodimethylsilane, trimethylethoxysilane, methyltrimethoxysilane, and methyltriethoxysilane; 1,3-divinyltetramethyldisilazane; 1,3-diethenyl-1,1,3,3-tetramethyldisiloxane; N,1,1,1-tetramethyl-N-(trimethylsilyl)silylamine; 1,1,1,3,3,3-hexamethyldisilazane; and 1,3-Bis(trimethylsilyl)urea. The company was founded in 2009 and is based in Suqian, China.

name: Hebei Yangyuan ZhiHui Beverage Co., Ltd.
summary: Hebei Yangyuan ZhiHui Beverage Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, processing, production, and sale of walnut milk beverages in China. The company's products include protein and compound drinks. It also sells its products online. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Hengshui, China.

name: Xinjiang La Chapelle Fashion Co., Ltd.
summary: Xinjiang La Chapelle Fashion Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, designs, markets, and sells apparel products for ladies' casual wear in the People's Republic of China. Its products include tops, bottoms, dresses, and accessories. The company offers its apparel products under the various brands, such as La Chapelle, Puella, 7m, Candie's, La Babité, JACK WALK, Pote, MARC ECKO, 8em, and Naf Naf; and other brands, including Siastella, UlifeStyle, and Gartine. It is also involved in the sale of apparel products; and asset management, information technology, and warehousing services. The company sells its products through retail points, as well as through online platform. As of December 31, 2020, it had a retail network of 959 retail points, including 561 concessionaire counters, 331 standalone retail outlets, and 67 franchising retail outlets. The company was formerly known as Shanghai La Chapelle Fashion Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Xinjiang La Chapelle Fashion Co., Ltd. in July 2020. Xinjiang La Chapelle Fashion Co., Ltd. was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Shanghai, People's Republic of China.

name: Changzhou Tenglong AutoPartsCo.,Ltd.
summary: Changzhou Tenglong AutoPartsCo.,Ltd. researches, develops, manufactures, and sells auto parts in China. The company offers air-conditioning pipe lines, such as compressor suction, IHX, compressor exhaust, expansion valve inlet and outlet, and condenser connecting pipe assemblies; auto heat exchange connecting tubes, including heater and oil cooling inlet and outlet pipes, and evaporator inlet pipes; and auto heat exchange accessories comprising filling valves, connectors, covers, flanges, and brackets. It also provides receiving driers; auto sensors consisting of diesel engine exhaust temperature, water temperature, and sunlight sensors; EGR cooling parts; auto precision aluminum tubes, such as intercooler, afflux, and flat tubes, as well as KOMO pipes; and reservoir package in master cylinder for automobile brake systems. The company also exports its products to North America, South America, Europe, Japan, and South Asia regions. Changzhou Tenglong AutoPartsCo.,Ltd. was founded in 1997 and is based in Changzhou, China.

name: Shanghai Yahong Moulding Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Yahong Moulding Co., Ltd. designs and manufactures medium and small-sized precise plastic moulds. The company is based in Shanghai, China.

name: Shenzhen Goodix Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Goodix Technology Co., Ltd. operates as an integrated solution provider for applications based on IC design and software development offering software and hardware semiconductor solutions worldwide. It provides biometric authentication solutions for android devices, IoT applications, and automotive electronics. The company offers microcontrollers; Bluetooth low energy SoC chips; heart rate sensors; audio amplifiers; fingerprint sensors, including in-display fingerprint sensor, live finger detection, invisible fingerprint sensor, covered fingerprint sensor, and fingerprint sensor with hard coating solutions; and touchscreen and touchkey controllers, and mousepad solutions. Its products and solutions are used by various mobile brands, including Huawei, OPPO, vivo, Xiaomi, Samsung, Google, Amazon, Dell, HP, LG, OnePlus, Nokia, ASUS, etc. The company sells its products directly, as well as through agents and distributors to module makers, integrated solution providers, and device manufactures. The company was formerly known as Shenzhen Huiding Technology Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Shenzhen Goodix Technology Co., Ltd. in April 2017. Shenzhen Goodix Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.

name: Kehua Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: Kehua Holdings Co., Ltd. engages in the design, manufacture, and sale of automobile turbocharger components, hydraulic pumps/valves, and machinery fittings in China. The company also offers construction machinery parts. It also provides its products to customers in North America, South America, Europe, Japan, South Korea, etc. The company was formerly known as Liyang Kehua Machinery Manufacture Co., Ltd. Kehua Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 2002 and is based in Jiangsu, China.

name: Fujian Highton Development
summary: Fujian Highton Development Co., Ltd. is a maritime shipping company specializing in the transport of dry bulk goods across both domestic Chinese and international waters. Its fleet handles a wide array of commodities, including essential raw materials like coal, iron ore, and slag, in addition to agricultural products such as fertilizers and grain. The company's business model encompasses both voyage and time charter arrangements, alongside standard cargo shipping operations. Its substantial fleet consists of 51 dry bulk carriers in total, comprising 19 vessels on long-term lease and 32 wholly owned and operated ships. Established in 2009, the firm is headquartered in Fuzhou, China.

name: Zhejiang Rongsheng Environmental Protection Paper Joint Stock Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Rongsheng Environmental Protection Paper Joint Stock Co., Ltd. produces and sells recycled paper products in China. The company offers kraft cardboard paper, corrugated base paper, corrugated cardboard, and kraft board paper, as well as packaging products. It also produces steam. The company exports its products. The company was founded in 1980 and is based in Pinghu, China.

name: GUILIN FUDA Co.,Ltd.
summary: GUILIN FUDA Co.,Ltd. develops, produces, and sells auto parts and components in China. Its products include engine crankshafts, automobile clutches, gears, precision forgings, and bolts. The company is based in Guilin, China. GUILIN FUDA Co.,Ltd. is a subsidiary of Fuda Holdings Group Co., Ltd.

name: Bohai Ferry Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Bohai Ferry Group Co., Ltd. engages in water transportation business in China. It is also involved in the ticketing, cruise travel, ship leasing, freight transportation, and finance lease businesses. The company was formerly known as Shandong Bohai Ferry Co., Ltd. Bohai Ferry Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Yantai, China.

name: Zhejiang Shapuaisi Pharmaceutical Co.,Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Shapuaisi Pharmaceutical Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of pharmaceutical products. The company provides its products to ophthalmology, antipyretic and analgesic, antibacterial anti-inflammatory, endocrine, liver disease adjuvant, cardiovascular, detoxification, diuretic row stone, gynecology, infusion, and jianweixiaosh categories. It offers its products in injections, oral solutions, eye drops, tablets, capsules, suppositories, granules, medicine raw materials, rinsing agents, mixtures, and other dosage forms. Zhejiang Shapuaisi Pharmaceutical Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1978 and is based in Pinghu, China.

name: Lanzhou LS Heavy Equipment Co., Ltd
summary: Lanzhou LS Heavy Equipment Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, design, manufacture, installation, and after-sale technical service of petrochemical equipment in Asia, Europe, Africa, and the United States. It offers pressure vessel, fast forging unit, nuclear power new energy, and other high-end energy equipment, as well as plate heat exchangers. The company was founded in 1953 and is based in Lanzhou, China.

name: Servyou Software Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Servyou Software Group Co., Ltd., based in Hangzhou, China, functions as a comprehensive provider of financial and taxation information services within the country. The company supplies tax authorities with applications for managing taxes and analyzing tax data. Additionally, it develops, operates, and maintains intelligent electronic tax bureau systems designed to facilitate tax collection, administration, and informed decision-making, while also offering crucial information support and professional services for China's tax framework. Its core offerings encompass personal income tax management solutions, tools for tax data analysis, and sophisticated electronic tax office platforms. Servyou's clientele primarily comprises government tax bodies, private tax enterprises, and various financial and tax intermediaries.

name: Zhejiang Tuna Environmental Science & TechnologyCo.,Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Tuna Environmental Science & TechnologyCo.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, and turnkey contract of flue gas purification technologies in China and internationally. The company undertakes engineering projects, such as wet lime-stone, semi-dry, and ammonia flue gas desulphurization, as well as SCR flue gas denitration, bag\electric precipitator, and other projects on EPC and BOT basis. It also offers desulfurization products, including MST series wet-type limestone ball mills, rubber lined pipes, TBF-DU belt type vacuum filters, TLD single-shaft double louver series dampers, TME mist eliminators, and TSP-I spray banks; dedusting equipment comprising wet electro-static precipitators and electric-bag composite dust collectors, as well as dry dust remover technology; and cellular and plate catalysts. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Shaoxing, China.

name: Ningbo Shenglong Automotive Powertrain System Co., Ltd.
summary: Ningbo Shenglong Automotive Powertrain System Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells automotive powertrain systems in China and internationally. It offers variable displacement oil pumps, tandem vacuum/variable displacement oil pumps, start/stop pumps, fixed displacement engine and transmission pumps, and high pressure DCT and brake system pumps; and assembly, traditional, and hollow camshafts, as well as aluminum die castings. The company is based in Ningbo, China.

name: Jiangsu Xinquan Automotive Trim Co.,Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu Xinquan Automotive Trim Co.,Ltd. designs, develops, manufactures, sells, and supplies auto parts in China. The company offers interior and exterior trim components and molds; and dashboards, passenger car cockpit system assemblies, and heavy truck top cabinets. Jiangsu Xinquan Automotive Trim Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2001 and is based in Changzhou, China.

name: GoldenHome Living Co., Ltd.
summary: GoldenHome Living Co., Ltd., headquartered in Xiamen, China, is dedicated to the full lifecycle of integrated kitchen cabinetry and a variety of customized, intelligent home furnishings within the Chinese market. This encompasses everything from initial research, design, and development to production, sales, installation, and post-purchase service. Complementing its core offerings, the company also provides wardrobes, wooden doors, and smart home appliances. GoldenHome distributes its products through an extensive retail footprint throughout China, consisting of 1,585 kitchen cabinet stores, 722 Jujia brand wardrobe outlets, and 181 Jujia wooden door stores. The company was founded in 1999.

name: Zhejiang Huangma Technology Co.,Ltd
summary: Zhejiang Huangma Technology Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, researches, manufactures, and sells surfactants and related products in China. It primarily offers PCE with polymer polyether plates, C4 derivative functional intermediates, modified silicone new materials with high performance polyether plates, and textile auxiliaries with green new surfactant plates. The company provides its products for use in lubricant and metalworking, coating and ink, agrochemical adjuvant, PCE, water treatment, specialty fiber, personal care, and composite material applications, as well as in silicones surfactants and textile auxiliaries. Zhejiang Huangma Technology Co.,Ltd was founded in 2003 and is based in Shaoxing, China.

name: Suzhou Institute of Building Science Group Co.,Ltd
summary: Suzhou Institute of Building Science Group Co., Ltd., a Chinese firm based in Suzhou, operates within the country's construction industry. Established in 1979, the company delivers a wide array of services, including architectural planning, engineering project oversight, waterproof finishing applications, structural reinforcement, and quality assurance inspections. It also provides industry-specific education and training. Furthermore, Suzhou Institute is actively involved in sustainable construction and urban development. This encompasses research, design, construction, product innovation, testing, technical advisory, and sales representation for green building initiatives, energy-saving technologies, and related equipment. The company also contributes to urban regeneration projects. In terms of products, it manufactures and distributes various construction materials. This range includes waterproofing agents, interior and exterior latex paints, concrete additives, building adhesives, stone curing compounds, and external thermal insulation systems. Its comprehensive solutions are utilized across diverse sectors such as rail transportation networks, integrated urban utility corridors, sustainable urban water management (sponge cities), urban revitalization schemes, specialized town developments, and water conservancy and hydroelectric infrastructure, among other areas.

name: Hongyuan Green Energy Co., Ltd.
summary: Wuxi Shangji Automation Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of precision machine tools. It offers special processing equipment for high-hard and brittle materials and general-purpose CNC cylindrical grinders. The company's products include solar photovoltaic precision equipment, sapphire material processing equipment, and semiconductor material processing equipment; and universal CNC cylindrical grinders, such as CNC cylindrical grinders, roll grinders, and other products. Wuxi Shangji Automation Co., Ltd. was founded in 2002 and is based in Wuxi, China.

name: Zhejiang Huazheng New Material Co., Ltd.
summary: ZheJiang Huazheng New Material Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of epoxy resin copper clad laminates in China and internationally. The company also offers functional composites, thermoplastic honeycomb materials, and other new material products. The company was founded in 2003 and is based in Hangzhou, China.

name: Qingdao Hiron Commercial Cold Chain Co., Ltd.
summary: Qingdao Hiron Commercial Cold Chain Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, sale, and service of commercial cold chain equipment. Its products include commercial freezing display cabinets, commercial refrigerating display cabinets, supermarket display cabinets, commercial intelligent display cabinets, other cold chain equipment, as well as optional accessories. The company also provides customized solutions and professional services for customers to store products. It supplies products for cold drinks, cold food, beer, beverage, dairy, supermarket chain, convenience store, and other industries. The company was founded in 2006 and is based in Qingdao, China.

name: Jiangsu Yabang Dyestuff Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu Yabang Dyestuff Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of dyes and dye intermediates in China. It offers disperse, vat, and solvent dyes; and benzoic acid, benzoyl chloride, triclosan, benzaldehyde, hydrochloric acid, (o-) chlorobenzaldehyde, and (ortho) chlorobenzonitrile. The company also provides sulfuric and chlorosulfonic acids; and operates and disposes hazardous solid wastes, as well as develops and produces combined heat and power products. In addition, it engages in the production of steam, as well as wastewater treatment business; import and export business; and energy supply business. The company also exports its products. Jiangsu Yabang Dyestuff Co., Ltd. was founded in 2006 and is based in Changzhou, China.

name: Shanghai Wondertek Software Co., Ltd
summary: Shanghai Wondertek Software Co., Ltd operates within the video intelligence domain, delivering a diverse range of software products and specialized solutions. Its portfolio encompasses an Operation Management System, meticulously designed for managing multimedia content across the internet. For enhanced connectivity, the company offers Multi-Screen Interactive solutions, seamlessly linking mobile devices with televisions. Enterprises can also benefit from their Electronic Work Order System, which efficiently defines workflows and manages resources. Furthermore, Wondertek provides advanced Video Encoding and Transcoding products, supporting online conversion for high-definition (HD), 4K, and High Dynamic Range (HDR) video formats. Other key offerings include a Content Propagation Matrix System, a robust platform for multi-channel content distribution, and Client Middleware, which serves as a powerful cross-platform engine for application development. The Converged Media Asset System stands out as an integrated multimedia management platform, capable of handling petabyte-level storage, diverse formats, and sophisticated retrieval operations. Rounding out their offerings, the Smart Super Business System incorporates cutting-edge artificial intelligence technology. Founded in 2009, Shanghai Wondertek Software Co., Ltd is based in Shanghai, China.

name: Shanghai Huide Science & Technology Co.,Ltd
summary: Shanghai Huide Science & Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research, production, sale, and service of polyurethane (PU) resin for synthetic leather and polyester polyol in China. The company offers polyurethane resins, including dry coating, dry adhesive, wet process, dry two-component, dry foam type, wet nubuck, high peel strength, hydrolyzing resis and high peel strength, cold-resistant and non-yellowing, etc. It also exports its products to the Southeast Asia, Europe, the United States, and internationally. The company was founded in 1997 and is based in Shanghai, China.

name: Runben Biotechnology
summary: Runben Biotechnology Co., Ltd. focuses on the creation, production, and distribution of mosquito repellent solutions, infant care items, and essential oil products. The company primarily sells its offerings through digital sales channels. Established in 2013, Runben Biotechnology is headquartered in Guangzhou, China, and functions as a division of Guangzhou Zhuofan Investment Holding Co., Ltd.

name: Zhejiang E-P Equipment Co Ltd
summary: Zhejiang E-P Equipment Co., Ltd. focuses on the development, manufacturing, and distribution of electric-powered material handling equipment, in addition to other types of motorized industrial vehicles. Their extensive product line features items such as electric forklifts, reach trucks, electric order pickers, electric pallet trucks, electric stackers, electric tow tractors, and conventional internal combustion engine forklifts.

name: Goneo Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Gongniu Group Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of civil electrical products. It offers standard, high-end surge protector, and USB power strips, as well as smart WiFi sockets, USB travel power adapters, digital timers, and power transformers; digital accessories, such as car chargers, USB cables, and power banks; decorative switches and sockets; and eye-care LED lights. The company was founded in 1995 and is based in Cixi, China.

name: Shanghai Porigine Chemical Material Group Co. Ltd.
summary: Ribo Fashion Group Co., Ltd. designs and sells clothing products for women in China. The company offers women's wear under the Broadcast, Personal Point, and TAORAY WANG brands. Ribo Fashion Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.

name: Shanghai Baolong Automotive Corporation
summary: Shanghai Baolong Automotive Corporation manufactures and sells automotive parts and components in China. It offers tire pressure monitoring systems (TPMS) for passenger cars and commercial vehicles, TPMS service kits, TPMS OE replacement sensors, pressure and temperature sensors, rain sensors, view systems, etc. The company also provides tire and wheel service products comprising tire valves and accessories, wheel balancing weights and related tools, wheel bolts and nuts, and others; and multi-functional steel exhaust components, such as tailpipes, cones, mufflers, etc., as well as air springs, hydro-forming automotive body parts, and aluminum parts. It serves car makers and Tier 1 suppliers, as well as the tuning market. Shanghai Baolong Automotive Corporation was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.

name: Anhui Yingjia Distillery Co., Ltd.
summary: Anhui Yingjia Distillery Co., Ltd. operates in the brewing industry. The company offers wine. It markets its products to approximately 20 provinces, municipalities, and autonomous regions in China. The company was founded in 2003 and is based in Lu'an, China. Anhui Yingjia Distillery Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of Anhui Yingjia Group.

name: Anhui Jiuhuashan Tourism Development Co., Ltd.
summary: Anhui Jiuhuashan Tourism Development Co., Ltd. provides tourism services in the People's Republic of China. It is involved in the cableway, hotel, travel agency, tourist passenger transportation, and e-commerce businesses. Anhui Jiuhuashan Tourism Development Co., Ltd. was founded in 2000 and is based in Chizhou, the People's Republic of China.

name: Shanghai Emperor of Cleaning Hi-Tech Co., Ltd
summary: Shanghai Emperor of Cleaning Hi-Tech Co., Ltd provides water treatment and air duct cleaning services. It offers process water, sewage, boiler water, circulating water, and other water treatment services for various industries, such as iron and steel metallurgy, petrochemical, pulp and paper, automobile manufacturing, electronics, and medicine; and civil water treatment technology services, including commercial air conditioning water treatment, rainwater harvesting, water reuse, landscape water treatment, and water saving services in commercial buildings, airport stations, urban complexes, etc. The company's duct cleaning services comprise central air-conditioning duct cleaning and disinfection, closed space environment disinfection, and other services for hotel business buildings, airport, high-speed rail stations, urban complexes, and other places. Shanghai Emperor of Cleaning Hi-Tech Co., Ltd was founded in 1994 and is based in Shanghai, China.

name: Heilongjiang Tianyouwei Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Heilongjiang Tianyouwei Electronics Co., Ltd., established in 2003 and headquartered in Suihua, China, specializes in the comprehensive development and provision of automotive electronic systems. The company's operations encompass everything from research and design to manufacturing, sales, and after-sales service for in-vehicle instrumentation. Their diverse product portfolio includes various types of instrument clusters, such as electronic, full LCD, and dual-screen models, alongside vehicle infotainment units, climate control systems, and wireless charging solutions for automobiles.

name: Quick Intelligent Equipment Co., Ltd.
summary: Quick Intelligent Equipment Co., Ltd. (QIE) is a global enterprise dedicated to the research, development, manufacturing, and sale of advanced precision assembly technologies for electronics. The company offers a comprehensive portfolio of solutions, featuring a diverse array of precision soldering equipment, which includes iron, laser, selective, hotbar, high-frequency induction, and hot air soldering systems, as well as specialized micro spot welding and molten-type soldering robots. Beyond soldering, QIE provides essential automation systems such as double-sided, top, and bottom automatic optical inspection (AOI), dispensing systems, and automated screwing systems. Their product range further extends to specialized BGA rework stations, intelligent soldering/desoldering/rework solutions, ESD protection, and fume extraction systems. Additionally, QIE develops complete production line solutions tailored for applications like PCBA-DIP, 5G filter, 3G electronic, EPB, ignition coil, and chip module integrations. These sophisticated solutions are vital across various industrial sectors, including 3C intelligent terminals and modules, automotive electronics, 5G telecommunications infrastructure, smart home devices, and the burgeoning new energy lithium battery industry. Founded in 1993, Quick Intelligent Equipment Co., Ltd. is headquartered in Changzhou, China.

name: Jiangshan Oupai Door Industry Co., Ltd
summary: Jiangshan Oupai Door Industry Co., Ltd engages in the research and development, manufacture, sale, and service of wooden doors in China. It offers wooden doors for bedrooms, kitchen and bath rooms, and living rooms, as well as provides wooden door accessories. The company markets its products through approximately 2,000 terminal stores. It also exports its products to Europe, the United States, Africa, and internationally. The company is based in Jiangshan, China.

name: Zhejiang Tion Vanly Tech Co
summary: This company offers comprehensive services spanning the entire product lifecycle, from initial research and development to manufacturing, sales, and after-sales support, for vehicle components. Specifically, it specializes in stamped and welded structural elements and various smaller functional sub-assemblies, catering to automotive manufacturers throughout China.

name: Cybrid Technologies Inc.
summary: Cybrid Technologies Inc. manufactures and sells thin film polymer functional materials in China. Its products include solar module backsheets, solar encapsulant films, insulation patches, repairing tapes, positioning tapes, C type high temperature products, single sided framing adhesive tapes, tapes for mobile graphite sheet heat dissipation, black shading PET double-sided tapes, protective films, tapes for speakers, dicing tapes, thin double side cotton tapes, insulation tapes, thermal conductive pads, electronic conductive tapes, and stiffener tapes. The company was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Suzhou, China.

name: Zhejiang Oceanking Development Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Oceanking Development Co., Ltd. is engaged in the entire lifecycle of chlor-alkali chemical products, from their initial research and development to their manufacturing and market distribution. The company's diverse portfolio includes critical chlor-alkali substances such as liquid caustic soda, liquid alkali, liquid chlorine, chlorinated paraffin, sodium hypochlorite, hydrochloric acid, and hydrogen chloride gas. It also produces organic compounds like methyl isobutyl ketone and diisobutyl ketone. Founded in 2004, the enterprise operates from its base in Ningbo, China.

name: Shanghai Aiyingshi Co.,Ltd
summary: Shanghai Aiyingshi Co.,Ltd provides maternal and child products in China. The company's products include infant dairy products, feeding supplies, toiletries, cotton textiles, paper products, toys, lathes, and other products. As of September 30, 2020, it operated 282 direct stores in Shanghai, Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Fujian, Chongqing, and Shenzhen. The company also sells its products through an online platform. Shanghai Aiyingshi Co.,Ltd was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.

name: Yuanli Chemical Group Co.,Ltd.
summary: Yuanli Chemical Group Co.,Ltd. specializes in the innovation, manufacturing, and global distribution of fine chemicals. Its product portfolio includes environmentally friendly solvents, dual-alcohol compounds, tailored plasticizers, and effective coalescing agents. These offerings cater to a diverse range of sectors, such as coatings, polymers, plastic additives, pigments, pharmaceuticals, and broader chemical applications. The company boasts an international reach, distributing its products to approximately 50 countries and regions worldwide. Founded in 2003 and headquartered in Weifang, China, the enterprise was formerly identified as Shandong Yuanli Science and Technology Co.,Ltd.

name: Riyue Heavy Industry Co., Ltd.
summary: Riyue Heavy Industry Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells large and extra-large heavy duty equipment castings. The company's primary products include wind power turbine generator, heavy diesel engine, large plastic injection molding machine, large machining center, and giant mining machine series of castings. It also provides lement machine, gear box, centrifugal ingot mould, slider of machine, and sly-wheel gear series of castings, as well as heavy section ductile iron castings. The company is based in Ningbo, China.

name: Ningbo Fujia Industrial Co., Ltd.
summary: Ningbo Fujia Industrial Co., Ltd. research, design, produces, and sells vacuum cleaners, motors, and vacuum cleaner spare parts in China, North America, Europe, Asia, the Oceania, and internationally. The company also provides power, industrial, commercial, and household energy storage system solutions; and small cleaning appliances, including vacuum cleaners, sweeping robot products, and other. It sells office supplies, building materials, and furniture parts. Ningbo Fujia Industrial Co., Ltd. was founded in 2018 and is based in Yuyao, the Republic of China.

name: China Bester Group Telecom Co., Ltd.
summary: China Bester Group Telecom Co., Ltd. engages in the planning, design, construction, maintenance, and optimization of communications networks for telecom operators in China. It also provides communication and information services for enterprises and government. In addition, the company offers mobile communication network construction, switching and intelligent system network construction, optical network transmission line construction, and communication infrastructure engineering services; and technical consulting and network planning, and survey design services. Further, it provides computer technology development services; software development services; network technology research and development services; communication system technology services; and information electronic technology services. China Bester Group Telecom Co., Ltd. was founded in 1992 and is based in Wuhan, China.

name: Zhangjiagang Elegant Home-Tech Co., Ltd
summary: Zhangjiagang Elegant Home-Tech Co., Ltd manufactures and sells upholstered furniture. Their products include sofas, chairs, and related home furnishings, which are sold in domestic and international markets. The company is based in Zhangjiagang, China.

name: Chimin Health Management Co., Ltd.
summary: Chimin Health Management Co., Ltd. develops, produces, and sells human drugs and medical devices in China. The company offers non-PVC soft bag double tube double valves, single valves, and single-tube double valves; plastic bottles; and other packaging forms. It also provides safe self-destruct syringes, disposable sterile infusion equipment, disposable and precision infusion sets, multi-layer PP co-extruded hoses, and other syringes; peritoneal dialysis solutions; and hemodialysis supplies, as well as medical services. The company was formerly known as Zhejiang Chimin Pharmaceutical Co.,Ltd. Chimin Health Management Co., Ltd. was founded in 1996 and is based in Huangyan, China.

name: Hengtong Logistics Co., Ltd.
summary: Hengtong Logistics Co., Ltd. engages in the logistics business in China. The company is involved in the LNG and LPG logistics transportation and sales, gas station construction and operation, gasification peaking station construction and operation, gas pipeline investment operation, distributed energy development and operation, and gas industry personnel technical training businesses. It also engages in road transportation, port warehousing, shipping agency, large equipment hoisting, car rental, vehicle sales and maintenance, driving skills training, qualification training business, and agricultural machinery sales and service. In addition, the company focuses on smart logistics research and development and big data application. The company was formerly known as Longkou Hengtong Transportation Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Hengtong Logistics Co., Ltd. in December 2011. Hengtong Logistics Co., Ltd. was founded in 2007 and is based in Yantai, China.

name: Xinfengming Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Xinfengming Group Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells polyester yarns in China, Turkey, Egypt, Vietnam, South Korea, Pakistan, Spain, Italy, and internationally. It provides moisture absorption and sweat discharging, warm hollow, fire proof, bamboo charcoal, lat, and antibacterial fibers. The company was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Tongxiang, China.

name: Vohringer Home Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Vohringer Home Technology Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells wooden flooring products in China. It offers laminate flooring, solid wood flooring, and cabinet furniture products. The company was founded in 1995 and is based in Shanghai, China.

name: Xinjiang Xuefeng Sci-Tech (Group) Co., Ltd.
summary: Xinjiang Xuefeng Sci-Tech (Group) Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and marketing civil explosives primarily for use in the field of infrastructure construction, economic construction, and mineral resources development. The company's products include emulsion and site mixed explosives; expanded ammonium nitrate explosives; detonating cords; and ordinary instantaneous electric, coal electric, and electronic detonators. It also offers blasting and armed escort services. The company also exports its products to Central Asia. Xinjiang Xuefeng Sci-Tech (Group) Co., Ltd. was founded in 1958 and is based in Ürümqi, the People's Republic of China.

name: Shenzhen Kinwong Electronic Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Kinwong Electronic Co., Ltd. engages in research, development, production, and sale of printed circuit boards (PCB) and electronic materials in China and internationally. It provides conventional PCBs, including single-layer, double-layer, and multi-layer PCBs; metal-based PCBs that comprise copper, aluminum, stainless steel, and iron; flexible PCBs, such as single and double side, and multilayer PCBs; and high density interconnect, RF microwave, rigid-flex, and high layer count PCBs, as well as embedded copper inlays. The company also offers engineering and design services. It serves automotive, smart terminal, consumer, power supply, telecom, industrial and medical, and computing markets. The company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China. Shenzhen Kinwong Electronic Co., Ltd. was formerly a subsidiary of Kinwong Group Limited.

name: Zhejiang Ausun Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Ausun Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. develops, produces, and sells specialty drug substances and pharmaceutical intermediates. The company offers prostaglandins and its intermediates; APIs; fluorine and antibacterial products; and intermediates. It also provides products for liver disease, respiratory system, and cardiovascular and cerebrovascular, as well as entecavir for the treatment of hepatitis B. In addition, the company is involved in the customized processing, and research and development business. Zhejiang Ausun Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. was founded in 2010 is headquartered in Linhai, China.

name: Solbar Ningbo Protein Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Solbar Ningbo Protein Technology Co., Ltd. (symbol: 603231.SS) specializes in the research, development, production, and global sale of various soybean protein-based products. The company's extensive product line includes functional and textured soy protein concentrates, textured soy proteins, fibrous textured vegetable proteins, isolated soy proteins, and defatted soy flours. To reach its customer base, Solbar Ningbo employs a hybrid distribution model, utilizing a network of distributors while also engaging in direct sales to multinational clients. Founded in 2003, the company operates from its headquarters in Ningbo, China.

name: Koal Software Co., Ltd.
summary: Koal Software Co., Ltd. develops public key infrastructure platform in China. The company offers identity security infrastructure, such as root certificate issuing, certificate issuing, certificate registration auditing, key and certificate integrated management, and trusted identity management systems; password service platform, including timestamp and signature verification servers, and electronic signature systems; and authentication and access control products comprising security authentication, SSL application delivery, and single sign-on gateways. It also provides terminal security and admission control products, such as LAN access control, and terminal security login and file protection systems; and data security and privacy protection products, including secure email, network and net shield safe, USB guardian, print control, and secure instant messaging systems. In addition, the company offers unified authentication, terminal security password module, Internet of Things security, connected car security, certificate authentication system, and mobile security solutions. It serves public security, immigrations, and ministries; the information technology, finance, and manufacturing industries; banks, stock exchanges, and financial institutions; and military industry groups in the field of defense. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.

name: DaShenLin Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd.
summary: DaShenLin Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd. manufactures, wholesales, and retails pharmaceutical products in China. The company was founded in 1999 and is based in Guangzhou, China.

name: Quectel Wireless Solutions Co., Ltd.
summary: Quectel Wireless Solutions Co., Ltd engages in the research, manufacture, and supply of industrial-grade cellular and Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) modules worldwide. The company offers 4G, 3G, 2G, automotive, smart, LPWA (Low Power Wide Area), GNSS IoT modules, as well as short range modules and EVB kits, including LTE, LTE-A, LPWA, UMTS/HSPA(+), GSM/GPRS, and GNSS modules; and technical support services. Its wireless modules are used in telematics and transport, energy, payment, security, smart city, gateway, industrial IoT, life and healthcare, and agriculture and environment industries. The company offers its products through distributors. Quectel Wireless Solutions Co., Ltd was founded in 2010 and is based in Shanghai, China.

name: HangZhou Nbond Nonwovens Co., Ltd.
summary: HangZhou Nbond Nonwovens Co., Ltd. develops, produces, and sells spunlace nonwovens materials in China and internationally. The company's spunlace nonwovens products cover various series and specifications, including beauty care materials, industrial materials, household wiping materials, medical materials, and various series of products for other fields and purposes. It also offers wet wipes, industrial wipes, etc. The company was founded in 2002 and is based in Hangzhou, China.

name: Zhejiang Xiantong Rubber&Plastic Co.,Ltd
summary: Zhejiang Xiantong Rubber&Plastic Co.,Ltd. produces and sells automotive seals in China. The company's products include door and window seals; decorative parts; and metal rolls, as well as rolled parts. The company was founded in 1994 and is based in Xianju, China.

name: Grace Fabric Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Grace Fabric Technology Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of e-glass fabrics worldwide. The company offers middle and high grade e-glass fabric series. Its products are used in automotive structure parts, electrical insulation, high temperature insulation, building materials, aerospace, and sports equipment applications. The company was founded in 1998 and is based in Shanghai, China.

name: China Nerin Engineering Co Ltd
summary: China Nerin Engineering Co., Ltd. operates as an expert engineering firm, delivering core technical services that encompass engineering design and advisory, comprehensive project management, and the integration of specialized equipment.

name: Hangzhou Electronic Soul Network Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Hangzhou Electronic Soul Network Technology Co., Ltd., researches, develops and publishes online and mobile games in China and internationally. It offers H5 games, VR games, consoles, stand-alone games, and apps platforms, as well as comics and e-sports events, and other fields. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Hangzhou, China.

name: WuXi AppTec Co., Ltd.
summary: WuXi AppTec Co., Ltd., an investment holding company, provides research, development, and manufacturing services to discover, develop, and manufacture small molecule drugs, and cell and gene therapies in the People's Republic of China, rest of Asia, the United States, Europe, and internationally. The company operates through China-Based Laboratory Services, U.S.-Based Laboratory Services, Clinical Research and Other CRO Services, CDMO Services, and Others segments. It offers laboratory services, such as synthetic chemistry, biology, medicinal chemistry, analytical chemistry, testing, drug metabolism and pharmacokinetics, toxicology, bioanalytical, and medical devices safety testing services, as well as manufacturing and testing for cell and gene therapies, and absorption, distribution, metabolism, and excretion services. The company also provides clinical research services, including clinical development and site management organization services; clinical development services comprising project planning, clinical operation, and monitoring and management of phase I-IV clinical trials, outcomes research, and medical device trials; embedded outsourcing; and clinical informatics services. In addition, it offers CDMO services; and administrative services, as well as sells raw and scrap materials. Further, the company engages in the laboratory-used biological assets cultivation business. WuXi AppTec Co., Ltd. was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Shanghai, the People's Republic of China.

name: Hoshine Silicon Industry Co., Ltd.
summary: Hoshine Silicon Industry Co., Ltd. produces and sells silicon-based materials in China and internationally. It offers silicon metals and metal powders; and silicone monomer, intermediate, rubber RTV and HTV, sealant, fluid, and fumed silica, as well as graphite carbon electrode. The company was founded in 2005 and is based in Pinghu, China.

name: TSI Group Co Ltd
summary: Based in Shanghai, this enterprise is dedicated to the research, development, production, and distribution of dietary nutritional supplements. Its prominent offerings encompass critical ingredients such as GlucosaGreen (a vegan form of glucosamine), myHMB (β-hydroxy β-methylbutyrate), PEAK ATP (adenosine triphosphate), and an array of additional beneficial health compounds.

name: Ningbo Tianlong Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Ningbo Tianlong Electronics Co., Ltd. produces and sells plastic parts for electronic products in China. The company offers industrial parts for use in medium-low and low voltage products, adapters, and low-voltage terminals and distribution cabinets. It also provides plastic casings for cellular phones and digital cameras; and high precision plastic parts, such as car cooling fans, gears, gear housings, BCM housings, GID/TID housings, brush holders, filter components, and other small components for vehicles. In addition, the company produces molds for consumer products, precision automotive parts, precision industrial products, etc.; and plastic parts for printers and other consumer products, wall plates, and power sockets, as well as engages in the turnkey assembly of cell phone and digital camera mockup. Further, it offers plastic bobbins for deflector yolks, transformers, and ballasts, as well as PCM parts, control wall plates, and other precision plastic components. The company also exports its products to Japan, North America, Germany, and other countries. Ningbo Tianlong Electronics Co., Ltd. is based in Ningbo, China.

name: Beijing Yuanliu Hongyuan Electronic Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing Yuanliu Hongyuan Electronic Technology Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of electronic components in China and internationally. It offers chip, leaded, and metal bracket multilayer ceramic capacitors, as well as DC filters. The company also sells electronic components as agents of other manufacturers. Its products are used in civilian, aerospace, aviation, shipbuilding, weapons, electronic information, rail roads, alternative energy, and other industries. Beijing Yuanliu Hongyuan Electronic Technology Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2001 and is based in Beijing, China.

name: Guangdong Songfa Ceramics Co.,Ltd.
summary: Guangdong Songfa Ceramics Co.,Ltd. designs, produces, and sells chinaware products worldwide. It operates through three divisions: Family Use Chinaware, Tailor Made Chinaware, and Hotel Use Chinaware. The company offers a line of household products, including tableware, tea and coffee sets, decorative chinaware products, and collections, as well as stainless steel, crystal, and glass household products. It also provides dinnerware, and cups and saucers, as well as tailor made products for families, businesses, and weddings. The company was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Chaozhou, China.

name: Jiangsu Seagull Cooling Tower Co.,Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu Seagull Cooling Tower Co.,Ltd. manufactures and supplies cooling technologies in China and internationally.
