It offers seawater, high level water collection, low-noise enclose type, closed type, FRP, concrete, plume-abatement and water-saving, and steel structure cooling towers; and spare parts, such as nozzles, drift eliminators, plume abatements, silencing devices, fills, and fan stacks and systems. The company also provides installation and commissioning services. It serves customers in petrochemical, chemical, power plant, steel plant, and sugar mill applications. The company was founded in 1997 and is based in Changzhou, China.

name: Yong Jie New Material Co Ltd
summary: Yong Jie New Material Co., Ltd. is dedicated to the comprehensive process surrounding aluminum products. This includes their innovation through research and development, manufacturing, and ultimately, market distribution. The company provides a diverse portfolio of aluminum materials, encompassing various configurations such as sheets, alloys, foil, coils, panels, and strips.

name: Zhejiang Lianxiang Smart Home Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Lianxiang Smart Home Co., Ltd. focuses on the entire lifecycle of embroidered wall coverings within the Chinese market, from their research and development to manufacturing and ultimate sale. Its diverse product portfolio encompasses various wall covering styles, including intricate embroidery, jacquard, 'fine printing 230', Inca embroidered patterns, and modern digital prints. The company also produces collar embroidered curtains, all sold under its LEADSHOW brand. Established in 2004, the firm's headquarters are situated in Jiaxing, China.

name: Jiangsu Teeyer Intelligent Equipment Co.,Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu Teeyer Intelligent Equipment Co., Ltd., a Chinese enterprise, excels in the entire process of automated and mechanical support machinery, from initial research and conceptualization to manufacturing and sales across China. Their diverse offerings include equipment for raw material preparation, such as grinding mills, slurry mixers, storage tanks and silos, jaw crushers, various conveyors, and dust collection systems. They also provide advanced solutions for automated steel mesh fabrication and circulation, encompassing mesh welding machines, wax-dipping and lifting mechanisms, dowel insertion and extraction hoists, assembly line conveyors for mesh frames, and anti-corrosive liquid dipping and drying systems. The company's portfolio extends to precision cutting machines, featuring both cross and vertical cutters, mobile cutting units, tongue-and-groove milling devices, vacuum suction hoods, tiling hoists, and top-and-bottom cleaning systems. For autoclaving processes, they supply essential components like traction mechanisms, transfer carts for pre- and post-autoclave operations, hardening trolleys, the autoclaves themselves, automated mobile bridges, and integrated gas distribution and recovery systems. Furthermore, their expertise covers finished product packaging, offering separators, clamping and rotating hoists for products, conveyor lines, and specialized packaging and stretch film machines. Beyond physical equipment, they deliver comprehensive production control systems, alongside project management and integrated operation and maintenance services. Founded in 1958, the company's base of operations is in Changzhou, China.

name: Jiangsu Hengxing New Material
summary: Jiangsu Hengxing New Material Technology Co., Ltd is an international enterprise specializing in the research, development, and production of chemical substances. The company's diverse product line includes various organic compounds such as ketones, acids, esters, alcohols, aldehydes, ethers, and acid anhydrides. Its main operations are headquartered in Jiangsu, China.

name: Yindu Kitchen Equipment Co., Ltd
summary: Yindu Kitchen Equipment Co., Ltd. engages in the research, design, manufacture, direct sale, and after-sale services of commercial kitchen equipment in China and internationally. It offers commercial and display refrigerators, chafing dish and gas equipment, and ice maker machines under the Yindu Catering, Issa, and Five Arrows sub brands. The company was founded in 2003 and is based in Hangzhou, China.

name: Shandong Daye Co., Ltd.
summary: Shandong Daye Co., Ltd. researches and develops, manufactures, and distributes bead wires, steel cords, hose wires, and complex products in China. The company is based in Zhucheng, China.

name: Jingjin Environmental Protection Co.,Ltd.
summary: Jingjin Environmental Protection Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells filter press machines and related equipment for use in environmental protection, chemical engineering, food, pharmaceutical, metallurgy, and coal industry. Its products include filter press, low temperature dryer, filter press, filter plate, filter press auxiliary system, filter press accessories, filter equipment, and filter cloth. The company was founded in 1988 and is based in Dezhou, China.

name: Suzhou Secote Precision Electronic Co.,LTD
summary: Suzhou Secote Precision Electronic Co.,LTD provides automation solutions in China. It also involved in integrating non-standard automation research and development program design, precision machining, assembly and commissioning, installation training, and service support activities. The company's solutions comprise automated assembly of line bodies, packaging lines, measuring equipment, test equipment, and treatment tools; and intelligent manufacturing and smart factory overall planning services, including technical consultation and feasibility analysis. It also undertakes turnkey projects, such as data experiment, system design, program writing, system integration, installation, and commissioning, as well as provides industrial laser processing equipment comprising laser welding, laser ultra-fine processing, laser marking, laser cleaning solutions, etc. The company's products are used in the consumer electronics, automotive, medical, home appliances, daily chemicals, food, cosmetics, commodity, laser, and other industries. Suzhou Secote Precision Electronic Co.,LTD was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Suzhou, China.

name: Jiangsu Riying Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu Riying Electronics Co., Ltd. designs, manufactures, and sells automotive washing systems and wiring harnesses. It offers washing systems for front and rear windshields, headlights, and sensors; precision injections; vehicle electronics, such as rain, temperature, and sunlight light sensors, as well as sunroof controllers; and automotive wiring harnesses and connectors. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Changzhou, China.

name: Foshan Haitian Flavouring and Food Company Ltd.
summary: Foshan Haitian Flavouring and Food Company Ltd. produces and sells flavorings and food products in China. It provides soy sauce, oyster sauce, paste, vinegar, cooking wine, granulated chicken bouillon, fermented beancurd, seasoning extract, chicken powder seasoning, sesame oil, monosodium glutamate, pickle, and grain products, as well as drinks and gift boxes. The company also exports its products to approximately 60 countries and regions worldwide. Foshan Haitian Flavouring and Food Company Ltd. was founded in 1955 and is based in Foshan, China.

name: Tederic Machinery Co., Ltd.
summary: Tederic Machinery Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells professional injection molding machine (IMM) products worldwide. The company offers toggle type, two-platen, full electric type, and multicolor IMM production lines, as well as related components. Its products have applications in auto parts, home appliances, logistics, industrial and civil products, utility tunnel and pipe fitting, electronics and office automation, and food and medicine package industries. The company was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.

name: StarPower Semiconductor Ltd.
summary: StarPower Semiconductor Ltd. researches, develops, produces and sells power semiconductor components worldwide. The company offers IGBT, MOSFET, IPM, FRD, SiC, and other modules. Its products are used in energy vehicles, inverters, inverter welding machines, ups, photovoltaic/wind power, SVG, white goods, and other fields. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Jiaxing, China.

name: Huaqin Co., Ltd.
summary: Huaqin Co., Ltd. researches, develops, designs and distributes smart hardware products, including mobile phones, laptops, tablets, smart wearables, AIoT products and servers. The company was founded by Wen Sheng Qiu in 2005 and has its head office in Shanghai, China.

name: Ningbo Yongxin Optics Co., Ltd.
summary: Ningbo Yong Xin Optics Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells optical instruments and components in China. It offers optical microscopes and optical components used for various applications in optical and electronic products, such as bar-code scanners, motion optics, automotive driving, high-end cameras, HD projection, teaching, life sciences, semiconductors, etc. The company offers its products under the NOVEL, JIANGNAN, and NEXCOPE brands. It also exports its products to approximately 100 countries. The company was formerly known as Ningbo Yongxin Optical Instrument Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Ningbo Yong Xin Optics Co., Ltd. in 2000. Ningbo Yong Xin Optics Co., Ltd. was founded in 1997 and is based in Ningbo, China.

name: Hangcha Group Co., Ltd
summary: Hangcha Group Co., Ltd manufactures and sells forklift trucks in China. The company's material handling equipment include internal combustion (IC) forklift trucks, electric forklift trucks, warehouse equipment, tow tractors, side loading forklifts, explosion proof forklifts, empty container handlers, reach stacker, lifting platforms, and pallet truck forks for roll goods, as well as OEM components and parts, spare parts, and after-services internationally. It is also involved in the import and export activities. The company was founded in 1956 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.

name: Jiang Su Suyan Jingshen Co.,Ltd.
summary: Jiang Su Suyan Jingshen Co.,Ltd. engages in the research, production, distribution, and sale of salt and salt chemicals in Southeast Asia. It offers industrial and edible salts, calcined soda, sodium sulfate, calcium chloride, and other products under the Huai and Jingshen brands. The company was formerly known as Jiangsu Jingshen Salt & Chemical Industry Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Jiang Su Suyan Jingshen Co.,Ltd. in January 2019. Jiang Su Suyan Jingshen Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Huai'an, China.

name: Zhejiang Huatie Emergency Equipment Science & Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Huatie Emergency Equipment Science & Technology Co.,Ltd. engages in the rental of construction equipment in China. The company leases various steel support, bailey, bowl buckle, steel, and other security support equipment; professional construction safety support equipment for urban rail construction, civil construction, etc.; and multi-functional scaffoldings and steel pipes, fasteners, and wheeled scaffolding. It also provides stress monitoring systems for construction safety; and optimization design, maintenance, and other business services. In addition, the company offers deep foundation pit support stress testing equipment, as well as development of building support technology, building construction safety maintenance services, and deep foundation pit support stress testing equipment design, installation, and repair services. Its products are used in the construction of buildings, viaducts, overpasses, highways, railways, bridges, power plants, and other projects. The company was formerly known as Zhejiang Huatie Construction Safety Science and Technology Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Zhejiang Huatie Emergency Equipment Science & Technology Co.,Ltd. in September 2019. Zhejiang Huatie Emergency Equipment Science & Technology Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.

name: Zhende Medical Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhende Medical Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of medical products in China and internationally. It offers medical dressing products, pressure treatment and fixation products, wound care products, surgical infection management products, incontinence care products, industrial automation equipment, etc. The company is headquartered in Shaoxing, China.

name: Hengdian Group Tospo Lighting Co., Ltd.
summary: Hengdian Group Tospo Lighting Co., Ltd. researches and develops, manufactures, and sells light source products, Indoor lightings, professional lightings, lighting control products, structural components, and engineering plastics. Its products include LED bulbs, spotlights, decorative lights, straight tubes and pipes, energy-saving lamps, LED indoor lighting products, panel lights, downlights, bracket lights, grille lights, intelligent lamps, street lamps, floodlights, mining lamps, wall lamps, security lamps, and other products. The company was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Dongyang, China. Hengdian Group Tospo Lighting Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of Hengdian Group Holdings Limited.

name: Ningbo Xusheng Auto Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Ningbo Xusheng Auto Technology Co., Ltd. produces and sells auto parts and industrial parts. The company offers gearshift system, and transmission and battery systems; and heavy truck clutch, battery pack, motor, transmission, and reducer housings, as well as motor and reducer integrated cases. The company was formerly known as Ningbo Xusheng Machinery Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Ningbo Xusheng Auto Technology Co., Ltd. in August 2015. The company was founded in 2003 and is based in Ningbo, China.

name: HMT (Xiamen) New Technical Materials Co., Ltd
summary: HMT (Xiamen) New Technical Materials Co., Ltd. is an enterprise actively engaged in the research, development, production, and global distribution of various fabrics, serving both its domestic market in China and international clients. The company's diverse product range features specialized textiles such as materials for automotive airbags, complete airbag modules (including One-Piece Woven - OPW technology), safety belt fabrics, mesh materials, and bulletproof textiles, alongside a broader selection of industrial fabrics. Established in Xiamen, China, in 2002, the firm was initially named Huamao (Xiamen) Technical Textile Co., Ltd. before officially adopting its current corporate identity, HMT (Xiamen) New Technical Materials Co., Ltd., in 2010.

name: Anhui Yingliu Electromechanical Co., Ltd.
summary: Anhui Yingliu Electromechanical Co., Ltd. develops, manufactures, and sells high-precision steel casted and machined components in China, Europe, and the United States. It offers various steel castings, including intermediate and finished products, as well as investment castings. The company also offers nuclear products for nuclear equipment manufacturers and technology providers. It serves various industries comprising petroleum and natural gas; electric power generation, including nuclear, coal-fired, hydro, and wind plants; mining machinery devices; construction machinery, chemicals flow-control, medical, refrigeration flow-control, and environment flow-control equipment; and railroad, ship, and other transport equipment. Anhui Yingliu Electromechanical Co., Ltd. is based in Hefei, China.

name: Well Lead Medical Co., Ltd.
summary: Well Lead Medical Co., Ltd. specializes in the comprehensive process of researching, producing, and commercializing medical catheters. These essential devices serve critical applications in various fields such as anesthesia, urology, respiratory care, and hemodialysis. The company's product portfolio also extends to drainage, suction, and nutritional delivery systems. Its offerings are integral to hospital environments, supporting surgical operations, therapeutic interventions, and both emergency and routine clinical patient management. Founded in Guangzhou, China, in 2004, the firm boasts a significant global presence, distributing its solutions across key markets including China, North America, Europe, and Japan.

name: Zhejiang Goldensea Hi-Tech Co., Ltd
summary: Zhejiang Goldensea Hi-Tech Co., Ltd is a prominent manufacturer and distributor of environmental filtration solutions, serving both domestic Chinese and international markets. Its extensive product portfolio encompasses a wide array of specialized filters, including those designed for air purifiers, fresh air systems, automotive and rail transit air conditioning, ventilation fans, and office automation (OA) equipment. Beyond filters, the company also produces air conditioning wind wheels, full heat exchangers, standalone air purifiers, and vehicle-mounted purification units. Furthermore, its capabilities extend to the supply of screens, fans, injection-molded parts and components, and precision molds. Established in 1992, the company previously operated as Zhejiang Goldensea Environment Technology Co.,Ltd. It maintains its headquarters in Shanghai, China.

name: Suzhou W Deane New Power Elec
summary: Suzhou West Deane New Power Electric Co., Ltd., based in Suzhou, China, is an enterprise focused on the entire process of electrical connection product development. This encompasses research, design, production, and market distribution. Their specialized offerings include cutting-edge battery connection systems and composite busbars. The company was co-founded by Shu Xin Pan and Jian Hua Sheng on May 31, 2007.

name: Healthcare Co., Ltd.
summary: Healthcare Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells memory foam products in China. The company provides foam toppers, mattresses, sofas, and pillows. It also sells its products under the MLILY brand through company-owned retail shops. The company also exports its products to Europe, Russia, the Middle East, and North Africa. Healthcare Co., Ltd. was founded in 2003 and is based in Rugao, China.

name: Liaoning Fu-An Heavy Industry Co.,Ltd
summary: Liaoning Fu-An Heavy Industry Co.,Ltd is a key manufacturer and supplier specializing in steel castings for a variety of technical and industrial equipment applications. The company's extensive product portfolio encompasses a wide array of cast components, including high/medium pressure inner and outer cylinders, cubic slag tanks, ton archways, partition covers and sleeves, PAC MA servomotor cylinder heads, cranks, suction ring cavities, tugboats, bearing seats, TW blades, baishan leafs, guide vanes, runner hubs, lower ring bands, crowns, steam seal bodies, elbows, frames, wheels, and bogies. Beyond its core casting operations, Liaoning Fu-An Heavy Industry Co.,Ltd also delivers advanced integrated unit control systems, industrial gas turbine generator sets, standalone gas turbines, and various other specialized equipment. Established in 2004, the company is headquartered in Anshan, China.

name: Chengbang Eco-Environment Co.,Ltd.
summary: Chengbang Eco-Environment Co.,Ltd. primarily operates in the construction industry in China. The company provides integrated solutions in the areas of consulting planning, planning and design, investment and construction, and maintenance and operation management. The company provides urban and rural, tourism, and cultural creative planning services; landscape architectural and construction engineering services; landscaping services; services in the areas of water pollution control, soil remediation, and geological disaster management; and tourism and its information consultancy services. It also undertakes municipal public, lighting, water conservancy, and cultural relics protection works, as well as housing construction, municipal utility, and ancient building projects; and operates thematic scenic spots and characteristic towns. The company was formerly known as Zhejiang Chengbang Landscape Co.,Ltd. The company was founded in 1996 and is based in Hangzhou, China.

name: Sichuan Teway Food Group Co.,Ltd
summary: Sichuan Teway Food Group Co.,Ltd engages in the research, development, production, and sale of flavor compound seasonings under the Da Hong Pao, Good Family, Celebrity, and Ignition names in China. The company also exports its products to the United States, Britain, Canada, Australia, and other countries. Sichuan Teway Food Group Co.,Ltd is based in Chengdu, China.

name: Dalian Energas Gas-System Co., Ltd.
summary: Dalian Energas Gas-System Co., Ltd. designs, manufactures, sells, and services fuel gas transmission-distribution systems and related products in China and internationally. Its primary products include fuel gas distribution systems, fuel gas application systems, spare parts, etc. The company's application system products comprise auxiliary equipment for gas turbines, material supply directly pipes for gas turbines, and seal pipes of steam turbines. It also provides gas distribution systems comprising boosting stations, reducing stations, long-distance pipeline distribution systems, offshore platform distribution systems, and city gate stations; gas application systems consisting of final and fuel, water washing, and lubricating oil skids, as well as MSD and seal piping systems; and distributed energy solutions, such as combined cooling heating and power systems. In addition, the company offers fuel gas pressure regulating boxes and regulators, and LNG gas filling stations. Further, it provides manufacturing, packing, transportation, erection, commissioning, start-up, and after sale services. The company was founded in 2002 and is based in Dalian, China.

name: Hunan Meihu Intelligent Manufacturing Co., Ltd.
summary: Hunan Meihu Intelligent Manufacturing Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of engine oil pumps, water pumps, transmission pumps, and other pump products for the automotive industry in China and internationally. The company's main products include diesel and gasoline engine oil pumps, electric pumps, modular products, and precision gears.

name: ZHEJIANG DIBAY ELECTRIC CO.,Ltd.
summary: ZHEJIANG DIBAY ELECTRIC CO.,Ltd. researches, develops, manufactures, and sells mechanical and electrical compressor motors to high-tech enterprises in China. It offers energy, air, and aluminum refrigerator compressor motors. The company was founded in 1985 and is based in Shengzhou, China.

name: Zhejiang Meilun Elevator Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Meilun Elevator Co., Ltd. designs, manufactures, and sells elevators and escalators in China. It offers passenger and freight elevators; moving walks; and elevator accessories. The company was founded in 1979 and is based in Shaoxing, China.

name: Super Telecom Co.,Ltd
summary: Super Telecom Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, provides communication, ICT, and new energy services in China. The company offers telecommunication technology services, including communication engineering and maintenance, network optimization, and IoT maintenance services; intelligent hardware, such as full-band NB-IoT chip, communication modules, small cell, smart meters, and fire control hardware; and IoT solutions comprising intelligent water utilities, gas, energy, fire control, air conditioning control, logistics, manufacture, retail, and agriculture, as well as smart street lamps and elevator safety monitoring solutions. It is also involved in the new energy services comprising design, survey, NDRC report, and grid connection of photovoltaic small cells, including photovoltaic small cells and track lighting systems; energy storage application products, including container standard cabinet based on lithium batteries; and backup power applications. In addition, the company offers micro-power wireless IoT and LoRa/NB-IoT modules; cloud platform services; energy-saving goods; and emission reduction and energy management solutions. Further, it engages in computing power; manufacture of computer, communication, and other electronic equipment; internet and related services; research and experimental development; construction and installation; AI; energy technology technical services; software and information technology; and technology promotion and application services. The company serves the e-commerce, logistics, manufacturing, retail, healthcare, finance, and civil service industries. The company was formerly known as GuangDong Super Telecom Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Super Telecom Co.,Ltd in May 2019. Super Telecom Co.,Ltd was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Guangzhou, China.

name: Jiangsu Suzhou Rural Commercial Bank Co., Ltd
summary: Jiangsu Suzhou Rural Commercial Bank Co., Ltd, a financial institution operating across China, delivers a comprehensive suite of banking and financial services to both individual consumers and corporate clients. Its offerings encompass various deposit options, such as current and savings accounts, alongside certificates of deposit. The bank also provides diverse lending facilities, including general loans and specialized financing for corporate entities and small-to-medium enterprises (SMEs). Additional services cover wealth management, digital banking platforms, and card issuance. For international operations, the bank facilitates trade finance and settlement, letters of credit, and foreign currency savings and exchange. Established in 2004, the institution initially operated as Jiangsu Wujiang Rural Commercial Bank Co., Ltd. before adopting its current name, Jiangsu Suzhou Rural Commercial Bank Co., Ltd., in March 2019. Its headquarters are located in Suzhou, China.

name: Shanghai Sheng Jian Environment Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Sheng Jian Environment Technology Co., Ltd. is engaged in providing environmental protection solutions and services. The company focuses on waste gas treatment, water treatment, and soil remediation projects. They are based in Shanghai, China.

name: Shanghai Bloom Technology, Inc.
summary: Shanghai Bloom Technology, Inc. specializes in delivering comprehensive system solutions for the management of powdered and granular materials. Its expertise spans pneumatic conveyance, precise metering and mixing, secure storage, thorough blending, and homogenization of these substances. Additionally, the company provides corresponding components, replacement parts, and related support services. Established on November 19, 2001, its principal office is located in Shanghai, China.

name: Nanjing OLO Home Furnishing Co.,Ltd
summary: Nanjing OLO Home Furnishing Co.,Ltd. designs, develops, produces, and sells home furnishing products in China. It offers kitchen cabinets and full-house furniture. The company was founded in 2006 and is based in Nanjing, China.

name: Sichuan Furong Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Sichuan Furong Technology Co., Ltd engages in the research, development, production, and sale of aluminum structural parts for consumer electronics products. Its products are used as materials for housings, back plates, and middle frames of consumer electronics products, such as smart phones, tablets, and notebook computers. The company is based in Chengdu, China.

name: Guangdong Ellington Electronics Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Guangdong Ellington Electronics Technology Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells double-sided and multi-layered printed circuit boards in China. Its products are used in computers and computer peripherals, consumer electronics, communication products, industrial controls, automotive electronics, medical instructions, etc. The company was formerly known as Ellington Co., Ltd and changed its name to Guangdong Ellington Electronics Technology Co., Ltd. in November 2007. The company was founded in 2000 and is based in Zhongshan, China.

name: Shanghai Ace Investment & Development Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Ace Investment & Development Co., Ltd., established in 2003 and headquartered in Shanghai, China, operates as a subsidiary of Jiangsu Yashi Investment Group Co., Ltd. This company specializes in comprehensive supply chain management across China, focusing on both logistics services and supply chain execution trading. Its extensive offerings include multimodal transportation via rail, road, and waterways, as well as third-party logistics (3PL) solutions. The firm also provides bonded warehousing, manages loading and unloading operations, and offers supervision for warehousing and logistics activities. Furthermore, it actively engages in the logistics and trade of various commodities, such as sulfur, fertilizers, non-ferrous metals, mineral products, and other general goods.

name: Tianyang New Materials (Shanghai) Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Tianyang Hot Melt Adhesives Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells thermoplastic hot melt and reactive adhesive products in China and internationally. It offers copolyester and copolyamide powders; web, film, and PUR adhesives; modified polyamide materials; solar encapsulation films; and electronic adhesives. Its products are used in clothing and textile; automobile interior; electronic appliances; EVA encapsulation; reflective, shoe, and construction materials; industrial filtration; home decoration; printing packaging; interior decoration; and paint and other fields. The company was formerly known as Shanghai Sanren Chemical Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Shanghai Tianyang Hot Melt Adhesives Co., Ltd. in 2002. Shanghai Tianyang Hot Melt Adhesives Co., Ltd. was founded in 1993 and is based in Shanghai, China.

name: Zhejiang Baida Precision Manufacturing Corp.
summary: Zhejiang Baida Precision Manufacturing Corp. produces and sells air-conditioning compressor parts, refrigerator compressor parts, auto parts, cold extrusion parts, and other products in China. The company also exports its products to approximately 10 countries and regions in Europe, the United States, Southeast Asia, etc. Zhejiang Baida Precision Manufacturing Corp. was founded in 1995 and is based in Taizhou, China.

name: Suzhou Longjie Special Fiber Co., Ltd.
summary: Suzhou Longjie Special Fiber Co., Ltd. engages in the production and sale of various polyester filaments in China and internationally. Its products primary include FDY and DTY island composite fiber; DTY eco-friendly three-dimensional composite colored fiber; FDY flat filament series products; monocomponent potential controllable crimpled fiber; and PTT fiber, as well as various polyester industrial filaments, such as high strength type, high strength low contraction type, high strength abrasion-proof type, activated type, anti-wicking type, fine-denier type, etc. The company is based in Zhangjiagang, China.

name: Sunway Co., Ltd.
summary: Sunway Co., Ltd. designs, manufactures, and sells cable products for nuclear power stations. The company was formerly known as Sichuan Star Cable Co., Ltd. Sunway Co., Ltd. was founded in 2003 and is based in Leshan, China.

name: Suzhou Fengbei Biotech Stock Co.
summary: Suzhou Fengbei Biotech Stock Co., Ltd. centers its operations around the extensive repurposing of waste oil resources, also maintaining a division for oleochemicals. The company predominantly manufactures valuable products derived from recycled oils and fats. Its offerings include bio-based materials, biofuels, DD oil, and various fatty acids. This enterprise, based in Suzhou, China, commenced its activities on July 25, 2014.

name: Guangdong Dcenti Auto-Parts Stock Limited Company
summary: Guangdong Dcenti Auto-Parts Stock Limited Company researches and develops, manufactures, and sells auto-parts in China. It provides aluminum alloy wheels to chain stores. The company offers STW, LM, and DCTL wheels under the DCENTI brand name; Borghini, Red Sport, U2, Velocity, and GIMA wheels under the Velocity series; and RDR wheels under the RDR series. It also exports its products. The company was formerly known as Stonewell International Corporation and changed its name to Guangdong Dcenti Auto-Parts Stock Limited Company in July 2014. Guangdong Dcenti Auto-Parts Stock Limited Company was founded in 1999 and is based in Taishan, China.

name: Great-Sun Foods Co., Ltd.
summary: Great-Sun Foods Co., Ltd. is a comprehensive agricultural enterprise focused on the entire supply chain for fruits and vegetables. Its operations encompass every stage, from cultivation and post-harvest acquisition, including field pre-cooling and frozen storage, through meticulous product selection, classification, processing, and packaging, culminating in cold chain distribution. The company offers an extensive and diverse range of fresh produce. Its fruit selection includes popular staples like apples, cherries, and grapes, alongside exotic varieties such as durians, mangosteens, and dragon fruits, to more specialized items like kumquats and winter dates. For vegetables, Great-Sun Foods provides a wide array spanning common options like cauliflowers, spinach, and potatoes, to specialty items including various mushrooms, bamboo shoots, and water chestnuts. Beyond its domestic market, Great-Sun Foods maintains a global presence, exporting its products to numerous international destinations across North America (U.S., Canada), Australia, Southeast Asia, Hong Kong, India, and the Middle East. The company was established in 1992 and is headquartered in Shantou, People's Republic of China.

name: Jack Sewing Machine Co., Ltd.
summary: Jack Sewing Machine Co., Ltd. designs and manufactures sewing equipment in China and internationally. The company provides spreading, automatic cutting, lockstitch, overlock, interlock, special, and automatic pocket welting machines, as well as motors. Its products are used in various industries, such as apparel, footwear, luggage, furniture, leather, automotive, aerospace, etc. The company was founded in 1995 and is based in Taizhou, China.

name: Zhejiang Dingli Machinery Co.,Ltd
summary: Zhejiang Dingli Machinery Co.,Ltd develops, manufactures, and sells various aerial working platforms in China, Europe, the United States, Asia, and Africa. It offers self-propelled telescopic and articulating boom lifts; scissor lifts; self-propelled vertical lifts and mobile vertical lifts; self-propelled aerial stock pickers and mobile aerial stock pickers; and mast climbers. The company's products are used in construction, commercial and industrial, and national defense and military fields. Zhejiang Dingli Machinery Co.,Ltd was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Deqing, China.

name: Square Technology Group Co.,Ltd
summary: Square Technology Group Co.,Ltd is a Chinese company that specializes in the research, development, manufacturing, and marketing of food refrigeration equipment and specialized tank containers. Its advanced freezing technology serves a wide array of food industries, providing solutions for items such as aquatic products, various types of noodles, fruits and vegetables, meats, prepared and fast foods, snack items, and ice cream. While primarily focused on the domestic market, the company also distributes its products globally. Established in 1990, Square Technology Group is based in Nantong, China.

name: Shanghai Longcheer Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Longcheer Technology Co., Ltd. is an enterprise that comprehensively researches, designs, develops, manufactures, and provides after-sales service for a wide range of smart electronic products. Its primary offerings include mobile phones, tablets, smart wearable devices, artificial intelligence (AI) and virtual reality (VR) solutions, and automotive electronics. The company serves both domestic Chinese and international markets. Complementing its core portfolio, Longcheer Technology also produces True Wireless Stereo (TWS) products, digital photo frames, smart home systems, and various smart audio and speaker devices. The firm's clientele primarily consists of leading consumer electronics brands and technology-focused enterprises. Established in 2002, Shanghai Longcheer Technology Co., Ltd. is headquartered in Shanghai, China.

name: Cinderson Tech (Suzhou) Co., Ltd.
summary: Established in Suzhou, China, in 2004, this enterprise specializes in the research, manufacturing, and distribution of micro and specialized motors, in addition to associated products. These motor solutions are extensively utilized in household cleaning appliances, various power tools, and garden machinery.

name: Fujian Anjoy Foods Co., Ltd.
summary: Fujian Anjoy Foods Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of frozen fish and meat products in China. The company primarily offers fried fish balls, Q fish plates, and fish tofu and other quick-frozen surimi products; dumplings, pee meatballs, kiss intestines, and other quick-frozen meat products; and hand-caught cakes, as well as frozen noodles and rice products and frozen dishes. The company markets its products through a network of distributors, supermarkets, special communications, and e-commerce channels. The company was founded in 2001 and is based in Xiamen, China.

name: Guangdong Wencan Die Casting Co., Ltd.
summary: Guangdong Wencan Die Casting Co., Ltd. researches, develops, produces, and sells automobile aluminum alloy precision die castings worldwide. Its automobile castings include engine systems, electronic control systems, transmission systems, chassis steering systems, brake systems, air management systems, wiper systems, and body structure parts. The company also provides non-automotive pressure castings, including yacht driving axle housings, yacht engine covers, and heat sinks. Guangdong Wencan Die Casting Co., Ltd. was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Foshan, China.

name: Ananda Drive Techniques(Shanghai)Co., Ltd.
summary: Ananda Drive Techniques (Shanghai) Co., Ltd., established in 2011 and headquartered in Shanghai, China, specializes in the development, manufacturing, and distribution of electric propulsion systems. The company primarily targets the electric two-wheeler market within China. Its product range includes components such as reduction hub motors, mid-mounted motors, and batteries. Additionally, Ananda Drive Techniques offers complete electric drive systems, which integrate essential elements like controllers, sensors, and displays. The company also produces relays and industrial control equipment.

name: Nanjing Well Pharmaceutical Group Co.,Ltd.
summary: Nanjing Well Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd., founded in 2000 and headquartered in Nanjing, China, is primarily engaged in the research, development, manufacturing, and distribution of pharmaceutical excipients within the Chinese market. These essential auxiliary materials are utilized in both injectable and non-injectable drug formulations. Beyond its pharmaceutical focus, the company also supplies an extensive range of synthetic base oils for various industrial applications, including hydraulic fluids, lubricity additives for metals, metal quenching agents, compression lubricants, gear oils, chain lubricants, and base stocks for engine oils, heat transfer oils, and greases. Furthermore, its product portfolio diversifies into other specialized chemicals such as paints and coatings, textile chemicals, field chemicals, and low-foam metal cleaners. The company boasts a global presence, exporting its products to key markets in Europe, the United States, Southeast Asia, and other international regions. Originally known as Nanjing Well Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., the company officially adopted its current name, Nanjing Well Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd., in April 2020.

name: Chongqing Zhixin Indl Co. Ltd.
summary: Chongqing Zhixin Industrial Co., Ltd. is dedicated to the design, manufacturing, and distribution of automotive components produced through stamping and welding techniques, along with their related molds. The company's product portfolio includes: Cold-stamped parts: This category features items such as floor panels, taillight brackets, water flow channels, wheel hub packages, roof skylights, beam roofs, brake disc dust covers, heat shields, and bracket reinforcements. Thermoformed components: Their offerings here encompass door knockers, both coated and uncoated boards, plates with unequal thicknesses, and patch board varieties. Welded assemblies: These comprise front and rear longitudinal beams, wheel hub assemblies, floor assemblies, battery box covers, and CCB (steering support) units. Molds and tools: Their comprehensive tooling range covers thermoforming molds, transfers, 2D/3D molds, progressive dies, and connection molds, as well as necessary gauges and welding tools. Founded in 1995, the company is based in Chongqing, China.

name: Hunan Heshun Petroleum Co.,Ltd.
summary: Hunan Heshun Petroleum Co., Ltd. engages in the wholesale and retail of gasoline and diesel in China. It is also involved in the gas station and convenience store operation, refined oil storage, and refined oil logistics and distribution activities, as well as investment and construction of gas stations and oil depots. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Changsha, China.

name: Kingclean Electric Co.Ltd
summary: Kingclean Electric Co.Ltd manufactures and sells high-speed and automobile motors, cleaning and kitchen appliances, and garden tool products in the People's Republic of China. Its products include vacuum cleaners, high pressure washers, motors, car motors, hard floor polishers, and carpet washers, as well as small home appliances, such as food cooking machines, juicers, and soymilk makers. The company also exports its products. The company was founded in 1994 and is based in Suzhou, the People's Republic of China.

name: Xuancheng Valin Precision Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Xuancheng Valin Precision Technology Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells elevator counterweight blocks, elevator compensation cables, sheet metal products, and processed products and other machinery accessories in China and internationally. The company was formerly known as Xuancheng Hualing Elevator Parts Co., Ltd. Xuancheng Valin Precision Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2005 and is based in Lang Xi, China.

name: Anhui Transport Consulting & Design Institute Co.,Ltd.
summary: Anhui Transport Consulting & Design Institute Co., Ltd., along with its subsidiaries, specializes in offering comprehensive engineering survey, design, and advisory services to clients both in China and worldwide. The company provides expertise across a wide array of infrastructure and development sectors, including road networks, waterborne transportation, municipal infrastructure, building construction, water resource management, ecological and territorial remediation, and landscape planning. Furthermore, its specialized services extend to encompass transportation strategic planning, soil and water conservation, environmental impact assessments, urban development schemes, and geological disaster evaluations. Established in 1960, the firm's main operational base is located in Hefei, People's Republic of China.

name: Huada Automotive Technology Corp.,Ltd
summary: Huada Automotive Technology Corp.,Ltd produces and sells car parts and components primarily in China. The company was founded in 1990 and is based in Jingjiang, China.

name: Dongzhu Ecological Environment Protection Co.,Ltd
summary: Dongzhu Ecological Environment Protection Co.,Ltd engages in the garden construction, and landscape planning and design businesses in China. The company is also involved in the ecological wetland; garden and municipal engineering construction; and green maintenance activities. In addition, it produces and sells seedlings. The company was founded in 2001 and is based in Wuxi, China.

name: Dalian BIO-CHEM Company Limited
summary: Established in 2003 and headquartered in Dalian, China, Dalian BIO-CHEM Company Limited specializes in the manufacture and distribution of antimicrobial agents, specifically bactericides, antiseptics, and fungicides. These products serve a broad spectrum of industrial sectors across continents, including Europe, North and South America, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia. The company's offerings perform various crucial functions: they act as disinfectants and effective algaecides for water treatment systems in industries like petrochemicals, power generation, central air conditioning, and industrial cooling. Additionally, they provide corrosion protection within aqueous systems, found in products such as emulsions, mineral slurries, pigment dispersions, adhesives, tackifiers, metalworking fluids, and cosmetics. Their solutions also extend to the aqueous formulations used in leather, paints, coatings, textiles, and dyeing processes. Furthermore, Dalian BIO-CHEM's products combat mildew and algae, and the company offers a specialized dry film preservative tailored for paints and coatings.

name: Fujian Aonong Biological Technology Group Incorporation Limited
summary: Fujian Aonong Biological Technology Group Incorporation Limited engages in the feed, animal protection, pig raising, raw materials trade, agricultural Internet, and other businesses in China and internationally. The company offers nutrition products; professional pig services; probiotics, such as bacillus, lactic acid bacteria, and yeast; and various mixed feed additives and liquid multi-dimensional additives. It also provides vaccines, veterinary drug preparations, micro ecological preparations, powders, premixes, oral liquids, and disinfectants, as well as terminally sterilized and sterilized non-intravenous. In addition, the company offers professional management systems, and information and trading platforms; and information solutions and services for the daily management of downstream pig farms, as well as support services to downstream customers. Further, it operates in breeding and insurance industries. The company was founded in 2011 and is based in Xiamen, China.

name: Shanghai Shuixing Home Textile Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Shuixing Home Textile Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, design, production, and sale of home textiles in China and internationally. It offers bedspreads, quilts, pillows, single-piece combinations, cushions, children's products, summer supplies, blankets, and others. The company sells its products through specialty stores and mall counters in China. Shanghai Shuixing Home Textile Co., Ltd. was founded in 2009 and is based in Shanghai, China.

name: Solareast Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: Solareast Holdings Co., Ltd. operates in solar thermal industry worldwide. The company's products include compact solar water heaters, including non-pressure, pressurized pre-heated, pressurized heat pipe, non-pressure and pressurized flat plate, and pressurized double tank solar water heaters; solar collectors comprising heat pipe, U pipe, CPC, DMG, flat plate, and non-pressure project collectors; split solar heating systems; and domestic series and swimming pool heat pumps, as well as water purifiers. It also offers accessories, such as controllers, collector mounting brackets, mounting brackets, flexible steel pipes, expansion tanks, and thermostatic mixing faucets. The company was formerly known as Jiangsu Sunrain Solar Energy Co.,Ltd. Solareast Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Lianyungang, China.

name: Cisen Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
summary: Cisen Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells chemical drug preparations and health care products in China and internationally. The company's chemical drug preparations include liver disease drugs, antitumor and auxiliary drugs, nutrition preparations, contrast agents, antibiotics, digestive system agents, polypropylene ampoules, and external preparations, as well as sedation anesthesia, cardiovascular, cough and asthma, immunomodulator, infusion, and therapeutic infusion products. It also engages in the formulation, development, manufacturing, and marketing of generic pharmaceutical products. The company was formerly known as Shandong Lukang Cisen Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Cisen Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. in 2011. Cisen Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. is based in Jining, the People's Republic of China.

name: Guangxi Liuzhou Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
summary: Guangxi Liuzhou Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. engages in the distribution and retail of pharmaceutical products in China. The company was founded in 1981 and is based in Liuzhou, China. Guangxi Liuzhou Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of Liuzhou Liangmianzhen Co., Ltd.

name: Jiangsu King's Luck Brewery Joint-Stock Co., Ltd.
summary: Established in 1996 and based in Huai'an, China, Jiangsu King's Luck Brewery Joint-Stock Co., Ltd. is involved in the manufacturing and distribution of alcoholic beverages. The company's product line, which includes both liquor and wine, is primarily marketed under the recognized brand names of Gaogou, Jinshiyuan, and Guoyuan.

name: Jiangyin Huaxin Precision Technology Corporation
summary: Jiangyin Huaxin Precision Technology Corporation is engaged in the research, development, production, and sale of precision stamping products. The company's main products are various types of precision stamped iron cores, including cores for new energy vehicle drive motors, micro motors, electrical equipment, and ignition coils. It also produces the precision stamping dies required for its core production and supplies its products to automotive parts manufacturers, motor manufacturers, and electrical equipment manufacturers.

name: Anbang Save-Guard Group Co.,Ltd.
summary: Anbang Save-Guard Group Co., Ltd., established in 2006 and headquartered in Hangzhou, China, delivers a comprehensive suite of security and outsourcing services, primarily catering to the financial sector. The company's core offerings include specialized armed escort for financial assets and robust financial outsourcing solutions, which encompass secure transport and custody services. Beyond these, Anbang provides integrated security services, ranging from safeguarding critical infrastructure and managing large-scale event security to designing, selling, and installing intelligent security systems, alongside offering professional security training. Furthermore, Anbang Save-Guard delivers diverse emergency response capabilities. These include property and document management for significant organizations, traffic incident emergency services, logistical management for social emergency materials, and essential emergency rescue operations. The company also extends its expertise to provide multi-tiered security frameworks and international security services.

name: Eastern Pioneer Driving School Co., Ltd
summary: Eastern Pioneer Driving School Co., Ltd provides motor vehicle and civil aircraft driving training services in China. It provides driving and flight training; agency; rental; catering; and accommodation services. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.

name: Asia Cuanon Technology (Shanghai) Co., Ltd.
summary: Asia Cuanon Technology (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, and service of functional architectural coatings, thermal insulation decorative panels and materials, and fire insulation products in China. The company also provides paint engineering coatings, plasters, tile adhesives, and interior wall and external wall insulation products. Its products are used in real estate, residential community, hotel/office, and public construction projects. The company is headquartered in Shanghai, China.

name: Zhejiang Sanmei Chemical Industry Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Sanmei Chemical Industry Co., Ltd. provides foaming agents/hydrofluoric acid, fluorinated refrigerant, ODS substitute products, fluoride salt, and calcium sulfate. The company is based in Jinhua, China.

name: Suzhou Etron Technologies Co.,Ltd.
summary: Suzhou Etron Technologies Co.,Ltd. provides electronics manufacturing services worldwide. The company offers industrial products, such as power supplies, motor driver devices, smart meters, and test measurement products for service system, wind power generation, and intelligent instrument industries; telecommunication products comprising wireless filter and DDCS for use in antenna buildings, data centers, and enterprise networks; and health care products consisting of assembled PCBA of medical devices that are used for the analysis, diagnosis, and treatment applications. It also provides automotive products; and consumer products in cleaning machines, electronical tools, sanitary ware, and others. The company was founded in 2001 and is based in Suzhou, China.

name: Yonz Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Yonz Technology Co.,Ltd. is a Chinese enterprise dedicated to the research, development, manufacturing, and commercialization of aluminum alloy structural components for photovoltaic (PV) systems. The firm offers a comprehensive range of products, including various types of PV frames, building-integrated photovoltaic (BIPV) solutions, solar aluminum alloy mounting brackets, and specialized solar roof tiles. Additionally, Yonz Technology engages in the distribution of other photovoltaic bracket components. These essential products are designed to be integral parts of photovoltaic modules. Headquartered in Changzhou, China, the company was established in 2016.

name: Fujian Apex Software Co.,LTD
summary: Fujian Apex Software Co.,LTD specializes in delivering sophisticated platform software and IT services throughout China. Its core offering is LiveBOS, a comprehensive business process management (BPM) platform. This system is engineered for diverse applications across the financial industry, spanning securities, futures, funds, banking and trust operations, electronic trading, and asset management. Headquartered in Fuzhou, China, the firm has been a market presence since its establishment in 1996.

name: Huida Sanitary Ware Co., Ltd.
summary: Huida Sanitary Ware Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells ceramic sanitary ware products in China and internationally. It offers smart toilet, toilet basins, bidets, bathroom cabinets, urinals, faucets, stainless steel kitchen sinks, showers, washing machine cabinets, bathtubs, shower rooms, unit bathrooms, bathroom accessories, and other products. The company was founded in 1982 and is based in Tangshan, China.

name: Guangdong Champion Asia Electronics Co.,Ltd.
summary: Guangdong Champion Asia Electronics Co.,Ltd. specializes in the production and distribution of high-density double-sided and multilayer printed circuit boards throughout the People's Republic of China. These sophisticated electronic components are primarily integrated into various sectors such as consumer devices, automotive systems, information technology and telecommunications, industrial automation, security apparatus, power management, renewable energy solutions, and medical equipment. The company, which was established in 2005, operates from its head office situated in Huizhou, China.

name: Getein Biotech, Inc
summary: Getein Biotech, Inc researches, develops, produces, and sells in vitro diagnostic products in China and internationally. The company provides diagnostic reagents and analyzers; calibrators; reagent raw materials, such as monoclonal and polyclonal antibodies, antigen, antiserum, and microsphere; and cardiac marker, inflammation, renal function, coagulation, thyroid function, fertility, diabetes care, and thrombus products. It also offers products in the area of cardiovascular, inflammatory, diabetes, fertility, renal, liver, and others. The company was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Nanjing, China.

name: A-Zenith Home Furnishings Co., Ltd.
summary: Based in Shanghai, China, A-Zenith Home Furnishings Co., Ltd. has been supplying a comprehensive range of furniture products across China since its founding in 2000. The company offers an extensive selection of household items, including furnishings for living rooms, dining areas, studies, and bedrooms, alongside decorative pieces. Beyond manufacturing, A-Zenith also provides interior design and furniture maintenance services. The firm officially changed its name from A-Zenith Furniture Co., Ltd. to its current designation in April 2017.

name: Guangzhou Tongda Auto Electric Co., Ltd.
summary: Guangzhou Tongda Auto Electric Co., Ltd. is dedicated to the comprehensive lifecycle of advanced automotive electrical solutions. The company specializes in the research, development, production, and commercialization of sophisticated in-vehicle intelligent terminal systems designed for extensive information management, alongside a variety of complementary automotive electrical products. Furthermore, it manufactures and distributes a broad spectrum of general auto parts and accessories. Its diverse product portfolio encompasses offerings such as new energy vehicle systems, intelligent onboard technologies, vehicular media solutions, and various other integrated vehicle components. The company was established on January 11, 1994, and its main operational base is situated in Guangzhou, China.

name: Beijing Wantai Biological Pharmacy Enterprise Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing Wantai Biological Pharmacy Enterprise Co., Ltd. researches, develops, produces, distributes, and sells infectious disease diagnostic reagents and vaccines in China and internationally. The company provides COVID 19, HIV and HTLV, Hepatitis, EV-71, and Tuberculosis diagnostics test kits; Hepatitis C and Syphilis detection reagents; automated immunoassays; ELISA kits and rapid tests for infectious disease diagnostics; chemiluminescence and clinical chemistry reagents; immunodiagnostic reagents; and Hepatitis E and human papillomavirus vaccines. It serves blood banks, hospitals and clinics, reference laboratories, border inspection centers, blood-processing companies, and research institutes. The company was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.

name: Xinjiang Xintai Natural Gas Co., Ltd.
summary: Xinjiang Xintai Natural Gas Co., Ltd. engages in the transmission, distribution, and sale of natural gas in China. It serves civil, commercial, automotive, and industrial parks. The company was formerly known as Xinjiang Xintai Investment (Group) Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Xinjiang Xintai Natural Gas Co., Ltd. in December 2012. Xinjiang Xintai Natural Gas Co., Ltd. was founded in 2000 and is based in Urumqi, China.

name: Yingkou Jinchen Machinery Co., Ltd.
summary: Yingkou Jinchen Machinery Co., Ltd. operates as a system integration supplier of automated production solutions for industrial enterprises worldwide. It provides photovoltaic panel production solutions comprising automatic glass handlers, automatic loading handler, EVA automatic cutting and layup machines, bidirectional conveyers, automatic template placement machines, automatic stringers, buffers, automatic layup systems, automatic bussing stations, EVA/TPT automatic cutting and holing machines, EVA/TPT automatic layup robot arms, laser scribers, and single flash sun simulators, as well as lifting units for visual inspections; and packaging solutions, including full-automatic binning and unpacking machines. The company also offers wafer loading/unloading systems for PECVD and RIE, wafer transfer systems for diffusion, wafer sorting systems; and handing and conveying line of glass deep-processing, and automated production line of plastic floor for architectural industry. In addition, it provides glass cleaning and drying machines, auxiliary equipment, and industry specific machines. Further, the company offers software solutions, which include manufacturing execution systems, visual inspection integration solutions, and optical detection systems. Yingkou Jinchen Machinery Co., Ltd. is headquartered in Yingkou, China.

name: Mubang High-Tech Co.,Ltd.
summary: BanBao Co., Ltd. researches, develops, produces, and sells educational plastic block and infant preschool block toys in China. The company was founded in 2003 and is based in Shantou, China.

name: Jinzhou Yongshan Lithium Co., Ltd
summary: Jinzhou Yongshan Lithium Co., Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in research and development, production, and sale of battery-grade lithium carbonate and battery-grade lithium hydroxide in China. The company also offers anhydrous lithium hydroxide. Its products are used in power batteries for new energy vehicles, energy storage batteries, and batteries for consumer electronics products. The company also exports its products. Jinzhou Yongshan Lithium Co., Ltd was founded in 2003 and is based in Changsha, China.

name: Suzhou Huazhijie Telecom Co
summary: Suzhou Huazhijie Telecommunications Co., Ltd., a national high-tech enterprise established in 1992, is headquartered in Suzhou, China. The company specializes in the research, development, and production of a diverse range of advanced components, including smart switches, control modules, battery management systems (BMS), brushless motors and their controllers, and precision mechanical parts. Operating as a worldwide supplier, it serves critical sectors such as power tools, consumer electronics, and the automotive industry, notably providing comprehensive, ready-to-use solutions specifically for power tool applications.

name: Yangzhou Tinfulong Grp Co Ltd
summary: Yangzhou Tinfulong Group Co Ltd is a Chinese entity dedicated to the development, production, and distribution of specialized polyester staple fibers and other chemical fiber products. The company's activities encompass the full spectrum from innovative fiber design and manufacturing processes to robust marketing and sales efforts, reaching customers in numerous regions.

name: Runner (Xiamen) Corp.
summary: Runner (Xiamen) Corp. manufactures and sells kitchen and bathroom, water purification, fresh air purification, health care, and other home furnishing produts in China and internationally. It offers faucets, showers, bathroom accessories, showerdoors, and toilet parts; household, commercial, whole house, and replacement filters; and wall mount fresh air ventilation systems, cabinet type fresh air ventilation systems, fresh air ventilation systems, and empty machine series. The company also provides gerontic care and health care products; and intelligent equipment and auto parts. Runner (Xiamen) Corp. was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Xiamen, China.

name: WuXi Xinje Electric Co.,Ltd.
summary: WuXi Xinje Electric Co.,Ltd. engages in the development, production, and sale of industrial automation products in China. The company offers PLC, human-machine interface, integrated controller, special modules, and other products for industrial control; and server system, stepping system, inverter for sport control. It also provides WIFI modules, 4GBOX, and other wireless communication modules, as well as Ethernet-based communication modules; cloud platform and server deployment; and integrated smart cameras manipulators, robot controllers, and teaching pendants. The company's products are used in various fields of automation, including printing and packaging, food and drink, machining assembly, textile, electronics manufacturing, building materials, machine tool, and other related industries and fields. WuXi Xinje Electric Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2008 and is based in Wuxi, China.

name: Qingdao Topscomm Communication INC.
summary: Qingdao Topscomm Communication INC. designs, researches and develops, manufactures, and sells smart products for electric power and fire protection primarily in China. The company offers smart energy meters, such as smart prepayment and advanced metering infrastructure (AMI), and conventional meters; communication terminals, including data collectors and concentrators, and communication converters; energy data acquisition, distribution automation, power quality, and renewable energy systems; and communication chips and modules. It also provides AMI, prepayment vending, water/gas/heat and electricity meter AMR/AMI, distribution automation and management, and low and medium voltage PLC communication solutions. In addition, the company offers billing management, photovoltaic power management, and wind turbine control systems; and data collection operation and maintenance, line loss management, engineering installation, operation and distribution coordination, and power design services. Its products are used in the fields of smart grid, smart metering, new energy, fire protection, smart home, etc. Qingdao Topscomm Communication INC. was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Qingdao, China.

name: Anhui Genuine New Materials Co.,Ltd.
summary: Anhui Genuine New Materials Co.,Ltd. researches and develops, manufactures, and deals in printing and packaging materials in China and internationally. It offers cigarette sealing and cigarette tipping paper products; printed aluminum castling papers; and thermal transfer foils for use in cigarette tipping papers, gifts, and other decoration packages, as well as thermal transfer films. The company was formerly known as Taihu Jiyou Paper Industry Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Anhui Genuine New Materials Co.,Ltd. in March 2016. Anhui Genuine New Materials Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1998 and is based in Hefei, China.

name: Quanzhou Jiadeli Electronics Materi
summary: Quanzhou Jiadeli Electronics Material Co., Ltd. engages in research, development, and production of polypropylene films for capacitors. The company was founded by Huang Dong Liang on May 08, 2002 and is headquartered in Quanzhou, China.

name: GuiZhou SanLi Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
summary: GuiZhou SanLi Pharmaceutical Co.,LTD. engages in the research and development, production, and marketing of pharmaceutical products. It offers pediatric medication, respiratory system medication, cardiovascular and cerebrovascular drugs, digestive medicine, trauma injury medication, rehabilitation medicine, and ophthalmic medicine. The company was founded in 1995 and is based in Guiyang, China.

name: G-bits Network Technology (Xiamen) Co., Ltd.
summary: Established in 2004 and headquartered in Xiamen, China, G-bits Network Technology (Xiamen) Co., Ltd. specializes in the creation and management of video games. Their portfolio includes diverse titles available on client, web, mobile, and virtual reality (VR) platforms.

name: Zhejiang Jiuzhou Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd
summary: Zhejiang Jiuzhou Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd manufactures and sells active pharmaceutical ingredients (API) and intermediates in China and internationally. Its API pipeline comprise central nervous system, non-steroidal, anti-infection, hypoglycemic and antiviral, tumor treatment, and cardiovascular drugs. The company also provides asymmetric catalysts and lithium battery materials. Zhejiang Jiuzhou Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd was founded in 1973 and is based in Taizhou, China.

name: Guizhou Transportation Planning Survey&Design Academe Co.,Ltd.
summary: Guizhou Transportation Planning Survey&Design Academe Co.,Ltd. engages in the engineering consulting and contracting business in China and internationally. It offers consulting, test and inspection, supervision, construction, and general contracting services for roads, bridges, tunnels, ports, and waterways, as well as geotechnical, electromechanical, municipal, and construction projects. The company was founded in 1958 and is based in Guiyang, China.

name: Jiangxi Redboard Tech Co. Ltd.
summary: JiangXi Redboard Technology Co., Ltd. manufactures and sales printed circuit boards (PCBs) products. The company’s products include HDI boards, rigid PCBs, FPCs, RFPCs, and IC substrates. The company serves the communication, automotive, industrial control, and medical industries. It exports its products in Hang Kong, Singapore, Japan, Europe and the United States. The company was founded in 2005 and is based in Ji'an, China. Jiangxi Redboard Technology Co.,Ltd. is a subsidiary of Red Board Limited.

name: Shanghai Fengyuzhu Exhibition Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Fengyuzhu Exhibition Co., Ltd. operates in the exhibition industry in China. It operates approximately 500 theme exhibition halls that include provincial capitals, city pavilions, theme pavilions, museums, science and technology museums, park pavilions, corporate pavilions, memorial halls, tourist experience museums, and citizen cultural centers. Shanghai Fengyuzhu Exhibition Co., Ltd. was found in 2003 and is based in Shanghai, China.

name: Leshan Giantstar Farming & Husbandry Corporation Limited
summary: Leshan Giantstar Farming & Husbandry Corporation Limited engages in the research, production, and sale of leather and leather products in China. The company offers car seat, upholstery bag, furniture, and decorative leather products. It also operates online store for its products. The company was formerly known as Sichuan Zhenjing Corporation Limited and changed its name to Leshan Giantstar Farming & Husbandry Corporation in August 2020. Leshan Giantstar Farming & Husbandry Corporation was founded in 1993 and is based in Leshan, China.

name: Ecovacs Robotics Co., Ltd.
summary: Ecovacs Robotics Co., Ltd. engages in research, development, design, manufacture, and sale of robotic products. Its products include DEEBOT, a floor-cleaning robot; WINBOT, a window-cleaning robot; ATMOBOT, a mobile air-purifier robot; and BENEBOT, a shopping assistance robot. The company has operations in China, Japan, Germany, the United States, Canada, the Czech Republic, France, Iran, Malaysia, Poland, Spain, Switzerland, and internationally. The company was founded in 2006 and is based in Suzhou, China.

name: Flying Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Flying Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, manufacturing, and sale of elevator door systems, elevator integrated control systems, elevator decoration products, and elevator cabin and door parts in China. The company was formerly known as Wuxi City Zhan Peng Technology Company Limited. The company was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Wuxi, China.

name: Bafang Electric (Suzhou) Co.,Ltd.
summary: Bafang Electric (Suzhou) Co., Ltd. manufactures e-mobility components and complete systems for e-bikes and electric scooters in Europe, China, and the United States. It offers mid, front, rear, BBS, e-kickboard, and e-tricycle drive systems; front, mid, rear, and complete wheel motors; LED and LCD human machine interface products; carrier, frame downtube, and seat tube batterie, as well as chargers; speed detection and pedal sensor products; sine and square wave controllers; and bus, light, power, and motor extension cables. The company also provides various accessories, such as bash guards, carriers, throttles, e-brakes, chain wheels, cranks, fixation parts, handle lock nuts, chain cases, and motor covers. Bafang Electric (Suzhou) Co., Ltd. was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Suzhou, China.

name: EmbedWay Technologies (Shanghai) Corporation
summary: EmbedWay Technologies (Shanghai) Corporation provides intelligent system solutions for network visibility infrastructure, and embedded and converged computing platforms in China. The company offers network visibility infrastructure, and embedded and converged computing products. Its products are used in information security, wireless network, communication device manufacturing, telecommunication, network and signaling monitoring, and video processing, as well as value-added services. EmbedWay Technologies (Shanghai) Corporation was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.

name: Shanghai Sunglow Packaging Technology Co.,Ltd

name: Nacity Property Service Group Co., Ltd.

name: JiangSu Zhenjiang New Energy Equipment Co., Ltd.

summary: Beijing Tricolor Technology Co., Ltd manufactures and sells professional audio and video products worldwide. name: Keeson Technology Corporation Limited
summary: Keeson Technology Corporation Limited develops, manufactures, and sells smart bedroom furniture. The company provides smart adjustable electric beds and mattresses. Keeson Technology Corporation Limited was founded in 2005 and is based in Hangzhou, China.

name: Noblelift Intelligent Equipment Co.,Ltd.
summary: Noblelift Intelligent Equipment Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells material handling equipment in China. Further, it provides automatic walking, vertical lift, and platform extension functions for electric power, petrochemical, and manufacturing equipment installation and maintenance sectors. The company also offers logistic solutions. Noblelift Intelligent Equipment Co.,Ltd. is headquartered in Changxing, China.

name: Sunstone Development Co., Ltd.
summary: Sunstone Development Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sales of prebaked carbon anodes for the aluminum industry in China and internationally. The company also provides aluminum anode products, battery anode material, and film capacitor series. It is also involved in the import of petroleum coke, as well as export of prebaked anodes. In addition, the company offers low-carbon services. Sunstone Development Co., Ltd. was founded in 2003 and is based in Linyi, China.

name: Beijing United Information Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Beijing United Information Technology Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the online commodity trading business in China. It also engages in information technology services; investment management; and transportation services. name: Chahua Modern Housewares Co., Ltd.
summary: Chahua Modern Housewares Co., Ltd. engages in the design, development, production, and sale of various plastic housewares in China. name: Beijing Hanjian Heshan Pipeline Co.,Ltd
summary: Beijing Hanjian Heshan Pipeline Co.,Ltd manufactures and sells pre-stressed steel cylinder concrete pipes, pressure steel pipes, drainage pipes, commercial concrete products, and concrete box culverts in China. The company was founded in 2004 and is based in Beijing, China.

name: Junhe Pumps Holding Co., Ltd
summary: Junhe Pumps Holding Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of household water pumps in China, Europe, North America, Australia, and internationally. It offers submersible, garden, deep well, fountain, and pool pumps, as well as accessories. Junhe Pumps Holding Co., Ltd. was founded in 2003 and is based in Ningbo, China.

name: Hangzhou Cable Co., Ltd.
summary: Hangzhou Cable Co., Ltd. is actively involved in the global market, focusing on the research, development, production, and distribution of a comprehensive range of wires and cables. Its extensive product catalog includes various cable types such as high-voltage, power, overhead, control, mineral insulation, mining, and rubber cables, as well as different kinds of wires, specifically aluminum alloy, overhead, and plastic wires. The company further provides specialized offerings for transmission initiatives, including high-voltage temperature-sensing cables, steel-core aluminum alloy wires, and heat-tolerant aluminum alloy wires. Established in 1958, the firm's main offices are situated in Hangzhou, China.

name: Zhongman Petroleum and Natural Gas Group Corp., Ltd.
summary: Zhongman Petroleum and Natural Gas Group Corp., Ltd., an oil and gas company, engages in the drilling engineering contractor and petroleum equipment manufacture businesses. name: Kunshan Kersen Science & Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Kunshan Kersen Science & Technology Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells precision metallic components. name: Clenergy (Xiamen) Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Clenergy (Xiamen) Technology Co., Ltd. researches, develops, manufactures, sells, and services solar products in China and internationally. summary: Jiangsu Lettall Electronic Co.,Ltd produces and sells electronic components in China. name: Lafang China Co.,Ltd
summary: Lafang China Co.,Ltd engages in the research and development of personal care products in China. The company was formerly known as Guangdong Lafang Rihua Co., Ltd. Lafang China Co.,Ltd was founded in 2001 and is based in Shantou, China.

summary: Shanghai Laimu Electronics Co.,Ltd researches and develops, produces, and sells precision electronic components in China. summary: Zhenhai Petrochemical Engineering CO., LTD engages in general contracting, engineering design, project management, supervision, engineering consulting, project price review, and project bidding agency businesses. name: Yantai Eddie Precision Machinery Co., Ltd.
summary: Yantai Eddie Precision Machinery Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of hydraulic main pumps, travel and slewing motors, and multiway control valves for construction machinery and marines in China. name: Hailir Pesticides and Chemicals Group Co.,Ltd.
summary: Hailir Pesticides and Chemicals Group Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of pesticides and fertilizers in China. name: Shanghai Shine-Link International Logistics Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Shine-Link International Logistics Co., Ltd. provides a wide range of logistics solutions to a global clientele, including numerous Fortune 500 corporations. summary: Jinhua Chunguang Technology Co.,Ltd engages in the research and development, and manufacturing of hose assemblies for cleaning appliances. The company was founded in 2000 and is based in Jinhua, China.

summary: Autobio Diagnostics Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and distribution of clinical diagnostic products in China and internationally. It develops immunoassay, biochemistry, microbiology, and IVD reagents; and instruments, such as automation and semi-automation systems, as well as medical laboratory solutions. summary: Jiangsu New Energy Development Co., Ltd. focuses on the entire lifecycle of sustainable power generation, from funding and building to the ongoing management of wind, solar, and biomass energy plants. In addition to its energy projects, the firm also engineers and fabricates specialized industrial equipment, including marine wind power generators. Founded in 2002, this Nanjing, China-based enterprise operates as a division of Jiangsu Guoxin Investment Group Limited.
industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

name: Anji Foodstuff Co., Ltd
summary: Anji Foodstuff Co., Ltd. engages in the development, production and sale of seasoning powders, seasonings from natural extracts, herbs and spices, sauces, and condensed soups in China and internationally. Its seasoning powder of mixed flavors include seasonings for spare-rib, concentrated pork stocks, beef powders, chicken powders, fried rice noodle seasonings, seasonings for seafood, and others; and seasonings from natural extracts comprise mushroom extract seasonings, bonito flavor bisques, scallop bisques, fresh extract seasonings, MSG seasonings, abalone extract seasonings, and others. The company's herbs and spices comprise white pepper powders, five spices powders, and others; sauces include oyster, chili, curry seasoning, spare rib, and other sauces; and condensed soups comprise concentrated chicken consomme, concentrated shark fin bisque, concentrated abalone extract, concentrated pottage, and others. Anji Foodstuff Co., Ltd. was founded in 1995 and is based in Quanzhou, China.

name: YouYou Foods Co., Ltd.
summary: YouYou Foods Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of meat and vegetables. It offers range of pickled meat and vegetables, which includes chicken, seafood, skin crystal, halogen, vegetarianism, and gift box series products. The company was founded in 1997 and is based in Yubei, China.

name: Changzheng Engineering Co.,LTD
