The company provides cover assemblies, driven disk assemblies, release bearing products, four-piece sets, hydraulic bearing products, flywheel torsion dampers, hydraulic torque converters, self-adjusting clutches, brake pads, boosters, clutch master cylinders, and double acting clutches. It offers its products for passenger cars and commercial vehicles under the Iron Flow, Desa, and WESTLAKE brands. The company also exports its products to the United States, Europe, Asia, Africa, the Middle East, and other countries. Zhejiang Tieliu Clutch Co., Ltd. was founded in 2009 and is based in Hangzhou, China.

name: Sinosoft Co.,Ltd
summary: Sinosoft Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development of computer software. The company focuses on industry application software development covering application software, supporting software, system integration, and other application levels. It provides its solutions in the areas of property insurance, life insurance, health care, governments, financial sector, and call centers, as well as media, energy, postal, traffic, and civil aviation fields; and discipline inspection, enterprise information, and agent products. The company was founded in 1996 and is based in Beijing, China.

name: Suzhou Xingye Materials Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Suzhou Xingye Materials Technology Co.,Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, sale, and technical servicing of foundry functional new materials in China. It offers resins, including no-bake furan and phenolic urethane, ester and CO2 cured alkaline phenolic, cold box, easy-collapsible urethane no-bake, and acrylic resins, as well as sulfonic acid catalyst; and functional coatings, such as water-based/alcohol-based, high performance, flow, lost foam, metal mold, and special purpose coatings. The company also provides smelting material products; and feeder head products consisting of exothermic-insulating feeder sleeves, vertical cylinders, covering agents, neck downs, and boards, as well as breaker cores. In addition, it offers auxiliary materials, filter products, etc. The company's products are used in automobile, internal combustion engine and agricultural machinery, power generation, rail transportation and shipbuilding, engineering machinery, mining and heavy machinery, machine tools, cast pipes and valves, and other equipment manufacturing industries. Suzhou Xingye Materials Technology Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1996 and is based in Suzhou, China.

name: L&K Engineering (Suzhou) Co.,Ltd.
summary: L&K Engineering (Suzhou) Co.,Ltd., established in Suzhou, China, in 2002, is a specialist provider of cleanroom engineering services throughout China. The company extends its expert technical solutions to a diverse range of sectors, including semiconductor manufacturing, optoelectronics, solar energy, biopharmaceuticals, food processing, healthcare facilities, and commercial properties. It operates as a subsidiary of L&K Engineering Co., Ltd.

name: Hangzhou Greenda Electronic Materials Co., Ltd.
summary: Hangzhou Greenda Electronic Materials Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and servicing of high-purity electronic chemicals worldwide. It offers electronic chemical products for TFT-LCD, IC, PV, and other industries. The company was founded in 2001 and is based in Hangzhou, China.

name: Fujian Raynen Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Fujian Raynen Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the distribution of IC products in China. The company also researches, develops, produces, and sells computer control systems for knitting machines and textile servo drivers. Its products include flat knitting machine computer control systems, vamp flat knitting machine computer control systems, operation boxes, main controllers, take-down comb controllers, carriage controllers, and integrated power supply products; and single-axis and digital dual-axis servo drivers. In addition, the company is involved in various activities, including application software development for knitting industry, industrial electrical automation products distribution, system integration, etc. Fujian Raynen Technology Co., Ltd. was formerly known as Fujian Raynen Electronics Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Fujian Raynen Technology Co., Ltd. in 2013. The company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Fuzhou, China.

name: Bomin Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Bomin Electronics Co., Ltd. designs, produces, and sells PCBs in China and internationally. The company primarily offers high density interconnect, general double-sided, multi-layer, microwave high-frequency, heavy copper, metal base/core and flexible, and rigid-flex boards. Its products are used in communication equipment, medical devices, military hi-tech products, test systems, aeronautics and astronautics, household electronic products, automotive products, industrial control electronics, consumer electronics, high frequency microwave electronics, and other fields. Bomin Electronics Co., Ltd. was founded in 1994 and is based in Meizhou, China.

name: Jiangsu Lidao New Materials Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu Lidao New Materials Co., Ltd. researches, develops, produces, and sells aluminum products in China and internationally. It offers aluminum magnesium and manganese roofing materials, color coated aluminum, and coated aluminum plates, as well as coated, embossed, and hammer aluminum rolls for use in various fields comprising construction, electronic appliances, lighting, furniture, bags, cans, and other materials. The company was founded in 2004 and is based in Changzhou, China.

name: Tangshan Sunfar Silicon Industries Co.,Ltd.
summary: Tangshan Sunfar Silicon Industries Co.,Ltd. produces and sells trichlorosilane, potassium hydroxide, potassium sulfate, and silicon tetrachloride products in China. It also exports its products to South Africa, India, Malaysia, Indonesia, Taiwan, South Korea, Australia, etc. The company was founded in 2006 and is based in Tangshan, China.

name: Yifeng Pharmacy Chain Co., Ltd.
summary: Yifeng Pharmacy Chain Co., Ltd. retails pharmaceutical products in China. The company primarily offers ENT, dermatology, gastroenterology, rheumatology, andrology, gynecology, pediatric, body slimming, and nutrition products. It operates approximately 680 pharmaceutical chain stores in Hunan, Hubei, Shanghai, Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Jiangxi, and other six provinces and cities. The company is based in Changsha, China.

name: Zhejiang Jianye Chemical Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Jianye Chemical Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells chemical products in China. The company offers low carbon fatty amines, plasticizers, acetates, liquid sulfur dioxide, etc. It also exports its products worldwide. The company is based in Hangzhou, China.

name: Xuelong Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Xuelong Group Co., Ltd. is engaged in the production and sale of automobile components and parts. Their main products include automotive stamping parts, welded parts, and die-casting parts. The company is based in China.

name: Xiangyang Changyuandonggu Industry Co., Ltd.
summary: Xiangyang Changyuandonggu Industry Co., Ltd. engages in the design, manufacture, and sale of diesel engine parts to companies and manufacturers. It primarily offers cylinder blocks, heads, flywheel housings, connecting rods, engine covers, exhaust pipes, and gearboxes. The company was founded in 2001 and is based in Xiangyang, China.

name: Daqian Ecology&Environment Group Co.,Ltd.
summary: Daqian Ecology&Environment Group Co.,Ltd. provides landscape architecture design services. It offers ecological landscape design and construction, ecological environment, tourism, cultural construction, and environment operation, as well as sculpture art services. The company was formerly known as Daqian Ecology & Landscape Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Daqian Ecology&Environment Group Co.,Ltd. in January 2018. Daqian Ecology&Environment Group Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1988 and is based in Nanjing, China.

name: WPG (Shanghai) Smart Water Public Co., Ltd.
summary: WPG (Shanghai) Smart Water Public Co., Ltd. engages in the research and consulting, program design, production, software development, and operation and maintenance services of equipment in the domestic water supply industry. It offers water supply, centralized drinking water, non-negative pressure water supply, and inverter equipment; tap water booster station; and ward water pumps, as well as smart water management platform. The company was founded in 2011 and is based in Shanghai, China.

name: Harson Trading (China) Co., Ltd.
summary: Harson Trading (China) Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells shoes for women primarily in China. The company is based in Kunshan, China.

name: Hunan Baili Engineering Sci&Tech Co.,Ltd
summary: Hunan Baili Engineering Sci&Tech Co.,Ltd provides engineering consulting and design, procurement, construction, and project management services in China and internationally. The company offers its services primarily for petrochemical and coal chemical industries covering the fields of petroleum refining, chemical raw materials, synthetic fiber, synthetic rubber, synthetic resins, and coal chemicals, as well as oil and gas storage and transportation. Hunan Baili Engineering Sci&Tech Co.,Ltd is based in Yueyang, China.

name: Shanghai Kelai Mechatronics Engineering Co.,Ltd
summary: Shanghai Kelai Mechatronics Engineering Co.,Ltd engages in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of intelligent equipment and industrial robot systems. It offers industrial robot systems and flexible automation equipment for use in automotive electronics and interiors, etc. The company was founded in 2003 and is based in Shanghai, China.

name: Eurocrane (China) Co., Ltd.
summary: Eurocrane (China) Co., Ltd., based in Suzhou, China, and established in 2002, operates as a global provider and manufacturer of advanced lifting and material handling solutions. Its comprehensive product portfolio includes a diverse range of cranes such as overhead, gantry, jib, flexible girder, and specialized models for clean room or explosion-proof environments. Additionally, the company supplies electric hoists, transmission systems, and various components for engineering machinery. Beyond its product offerings, Eurocrane provides essential services, encompassing equipment installation, emergency maintenance, inspection, system upgrades, technical training, and the supply of spare parts. The company's offerings are widely utilized across a broad spectrum of industries, including heavy manufacturing, transportation and logistics, energy (such as nuclear and wind power), automotive, marine, aerospace, defense, and specialized sectors like food processing, pharmaceuticals, metallurgy, petrochemicals, and waste management.

name: China Master Logistics Co., Ltd.
summary: China Master Logistics Co., Ltd. operates as an integrated logistics company in China. It operates through Cross-Border Container Logistics; Engineering Logistics; and Resource Transshipment Logistics segments. The company offers freight forwarding services comprising booking agency, freight forwarding, TCR logistics, air parcel, customs clearance, supply chain management, over-seas network, and consultation solutions. It also provides container management, depot service, container leasing, container technical services, LCL logistics, and bonded logistics services; and international shipping agency, emergency rescue and tugging, issuing B/L on behalf of carrier, chartering and booking, and spare parts logistics services. In addition, the company offers coastal transportation services, such as foreign trade feeder services, domestic cargo transportation, coastal empty re-position, break bulk transportation, special cargo shipping solution, and out of gauge (OOG) containers; projects logistics and professional heavy hauling vehicles solutions; bulk logistics solutions and various value-added services; and cold chain logistics solutions. Further, it provides land transportation management platform. The company was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Qingdao, China. China Master Logistics Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of Qingdao Zhongchuang United Investment Development Co. Ltd.

name: Nantong Acetic Acid Chemical Co., Ltd.
summary: Nantong Acetic Acid Chemical Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells food and feed additives, pharmaceutical and pesticide intermediates, dye and pigment intermediates, and organic chemical raw materials in China. Its food and feed additives include sorbic acid, potassium sorbate, dehydroacetic acid, sodium dehydroacetate, nicotinic acid, nicotinamide, and clopidol; pharmaceutical and pesticide intermediates comprise methyl acetoacetate, ethyl acetoacetate, 2-cyanopyridine, 3-cyanopyridine, and 4-cyanopyridine; and organic chemical raw materials consist of diketene, acetonitrile, and crotonaldehyde. The company's dye and pigment intermediates comprise acetoacetanilide, 2-methylacetoacetanilide, N-acetoacetyl-4-methylaniline, o-acetoacetaniside, p-acetoacetaniside, p-acetophenetidide, 2-chloroacetoacetanilide, 1-(p-tolyl)-3-methyl-5-pyrazolone, 1-phenyl-3-methyl-5-pyrazolone, 5-acetoacetlamino benzimdazolone, and naphthol AS-G; 2,4-dimethylacetoacetanilide; acetoacetic-2,5-dimethoxyanilide; 4-chloro-2,5-dimethoxyacetoacetanilide; and N,N'-(1,4-phenylene)bis(acetoacetamide). It also offers customized products, such as sodium acetate anhydrous, N-methylacetoacetamide, 2-isopropyl-4-methyl-6-pyrimidinone, 3-methyl-1-(4-sulfophenyl)-5-pyrazolone, 1-(3-sulfophenyl)-3-methyl-5-pyrazolone, 1-(3'-chlorophenyl)-3-methyl-5-pyrazolone, and 1-(2-chlorophenyl)-3-methyl-5-pyrazolone. The company also exports its products. Nantong Acetic Acid Chemical Co., Ltd. was founded in 1959 and is based in Nantong, China.

name: Silvery Dragon Group Co., Ltd. Tianjin
summary: SILVERY DRAGON PRESTRESSED MATERIALS CO., LTD. TIANJIN manufactures and sells pre-stressed concrete steel products in China. The company offers spiral rib PC, PCCP steel, plane surface PC steel, and indented PC wires; PC steel bars; indented spiral-rip PC strands; PE strands; spiral hollow cables; and galvanized PC wires and strands. It also provides PC bar systems, which are used in CRTS I type post tension high-speed railway track plates; spiral rib wires that are used in CRTS II type pre-tensioned high-speed railway track plates; and PC steel systems, which are used in CRTS III type pre-tension high-speed railway track plates, as well as PC steel bars for mine reinforcement. The company supplies its products for use in railway, highway, water conservancy, and construction industries, as well as special pre-stressed concrete structure. It also exports its products to approximately 80 countries. SILVERY DRAGON PRESTRESSED MATERIALS CO., LTD. TIANJIN was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Tianjin, China.

name: Sino-Agri Leading Biosciences Co.,Ltd
summary: Sino-Agri Leading Biosciences Co.,Ltd, established in 2009 and based in Beijing, China, is an agrochemical company dedicated to the entire lifecycle of crop protection products. The firm engages in the research, development, production, and worldwide distribution of agricultural chemicals. Its product portfolio encompasses a variety of essential solutions, including insecticides, fungicides, and herbicides. This company operates as a subsidiary of the China National Agricultural Means Of Production Group Corporation.

name: ChongQing Zhengchuan Pharmaceutical Packaging Co.,Ltd.
summary: ChongQing Zhengchuan Pharmaceutical Packaging Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacturing, and selling of pharmaceutical glass packaging materials in China. It offers injection and oral liquid bottles; ampoules and medicinal glass tubes; and plastic flip off and aluminum caps. The company also offers various borosilicate glass bottles and soda lime glass tubes. The company was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Chongqing, China.

name: Jiangxi Guotai Group Co.,Ltd.
summary: Jiangxi Guotai Group Co.,Ltd. engages in the civil explosives, military new materials, rail transit automation, and information technology businesses in China. The company offers industrial explosives, such as permitted emulsion explosives for grade III coal mines; no. 2 rock emulsion explosive; packaged emulsified granular ammonium oil explosives; and expanded ammonium nitrate explosive. It also provides detonating tube, industrial explosive cable, initiation busbar, electronic control module, electronic parallel pin wire, and basic detonator; and information technology products, such as Ganpo party building, Jiangxi State-owned assets safety supervision platform, mobile e-site, grassroots governance, smart factories, Gan Shutong industrial internet platform, digital surveying and mapping virtual simulation system, intelligent power supply safety management system, power supply operation safety management system, auxiliary monitoring system for railway traction substations, intelligent power supply operation and maintenance system, intelligent equipment inspection system, and 6C system integrated data processing center. In addition, the company offers small solid rocket engines and military tungsten-based destructive material. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Nanchang, China.

name: Shenzhen SunXing Light Alloys Materials Co.,Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen SunXing Light Alloys Materials Co.,Ltd. develops, produces, and sells light alloy materials in China. It offers aluminum and magnesium alloy materials for use in various fields, such as military, aerospace, navigation, and rail transit. The company was founded in 1992 and is based in Shenzhen, China.

name: JCHX Mining Management Co.,Ltd.
summary: JCHX Mining Management Co.,Ltd. engages in mine engineering, development, and construction activities in the People's Republic of China and internationally. It is also involved in contract mining activities; and the research and development of non-ferrous, ferrous, and chemical industries. The company was founded in 1997 and is based in Beijing, the People's Republic of China.

name: Zhejiang Jihua Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Jihua Group Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, operates in the dyestuff industry. The company produces and sells disperse, reactive, acid, direct, and vulcanizing dyes. It also provides dyestuff intermediates, H acid, synthetic-anthraquinone products, macromolecular materials, and polyurethane foams. In addition, the company offers organic silicon temperature resistant coating, fluorine-containing coating, and other products; sulfuric acid; and thermoelectric and other fundamental raw materials, as well as products for auxiliary, pharmaceutical, and financial industries. It also exports its products. The company is based in Hangzhou, China.

name: Nanjing Chervon Auto Precision Technology Co., Ltd
summary: Nanjing Chervon Auto Precision Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of automotive components. The company offers engine parts, such as sprocket and throttle parts; compressor parts, including swashplates and air conditioning compressor housings; transmission products comprising valve body, shift housing, hub, and gearbox hub products; new energy products that include electric motor shafts and electric vehicle motor assemblies; and steering and brake parts for use in high-end cars. It also provides gloss panels, outlets, drum tripods, drying out the air ducts, panel linings, and panels for washing machines; gears for agricultural machinery; valve lifters, pull rod heads, left and right taps, and hook up products for use in high-speed rails; and other parts. The company was founded in 2012 and is based in Nanjing, China.

name: Guangdong Marubi Biotechnology Co., Ltd.
summary: Guangdong Marubi Biotechnology Co., Ltd. provides eye care product under the Maru brand in China. It offers eye cream and facial series products through e-commerce platform. The company is based in Guangzhou, China.

name: Jiangyin Hengrun Heavy Industries Co., Ltd
summary: Jiangyin Hengrun Heavy Industries Co., Ltd manufactures and sells flanges and forgings in China. It offers ring forgings, nozzles, support rings for turbines, spherical and main shaft forgings, slewing bearings, rolling ring and free forgings, flanges for large-scale wind tower foundations, packing of wind power flanges, forged flanges, and long welding neck flanges, as well as bearing and gear blanks, and tube sheets and discs. The company was formerly known as Jiangyin Henrun Flange Co., Ltd. Jiangyin Hengrun Heavy Industries Co., Ltd was founded in 2003 and is based in Jiangyin, China.

name: GigaDevice Semiconductor (Beijing) Inc.
summary: GigaDevice Semiconductor (Beijing) Inc., a fabless company, provides memory technology and IC solutions. It provides serial peripheral interface (SPI) NOR flash, SPI NAND flash, parallel NAND flash, known good die, and cross-reference memory products, as well as microcontrollers for use in automotive/industrial, computing, consumer, Internet of Things, network/telecom, and mobile communication applications. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.

name: Shanghai Kindly Enterprise Development Group Co.,LTD.
summary: Shanghai Kindly Enterprise Development Group Co.,LTD. produces and sells disposable medical polymer devices worldwide. It offers syringes, infusion sets, transfusion sets, medical tubes, needles and cannulas, and medical bags. The company also provides medical package materials, including PPPE composite films, medical packing films, sterilization indicator strips and Bowie Dick test packs, sterilization indicator tapes, medical wrapping papers, paper bags, and sterilization reels; and intervention accessories, such as guide wire, Y-connectors, inflation device, mainfold kit, pressure bandages, angiography syringes, stopcocks, sterile seldinger needle, introducer sets and tool kits, pressure transducer, extension tube, seldinger needles, hemostasis balloons, extension lines with needle free valves, pressure monitoring tubing products, and spine tool kits, as well as guiding, micro, and angiography catheters. In addition, it offers self-sealing pouches, tyverk reels, mini-spikes, PE extension tubes, suction catheter kits, irrigation kits, heparin caps, and umbilical cord clamps. Further, the company provides accessories, such as umbilical cord clamps, safety box, and stopcocks; and medical kits includes suction catheter and irrigation kits, and puncture sets. The company was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.

name: SEC Electric Machinery Co., Ltd.
summary: Based in Wuxi, China, SEC Electric Machinery Co., Ltd. is a manufacturer and supplier of a broad range of electric motors and related electrical apparatus. The company's comprehensive motor portfolio features diverse AC models, including squirrel cage asynchronous, wound rotor induction, compact asynchronous, flameproof, safety, petroleum drilling, and marine propulsion motors. It also produces medium and large DC motors, alongside various synchronous motors, synchronous variable frequency motors, and specialized motors for mine hoists and milling applications. Beyond motors, SEC Electric Machinery also provides a selection of generators, such as wind, turbo, short-circuit, and diesel engine types, as well as essential electrical components like transformers and frequency inverters. These products are utilized across numerous industrial sectors, including metallurgy, power generation, cement, petrochemicals, mining, papermaking, oil drilling, wind energy, water management, and shipbuilding. While operating primarily within China, the company also extends its reach globally, exporting its products to international markets such as the United States, Germany, Switzerland, France, Italy, Russia, South Korea, South Africa, Brazil, India, and Egypt.

name: Hunan Aihua Group Co., Ltd
summary: Hunan Aihua Group Co., Ltd engages in the design, development, manufacture, and sale of aluminum electrolytic capacitors in the People's Republic of China and internationally. The company also manufactures aluminum foil and machines. It serves lighting, new energy, telecom, industrial, automotive, computer, home applications, and medical markets. Hunan Aihua Group Co., Ltd was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Yiyang, the People's Republic of China.

name: Suzhou MedicalSystem Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Suzhou MedicalSystem Technology Co., Ltd. provides solutions in clinical informatics and digital hospital field in China. It offers DoCare anesthesia clinical information system that focuses on serving the perioperative clinical work; and provides streamlined, informational, automatic, and intelligent integrated management platform for clinical business. The company also provides DoCare intensive auxiliary diagnosis clinical information system that mines and scientifically analyzes for ICU patients' treatment data with medical information, such as patients' treatment information, inspection information, nursing information, and doctor's advice data. In addition, it offers DoCare operative medical behavior management system that establishes the intelligent management system for the operation resources and personnel behavior; and DoCare emergency clinical information system for management of emergency clinical, including pre-hospital first aid, pre-examination and triage, emergency rescue, emergency under observation, emergency operating room, emergency ICU, and patient outcome. Further, the company provides DoCare pre-hospital first aid clinical information system that provides a unified service platform, which has digital information for emergency command center, emergency doctors, emergency nurses, visiting medical personnel, and patients. Additionally, it offers smart OT, ICU, and emergency solutions; and smart specialty solutions, such as laminar airflow room, clinical pathway, and mobile nursing information systems, as well as central sterile supply department management systems. The company was founded in 2005 and is based in Suzhou, China.

name: Shenzhen Leading Semiconductor Industry Co., Ltd.

It offers optical equipment for use in the areas of petrochemicals, high-speed rail, power monitoring, and civil products, as well as in infrared thermal imaging intelligent early warning monitoring system and high-speed railway intelligent detection system. The company was founded in 2007 and is based in Harbin, China.

name: Advanced Micro-Fabrication Equipment Inc. China
summary: Advanced Micro-Fabrication Equipment Inc. China engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of high-end semiconductor equipment and related semiconductor equipment in China, Taiwan, and internationally. The company offers etch products, including Primo D-RIE, Primo AD-RIE, Primo SSC AD-RIE, Primo iDEA, Primo HD-RIE, Primo TSV, Primo Nanova, Primo Twin-Star, and Primo UD-RIE; and MOCVD products, such as Prismo D-BLUE, Prismo A7, Prismo HiT3, and Prismo UniMax. It also provides Preforma Uniflex CW system, a CVD metal-tungsten deposition equipment; and Volatile Organic Compounds (VOC) air purifier for industrial use. Advanced Micro-Fabrication Equipment Inc. China was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Shanghai, the People’s Republic of China.

name: Touchstone International Medical Science Co., Ltd.
summary: Touchstone International Medical Science Co., Ltd. is a global enterprise specializing in the design, production, and distribution of surgical staplers. These medical instruments are specifically engineered for utilization in both laparoscopic and open surgical procedures. Established in 2003, the company is headquartered in Suzhou, People's Republic of China.

name: Traffic Control Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Traffic Control Technology Co., Ltd. delivers comprehensive solutions for the rail transit sector. The company's offerings encompass advanced train control systems, including communication-based train control (CBTC), interconnected CBTC variants, and fully automatic operation (FAO) systems. They also develop vehicle-to-vehicle communication-enabled train control, intelligent passenger service platforms, dedicated urban rail transit cloud infrastructure, and smart obstacle detection technologies for railway operations. Beyond product development, the firm actively engages in research for urban rail signaling systems, provides specialized services in system integration and general contracting for signaling projects, and offers crucial maintenance and technical assistance. Established in 2009, its headquarters are located in Beijing, China.

name: Shanghai MicroPort Endovascular MedTech Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai MicroPort Endovascular MedTech Co., Ltd. develops, manufactures, and sells technologies and products in the healthcare business. The company primarily offers solutions for aortic and peripheral diseases. Its products include TAA and AAA stent graft systems, balloon inflation catheters, and PTA balloon dilatation catheters. The company was founded in 2012 and is based in Shanghai, the People's Republic of China. Shanghai MicroPort Endovascular MedTech Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of Shanghai MicroPort Medical (Group) Co., Ltd.

name: Leader Harmonious Drive Systems Co., Ltd.
summary: Leader Harmonious Drive Systems Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, design, production, and sale of precision transmission devices. It offers harmonic reducers, mechatronics actuators, and precision parts for use in manufacturing fields, such as industrial robots, service robots, CNC machine tools, aerospace, medical equipment, semiconductor production equipment, and new energy equipment. The company is based in Suzhou, China.

name: Espressif Systems (Shanghai) Co., Ltd.
summary: Espressif Systems (Shanghai) Co., Ltd., a fabless semiconductor company, designs and sells Wi-Fi and Bluetooth, low-power IoT solutions in China. The company offers wireless SoCs; modules combining Wi-Fi and BT/BLE; and development boards, as well as software products. It also provides hardware services. The company serves customers in industrial automation, wearable electronic, healthcare, consumer electronic, and smart home sectors. Espressif Systems (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.

name: Anji Microelectronics Technology (Shanghai) Co., Ltd.
summary: Anji Microelectronics Technology (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of semiconductor materials worldwide. It offers copper, barrier, TSV, oxide, silicon/polysilicon, Al, and BSI CMP slurries; and stripping/cleaning solutions, such as post Al etch residue removers and bulk photoresist strippers. The company was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.

name: Guangzhou Fangbang Electronics Co.,Ltd
summary: Guangzhou Fang Bang Electronics Co., Ltd. engages in the development, production, sale, and service of electronic materials in China. Its products include shielding films, conductive adhesive films, flexible copper clad laminates, and ultra-thin copper foils. The company was founded in 2010 and is based in Guangzhou, China.

name: Aofu Environmental Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Aofu Environmental Technology Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells ceramic substrates worldwide. It offers SCR ceramic substrates, DPF ceramic substrates, and heat storage products. The company was founded in 2002 and is based in Dezhou, China.

name: Suzhou Harmontronics Automation Technology Co., Ltd
summary: Suzhou Harmontronics Automation Technology Co., Ltd engages in the research, development, design, manufacture, sale, and after-sale service of automatic equipment in China and internationally. It provides standard equipment, such as PCB press-inserting machines, chemical-integrated machines, and lamination molding machines; and develops manufacturing software. The company serves customers in automotive electronics, health care, new energy battery, and other industries. Suzhou Harmontronics Automation Technology Co., Ltd was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Suzhou, China.

name: DBAPPSecurity Co., Ltd.
summary: DBAPPSecurity Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of cybersecurity products in China. The company offers security products, including APT Discovery platform, Operation and Maintenance Audit and Risk Control System, Comprehensive Log Auditor, Database Auditor, Web Vulnerability Scanner, and Cloud and Big Data Security platforms, as well as SaaS cloud security services. It also provides professional security services, including application security, big data security, cloud security, IoT security, ICS security, industrial Internet security, etc. The company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.

name: Shenzhen JPT Opto-Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen JPT Opto-Electronics Co., Ltd. is a China-based company specializing in the research, development, production, and sales of fiber lasers, optical components, and related laser equipment. Their products are used in various industrial applications, including laser marking, cutting, welding, and cleaning, contributing to advancements in manufacturing processes. The company is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.

name: Guangzhou Jet Bio-Filtration Co., Ltd.
summary: Guangzhou Jet Bio-Filtration Co., Ltd. researches, develops, manufactures, and sells laboratory consumable products. The company's principal products include laboratory consumables, such as pipettes, tissue culture products, centrifuge tubes, filtration products etc.; and analyzers, lab equipment, reagents, gloves, and other products. It provides its products to approximately 50 countries, including the United States, Japan, Canada, Germany, Australia, and South Korea. The company was founded in 2001 and is based in Guangzhou, China.

name: QuantumCTek Co., Ltd.
summary: QuantumCTek Co., Ltd. manufactures quantum information technology enabled ICT technology security products and services in China. The company offers quantum key distribution terminals; channels and key network switching products; landline and mobile encryption application products; and teaching systems and scientific instruments. It also provides components, such as single-photon detectors; Quantum random number generators; and devices, including QCL-100 high-speed picosecond pulsed laser devices, periodically poled lithium niobate waveguides, geiger-mode InGaAs avalanche photodiodes, micro-processor compensated variable optical attenuators, QFPS fiber phase shifters, QMPC-100 manual polarization controllers, and QEPC-100 dynamic polarization controllers. In addition, the company offers network and element management and control software. It serves government, financial, and energy industries. The company was founded in 2009 and is based in Hefei, China.

name: Beijing Worldia Diamond Tools Co.,Ltd.
summary: Beijing Worldia Diamond Tools Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of high precision diamond cutting tools in China. The company offers PCD tools, CBN tools, milling cutters, special tools, CVD diamond tools, and diamond scribing wheels. Its products are used in automotive, electronic, new energy, and other industries. The company sells its products directly, as well as through a network of distributors and dealers. Beijing Worldia Diamond Tools Co.,Ltd. also exports its products. The company was formerly known as Beijing Supower Science and Technology Development Co., Ltd and changed its name to Beijing Worldia Diamond Tools Co.,Ltd. in 2015. Beijing Worldia Diamond Tools Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2000 and is based in Beijing, China.

name: Micro-Tech (Nanjing) Co., Ltd.
summary: Micro-Tech (Nanjing) Co., Ltd. is a key manufacturer and global supplier of non-vascular stents and disposable biopsy forceps. The company's primary markets span China, Europe, North America, and Oceania. Its extensive product portfolio includes specialized gastroenterology devices such as longwire and shortwire biliary stents, biopsy instruments, dilation and hemostasis products, EUS tools, nitinol stents, resection devices, retrieval systems, and related accessories. For pulmonology, offerings comprise airway stents, biopsy tools, dilation balloons, cytology brushes, retrieval devices, and additional accessories. Beyond its own product lines, Micro-Tech also provides original equipment manufacturing (OEM) and original design manufacturing (ODM) services to other medical device firms. Founded in 1999, the company is headquartered in Nanjing, China.

name: Hillstone Networks Co.,Ltd.
summary: Hillstone Networks Co.,Ltd. provides an infrastructure protection solutions to enterprises and service providers. The company provides edge protection solutions; cloud protection and security management solutions; breach protection solutions; and application delivery controller solution, as well as technical support and training services. It offers zero-trust network access; extended detection and response; cloud workload protection; secure SD-wan; network detection and response; and micro-segmentation for cloud data centers solutions. In addition, the company provides border security, cloud security, intranet security, data security, business security, intelligent security operation, security service, and security operation and maintenance services. The company serves safeguarding telcos and ISPs; fortifying financial services; enhancing security in higher education; and defending government agencies industries. Hillstone Networks Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Suzhou, China.

name: Hoymiles Power Electronics Inc.
summary: Hoymiles Power Electronics Inc. engages in the manufacture and sale of module level power electronics (MLPE) solutions in China and internationally. It offers microinverters, data transfer units, energy storage, and rapid shutdown products, EV charger, battery, string inverter, as well as accessories, such as single- and multi- microinverter systems. The company also offers monitoring equipment, photovoltaic power generation systems, circuit breakers. In addition, its products are used in residential, commercial, industrial, and utility-scale applications. Hoymiles Power Electronics Inc. was founded in 2012 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.

name: Beijing Tianyishangjia New Material Corp.,Ltd.
summary: Beijing Tianyishangjia New Material Corp., Ltd. researches and develops, produces, and markets brake pads and brake block series products for high-speed trains, EMU, rolling stock, urban rail transit vehicles. Its products include sintered brake pads, sintered brake shoes, organic brake pads, organic brake shoes, brake blocks, and other products. The company was founded in 2009 and is based in Beijing, China.

name: Shenzhen Transsion Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Transsion Holdings Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells smart devices in Africa. The company offers mobile phones under the TECNO, itel, and Infinix brands; smart accessories under the Oraimo brand; and home appliances under the Syinix brand, as well as after sales services under the Carlcare brand. It also provides mobile Internet services based on a self-developed operating system. The company operates in Nigeria, Kenya, Tanzania, Ethiopia, Egypt, Dubai, India, Pakistan, Indonesia, Vietnam, Bangladesh, and internationally. Shenzhen Transsion Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.

name: KINGSEMI Co., Ltd.
summary: KINGSEMI Co., Ltd. is a Chinese company that designs, develops, and sells integrated circuits (ICs), focusing on memory chips and related solutions. The company's products cater to various applications, including mobile devices, consumer electronics, and industrial equipment, contributing to the semiconductor industry. KINGSEMI is headquartered in China.

name: Wuhan Citms Technology CO.,LTD.
summary: Wuhan Citms Technology CO.,LTD. specializes in providing end-to-end solutions for smart city and intelligent transportation initiatives. Their core services involve system integration, custom software development, engineering design, and comprehensive support. The company's product portfolio is extensive, featuring advanced systems for traffic management and enforcement, such as automated red-light detection, intelligent road vehicle surveillance, and automatic parking violation capture. They also offer mobile policing tools, traffic data management platforms, and systems for vehicle control, including restricted-zone access. For violation processing, their solutions include self-service portals, auxiliary tools for offense handling, internet behavior management, and SMS notifications for online traffic infractions. Additionally, their public security offerings comprise specialized industry control systems, accident management support, integrated public security information systems, and specific illegal plug-in solutions for public security bureau traffic police detachments. Beyond product provision, Wuhan Citms Technology undertakes various significant projects. These include maintenance contracts for road traffic signal control equipment, the development of audio and video monitoring systems for detention facilities, stadium video surveillance installations, the construction of public security command centers, and police monitoring infrastructure projects. Their primary client base consists of local government agencies. Wuhan Citms Technology CO.,LTD. was established in 2007 and is headquartered in Wuhan, China.

name: Hangzhou Arcvideo Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Hangzhou Arcvideo Technology Co., Ltd. is a China-based provider of video processing and distribution solutions. Their offerings include video encoding, transcoding, streaming, and content management systems, catering to the media and entertainment industries. The company is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.

name: Hygon Information Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Hygon Information Technology Co., Ltd. is a Chinese enterprise dedicated to the research and development of advanced computing components, including microprocessors and specialized accelerators. The company's product line features high-performance processors specifically engineered for data centers, alongside mid-range processing units catering to industrial clients. Additionally, they provide a range of versatile processors for various applications, emphasizing high-performance, domestically developed options. Hygon's technology powers diverse sectors, finding utility in areas such as professional workstations, artificial intelligence, cloud infrastructure, data centers, demanding scientific and industrial computing tasks, and security systems. Established in 2014, Hygon Information Technology Co., Ltd. is headquartered in Beijing, China.

name: Loongson Technology Corporation Limited
summary: Loongson Technology Corporation Limited engages in the research, development, production, sale, and service of processor chips in China. The company offers processors, such as IT systems, industrial control embedded system, and loongson companion chip. It also provides Loongnix operating system that offers services for personal computers, servers, and cloud computing in the generalized informatization field; LoongOS, an industrial control operating system; Loongson Browser; and firmware. In addition, the company offers cloud terminals, computer, laptop, and desktop; dual-way, four-ways, high-density, and storage server; load balancing, switch, ethernet layer 3 switch, bastion machine, VPN, data gateway, high-performance firewall, GAP, and cipher machine; RTU, PLC, DCS controller mainboard, industrial core controller, industrial edge gateway, and industrial robots; intelligent door lock, treadmill, electric moped, and water meter; and industry self-service terminal equipment, question answering robot, intelligent blackboard, integrated operation and maintenance machine, DNS, lottery betting machine, safety filing cabinet, and self service terminal. Further, it provides ATM, high speed camera, and financial self-service terminal; power gateway and PLC, DCS controller mainboard, power GAP, power quality monitoring device, and clock synchronization device; and transportation industry solutions. Loongson Technology Corporation Limited was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.

name: Suzhou Everbright Photonics
summary: Suzhou Everbright Photonics Co., Ltd. is a global enterprise specializing in the comprehensive lifecycle of semiconductor laser chips, encompassing research, development, design, production, and sales. Established in 2012 and headquartered in Suzhou, People's Republic of China, the company caters to both domestic and international markets. Its extensive product catalog includes high-power single-tube and bar laser series, efficient VCSEL solutions, and optical communication chips. Furthermore, they supply individual diode laser chips, integrated laser devices, fiber-coupled modules, laser stacks, and direct diode laser systems. These advanced offerings are integral to various applications, such as industrial laser pumping, cutting-edge laser manufacturing equipment, biomedical technology, high-speed optical data transmission, machine vision, and advanced sensing systems.

name: Actions Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Actions Technology Co., Ltd. operates as a fabless semiconductor enterprise, specializing in the development and production of integrated Systems-on-Chip (SoCs) tailored for the portable multimedia market within China. Its product offerings include integrated circuits vital for Bluetooth wearables, speakers, and transmitters, as well as solutions for portable audio-visual devices, smart multimedia applications, and Bluetooth voice-controlled remotes. Founded in 2014, the company's main office is located in Zhuhai, China.

name: Eyebright Medical Technology (Beijing) Co., Ltd.
summary: Eye Bright Medical Technology Co., Ltd. develops a range of ophthalmic medical products. Its products include surgical implants and instruments, equipment, optometric lenses, eye drops, etc. for the treatment of ophthalmic diseases and vision problems, such as cataract, glaucoma, refractive errors, and other ophthalmic diseases. The company was founded in 2010 and is based in Beijing, China.

name: Rockontrol Technology Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Rockontrol Technology Group Co., Ltd. is a China-based company specializing in the development and manufacturing of industrial automation and control systems. Their products and solutions are applied in various sectors, including petrochemicals, metallurgy, and power generation, aiming to improve efficiency and safety in industrial processes. The company is headquartered in China.

name: Suzhou Novosense Microlectronics
summary: Suzhou Novosense Microelectronics Co., Ltd. is a Chinese enterprise dedicated to the research, development, design, and commercialization of analog and mixed-signal integrated circuits. The firm supplies a comprehensive array of specialized components, including various isolated and non-isolated drivers (such as half-bridge, single-channel, smart, automotive exterior LED, brushed DC motor, relay, and solenoid drivers), communication transceivers (like CAN/LIN and 485), diverse interfaces (I2C, LVDS/MLVDS, digital isolators, and other isolated interfaces), power management solutions (including isolated power products and low dropout regulators), and a wide selection of sensors (current, magnetic position, pressure, temperature/humidity, alongside sensor signal conditioning chips) and smart switches (high/low side). These advanced microelectronic solutions are deployed across numerous sectors, such as the automotive, industrial, information communication, and consumer electronics industries. Established in 2013, the company operates from its main office located in Suzhou, China.

name: InfoVision Optoelectronics (Kunshan) Co., Ltd.
summary: InfoVision Optoelectronics (Kunshan) Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells LCD display panels. Its products include mobile panels, desktop and laptop panels, tablet and industrial personal computer panels, notebook panels, vehicle displays, and automotive displays. The company was founded in 2005 and is based in Kunshan, China. InfoVision Optoelectronics (Kunshan) Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of Kunshan Guochuang Investment Group Co., Ltd.

name: Beijing Labtech Instruments Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing Labtech Instruments Co., Ltd. manufactures and supplies laboratory products and solutions to laboratory industry worldwide. Its primary products include organic/inorganic sample preparation systems, laboratory cooling/heating equipment, analytical instruments, and consumables. The company is based in Beijing, China.

name: Jiangxi JDL Environmental Protection Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangxi JDL Environmental Protection Co., Ltd. is a China-based company that provides environmental protection solutions and services. It focuses on waste treatment, water treatment, and ecological restoration projects. The company is headquartered in Jiangxi, China.

name: Beijing Baolande Software Corporation
summary: Beijing Baolande Software Corporation engages in the research and development, and sale of infrastructure software products in China, Nepal, Pakistan, and internationally. The company offers Web middleware, a HTTP protocol to support the EJB technology; application runtime platform software; application performance management technology, a real-time online monitoring technology; and service availability management platform, which provides proactive detection services for enterprise-class users. It also provides application server software, CORBA transaction middleware, message middleware, cloud management platform, APM, and distributed cache databases. In addition, the company offers BES application server, BES CloudLink, BES VBroker, BES WebGate, BES MQ, BES CacheDB, and other software products, as well as cloud computing technology. It serves telecommunication, financial, insurance, government, energy, and other industries. The company was founded in 2008 and is based in Beijing, China.

name: Zhuzhou Huarui Precision Cutting Tools Co.,Ltd
summary: Zhuzhou Huarui Precision Cutting Tools Co.,Ltd is a Chinese company that designs, manufactures, and sells precision cutting tools. The company's products are used in various industries, including automotive, aerospace, and machinery manufacturing, to improve efficiency and precision in machining processes. Zhuzhou Huarui Precision Cutting Tools Co.,Ltd is headquartered in China.

name: Jiangsu Yunyong Electronics and Technology Co.,Ltd
summary: Jiangsu Yunyong Electronics and Technology Co.,Ltd is a Chinese company focused on the research, development, production and sales of high-performance printed circuit boards (PCBs). Their products are used in various electronic devices and equipment across different industries. The company is headquartered in Jiangsu, China.

name: Mabwell (Shanghai) Bioscience Co., Ltd.
summary: Founded in 2017 and based in Shanghai, China, Mabwell (Shanghai) Bioscience Co., Ltd. is a biopharmaceutical enterprise dedicated to the discovery, development, production, and global commercialization of biological products. The company's comprehensive portfolio addresses a wide spectrum of medical conditions, including autoimmune disorders, various cancers, eye diseases, infectious ailments, and metabolic conditions. A key product is JUNMAIKANG, an Adalimumab injection utilized for autoimmune treatments. Mabwell also maintains a robust clinical pipeline, notably in oncology, where candidates 9MW2821 and 6MW3211 are advancing through Phase II studies, while 9MW2921, 9MW3811, and 7MW3711 are undergoing Phase I trials. Additionally, 8MW0511 has reached Phase III development, alongside 9MW0321. For autoimmune diseases, 9MW1911 and 9MW3811 are in their initial Phase I clinical trials. The company's metabolic product candidates include MAILISHU and 9MW3011. In ophthalmology, 9MW0813 and 9MW0211 are progressing through Phase III. Furthermore, 9MW1411 represents an infectious disease candidate in development.

name: Pylon Technologies Co., Ltd.
summary: Pylon Technologies Co., Ltd. is a China-based company specializing in the research, development, production, and sales of energy storage systems and solutions. Their products include lithium-ion batteries, battery management systems (BMS), and integrated energy storage solutions for residential, commercial, and industrial applications. The company is headquartered in Shanghai, China.

name: Cathay Biotech Inc.
summary: Cathay Biotech Inc. specializes in biochemical products, producing and marketing bio-based polyamide, bio-based DN5, long chain dibasic acids, and biobutanol. The company's corporate base is located in Shanghai, China.

name: Piesat Information Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Piesat Information Technology Co., Ltd. engages in research and application of satellite technology for remote sensing satellite and navigation satellite in China. The company offers pixel information expert (PIE), its flagship software for analyzing remote sensing image and data; and PIE-Map, a development platform that provides map navigation secondary development components, such as navigation cloud services and integrating solutions for the government, army, enterprises, and other clients. It also provides IT project consulting service to national satellite projects and other industries. The company was formerly known as Beijing PIESAT Information Technology Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Piesat Information Technology Co., Ltd. in March 2020. Piesat Information Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2008 and is based in Beijing, China.

name: AVE Science&Technology CO.,LTD
summary: AVE Science&Technology CO.,LTD operates comprehensively in the medical technology sector, engaging in the full spectrum of activities from initial research and development to manufacturing, sales, and post-sale support. Its diverse portfolio includes medical devices, biological reagents, remote medical diagnostic networks, specialized computer software, automated control systems, and various medical auxiliary equipment. The company's product offerings prominently feature advanced diagnostic instruments, such as analyzers for urine formed elements (along with their associated reagents), automated urine analysis systems, multi-functional microscopy devices, semi-automatic biochemical analyzers, and feces analyzers. Complementing these devices, AVE Science&Technology also supplies essential consumables, including reagent kits, quality control solutions for analyzers, test strips, and cleaning agents. Serving a global clientele, the company's reach extends across Europe, the United States, Asia, and Africa. Established in 2000, AVE Science&Technology CO.,LTD is headquartered in Changsha, China. The organization transitioned to its present name in September 2012, having previously been known as Changsha High - tech Industrial Development Zone Aiwei Technology Industrial Co., Ltd.

name: Beijing Hotgen Biotech Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing Hotgen Biotech Co., Ltd. develops, manufactures, and sells in-vitro diagnostic (IVD), point-of-care-testing (POCT) and biodefense products worldwide. Its IVD products include instruments and kits for aiding diagnosis in cardiovascular diseases, chronic liver diseases, tumor screening and risk stratification, kidney injury, rheumatoid arthritis, infection, infectious diseases, and risk assessment of preterm labor. The company's biodefense and food safety product line covers various bioterrorist agents, including Yersinia pestis, Anthrax, Brucella, Ricin, Abrin, etc.; and various food borne pathogenic bacteria, such as cholera, E. coli, salmonella, etc. Its biodefense products are used for military anti-bioterrorism campaign, customs inspection and quarantine, on-site inspection in centers for disease control, mobile bio-emergency inspection, on-site detection of food-borne pathogenic microorganisms, etc. Beijing Hotgen Biotech Co., Ltd. was founded in 2005 and is based in Beijing, China.

name: Wuxi Delinhai Environmental Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Wuxi Delinhai Environmental Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the cyanobacteria treatment technology business in China. It develops, sells, integrates, operates, and maintains cyanobacteria treatment equipment for the treatment of lake and reservoir cyanobacteria blooms; and the prevention and control of cyanobacteria blooms. The company was founded in 2009 and is based in Wuxi, China.

name: Chengdu JOUAV Automation Tech Co.,Ltd.
summary: Chengdu JOUAV Automation Tech Co.,Ltd. is a China-based company specializing in the development, manufacturing, and sales of industrial-grade unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) or drones. Their products are used for various applications, including surveying, mapping, inspection, and surveillance across different industries. Chengdu JOUAV Automation Tech Co.,Ltd. is headquartered in Chengdu, China.

name: Shanghai W-Ibeda High Tech.Group Co.,Ltd.
summary: Shanghai W-Ibeda High Tech. Group Co., Ltd., based in Shanghai, China, specializes in the research, development, and manufacturing of advanced automotive powertrain test bench products. Established in 1998, the company provides a comprehensive suite of testing solutions for both internal combustion and new energy vehicles. Its extensive product portfolio includes a variety of specialized test benches designed for engines (covering aspects like NVH end-of-line, electrical, rotational torque, performance, and cold testing, as well as diesel engine load hot tests and TDI engine fuel systems), transmissions (for reliability testing), and HEV/EV powertrains (for performance evaluation). The company also develops oil pump research and development test benches. Beyond these core offerings, it supplies fawer commercial vehicle steering products, chassis dynamometers, and dedicated testers for spark plugs, clutch functions, and engine camshaft profiles. Furthermore, Shanghai W-Ibeda High Tech. Group operates dedicated test centers for new energy automobile powertrains and complete vehicles. The company also provides a range of technical services to its customers and exports its products to international markets.

name: Piotech Inc
summary: Piotech Inc. engages in the research and development, production, sales, and technical services of semiconductor equipment in China. The company offers thin film equipment, such as plasma-enhanced chemical vapor deposition equipment, atomic layer deposition equipment, sub-atmospheric pressure chemical vapor deposition equipment, and high-density plasma-enhanced chemical vapor deposition equipment are used in integrated circuit logic chips, memory chips, and other manufacturing lines. It also provides hybrid bonding equipment used in the field of wafer-level three-dimensional integration. The company was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Shenyang, China.

name: Assure Tech (Hangzhou) Co., Ltd.
summary: Assure Tech (Hangzhou) Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of vitro diagnostic reagents, and instruments in China. It is also involved in POCT and plastic product manufacturing; online sales; pharmaceutical sales; and medical testing. In addition, the company offers drug of abuse, infectious disease, fertility, cardiac marker, tumor marker, allergen, and veterinary tests, as well as Biochemistry, chronic disease monitoring systems, and reader and analyzers. Further, it offers infectious disease, fertility, fecal occult blood, and vaginal pH tests. Assure Tech (Hangzhou) Co., Ltd. was founded in 2008 and is based in Hangzhou, China

name: Sinopep-Allsino Bio Pharmaceutical Co.,Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu Sinopep-Allsino Biopharmaceutical Co., Ltd., a biomedical company, engages in the research and development, production, and sale of peptides, oligonucleotides, and small molecule drugs in China. The company offers Peptide CDMO Services,GMP oligo, full-time equivalent, discovery, generic APIs, and formulation services. It is also involved in professional technical services. The company was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.

name: Earth-Panda Advanced Magnetic Material Co.,Ltd.
summary: Earth-Panda Advance Magnetic Material Co., Ltd. engages in the production and operation of rare-earth permanent magnetic materials. It offers sintered NdFeB, bonded NdFeB, rubber, and SmCo magnets. Its products are used in various applications in information technology, national defense, automobile, wind power, various electric motors, instruments, medical and magnetic machinery, and other sectors in Europe, the Americas, and Southeast Asia. The company is based in Hefei, China.

name: Beijing LongRuan Technologies Inc.
summary: Beijing LongRuan Technologies Inc. is a China-based software company specializing in providing enterprise-level software solutions and services. Their products include enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, supply chain management (SCM) software, and other business application software. Beijing LongRuan Technologies Inc. is headquartered in Beijing, China.

name: Hangzhou Mdk Opto Electronics Co.,Ltd.
summary: Hangzhou Mdk Opto Electronics Co.,Ltd. engages in the research, develops, manufactures, and sells acousto-optics, optoelectronics, semiconductor optics, semiconductor micro-nano circuit, and intelligent terminal products in China. The company offers optical sensor package substrates and carrier glass substrates, as well as ceramic substrate precision machining services; and biometric products, such as optical connectors for 3D structured light modules, biometric infrared bandpass optical filters, semiconductor wafer optical solutions, and optical filters for fingerprint recognition modules. It also provides image products, including smart phone and security camera filter assembly, infrared cutoff and optical low pass filters, ultra-low reflection optical lens, optical wavelength plates, and sapphire products; vehicle-mounted parts, such as pattern coating on glass wafer and absorption coated filters; and machine vision products, including colored glass optical coating film; as well as high-refractive index glass wafer precision engineering service for AR/MR parts. The company was founded in 2010 and is based in Jiaxing, China.

name: Beijing InHand Networks Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing InHand Networks Technology Co., Ltd. engages in research, development, and application of industrial Internet of Things (IoT) technology. The company provides industrial Internet of Things products, enterprise network products, digital distribution network products, smart vending control system products, and other products. It also offers cloud manager, edge routers, enterprise wireless AP, 5G outdoor unit, and series enterprise switch; cellular router and portable cellular router; cellular modems; iSCADA cloud service; DeviceLive cloud, edge computers, standard edge computers, edge gateways, industrial routers, industrial ethernet switches; and power distribution overhead line monitoring system and xenergy real-time energy management solution. In addition, the company provides AI vending cooler system and smart merchandiser system, as well as vehicle gateway and inconnect remote access services. It offers IoT solutions for business networking, industrial IoT, digital energy, smart commerce, and mobility sectors. The company was founded in 2001 and is based in Beijing, China.

summary: Established in 2010 and headquartered in Shanghai, China, Jiangsu Yahong Meditech Co., Ltd. is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to the discovery, development, and commercialization of innovative therapeutic drugs. Its primary focus lies in medicines targeting genitourinary system cancers, though its pipeline extends to a variety of other diseases, serving both domestic Chinese and international markets. The company's clinical-stage pipeline features several key candidates. Notably, two compounds, APL-1202 (an anti-tumor drug) and APL-1706 (an agent drug), are both undergoing Phase III trials for the treatment of non-muscle invasive bladder cancer. Another promising candidate, APL-1501, an oral MetAP inhibitor, is currently in Phase I testing for addressing urinary system tumors and drug-resistant urinary tract infections. Furthermore, APL-1702, a photodynamic therapy product, is in Phase III for tackling cervical high-grade squamous intraepithelial lesions that arise from HPV infections. Beyond these clinical programs, Jiangsu Yahong Meditech is actively exploring targeted protein degraders in its preclinical phase. This includes ASN-1764, aimed at triple-negative breast cancer; ASN-1780, intended for metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer; and APL-1901, designed to treat ER-positive breast cancer. The company's developmental efforts also encompass APL-1401, targeting moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis, and ASN-1733, for combating Acinetobacter baumannii infection.

name: Shanghai Aladdin Biochemical Technology Co.,Ltd
summary: Shanghai Aladdin Biochemical Technology Co.,Ltd is a China-based company that supplies biochemical reagents, chemical products, and laboratory consumables. The company provides products to research institutions, universities, and pharmaceutical companies. Shanghai Aladdin Biochemical Technology Co.,Ltd is headquartered in China.

name: Shanghai Junshi Biosciences Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Junshi Biosciences Co., Ltd., a biopharmaceutical company, engages in the discovery, development, and commercialization of various drugs in the therapeutic areas of oncology, metabolic, auto-immunity, neurologic, and infectious diseases in the People's Republic of China. The company offers JS001, a recombinant humanized anti-PD-1 monoclonal antibody under the trade name of TUOYIR for the indication of melanoma, mucosal melanoma, soft tissue sarcoma, nasopharyngeal carcinoma, urothelial carcinoma, non-small cell lung carcinoma, triple negative breast carcinoma, esophageal squamous cell carcinoma, and hepatocellular carcinoma. It is also developing UBP1211, a biosimilar of Humira for the treatment of rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, and psoriasis arthritis; JS002, a recombinant humanized anti-PCSK9 monoclonal antibody for treating hyperlipidemia; UBP1213, a recombinant humanized anti-BLyS monoclonal antibody for injection. In addition, the company is developing JS501, a biosimilar of Avastin; and JS003, a recombinant humanized anti-PD-L1 monoclonal antibody for injection; JS101, a pan-CDK inhibitor; TAB004/JS004, a recombinant humanized anti-BTLA monoclonal antibody for injection; and JS005, a recombinant humanized anti-IL-17A monoclonal antibody for injection. It has an agreement with Eli Lilly and Company to co-develop therapeutic antibodies for the potential prevention and treatment of COVID-19, the disease caused by the SARS-CoV-2 novel coronavirus; collaboration with Merck & Co., Inc. to explore new combination treatment for head and neck cancer patients, as well as Coherus Biosciences, Inc. for the development and commercialization of toripalimab, Junshi Biosciences' anti-PD-1 antibody; and a research collaboration and license agreement with Revitope Oncology Inc to explore immunotherapies with precision-targeted T-cell engaging antibodies. The company was founded in 2012 and is headquartered in Shanghai, People's Republic of China.

name: Beijing Bayi Space LCD Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing Bayi Space LCD Technology Co., Ltd. manufactures liquid crystal display (LCD) material, polymer dispersed liquid crystal (PDLC), and organic electroluminescent display (OLED) material. The company's products include single liquid crystal material, such as ester liquid crystals, alkyne liquid crystals, olefin liquid crystals, chiral liquid crystals, and acrylate liquid crystals; mixed liquid crystal material, such as twisted nematic (TN) LCD, super-twisted nematic (STN) LCD, thin-film-transistor (TFT) LCD, smart film, and liquid crystal monomers; and pharmaceutical intermediates. The company's products cover all kinds of liquid crystal material used in mobile phone, notebook and computer monitor, and LCD television (TV). The company serves crystal LCD panel makers. Beijing Bayi Space LCD Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2004 and is based in Beijing, China.

name: Jiangsu Cai Qin Technology Co., Ltd
summary: Jiangsu Cai Qin Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in the manufacturing of a diverse range of electronic components. The company produces various types of filters, including ceramic dielectric, dielectric waveguide, special, and LC filters, in addition to dielectric resonators, cavity filters, antennas, and duplexers. These essential components serve a broad spectrum of applications across civil, military, and various other industrial sectors. Established in 2004, Jiangsu Cai Qin Technology Co., Ltd. is headquartered in Jiangsu, China.

name: Shengyi Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Shengyi Electronics Co., Ltd. is a China-based company that manufactures printed circuit boards (PCBs). The company's products are used in various industries, including telecommunications, consumer electronics, and automotive. Shengyi Electronics Co., Ltd. is headquartered in China.

name: CanSino Biologics Inc.
summary: CanSino Biologics Inc. develops, manufactures, and commercializes vaccines in the People's Republic of China. The company develops Ad5-EBOV, an Ebola virus vaccine; and MCV2 and MCV4 vaccines for the prevention of N. meningitides; and DTcP vaccine for infants and DTcP Booster vaccine, which are in Phase I clinical trial for addressing the weaker protection preventing pertussis after primary vaccination. It also develops Tdcp Adolescent and Adult vaccine for treating pertussis; PBPV, a serotype-independent protein-based pneumococcal vaccine that is in Phase I clinical trial; PCV13i, a pneumococcal conjugate vaccine, which is in Phase I clinical trial; TB Booster for the BCG-vaccinated population; and Ad5-nCov, a recombinant novel coronavirus disease vaccine. In addition, the company is developing various preclinical stage products, including DTcP-Hib Combo vaccine; CSB012 to treat adenovirus; CSB013 for ZIKA virus; CSB105 to treat meningitis; CSB016 for treating shingles; and CSB107 for polio. It has a collaboration with The National Research Council of Canada to advance vaccine against COVID-19; and co-development agreement with Precision NanoSystems, Inc. to develop a mRNA lipid nanoparticle vaccine against COVID-19. CanSino Biologics Inc. was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Tianjin, the People's Republic of China.

name: Zhangjiagang Guangda Special Material Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhangjiagang Guangda Special Material CO.,LTD. produces and sells steel alloy ingots and forgings. It offers die and tool, alloy structural, railway locomotive, and special alloy steel, as well as wind and nuclear power products. The company also provides machine accessories. Its products are used in civil and military aircraft, armored car, racing, vessel, rail, petrochemical, wind power, power station, mining, machinery, and machinery applications. The company was founded in 2003 and is based in Zhangjiagang, China. Zhangjiagang Guangda Special Material CO.,LTD. operates as a subsidiary of Zhangjiagang Guangda Investment Holding Co., Ltd.

name: Zhuzhou CRRC Times Electric Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhuzhou CRRC Times Electric Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, in the research, development, designs, manufactures, and sells railway transportation equipment products, and provision of relevant services primarily in Mainland China and internationally. The company also produces propulsion and control systems for trains and electric vehicles, signaling systems, power supply solutions, platform screen doors, rail maintenance vehicles, marine engineering equipment, and component products for various applications. Its products for rolling stock and railways include EMU, locomotive, and mass transit systems; and components products consist of semiconductors, resistors, reactors, radiators, sensors, power capacitors, and heatsinks. The company's energy and industrial products comprise marine engineering, electric vehicle, and inverter and converter systems, as well as provides railway maintenance and construction machines. The company was formerly known as Zhuzhou CSR Times Electric Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Zhuzhou CRRC Times Electric Co., Ltd. in March 2016. The company was founded in 2005 and is based in Wanchai, Hong Kong.

name: Shanghai Friendess Electronic Technology Corporation Limited
summary: Shanghai Friendess Electronic Technology Corporation Limited engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of laser cutting control products and software. It offers laser cutting control systems, high-precision visual positioning systems, integrated CNC systems, and other accessories, as well as CypCut, HypCut ultra high power, and CypTube square tube laser cutting control software. The company was founded in 2007 and is based in Shanghai, China.

name: Hunan Nucien Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
summary: Hunan Nucien Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. is a China-based pharmaceutical company specializing in the research, development, production, and sales of pharmaceutical products. The company focuses on innovative drugs and generic drugs for various therapeutic areas. Hunan Nucien Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. is headquartered in China.

name: Zhiyang Innovation Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhiyang Innovation Technology Co., Ltd. is a China-based company specializing in providing integrated solutions for smart cities and intelligent transportation systems. They offer software, hardware, and services for traffic management, public safety, and environmental monitoring. Zhiyang Innovation Technology Co., Ltd. is headquartered in China.

name: Optowide Technologies Co., Ltd.
summary: Optowide Technologies Co., Ltd. is a China-based company that focuses on the design, development, and manufacturing of optical communication devices and components. They offer a range of products, including optical transceivers, optical amplifiers, and other active and passive optical components used in telecommunications networks. Optowide Technologies Co., Ltd. is headquartered in China.

name: Longyan Zhuoyue New Energy Co., Ltd.
summary: Longyan Zhuoyue New Energy Co., Ltd., a renewable energy company, produces biodiesel in Europe, East Asia, and North America. It also offers oleic acid methyl ester, C16C18 fatty acid methyl ester, coconut oil methyl ester, and glycerin. The company was founded in 2001 and is based in Longyan, China. Longyan Zhuoyue New Energy Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of China Biodiesel International Holdings Co. Ltd.
industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

name: Tianjin Jiuri New Materials Co., Ltd.
summary: Tianjin Jiuri New Materials Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of photoinitiators and pharmaceutical intermediates. It offers UV photoinitiators, such as free radical type, polymeric type, cationic type, and inhibitor photoinitiators. The company also provides reactive monomers, oligomers, and reactive amine synergists; fine chemicals; and UV absorbers. In addition, it offers solutions, such as low-odor, non-yellowing, benzene-free, polymeric, low emission, and water-based UV formulations, as well as through-curing formulations. The company was founded in 1998 and is based in Tianjin, China.

name: Beijing Huafeng Test & Control Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing Huafeng Test & Control Technology Co., Ltd. provides semiconductor IC testing systems and kits worldwide. The company is based in Beijing, China.

name: Beijing Infosec Technologies Co.,Ltd.
summary: Beijing Infosec Technologies Co.,Ltd. is a China-based company specializing in information security products and services. They provide solutions for network security, data protection, and security compliance. Beijing Infosec Technologies Co.,Ltd is headquartered in China.

name: Shanghai Medicilon Inc.
summary: Shanghai Medicilon Inc., a drug discovery contract research organization, provides drug discovery and development services to pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies in China and internationally. It offers chemistry services, including medicinal, synthesis, and analytical chemistry services, as well as process development services; and drug formulation services, such as pre-formulation and analytical development services, as well as research on quality control and clinical trial material services. The company also provides biology services comprising recombinant protein, crystallization and structural, discovery biology, computational biology and molecular modeling, and kinase services, as well as prepackaged M9 selenomethionine growth media kits and packages for growing cell culture in IPTG-inducible bacterial expression systems. In addition, it offers pharmacology services, including cancer xenograft, metabolic disease, inflammation and immunological, neurological disorders, and other disease models; services in the areas of in vitro ADME and in vivo pharmacokinetics; and bioanalytical services, such as large and small molecule services. Further, the company provides preclinical services comprising preclinical pharmacokinetic and safety evaluation. Shanghai Medicilon Inc. was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.

name: Autel Intelligent Technology Corp., Ltd.
summary: Autel Intelligent Technology Corp., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, sale, and servicing of automotive intelligent diagnostics equipment, detection and analysis systems, and automotive electronic components. It offers professional diagnostic tools, automotive tire pressure monitoring systems, ADAS series products for automotive intelligent assisted driving systems, and special and IMMO tools. The company also provides integrated intelligent maintenance cloud services; and diagnostic software. It primarily sells its products to approximately 50 countries and regions, including the United States, Germany, the United Kingdom, and Australia. The company was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.

name: Zhejiang Risun Intelligent Technology Co.,Ltd
summary: Zhejiang Risun Intelligent Technology Co.,Ltd engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of automatic production, automatic storage, automatic sorting and logistics system. It offers intelligent suspension production systems, intelligent suspension warehouse sorting systems, plane logistics transportation systems, intelligent intersection pallet sorting machines, intelligent stereo storage systems, real time data acquisition systems, intelligent mobile robots, MES, WMS, and other automated production equipment and logistics equipment. The company serves clothing, home textile, home, auto parts, cases, bags, shoes, baby carrier, electric business, logistics, warehousing, washing, and other industries. Zhejiang Risun Intelligent Technology Co.,Ltd was founded in 2005 and is based in Ningbo, China.

name: Jiangsu Beiren Robot System Co., Ltd
summary: Jiangsu Beiren Robot System Co., Ltd is a China-based company focused on the development, manufacturing, and sales of industrial robots and automation systems.
