Their products are used in various industries for tasks such as welding, assembly, and material handling. Jiangsu Beiren Robot System Co., Ltd is headquartered in China.

name: Orinko Advanced Plastics Co.,LTD.
summary: Orinko Advanced Plastics Co.,LTD. is a China-based company engaged in the research, development, production and sales of high-performance modified plastic materials. Their products are used in a variety of applications across various industries. Orinko Advanced Plastics Co.,LTD. is headquartered in China.

name: HitGen Inc.
summary: HitGen Inc. operates a platform for early-stage drug discovery research focusing on DNA encoded chemical libraries (DELs). Its DELs include encoded syntheses for diverse, drug-likesmall molecule, and macrocycle compounds. The company has internal projects in research, with Phase I, PCC generation, and in lead generation stages that focus on oncology, CVD, inflammation/respiratory, metabolism, and ophthalmology therapeutic areas. HitGen Inc. has a drug discovery research collaboration with Gilead Sciences, Galapagos NV, Kymera Therapeutics, Inc., and Morphic Therapeutic to identify potential small molecule leads; a strategic partnership with Oncodesign Société Anonyme for the identification and progression of new chemical entities; and an agreement with Lipigon Pharmaceuticals AB to include a second novel target. The company was founded in 2012 and is based in Chengdu, China.

name: Jinko Solar Co., Ltd.
summary: Jinko Solar Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, manufacturing, and sale of photovoltaic products and clean energy solutions in China, Europe, America, the Asia Pacific, and internationally. The company offers Tiger Neo 3.0, a photovoltaic module for power generation; liquid cooling energy storage system; and energy solutions, such as residential house roof, industrial and commercial distribution, and surface power plants, as well as half-cell and bifacial technology. It also provides silicon wafers, pulling rods, and batteries; photovoltaic cells; and battery components. It exports its products. The company was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China. Jinko Solar Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of JinkoSolar Investment Limited.

name: Wetown Electric Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Wetown Electric Group Co., Ltd., established in 1986 and headquartered in Yangzhong, China, is a global enterprise dedicated to the research, development, manufacturing, and sale of a comprehensive range of electrical products. The company's operations span across China, Southeast Asia, Australia, South America, Africa, and other international markets. Its diverse product portfolio includes advanced busway systems (covering low, high voltage, wind, nuclear, and resin casting applications) and various electrical distribution solutions, such as high and low voltage switchgear, box-type substations, and distribution boxes. It also produces components vital for the photovoltaic module industry, including welding belts and fluxes. Beyond finished goods, the group supplies fundamental raw materials like copper and aluminum for bus bar manufacturing, as well as tin-coated copper strips for solar modules. Innovative new material products for infrastructure are also offered, encompassing embedded channels for rail transit, pipe gallery supports, anti-seismic suspension systems, and photovoltaic supports. Complementing these, Wetown Electric provides comprehensive cable management systems, including steel, aluminum alloy, and data center cable trays, alongside mesh trays, optical fiber channels, wiring frames, and wire fixers. These solutions cater to an extensive client base across numerous sectors, such as critical infrastructure (government buildings, power generation, petrochemicals, rail transit), industrial applications (ferrous metallurgy, machinery, automotive), and commercial/public services (financial real estate, hotels, hospitals, IT, data centers, communications). Its offerings further support industries like tobacco, paper, food, transportation, textiles, and the growing photovoltaic sector.

name: Bingo Software Co., Ltd.
summary: Bingo Software Co., Ltd. is a Chinese enterprise dedicated to the development and commercialization of cloud computing products. Its core offerings include a suite of powerful cloud platforms: BingoCloudOS, an infrastructure-as-a-service (IaaS) solution; BingoFuse, designed to support cloud application deployment; BingoLink, an enterprise collaboration platform; BingoInsight, for managing data lakes; and BingoCMP, an IT-as-a-Service (ITaaS) capability platform tailored for businesses. Beyond these foundational cloud products, the company also delivers various specialized software systems, such as those for human resources, supply chain logistics, engineering project management, and contract management. Additionally, it provides mobile office platforms and comprehensive information solutions for business operations. Bingo Software extends its expertise to information and communication technology (ICT) solutions, along with extensive consulting services. These consulting services encompass strategic planning, management process optimization, architectural design, technology selection, custom product development, and system integration, particularly for the operational and maintenance requirements of the rail transit industry. The firm also crafts bespoke solutions, notably for e-government cloud infrastructure and specialized information systems supporting automotive research and development process verification. Serving a diverse clientele, Bingo Software caters to sectors including government, telecommunications, public security, finance, education, and information services, among others. Established in 2003, the company is headquartered in Guangzhou, China.

name: UCAP Cloud Information Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: UCAP Cloud Information Technology Co.,Ltd. is a China-based company providing cloud computing and data center solutions. Their services include cloud infrastructure, cloud storage, and data center construction and management. UCAP Cloud Information Technology Co.,Ltd. is headquartered in China.

name: Bonree Data Technology Co., Ltd
summary: Bonree Data Technology Co., Ltd provides application performance management services for enterprises in China. It also offers network performance management, big data, mobile app, and test products. In addition, the company provides financial, e-commerce, portal, aviation, manufacturing, live video, and operator solutions. Further, it offers support services. The company was founded in 2008 and is based in Beijing, China.

name: Shanghai Prisemi Electronics Co.,Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Prisemi Electronics Co.,Ltd. is a specialized high-tech enterprise dedicated to the research, development, manufacturing, and sale of power management integrated circuits (ICs) and discrete power components. Operating primarily within China, its product portfolio encompasses various power ICs, such as charge controllers, over-voltage protection (OVP) ICs, audio power amplifiers, and DC-DC power management solutions. Additionally, the company provides a range of power devices, including transient voltage suppression (TVS) diodes, MOSFETs, thyristor surge suppressors (TSS), Schottky barrier diodes (SBDs), Zener diodes, and transistors. These components are extensively utilized across diverse applications, from consumer electronics and network communication infrastructure to security monitoring systems and industrial sectors. While maintaining a strong domestic presence, Prisemi also exports its products to international markets like Hong Kong, Taiwan, and South Korea. The company's headquarters are located in Shanghai, China.

name: Guo Tai Epoint Software Co.,Ltd
summary: Guo Tai Epoint Software Co.,Ltd offers software and information technology solutions in China. The company operates through smart procurement, smart government affairs, and digital construction segments. It provides one-stop online service, big data, office collaboration, and unified city governance; E-government procurement, corporate procurement, and smart bidding tools; digital housing and development, digital construction, and digital cost estimation. It also provides scientific research and technical services. The company was founded in 1998 and is based in Zhangjiagang, China.

name: Thinkon Semiconductor Jinzhou Corp.
summary: Thinkon Semiconductor Jinzhou Corp. researches and develops, produces, and markets monocrystalline silicon products for IC etching in China and internationally. It offers silicon ingots, cylinders, plates, rings, and wafers. The company was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in Jinzhou, China.

name: SICC Co., Ltd.
summary: SICC Co., Ltd. and its subsidiaries research, develop, produce and sell silicon carbide substrates in China and abroad. It works on industrialising these substrates for renewable energy and AI uses, and its products include conductive single crystal and semi-insulating substrates.

name: BeOne Medicines Ltd. Class A
summary: BeOne Medicines AG, an oncology-focused enterprise headquartered in Basel, Switzerland, was established in 2010. This company is actively involved in the exploration and advancement of a diverse range of therapeutic solutions for cancer patients across key global regions, including the United States, China, Europe, and other international markets. Its current commercial portfolio features several significant treatments: BRUKINSA: A small molecule designed to inhibit Bruton's Tyrosine Kinase (BTK), indicated for various blood cancers. TEVIMBRA: An anti-PD-1 antibody immunotherapy utilized in the treatment of both solid tumors and blood cancers. PARTRUVIX: A selective small molecule inhibitor targeting the PARP1 and PARP2 enzymes, currently undergoing evaluation both as a standalone therapy and in combination approaches for different solid tumors. Beyond these marketed products, BeOne Medicines maintains a robust pipeline of clinical-stage assets. These encompass a broad spectrum of novel agents, such as small molecule inhibitors (e.g., targeting Bcl-2, BTK, TIGIT, MAT2A, PRMT5, KRAS, CDK4, CDK2, IRAK4, HPK-1), advanced antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) aimed at various targets (e.g., B7H3, FGFR2b, CEA, B7H4), and sophisticated bispecific antibodies (e.g., HER2-targeted, anti-GPC3x4-1BB, anti-MUC1xCD16A, anti-EGFRxMET). Additionally, the company is progressing multiple research programs within its preclinical development phase. To bolster its research and development initiatives, BeOne Medicines has established strategic alliances with prominent pharmaceutical entities, including Amgen, BMS, Bio-Thera, EUSA Pharma, Luye Pharmaceutical, and Novartis. The company, initially known as BeiGene, Ltd., is slated to officially adopt the name BeOne Medicines AG in May 2025.

name: Beijing Chunlizhengda Medical Instruments Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing Chunlizhengda Medical Instruments Co., Ltd., an orthopedic medical device company, engages in the research and development, production, and sale of surgical implants, instruments, and related products in the People's Republic of China. The company offers implantable orthopedic medical devices, which consist of joint prosthesis products and spinal products. It primarily sells its products through distributors, or on ODM and OEM bases under the Chunli brand, as well as to hospitals directly. The company also exports its products to 38 countries and regions in Asia, South America, Africa, Oceania, and Europe. Beijing Chunlizhengda Medical Instruments Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.

name: Guizhou Aviation Technical Development Co., Ltd
summary: Guizhou Aviation Technical Development Co., Ltd. specializes in the design, manufacturing, and commercialization of circular forged components. A key area of their expertise also encompasses advanced ring forgings for the aerospace industry. These high-performance parts are indispensable across a wide array of demanding sectors, such as aviation, shipbuilding, high-speed rail transport, nuclear energy, the broader space exploration field, and heavy construction machinery. The company, which was founded in 2006, has its main operations located in Guiyang, China.

name: Goodwill E-Health Info Co., Ltd.
summary: Goodwill E-Health Info Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development of medical information software in China. The company offers comprehensive electronic medical records, specialist electronic medical records, hospital data centers, smart medical product systems, internet medical product systems, hospital evaluation solutions, county medical community solutions, medical research solutions, cloud HIS platform, and smart elderly care solutions. It also provides IT strategic planning, management consulting, information system design, application software development, and operation and maintenance value-added services. The company was founded in 2006 and is based in Beijing, China.

name: China Southern Power Grid Technology Co.,Ltd
summary: China Southern Power Grid Technology Co., Ltd. delivers advanced technical services and intelligent equipment specifically designed for the power energy system sector. Its service portfolio encompasses specialized technical support for energy storage systems, along with comprehensive testing and commissioning solutions. The company's intelligent product offerings include robotics (such as drones), sophisticated smart power distribution apparatus, and cutting-edge smart monitoring devices. Founded in 1988, the enterprise is headquartered in Guangzhou, China.

name: Nexchip Semiconductor Corporation
summary: Nexchip Semiconductor Corporation engages in the research, development, production, and sale of integrated circuit-related products in China and internationally. The company offers display driver chips, CMOS image sensors, microcontrollers, power management, and logic applications products for use in consumer electronics, smartphones, smart home appliances, security, industrial control, and automotive electronics. It also provides technical services, including design and manufacturing services. In addition, the company engages in the research and development of electronic special materials, and new materials technologies; design and development; business management; business management, socio-economic, financial, information technology, and information consulting services; and investment activities. Nexchip Semiconductor Corporation was founded in 2015 and is based in Hefei, China.

name: Hangzhou Kaierda Welding Robot Co.,Ltd.
summary: Hangzhou Kaierda Welding Robot Co.,Ltd. engages in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of industrial welding equipment and welding robots in China. The company offers ultra-low splash and servo welding products, industrial robot arms and controllers, and semi-automatic and fully manual welding equipment; and after-sales services. Its products are used in automobile and auto parts manufacturing, fitness equipment, metal furniture, and other industries. The company was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.

name: Cambricon Technologies Corporation Limited
summary: Cambricon Technologies Corporation Limited creates core processor chips for various types of intelligent cloud servers, intelligent edge devices, and intelligent terminals. It offers terminal intelligent processor IPs, smart accelerator cards, and edge artificial intelligence acceleration cards; and Cambricon NeuWare, a software development platform for its cloud, edge, and end intelligent processor products. The company was founded in 2016 and is based in Beijing, China.

name: Shareate Tools Ltd.
summary: Shareate Tools Ltd., a manufacturer based in Suzhou, China, specializes in the production and distribution of advanced drilling implements and cemented carbide products. Its extensive product line encompasses a variety of rock drilling solutions, including rotary and tri-cone bits, water well bits, and down-the-hole (DTH) hammers with their corresponding bits. The company also supplies numerous tungsten carbide items specifically for mining applications, such as inserts, substrates, shield machine tools, coal cutter picks, and tungsten carbide tubular electrodes. Further offerings include precision components, diverse cutting tools, and a selection of tungsten carbide die products like plates, cold headings, hobs, and powder metallurgy dies, in addition to cermet materials. These specialized tools and materials cater to a broad spectrum of industries, including mining, oil and gas exploration, metalworking, petroleum, aerospace, electronics, maritime construction, chemical processing, textiles, and machinery manufacturing. Shareate Tools extends its reach globally, exporting products to regions such as South America, Africa, Australia, Russia, South Korea, the United States, and Canada. Established in 1973, the company adopted its current name, Shareate Tools Ltd., in May 2012, having previously operated as Kingdream Shareate Tools Ltd.

name: Jiangsu Eazytec Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu Eazytec Co., Ltd. is a China-based company specializing in the research, development, production, and sales of intelligent equipment and automated production lines. Their products are used in various industries, including electronics, automotive, and machinery. Jiangsu Eazytec Co., Ltd. is headquartered in China.

name: Triductor Technology (Suzhou) Inc.
summary: Triductor Technology (Suzhou) Inc. operates as a semiconductor company, specializing in the development and supply of mixed-signal integrated circuits, along with complementary hardware and software applications. Their offerings include chipsets for power line communication and carrier access networks. The company's service portfolio encompasses chip layout design, customized application solutions, and various technical support services. Furthermore, Triductor Technology provides communication algorithms, system software development, and both digital and analog circuit design expertise. Established in 2005, the firm is headquartered in Suzhou, China.

name: Suzhou GYZ Electronic Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Suzhou GYZ Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. is a China-based company specializing in the development, manufacturing, and sales of precision electronic components. Their products are used in various industries, including consumer electronics, automotive, and industrial equipment. Suzhou GYZ Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. is headquartered in China.

name: Suzhou Oriental Semiconductor Company Limited
summary: Headquartered in Suzhou, China, Suzhou Oriental Semiconductor Company Limited is a Chinese enterprise specializing in semiconductor technology, established in 2008. The company develops and supplies a diverse portfolio of products, including GreenMOS, SGTMOS, IGBTs, hybrid FETs, and Silicon Carbide (SiC) devices. These components are essential for a variety of applications, such as switched-mode power supplies (SMPS), inverters, motor drivers, and electric vehicle (EV) charging systems, among others.

name: C*Core Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: CCore Technology Co., Ltd., a leading semiconductor design firm based in China, delivers a broad spectrum of integrated circuit solutions. The company specializes in intellectual property (IP) licensing, custom chip development, and the provision of its own brand of chips and modules. These offerings are strategically deployed to bolster security across numerous sectors, encompassing cloud computing, big data analytics, the Internet of Things (IoT), intelligent storage, industrial automation, financial technology, server infrastructures, automotive systems, and smart consumer devices. In addition to its product lines, CCore provides comprehensive design services, including a diverse portfolio of IP products such as CPUs, IP libraries, and third-party tools. It also develops System-on-Chip (SoC) platforms specifically engineered for applications in industrial control, automotive electronics, IoT, and information security. The company further extends its offerings to include biosafety products and integrated software-hardware packages. Fundamentally, CCore's innovations are primarily utilized in critical domains like information security, automotive and industrial control systems, edge computing, and network communications. Established in 2001, the company operates from its headquarters in Suzhou, China.

name: Shanghai Model Organisms Center, Inc.
summary: Shanghai Model Organisms Center, Inc. (SMOC) is a prominent Chinese enterprise dedicated to the research and development of genetically engineered animal models. The company offers a broad spectrum of specialized rodent models, encompassing disease-specific, humanized, immunodeficient, tool, and fluorescent reporter strains of both mice and rats. Furthermore, SMOC produces custom cellular products, including fluorescently labeled, primary, and humanized cell lines. Beyond its core product offerings, SMOC delivers a comprehensive suite of support services. These include personalized model generation, animal husbandry and breeding programs, in-depth phenotypic analysis, and critical drug screening and evaluation services for preclinical research. Established in 2000, SMOC maintains its primary operations and corporate headquarters in Shanghai, China.

name: Suzhou Zelgen Biopharmaceuticals Co., Ltd.
summary: Suzhou Zelgen Biopharmaceuticals Co., Ltd. researches and develops, manufactures, and sells medicines in the People's Republic of China. It offers small molecule and recombinant protein drugs for the treatment of liver cancer, non-small cell lung cancer, colorectal cancer, thyroid cancer, nasopharyngeal carcinomas, myelofibrosis, hemorrhage, and hepatobiliary diseases. The company was founded in 2009 and is based in Kunshan, the People's Republic of China.

name: China Catalyst Holding Co., Ltd.
summary: Based in Dalian, China, China Catalyst Holding Co., Ltd., established in 2008, is actively engaged in the research, development, production, and global distribution of zeolite catalysts, tailored process solutions, and various fine chemicals. The company, formerly known as Dalian Heterogeneous Catalyst Co., Ltd. until its rebranding in November 2015, serves the environmental protection, energy, and chemical industries. Its extensive product portfolio includes specialized molecular sieves and a wide array of catalysts such as those used for hydrogen peroxide to propylene oxide (HPPO), epichlorohydrin (POCL), high-purity methanol, hydrogenation of dimethyl oxalate to ethylene glycol (DEG), ammoximation, pyridine, medical oxygen production (via zeolite adsorbents), and isomerization. Furthermore, China Catalyst supplies fine chemical compounds like tetrapropylammonium hydroxide, N,N,N-trimethyl-1-ammonium adamantine, and isopentenyl alcohol.

name: Guangdong Huate Gas Co., Ltd
summary: Guangdong Huate Gas Co., Ltd is a China-based company that specializes in the production, distribution, and sale of industrial gases. Their products are used in various industries including electronics, chemicals, and metallurgy. Guangdong Huate Gas Co., Ltd is headquartered in China.

name: Kaili Catalyst & New Materials Co.,Ltd.
summary: Kaili Catalyst & New Materials Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of precious metal catalysts in China and internationally. The company offers palladium, platinum, rhodium, ruthenium, and iridium series of catalysts. It also engages in research and development of catalytic application technology, and the recycling and reprocessing of waste precious metals catalysts. The company’s products are used in medicines, pesticides, dyes, pigments, paints, liquid crystal materials, electronic materials, petrochemicals, and other sectors. The company was formerly known as Xi'an Kaili Chemical Co., Ltd. Kaili Catalyst & New Materials Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1980 and is based in Xi'an, China.

name: Great Microwave Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Great Microwave Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of integrated circuit chips and microsystems in China. The company offers terminal radio frequency (RF) front-end chips, including terminal power amplifiers, low-noise amplifiers, and RF switches for use in wireless communication terminals, such as ad hoc networks, radios, digital intercoms, and navigation. It also provides Microsystems and modules that used in various phased array payload systems comprising spaceborne, ground-based, vehicle-mounted, and shipborne systems; and RF chips, microsystems, and modules for communications and radar industries. In addition, the company offers RF transceiver chips and ADC/DAC chips used in digital phased array systems, mobile communication systems, satellite internet, and other wireless communication terminals and communication radar systems, as well as power chips. It also provides technical services. The company was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.

name: Shanghai United Imaging Healthcare Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai United Imaging Healthcare Co., Ltd. engages in the provision, development, and production of advanced medical imaging solutions, radiotherapy equipment, life science instruments, and intelligent digital solutions worldwide. The company provides molecular imaging products; and magnetic resonance imaging solutions. It also offers computed tomography equipment; digital radiography equipment; mammography equipment; angiography equipment; mobile C-arm equipment; and radiotherapy systems comprising uRT-linac 506c, uRT-linac 306, and Intelligent RT Cloud Ecosystem. In addition, it provides uVision, a remote vision system that enables real-time positioning observation and automatic field of view identification; a low-dose, 3D mammography platform; and Remote Vision and Exposure Control technology application, a handheld X-ray from UIH that enables accurate positioning while reducing exposure radiation. Further, the company offers United Neuro, a medical imaging software used to analyze functional magnetic resonance imaging and diffusion tensor imaging data, and U-VIEWER, software that helps in viewing DICOM images. Additionally, it provides training, monitoring, maintenance, and troubleshooting services. Shanghai United Imaging Healthcare Co., Ltd. was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.

name: Beijing Fjr Optoelectronic Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing Fjr Optoelectronic Technology Co., Ltd. is a prominent producer of advanced optoelectronic solutions, specializing in infrared thermal imaging movement components and photoelectric sensors. These specialized products are integral to a wide array of applications, spanning from security monitoring and national defense to industrial testing and thermal measurement. Further uses include critical areas like fire search and rescue operations, advanced vehicle assisted driving systems, and various scientific research endeavors. Established in 2011, the company maintains its headquarters in Beijing, China.

name: Changchun BCHT Biotechnology Co.
summary: Changchun BCHT Biotechnology Co. Ltd. is a biopharmaceutical enterprise primarily focused on the research, development, production, and global commercialization of vaccines designed for human use. Its extensive product portfolio features key immunizations such as attenuated (live) herpes zoster and varicella vaccines, alongside a live, nasal, and freeze-dried influenza vaccine, and a rabies vaccine utilizing vero cell technology. This company was established in 2004 and is headquartered in Changchun, China.

name: TINAVI Medical Technologies Co., Ltd.
summary: TINAVI Medical Technologies Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and clinical application of orthopedic robotic systems. It offers TiRobot, an orthopedic robotic system used in orthopedic surgeries for spine and trauma. The company was founded in 2010 and is based in Beijing, China.

name: Xiamen Amoytop Biotech Co., Ltd.
summary: Xiamen Amoytop Biotech Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture, marketing, and sale of recombinant protein drugs using genetic engineering technology in China. It offers formulations, reagents, and APIs, as well as custom-manufacturing services. The company was founded in 1996 and is based in Xiamen, China.

name: Jing-jin Electric Technologies Co.,Ltd.
summary: Established in 2008 and headquartered in Beijing, China, Jing-Jin Electric Technologies (Beijing) Co., Ltd. is a global provider of advanced solutions for passenger and commercial vehicles. The company's diverse product portfolio encompasses key components for electric propulsion systems, including electric motors, e-motor controllers, electric drive modules, and electric machines. It also supplies hybrid powertrain elements such as hybrid transmissions and range extenders. Furthermore, Jing-Jin Electric offers comprehensive power battery products, specifically Battery Management Systems (BMS) and complete powerpacks.

name: Chengdu KSW Technologies Co.,Ltd.
summary: Chengdu KSW Technologies Co.,Ltd., founded in 2010 and based in Chengdu, China, specializes in the development, manufacturing, and sales of advanced wireless channel emulators and radio frequency (RF) microwave signal generators. The company delivers a wide array of solutions designed for communication testing and simulation. These include systems for 5G testing, automated test environments, MIMO V2X applications, wireless communication network assessments, radio signal acquisition and playback, channel simulation, and comprehensive equipment performance evaluation. In addition to integrated solutions, their product lineup features individual high-tech instruments such as wireless channel emulators, vector signal generators, spectrum/vector signal analyzers, vector signal transceivers, all-in-one radio testers, telemetry remote control receivers, HBI high-speed buses and modules, and other specialized measurement tools. Their clientele is diverse, serving mobile communication operators, equipment manufacturers, various radio research institutions, entities within the aerospace sector, and broader scientific research communities.

name: China Railway High-speed Electrification Equipment Corporation Limited
summary: China Railway High-Speed Electrification Equipment Corporation Limited excels in the research, manufacturing, and system integration of Overhead Contact System (OCS) equipment and urban mass transit products. The company is a prominent supplier within China's power supply equipment sector, catering to electrified railways and urban rail networks. Its comprehensive product line includes a range of OCS components specifically designed for electrified railways that operate at speeds from 160 km/h up to 350 km/h. For urban rail transportation, it provides diverse OCS components such as flexible, rigid, and mobile suspension systems, third rails, and specialized parts for maglev and straddle monorail lines. Furthermore, its offerings encompass steel columns, power fittings, construction tools, induction boards, fasteners, and various aluminum alloy castings. Founded in 1958 and based in Baoji, China, the company operates as a subsidiary of China Railway Electric Industry Co., Ltd.

name: MEMSensing Microsystems (Suzhou, China) Co., Ltd.
summary: MEMSensing Microsystems (Suzhou, China) Co., Ltd. provides MEMS sensor products and solutions in China. The company offers MEMS microphones, pressure sensors, and inertial sensors for various industries, including consumer electronics, industrial control, medical electronics and automotive, etc. It also provides MEMS design services. The company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Suzhou, China.

name: Hangzhou Hopechart IoT Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Hangzhou Hopechart IoT Technology Co., Ltd. develops, produces, and sells driving systems and advanced driver assistance systems in China. The company was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.

name: Sansure Biotech Inc.
summary: Sansure Biotech Inc. develops and sells upstream nucleic acid extraction kits, real time PCR diagnostic and research kits, and fluorescence systems in China and internationally. The company offers novel coronavirus nucleic acid diagnostic kits; viral hepatitis and AIDS, blood screening, and extraction kits; cancer-related biomarkers; and kits for respiratory tract diseases, STDs, digestive tract diseases, prenatal and postnatal care, and genetic diseases, as well as instruments and other consumables. It serves hospitals and laboratories. The company was founded in 2008 and is based in Changsha, China.

name: Zhejiang Heda Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Heda Technology Co., Ltd. is a key player in the water industry, providing advanced solutions for comprehensive water management. The company's extensive hardware portfolio includes intelligent products for leak detection and early warning, alongside smart valves for precise pressure regulation. It also manufactures a variety of advanced metering devices, such as remote multi-stream water meters (available in dry and wet types) and high-precision rotary-wing models. Furthermore, Heda offers specialized monitoring terminals to track vital metrics, including drainage levels, road water levels, smart manhole cover status, and pipeline velocity. Beyond hardware, Heda delivers a robust array of software platforms. These encompass unified smart water platforms, IoT connectivity solutions, emergency command systems, and sophisticated big data business intelligence tools for water resource analysis. The software capabilities extend to proactive leakage control and warning systems, pipeline pressure management systems, and comprehensive Geographic Information Systems (GIS) for network mapping, inspection, and maintenance. Additional software modules address field work order management and grid operational oversight. Moreover, Heda's software suite encompasses solutions for optimizing core operations, including production scheduling, scientific dispatch, online hydraulic modeling, and intelligent analysis with early warning for anomalous events. Specific management systems cater to secondary water supply, agricultural drinking water, application oversight, operating fee processing, comprehensive customer service, and metrology center functions. The company also furnishes systems for efficient equipment and water quality management. Established in 2000, Zhejiang Heda Technology Co., Ltd. maintains its headquarters in Jiaxing, China.

name: Zhejiang Orient Gene Biotech Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Orient Gene Biotech Co., Ltd. researches and develops, produces, and sells colloidal gold tests, urinalysis strips, raw materials, instruments, and molecular diagnosis products primarily in China. Its products include genetic diagnosis products; colloidal gold rapid diagnostic tests for drugs of abuse, infectious diseases, fertility, cardiac and tumor markers, and autoimmunity; dry chemical strips; bio-liquid diagnostic kits; clinical test instruments; POCT time-resolved fluor immunoassay test kits; raw materials; etc. The company also exports its products to North and South America, Europe, South Asia, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, Africa, Russia, and Australia. Zhejiang Orient Gene Biotech Co., Ltd. was founded in 2005 and is based in Huzhou, China.

name: Ningbo Solartron Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Ningbo Solartron Technology Co.,Ltd. researches, develops, produces, and sells functional films in China and internationally. It offers reflective, back sheet base, optical base, and other high performance functional films for use in liquid crystal display, semiconductor lighting, new energy, semiconductor flexible circuit board, and other fields. The company was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Ningbo, China.

name: Novoray Corporation
summary: Novoray Corporation researches, develops, manufactures, and sells industrial powder materials for various applications worldwide. The company offers crystalline silica powder, fused silica powder, soft composite silica powder, round corner crystalline silica powder, spherical silica powder, spherical aluminum oxide powder, sub-micron spherical silica powder, and acicular powder. It serves electronic materials, electrical insulating materials, ceramics, precision casting, paints and coatings, silicon rubber, functional rubber, plastics, and building materials manufacturing industries worldwide. Novoray Corporation was founded in 1984 and is based in Lianyungang, China.

name: iRay Technology Company Limited
summary: iRay Technology Company Limited develops, manufactures, and sells flat panel X-ray detectors for use in medical, dental, oncology, veterinary, security, and industrial imaging applications in China and internationally. It offers wireless radiography, tethered radiography, mammography, dynamic/real-time, and linear detector array products, as well as related software. The company was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.

name: Xinjiang Daqo New Energy Co.,Ltd.
summary: Xinjiang Daqo New Energy Co.,Ltd. focuses on the development, manufacturing, and commercialization of polysilicon, a vital component for the solar photovoltaic industry. Their offerings include various P-type single crystal polysilicon materials, specifically coral, dense aniseed, and compound feeding types. They also provide polycrystalline products such as loose bars, dense blocks, and bulk materials. Founded in 2011, the company's main operations are located in Shihezi, China, and it functions as an affiliate of Daqo New Energy Corp.

name: KEDE Numerical Control Co., Ltd.
summary: KEDE Numerical Control Co., Ltd. is a Chinese enterprise that specializes in the production and distribution of advanced Computer Numerical Control (CNC) systems alongside essential functional components. The company's product line encompasses a diverse array of machining centers, featuring sophisticated models like five-axis vertical, horizontal, and turning machines. Their offerings also include horizontal milling and turning compound units, specialized tool grinding equipment, high-speed bridge-type gantry systems, and blade milling machining centers. This extensive selection is further enhanced by their unique Detron series. In addition to complete systems, KEDE supplies vital functional parts such as precision motors, electric spindles, integrated sensing systems, direct drive milling heads, and robust turntables. Established in 2008 and headquartered in Dalian, China, KEDE Numerical Control Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Dalian Koyo Technology Group Co., Ltd.

name: OKE Precision Cutting Tools Co., Ltd.
summary: OKE Precision Cutting Tools Co., Ltd. is a China-based company specializing in the development, production, and sales of precision cutting tools. The company's products are used in machining processes across various industries, including automotive, aerospace, and mold manufacturing. OKE Precision Cutting Tools Co., Ltd. is headquartered in China.

name: Niutech Environment Technology Corporation
summary: Niutech Environment Technology Corporation engages in the research and development, production, and sale of environment protection equipment worldwide. It offers tire to oil, plastic to oil, oil purification, CB processing, biomass pyrolysis, and oil sludge systems. The company is based in Jinan, China.

name: Maider Medical Industry Equipment Co. Ltd.
summary: Maider Medical Industry Equipment Co. Ltd. is a China-based company specializing in the research, development, manufacturing, and sales of medical equipment. Their products include diagnostic imaging equipment, surgical instruments, and other medical devices used in hospitals and clinics. Maider Medical Industry Equipment Co. Ltd. is headquartered in China.

name: Chengdu M&S Electronics Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Chengdu M&S Electronics Technology Co., Ltd. is a company dedicated to the research, development, production, and sale of satellite communication technologies and systems. Operating in both the domestic Chinese and international markets, the firm's offerings include satellite navigation devices, specialized test equipment for navigation systems, and various technical support services. They also provide dynamic mobile satellite communication solutions designed for use in maritime vessels, aircraft, and automobiles. A primary application for their satellite communication products lies within the civil aviation sector. The company was established in 2013 and is headquartered in Chengdu, China.

name: Shenzhen Yanmade Technology Inc.
summary: Shenzhen Yanmade Technology Inc. engages in the research and development, design, production, and sale of automated and intelligent test equipment. The company offers automated test equipment, test fixtures, accessories, etc. It operates in the United States, Japan, South Korea, Thailand, Philippines, Taiwan, and internationally. The company was founded in 2012 and is based in Shenzhen, China.

name: Henan Shijia Photons Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Henan Shijia Photons Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of PLC photonic chips and optoelectronic devices. It offers PLC splitters, arrayed waveguide grating products, active products, optical fiber cables, and OEM platforms. The company was founded in 2010 and is based in Zhengzhou, China.

name: Kontour (Xi'an) Medical Technology Co., Ltd. Class A
summary: Kontour (Xi'an) Medical Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of Class III implantable medical devices in China. The company offers products in the fields of neurosurgery cranial repair and fixation, cardiothoracic surgery sternum fixation, and maxillofacial repair. It also provides oral products, including implants, implant guides, titanium mesh, GBR series nails, dental toolboxes, and related surgical auxiliary instruments. In addition, the company offers repair and fixation products that include traditional titanium materials, high-end PEEK materials, and absorbent polymer materials; PEEK4D bioactive plates; PEEK bone plates, titanium mesh plates, PEEK link plates, PEEK screws, titanium link plates, test molds, bone plugs, bone mesh, bone plug strips, disposable brain drainage devices, supporting surgical tools, and other complete products for skull repair and fixation surgery process. Kontour (Xi'an) Medical Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2005 and is based in Xi'an, China.

name: Novogene Co., Ltd.
summary: Novogene Co., Ltd. is a China-based genomics company providing sequencing services and bioinformatics solutions. They offer services for various research areas, including cancer, agriculture, and infectious diseases. Novogene Co., Ltd. is headquartered in China.

name: Beijing Qingyun Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing Qingyun Technology Co., Ltd. is a China-based company focusing on cloud computing and software-defined infrastructure solutions. They provide products and services for enterprises to build and manage their cloud environments. Beijing Qingyun Technology Co., Ltd. is headquartered in China.

name: Shanghai ZJ Bio-Tech Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai ZJ Bio-Tech Co., Ltd., established in 2005 and headquartered in Shanghai, China, specializes in the innovation, manufacturing, and distribution of molecular genetic diagnostic reagents, alongside related instruments and equipment, specifically for the Chinese market.

name: Shenzhen Fortune Trend Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Fortune Trend Technology Co., Ltd. provides securities market trading system software and securities information services in China and internationally. Its software products include market analysis system, securities trading system, intelligent service system, etc. The company also provides software maintenance services, such as software maintenance and upgrades, emergency support, irregular return visits, technical consultation, technical training, etc. In addition, it offers securities information services comprising authorized market information and financial data services for institutional or individual customers. Shenzhen Fortune Trend Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2007 and is based in Shenzhen, China.

name: Chengdu Olymvax Biopharmaceuticals Inc.
summary: Chengdu Olymvax Biopharmaceuticals Inc. specializes in the research, development, and distribution of vaccines. Their current product portfolio includes immunizations against tetanus, a severe and often fatal infectious disease that damages the nervous system due to toxins produced by Clostridium tetani, alongside a vaccine for Haemophilus influenzae type b. Beyond their existing offerings, the company is actively advancing new vaccine candidates targeting Staphylococcus aureus, a prevalent bacterium responsible for both hospital-acquired and community infections, and illnesses associated with Group A streptococcus. This enterprise was established in 2009 and operates from its base in Chengdu, China.

name: Shenzhen Chipscreen Biosciences Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Chipscreen Biosciences Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, and sale of original small molecule drugs. The company develops precursor compounds and original new drug product lines that are in various research phase of the specific global intellectual property protection in three areas, such as cancer, metabolic diseases, and autoimmune diseases. Shenzhen Chipscreen Biosciences Co., Ltd. was founded in 2001 and is based in Shenzhen, China.

name: Rayitek Hi-Tech Film Company Ltd., Shenzhen
summary: Rayitek Hi-Tech Film Company Ltd., Shenzhen is a China-based company specializing in the development, production, and sales of high-performance films and coatings. The company's products are used in various industries, including electronics, automotive, and construction. Rayitek Hi-Tech Film Company Ltd., Shenzhen is headquartered in China.

name: Beijing Jingwei Hirain Technologies Co., Inc.
summary: Beijing Jingwei Hirain Technologies Co., Inc. is a Chinese enterprise dedicated to the development, manufacturing, and commercialization of sophisticated electronic systems for the automotive sector. The company offers a broad array of products, including pioneering solutions for intelligent driving and advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS). These encompass intelligent driving domain controllers, vehicle-mounted computing platforms, millimeter-wave radar units, vehicle cameras, high-precision positioning modules, and driver monitoring systems. Additionally, the firm provides smart connectivity electronics, such as remote communication controllers (T-Box) and gate controllers. For vehicle body and comfort functionalities, Beijing Jingwei Hirain supplies various electronic components, including anti-pinch controllers, full-featured body control systems for passenger vehicles, keyless entry and start systems, dedicated body domain controllers, door and body control systems for commercial vehicles, electric tailgate controllers, door domain controllers, and seat controllers. Its portfolio also extends to chassis control systems, featuring electric power steering controllers, electronic parking systems, brake-by-wire technology, and chassis domain controllers. Furthermore, the company delivers electronic solutions for new energy and powertrain systems, suchising vehicle control units, battery management systems, and power transfer modules. Beyond its extensive product range, Beijing Jingwei Hirain offers customized development services for specific automotive electronic needs. The company, which was founded in Beijing, China, in 2003, continues to operate from its base in the city.

name: Shenzhen S-king Intelligent Equipment Co., Ltd. Class A
summary: Shenzhen S-king Intelligent Equipment Co., Ltd. engages in research, development, production, and sale of intelligent equipment and provision of technology system solutions. Its products include flat panel display module equipment, semiconductor equipment, camera module equipment, and Linear motor products. The company was founded by Yi Hong Huang and Yi Fen Huang on June 14, 2004 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.

name: Suzhou Iron Technology CO.,LTD
summary: Suzhou Iron Technology CO.,LTD. engages in the provision of intelligent medical material management solutions in China and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Smart Pharmacy, Smart Ward, Smart Warehousing, and Pharmaceutical Information. It offers drug storage and dispensing integration solutions; and automated manipulator dispensing, intelligent storage and retrieval, automated disassembly and repackaging, narcotic drugs dispensary, automated self-service medication dispensing, and automated blister medication dispensing systems, as well as narcotic drugs and category-psychotropic substances management machines. The company also provides intelligent medical supplies management cabinets, self-built building touchless sanitization systems, and hospital-wide integrated nursing solutions, as well as automatic packing machine for tablets and capsules, and integrated machine for medicine basket cleaning and disinfection. In addition, the company offers a software information management platform that provides medical services to various levels of medical institutions to establish a smart medical service system. Suzhou Iron Technology CO.,LTD. was founded in 2006 and is based in Suzhou, China.

name: Shanghai Holystar Information Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Holystar Information Technology Co., Ltd. is a China-based company specializing in providing IT solutions and services for the financial industry. They offer software for banking, securities, and insurance companies. Shanghai Holystar Information Technology Co., Ltd. is headquartered in China.

name: RemeGen Co. Ltd. Class A
summary: RemeGen Co., Ltd., a biopharmaceutical company, discovers, develops, produces, and commercializes biological drugs for the treatment of autoimmune, oncology, and ophthalmic diseases in Mainland China and the United States. The company offers Telitacicept (RC18) for the treatment of systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) autoimmune disease, rheumatoid arthritis, and myasthenia gravis; and Disitamab Vedotin (RC48), an antibody drug conjugate for the treatment of gastric cancer, urothelial carcinoma, breast cancer, and other tumors. It also develops products in various stages, including RC-28E, a fusion protein that targets vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) and fibroblast growth factor (FGF); RC88, an antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) that targets mesothelin; and RC148, a bispecific antibody ADC drug that in Phase1/2 clinical studies targeting program cell death protein 1 (PD-1) and VEGF; RC278, an ADC drug for the treatment of multiple solid tumors; and RC288, a dual-antibody ADC drug for the treatment of various tumors. The company was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Yantai, the People's Republic of China.

name: Xi'an Bright Laser Technologies Co.,Ltd.
summary: Xi'an Bright Laser Technologies Co.,Ltd. delivers comprehensive solutions for metal additive manufacturing and restoration. Its extensive range of offerings includes bespoke products, specialized equipment, fundamental raw materials, proprietary software, along with advanced 3D printing and various other technical services. The company's services benefit a wide spectrum of industries, notably aerospace, national security, energy production, medicine, tooling, and the automotive sector. Established in 2011, its principal operations are located in Xi'an, People's Republic of China.

name: Shanghai CEO Technology Co., Ltd. Class A
summary: Founded in 2011 and based in Shanghai, China, Shanghai CEO Technology Co., Ltd. (which rebranded from Shanghai CEO Environmental Protection Technology Co., Ltd. in May 2025) specializes in providing comprehensive environmental remediation solutions. The company offers advanced equipment and services primarily focused on two key areas: sludge management and waste gas purification. For sludge treatment, their offerings include sophisticated dehydration and drying technologies, notably integrated low-temperature vacuum systems. In the realm of air quality, they supply a variety of exhaust gas purification technologies, such as active oxygen ion systems, chemical treatment processes, biological filters, and molecular capture catalytic oxidation equipment. Beyond product provision, Shanghai CEO Technology is deeply involved in servicing urban and industrial park sewage treatment facilities. They also cover the full lifecycle of energy-saving and environmental protection technologies and equipment, from research and development and design to manufacturing, integration, installation, and ongoing maintenance. Their expertise extends to the purification of both odorous pollutants and volatile organic compounds (VOCs). The company further supports its clients with a range of specialized services, including carbon consulting, the development of emission reduction strategies, general equipment trading, comprehensive operation and maintenance services, and bespoke solutions tailored to specific needs.

name: Sunshine Guojian Pharmaceutical (Shanghai) Co., Ltd
summary: Sunshine Guojian Pharmaceutical (Shanghai) Co., Ltd is a China-based biopharmaceutical company focused on the research, development, manufacturing and commercialization of innovative antibody drugs. The company's products target major diseases, including cancer and autoimmune diseases. Sunshine Guojian Pharmaceutical (Shanghai) Co., Ltd is headquartered in China.

name: Beijing Succeeder Technology Inc.
summary: Beijing Succeeder Technology Inc. engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of in-vitro diagnostic products in China and internationally. Its products include coagulation analyzers and reagents, blood rheology analyzers, ESR analyzers, and platelet aggregation analyzers. The company was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.

name: Beijing SinoHytec Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing SinoHytec Co., Ltd. is a China-based company specializing in the development, production, and sales of hydrogen fuel cell systems and components. Their products are used in fuel cell vehicles and other applications. Beijing SinoHytec Co., Ltd. is headquartered in China.

name: Guangdong Greenway Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Founded in 2010, Guangdong Greenway Technology Co., Ltd. operates from Dongguan, China. This company specializes in the entire lifecycle of lithium-ion batteries, encompassing their research, development, manufacturing, and distribution to the market.

name: Hua Hong Semiconductor Ltd
summary: Hua Hong Semiconductor Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the manufacture and sale of semiconductor products in China, North America, Asia, and Europe. The company offers embedded non-volatile memory; standalone non-volatile memory, including NOR flash and EEPROM; power discrete devices; analog and power management platform; and specialty logic RF processes and image sensors. It also provides design services which covers design methodologies and design flow support, standard and customized internet protocol development, ASIC design, and one-stop services; multi-project wafer services; mask marking services; and backend, testing development, mass production, product engineering, and backside processing services. In addition, the company engages in real estate development; and trading activities. Its products are used in consumer electronics, industrial control, automotive electronics, Internet of Things, and communications and computers applications. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Shanghai, the People's Republic of China.

name: Jiangsu Feymer Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu Feymer Technology Co., Ltd. produces and sells hydrophilic functional polymers in China. The company offers functional monomers; chemicals for water and sludge treatment, membrane, pulp and paper, mineral washing, textile printing and dyeing, and oil and gas production; and water treatment membrane products. Jiangsu Feymer Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2010 and is based in Zhangjiagang, China.

name: Suzhou Mingzhi Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Established in 2003 and headquartered in Suzhou, China, this enterprise specializes in the engineering, development, and manufacturing of both core shop solutions and aluminum cast components. Its extensive array of core shop offerings encompasses essential equipment like core shooters, gassing units, and sand preparation systems. The firm also supplies diverse molds (permanent and semi-permanent), fixtures, and core boxes, alongside advanced solutions for inline core production, core centers, and inorganic process core technology. Beyond core shop items, the company fabricates aluminum castings tailored for a broad spectrum of applications, including parts for commercial and passenger vehicles, heat exchangers, railway equipment, and valves. Moreover, it provides expert services in core and casting research and development.

name: Jenkem Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Jenkem Technology Co., Ltd. develops and manufactures polyethylene glycol derivative (PEG) products in China. The company offers branched, linear, double substituted, heterofunctional double substituted, multi-arm, multi-arm hetero functional double substituted, and monodisperse PEG products, as well as amino, sulfhydryl, and N-terminal pegylated PEG products. It also provides PEGylation services for proteins, peptides, oligonucleotides, and small molecules, as well as custom PEG synthesis of PEG derivatives. The company was founded in 2001 and is based in Beijing, China.

name: Luoyang Jianlong Micro-nano New Material Co., Ltd
summary: Luoyang Jianlong Micro-nano New Material Co., Ltd is a China-based company that focuses on the research, development, production, and sales of micro-nano new materials. The company's products are used in various industries, including electronics, aerospace, and chemical engineering. Luoyang Jianlong Micro-nano New Material Co., Ltd is headquartered in China.

name: Chison Medical Technologies Co., Ltd.
summary: Chison Medical Technologies Co., Ltd. is a China-based company specializing in the development, manufacturing, and sales of medical ultrasound imaging systems. Their products are used in hospitals and clinics for diagnosis and monitoring of various medical conditions. Chison Medical Technologies Co., Ltd. is headquartered in China.

name: Guangzhou Sanfu New Materials Technology Co.,Ltd
summary: Guangzhou Sanfu New Materials Technology Co., Ltd. is a surface finishing technology solutions provider, primarily engaged in the research of surface finishing technologies and the development, production, and sales of new environmentally friendly surface finishing specialized chemicals and equipment. Its products are widely used in PCB manufacturing, 3C product manufacturing, automotive parts, hardware and sanitary ware, new energy, and many other industrial fields.

name: Zhejiang Damon Technology Co.,Ltd
summary: Zhejiang Damon Technology Co.,Ltd manufactures and sells logistics sorting equipment. The company offers box, pallet, sorting, and vertical conveyors; high speed palletizing systems; and intelligent storage picking systems. Its products are used in smart manufacturing, e-commerce, logistics, clothing, medicine, tobacco, retail, and other fields. The company was founded in 1997 and is based in Shanghai, China.

name: Skyverse Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Skyverse Technology Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells quality control equipment to enterprises involved in the front-end integrated circuit processes and packaging in China and internationally. The company offers unpatterned, three-in-one patterned, dark-field nano patterned, patterned, and bright- field nano patterned wafer defect inspection equipment; and optical critical dimension, metal film thickness, ratio etch, overlay, e-beam critical dimension, optical diffraction, wafer flatness, 3D surface profiling, and dielectric film metrology equipment series. It also provides software services, such as yield management, semiconductor auto defect classification, and semiconductor litho analysis and control systems. The company was founded in 2014 and is based in Shenzhen, China.

name: Bloomage BioTechnology Corporation Limited
summary: Bloomage BioTechnology Corporation Limited, an investment holding company, develops, manufactures, and sells bio-chemical products in China, rest of Asia, the Americas, Europe, and internationally. It offers sodium hyaluronic acid (HA) raw materials and end products for use in pharmaceutical, cosmetic, and health care products. The company's HA materials include pharmaceutical grade sodium hyaluronate under the Hyatrue name; food grade sodium hyaluronate under the HAPLEX name; cosmetic grade sodium hyaluronate under the Freda name; and Oligo HA under the Mini HA name. Its end products comprise modified sodium hyaluronic gel for injection under the BioHyalux and Dermallure names. The company also trades in HA end products and raw materials, cosmetic products, and medical devices. Bloomage BioTechnology Corporation Limited was founded in 2003 and is based in Central, Hong Kong.

name: Hangzhou Raycloud Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Hangzhou Raycloud Technology Co., Ltd. operates as an e-commerce software and service technology company. The company offers various products and services that help e-commerce merchants to do business. It provides e-commerce SaaS products and supporting hardware, as well as CRM SMS and operation services. The company's e-commerce SaaS products include super store manager, super express, and other software. Hangzhou Raycloud Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2016 and is based in Hangzhou, China.

name: Shanghai Haohai Biological Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Haohai Biological Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of biomedical materials in Mainland China, the United States, the United Kingdom, and internationally. The company offers ophthalmology, medical aesthetics and wound care, orthopedics, anti-adhesion, and homostasis products. It also provides medical sodium hyaluronate, medical chitosan, medical collagen sponge, and recombinant human epidermal growth factor (rhEGF), as well as biological reagents and materials. In addition, the company engages in the manufacture and sale of contact lens and intraocular lens materials, machines, and accessories; and investment and trading businesses. Further, it is involved in research and development of biological engineering and pharmaceutical products, as well as in the provision of related technology transfer, and consultation services. The company was formerly known as Haohai Limited and changed its name to Shanghai Haohai Biological Technology Co., Ltd. in 2010. Shanghai Haohai Biological Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.

name: Hefei Gocom Information Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Hefei Gocom Information Technology Co.,Ltd. is a Chinese company specializing in the development, manufacturing, and distribution of advanced signaling and intelligent dispatching systems for industrial railway applications. Their offerings also encompass monitoring solutions for narrow-gauge industrial rail transport and comprehensive information system integration services. These products are widely utilized across a diverse range of sectors, including metallurgy, mining, petrochemicals, port operations, power generation, and urban rail transit, specifically serving dedicated and specialized railway lines. The company, headquartered in Hefei, China, was established in 2000.

name: Shanghai Bright Power Semiconductor Co., Ltd.
summary: Established in 2008 and based in Shanghai, China, Shanghai Bright Power Semiconductor Co., Ltd. specializes in the design, manufacturing, and distribution of analog and mixed-signal integrated circuits. The company offers a comprehensive portfolio of solutions, particularly for LED lighting applications, encompassing a wide array of AC/DC drivers (including isolated, non-isolated, high/low power factor, linear, and flicker-free types, as well as constant voltage and current drives), DC drivers, auxiliary power ICs, and various dimming controls (such as switch, stepless, and SCR dimming). Beyond lighting, their products extend to AC/DC power supplies for household appliances and charger adapters. Furthermore, they provide essential components for motor control, including microcontrollers (MCUs), drive ICs, smart power modules, and field-effect transistors (FETs). Their advanced offerings also feature polyphase digital controllers, smart integrated power devices, integrated DC-DC converters, and electronic switch/hot-swap control circuits.

name: BeiJing Seeyon Internet Software Corp.
summary: BeiJing Seeyon Internet Software Corp. provides collaborative management software, solutions, and cloud services for organizational customers in China. It offers universal solutions covering process management, knowledge management, group control, portal management, and system integration; and business application solutions comprising cost budget, human resource, project, fixed asset, office equipment, procurement, document, conference, and sales management. The company also provides automotive, retail, IT service, clothing manufacturing, electronic, steel, food, pharmaceutical, and instrumentation industry solutions. In addition, it offers support services. The company was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.

name: Guobo Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Guobo Electronics Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of active phased array transmitter and receiver components and radio frequency integrated circuits in China. It offers active phased array T/R modules, RF modules, RF amplifier chips, and RF control chips for research institutes, OEMs, and mobile communication equipment manufacturers. The company was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Nanjing, China.

name: Nanjing Develop Advanced Manufacturing Co., Ltd.
summary: Nanjing Develop Advanced Manufacturing Co., Ltd. (NDAM) is a Chinese firm dedicated to the engineering, production, and commercialization of essential components for the oil and gas sector. The company's extensive product line features a variety of specialized items, including critical wellhead equipment like casing heads and tubing heads, spools, fracturing pump cylinders, Blowout Preventers (BOPs), and various pipeline valves. NDAM's robust offerings are vital across a broad spectrum of petroleum and natural gas operations. Their components support diverse applications, ranging from surface and subsea wellhead systems and drilling activities to shale gas fracturing and high-pressure fluid transportation, serving numerous conventional and unconventional oil and gas fields. The company's operational base is situated in Nanjing, China.

name: Jilin OLED Material Tech Co., Ltd.
summary: Jilin OLED Material Tech Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of organic electroluminescent materials and equipment for the new display industry in China. It offers electronic functional materials; hole functional materials; light-emitting functional materials, such as fluorescent materials and phosphorescent materials; OLED intermediates; and other functional materials. The company also exports its products to Japan, South Korea, Europe, the United States, and other countries. Jilin OLED Material Tech Co., Ltd. was founded in 2005 and is based in Changchun, China.

name: Hangzhou Huaguang Advanced Welding Materials Co., Ltd.
summary: Hangzhou Huaguang Advanced Welding Materials Co., Ltd. engages in the research and fabrication of welding materials; and provision of welding solutions in China and internationally. The company primarily produces copper-based and silver-based welding materials in the forms of rods, rings, wires, strips, foils, powder, paste, flux-cored, and flux-coated. Its products include silver brazing, copper-phosphorus brazing, high copper brazing, brass brazing, aluminum brazing, flux-cored brazing, and flux-coated brazing alloys, as well as brazing flux and alloys for vacuum welding. The company's products are useed in the industries of refrigeration, household appliances, machinery, electric appliances, aeronautics, petrochemical, automobiles, tools, hard alloys, measurements, new energy equipment, bathroom facilities, railroad systems, etc. Hangzhou Huaguang Advanced Welding Materials Co., Ltd. was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.

name: Shenzhen Xinyichang Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Xinyichang Technology Co., Ltd. is a China-based company specializing in the design, development, and sales of high-performance analog and mixed-signal integrated circuits (ICs). Their products are used in various applications, including power management, motor control, and sensor interfaces. Shenzhen Xinyichang Technology Co., Ltd. is headquartered in China.

name: Shanghai Fudan Microelectronics Group Company Limited
summary: Shanghai Fudan Microelectronics Group Company Limited designs, develops, and sells products of specific application integrated circuits (ICs) in Mainland China, rest of the Asia Pacific, and internationally. It offers security and identification products, including contact and contactless memory ICs, NFC tag and channel ICs, HF RFID tag ICs, contactless CPU card, chips, contact dual interface, CPU card chips, secured encryption chips, and HF readers. The company also provides smart meters ASIC chips, ultra-low general purpose MCU, and ePLC solutions; NVM products, such as EEPROM, SPI NOR flash, SPI and parallel NAND flash, and ASNVM; and specific analog circuits, including earth leakage protection device, lighting circuit, auto and motorcycle circuit, communication circuit, consumer electronics, etc. In addition, it offers bank, smart meter, social security, and smart transportation card solutions. Further, the company designs, develops, and sells IC testing software and products; produces probe cards; and offers research and consultancy services of IC technology, as well as testing services for IC products. The company was formerly known as Shanghai Fudan Microelectronics Company Limited. Shanghai Fudan Microelectronics Group Company Limited was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Shanghai, the People's Republic of China.

name: Pan Asian Microvent Tech (Jiangsu) Corporation
summary: Pan Asian Microvent Tech (Jiangsu) Corporation is a China-based company that develops and manufactures venting solutions for various applications. Their products are used in automotive, electronics, and packaging industries. Pan Asian Microvent Tech (Jiangsu) Corporation is headquartered in China.

name: CICT Mobile Communication Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: CICT Mobile Communication Technology Co., Ltd. provides mobile communication network equipment and mobile communication technology services to telecom operators in China and internationally. The company offers 8-ports, 12-ports, 16-ports, and 20-ports antenna; RAN products, such as AAU, all in one, BBU, mRRU, pRRU, and RRU series; and indoor and outdoor CPE series. It also provides operation solutions comprising fixed wireless access and IBS; enterprise solutions, including smart grid and mining, as well as smart city rail; and wireless network service, digitization and intelligent service, network construction and optimization, digital talent empowerment, and network O and M solutions. CICT Mobile Communication Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 1998 and is based in Wuhan, China.

name: Guangdong Jiayuan Technology Co.Ltd.
summary: Guangdong Jiayuan Technology Co.Ltd. manufactures and sells electrolytic copper foils. It offers single-sided matte copper foils, and double-sided light and roughened copper foils. The company was founded in 2001 and is based in Meizhou, China.

name: Shenzhen Lifotronic Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Lifotronic Technology Co., Ltd. is a China-based company specializing in the development, manufacturing, and sales of medical devices and equipment. Their products include minimally invasive surgical instruments, medical aesthetic devices, and other medical technologies. Shenzhen Lifotronic Technology Co., Ltd. is headquartered in China.

name: Jiangsu Goodwe Power Supply Technology Co., Ltd
summary: Jiangsu Goodwe Power Supply Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on the research, manufacture, and sale of PV inverters and energy storage solutions. It offers residential, commercial rooftop, ground utility, and energy storage inverters, as well as monitoring systems. The company was founded in 2010 and is based in Suzhou, China.

name: SBT Ultrasonic Technology
summary: SBT Ultrasonic Technology Co., Ltd. is engaged in the comprehensive process of researching, developing, manufacturing, and distributing advanced ultrasonic products. The company primarily focuses on providing sophisticated ultrasonic solutions for metal testing applications. Their extensive product portfolio includes a variety of ultrasonic welding systems, such as complete metal welding setups, real-time welding quality monitoring systems, and integrated smart welding and detection units. They also specialize in producing custom (ODM/OEM) horns and bottom molds. Specific welding equipment caters to applications like tapered bar and full-wave welding, as well as specialized systems for automotive wire harnesses and IGBT power module terminals. Additionally, SBT provides ultrasonic side cutting systems, including those utilized in mask production. Beyond welding, their offerings encompass diverse ultrasonic cutting solutions, featuring side cutting, straight cutting, 40kHz, and 20kHz systems. They also provide customization services for cutting assembly modifications and bespoke horns. For quality assurance and inspection, the company supplies X-ray detection systems with auto-rejection capabilities, CCD visual inspection systems specifically designed for the tire and rubber sector, and various industrial metal detectors, including pharmaceutical-grade, vertical fall, and pipeline models. SBT Ultrasonic Technology's innovative solutions serve critical roles in industries such as lithium-ion battery production, tire and rubber processing, and food and pharmaceutical quality detection. The company was established in 2007 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.

name: Guangzhou LBP Medicine Science & Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Guangzhou LBP Medicine Science & Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in the development and manufacture of innovative pathological diagnostic solutions for the Chinese market. Its comprehensive product portfolio includes advanced pathological diagnostic reagents and essential ancillary equipment. Among these are liquid-based cytology (LBC) offerings, encompassing both gynecological and non-gynecological series, complemented by specialized equipment. The company also provides fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH) products, which are applied across a broad spectrum of conditions. These applications range from various cancers, including breast, bladder, lung, cervical, prostate, and thyroid, to other complex diagnoses such as neuroblastoma, soft tissue sarcoma, diverse solid tumors, prenatal screening, complications in abortion, oligodendrocytes tumors, lymphoma, multiple myeloma, and several forms of leukemia (chronic myelogenous, chronic lymphocytic, acute myeloid, and acute lymphoblastic), as well as myelodysplastic syndromes. Furthermore, GLBP offers immunohistochemistry (IHC) products, comprising a range of antibodies, advanced detection and repair systems, complementary products, and complete IHC kits. Additionally, its capabilities extend to molecular genetic diagnosis products. Established in 2005, Guangzhou LBP Medicine Science & Technology Co., Ltd. is headquartered in Guangzhou, China.

name: Shenzhen Sine Electric Co.,Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Sine Electric Co.,Ltd. is a China-based company specializing in the research, development, production, and sales of power electronic products and solutions. Their products include variable frequency drives, servo systems, and power quality equipment. Shenzhen Sine Electric Co.,Ltd. is headquartered in China.

name: China Resources Microelectronics Limited
summary: China Resources Microelectronics Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the open foundry, integrated circuits (IC) design, IC testing and packaging, and discrete device businesses. The company provides IC manufacturing services for fables design houses and integrated device manufacturers. It also offers analog and power process technologies, including mixed signal, complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor (CMOS) logic, planar and trench double diffused metal oxide semiconductor (DMOS), an integration of bipolar and CMOS technology (BiCMOS), and DMOS devices (BCDMOS). In addition, China Resources Microelectronics Limited involves in the design and development of semiconductor IC products, such as MCU and audio and video processing SoC; analog and mixed signal ICs for power management and light emitting diode driving products; consumer ICs and wafers, including single chip radio circuits, audio amplifiers, calculation amplifiers, encoder/decoder circuits, LCD's, music voice, circuit for clock and watch, UPS and MCU, and photoelectric coupled receiver chips. Further, the company provides IC assembly, testing, and packaging services for semiconductor enterprises; and engages in the development and manufacture of power semiconductor discrete devices for energy saving lightings, home appliances, industrial control devices, and personal computers. It has operations in Mainland China, other countries in Asia, the United States, and Europe. The company was formerly known as CSMC Technologies Corporation and changed its name to China Resources Microelectronics Limited in 2008. China Resources Microelectronics Limited was founded in 1997. The company is based in Wuxi, China, and is considered a Red Chip company due to its listing on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange. As of November 2, 2011, China Resources Microelectronics Limited operates as a subsidiary of China Resources (Holdings) Co.,Ltd.

name: Fujian Supertech Advanced Material Co., Ltd.
summary: Fujian Supertech Advanced Material Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of vacuum insulation panels in China. Its vacuum insulation panels are used in refrigerators, freezers, refrigerated trucks and containers, water heaters, vending machines, ice storage tanks, and energy saving insulating materials. It also provides clod chain insulated boxes. Fujian Supertech Advanced Material Co., Ltd. was founded in 2007 and is based in Longyan, China.

name: Jiangsu Bioperfectus Technologies Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu Bioperfectus Technologies Co., Ltd. is a China-based company specializing in the development, manufacturing, and sales of molecular diagnostic products and solutions.
