Their products are used in clinical diagnostics, food safety testing, and animal health. Jiangsu Bioperfectus Technologies Co., Ltd. is headquartered in China.

name: Arctech Solar Holding Co., Ltd.
summary: Arctech Solar Holding Co., Ltd. provides solar tracking and racking systems for utilities, commercial, industrial, and residential projects worldwide. The company offers solar trackers, such as horizontal single axis trackers, horizontal single axis trackers with tilted modules, and tilt single axis trackers that improve the amount of the electricity through orientation of the PV panels towards the sun; and seasonal tilt, and dual and single pole mounting structures. As of December 31, 2018, it had a cumulatively installed capacity of approximately 19 GW; and had completed approximately 700 projects in 24 countries. The company is headquartered in Kunshan, China.

name: Genew Technologies Co.,Ltd.
summary: Genew Technologies Co.,Ltd. is a China-based company specializing in the development, manufacturing, and sales of radio frequency (RF) and microwave components and subsystems. Their products are used in various applications, including wireless communications, radar systems, and satellite communications. Genew Technologies Co.,Ltd. is headquartered in China.

name: China Railway Construction Heavy Industry Corporation Limited
summary: China Railway Construction Heavy Industry Corporation Limited (CRCHI) is a prominent global manufacturer specializing in equipment for the underground construction and rail transit industries. The company's core product offerings include heavy machinery such as tunnel boring machines (TBMs), shaft-boring machines, drilling jumbos, and concrete sprayers. It also supplies specialized tunnel vehicles for lifting and installation tasks, along with critical rail infrastructure components like railway turnouts, clips, and fasteners. CRCHI further diversifies its product range to encompass New Austrian Tunneling Method (NATM) equipment, comprehensive rail track and maglev systems, various railway transit solutions, agricultural machinery, green building construction tools, coal mine equipment, and general construction materials. Beyond products, the company delivers a full suite of services, including design, fabrication, training, on-site support, equipment refurbishment, and spare parts provision. Established in 2007, CRCHI maintains its headquarters in Changsha, China, operating as a subsidiary under the umbrella of China Railway Construction Corporation Limited.

name: GRIMP Advanced Materials Co., Ltd.
summary: GRIMP Advanced Materials Co., Ltd. is a China-based company specializing in the research, development, production, and sales of advanced composite materials. Their products are used in various industries, including aerospace, automotive, and construction. GRIMP Advanced Materials Co., Ltd. is headquartered in China.

name: GreenTech Environmental Co., Ltd.
summary: GreenTech Environmental Co., Ltd., established in 2004 and headquartered in Beijing, operates within the People's Republic of China. The company's core focus is on critical environmental projects, specifically in water management and the conversion of waste materials into usable resources. It provides a full spectrum of services, encompassing the engineering, construction, ongoing operation, management, and financial aspects of these initiatives. GreenTech's expertise extends to areas such as purifying and upgrading wastewater, facilitating water reuse, and general water environment improvement, often employing advanced membrane technologies in its solutions.

name: Chemclin Diagnostics Co., Ltd.
summary: Chemclin Diagnostics Co., Ltd. is a China-based company specializing in the research, development, production, and sales of in-vitro diagnostic products and services. They offer a range of diagnostic kits, reagents, and instruments for clinical testing. Chemclin Diagnostics Co., Ltd. is headquartered in China.

name: United Nova Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: United Nova Technology Co.,Ltd. is a global producer and supplier of power discrete components and modules, catering to both domestic Chinese and international markets. The company's comprehensive product portfolio features IGBTs, MOSFETs, analog integrated circuits (ICs), MEMS devices, and microcontrollers (MCUs). Beyond individual components, it delivers integrated system manufacturing solutions designed for critical sectors such as automotive, clean energy, industrial applications, and home appliances. Furthermore, United Nova Technology develops specialized products, including automotive-grade IGBT/SiC chips and modules, along with analog ICs crafted for high-voltage, mixed-signal applications. Established in 2018, the company initially operated as Semiconductor Manufacturing Electronics (Shaoxing) Corporation before officially changing its name to United Nova Technology Co.,Ltd. in November 2023. Its main office is situated in Shaoxing, China.

name: CSI Solar Co., Ltd.
summary: CSI Solar Co., Ltd. designs, processes, produces, and sells solar modules and photovoltaic systems in China and internationally. It operates through three segments: Components Business, Energy Business, and Energy Storage Business segments. The company offers crystalline silicon photovoltaic modules, solar system kits, inverters, and solar energy and battery energy storage systems, as well as components, silicon rods, batteries, and battery cells. It also engages in solar power and battery energy storage projects; and construction of solar power plants. In addition, the company provides engineering, procurement, and construction services. It serves the utility, commercial, residential, and industrial sectors. The company was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Suzhou, China. CSI Solar Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of Canadian Solar Inc.

name: Southchip Semiconductor Technology
summary: Southchip Semiconductor Technology (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. is a semiconductor design firm based in Shanghai, China, specializing in the creation of power and battery management solutions. The company offers a comprehensive portfolio of products, including various types of charging integrated circuits like buck-boost, charge pump, linear, wireless, and system-on-chip (SoC) chargers. Additionally, its offerings encompass battery protection components, general-purpose and charge pump DC-DC converters, and display power supply units. Southchip also provides standard load switches, along with versions integrated with USB controllers, as well as controllers for flyback and synchronous rectification circuits. Furthermore, the company develops USB Power Delivery (PD)/DPDM controllers and PD PHY chips. These advanced semiconductor products are vital for applications across consumer electronics, automotive systems, and industrial equipment. Established in 2015, Southchip Semiconductor Technology operates from its headquarters in Shanghai, China.

name: Jiangsu Aidea Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu Aidea Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. develops, produces, and sells pharmaceutical products. It offers folium sennae granules, powdered bacillus tablets, clindamycin hydrochloride capsules, sodium bicarbonate tablets, nitrendipine tablets, metronidazole tablets, compound gentamycin sulfate and procaine hydrochloride sulfate granules, and cefradine capsules, as well as raw materials. The company was founded in 2009 and is based in Yangzhou, China.

name: Yuanjie Semiconductor Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Yuanjie Semiconductor Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the design, research and development, production, and sales of optical chips in China and internationally. The company offers 2.5G, 10G, 25G, 50G, 100G, 200G; higher-speed DFB and EML laser series products; high-power silicon photonic light source products; and 1550-band automotive lidar laser chips used in the telecommunications, data center, automotive lidar, and other markets. The company was founded in 2013 and is based in Xi'an, China.

name: Guangdong Lyric Robot Automation Co.,Ltd.
summary: Guangdong Lyric Robot Automation Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of intelligent equipment in China and Internationally. It provides EV prismatic, cylindrical Li, and EV pouch battery cells; and coating machines, laser notching and slitting machines, laser cutting and stacking machines, winding machines, long prismatic and power soft pack battery cell assembly lines, forming and capacity grading machines, module and pack lines, x-ray inspection machines, aluminum shell injection machines, blade battery infusion, and ultrasonic pre- and final welding machines. The company also offers stacking and forming, as well as punching and sealing machines; nondestructive slicers and PERC laser grooving equipment; fuel cell stack assembly lines and molded graphite bipolar plate manufacturing solutions; and motor and e- motor rotor assembly lines, and three-in-one e-motor assembly solutions. In addition, it provides three-dimensional warehouses, two-way shuttles, stackers, multidimensional AGV products, and compound robots; and laser welding, marking, cutting, and cleaning machines. The company was founded in 2014 and is based in Huizhou, China.

name: HCR Co., Ltd
summary: HCR Co., Ltd. provides various data intelligence solutions in China. It offers solutions in field of data insight and focusing on the essence of business. The company assists the government to enhance the efficiency of management; and help enterprises to enhance efficiency and increase the revenue, make accurate decision, and reshape their business with the whole data driven and the artificial intelligence. It serves automobile, internet technology, consumer durable, healthcare, industrial sector, tourism, public affairs, telecom, retail, FMCG, finance, tobacco, environmental protection, and education industries. The company was founded in 2008 and is based in Beijing, China.

name: Qingdao Daneng Environmental Protection Equipment Co., Ltd.
summary: Qingdao Daneng Environmental Protection Equipment Co., Ltd. engages in the design, manufacture, and sale of energy-saving and environmental protection equipment in China. The company provides slag energy saving and environmental protection treatment systems, such as dry slag and wet slag, and CFB boiler slag treatment systems; flue gas energy saving and environmental protection treatment systems; clean energy consumption systems; and desulfurization wastewater environmental protection treatment systems. It also offers energy-saving and environmentally protection treatment system for the metallurgical industry; and high thermal conductivity modified PPS pipes. The company serves customers in the fields of electricity, heat, chemical industry, metallurgy, waste disposal, new energy, etc. The company was founded in 2006 and is based in Qingdao, China.

name: Shanghai Fudan-Zhangjiang Bio-Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Fudan-Zhangjiang Bio-Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, researches, develops, manufactures, and sells bio-pharmaceutical products. It offers genetic engineering platform drugs, including CD30-MMAE, which is in clinical trial Phase I for tumors; Trop 2 antibody-conjugated drug that is in pre-clinical studies for triple negative breast cancer, bladder and gastric cancer, and other tumors; and HER2 antibody-drug conjugate, which is in pre-clinical study for tumors. The company also provides photodynamic technical platform drugs, such as hemoporfin for port wine stain, which is in Phase IV clinical trial; aminolevulinic acid, which is in Phase II clinical trials for cervical diseases infected by HPV; and aminolevulinic acid that is in Phase I clinical trials for acne, as well as completed pre-clinical study for brain gliomas. In addition, it offers nano technical platform drugs comprising Nanoparticle Albumin-bound Paclitaxel that is in pre-clinical studies for tumors, as well as developing Doxorubicin liposome for tumors. Further, the company offers oral solid preparation technology, which includes obeticholic acid for Hepatobiliary disease; and JAK1 inhibitor that is in Phase I clinical trial for rheumatoid arthritis. Additionally, it researches and develops pharmaceutical and medical devices; medical diagnostic products; provides related services; and sells daily necessities, and clinical laboratory analysis instruments and software. It also engages in the technology development, transfer, consulting, and promotion activities; and production of freeze-dried powder injections and APIs, as well as invests in overseas medical projects. The company was founded in 1996 and is based in Shanghai, the People's Republic of China.

name: Wuxi Chipown Micro-electronics limited
summary: Wuxi Chipown Micro-electronics limited engages in the research and development, design, and supply of analog and mixed signal integrated circuits (ICs) in China. The company offers low voltage products, such as DC-DC, car charger IC, LED backlight, battery charger, current limiter, reset and detect, and high power white LED products; and high voltage products, including AC-DC, LED lighting, half-bridge driver, display driver, NeoFET, and other products. Its products are used in computers and peripheral products, mobile phones, personal digital terminals, home appliances, flat panel displays, and other fields. Wuxi Chipown Micro-electronics limited was founded in 2005 and is based in Wuxi, China.

name: Zhengyuan Geomatics Group Co.,Ltd.
summary: Zhengyuan Geomatics Group Co.,Ltd. engages in the research, development, and application of surveying and mapping geographical information technology services in China. The company operates in three segments: Surveying and Mapping Geographic Information, Underground Pipe Network, and Smart City. It offers smart city construction and operation business company; technical services for underground pipeline network safety operation and maintenance; and surveying and mapping geographic information technology service. The company serves urban construction, planning, land, railway, transportation, water conservancy, environmental protection, agriculture, forestry, marine, and other industries. Zhengyuan Geomatics Group Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1952 and is based in Beijing, China.

name: Wuxi Hyatech Co.,Ltd.
summary: WUXIHYATECH Co.Ltd is a China-based company focusing on providing solutions for smart manufacturing and industrial automation. They offer products and services for manufacturing execution systems (MES), process control, and data analytics. WUXIHYATECH Co.Ltd is headquartered in China.

name: Sichuan Tianwei Electronic Co.,Ltd.
summary: Sichuan Tianwei Electronic Co., Ltd. is a Chinese enterprise that specializes in the research, manufacturing, and sale of advanced technical solutions. The company's core offerings include sophisticated automatic fire and explosion suppression systems, high-energy ignition discharge devices for aviation, and precision fuse mechanisms. These products find critical application across a broad spectrum of industries, encompassing defense, aerospace, shipbuilding, and advanced electronics. Additionally, their technology is essential for sectors such as coal mining, energy, power generation, dust control, and transportation. The firm was established in 2001 and operates out of its headquarters in Chengdu, China.

name: Chengdu Easton Biopharmaceuticals Co., Ltd.
summary: Chengdu Easton Biopharmaceuticals Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, manufacture, and commercialization of pharmaceutical products. The company provides finished dosage forms in anesthetic/analgesics, cardiovascular, oncology, pediatrics, and other therapeutic fields. It also offers active pharmaceutical ingredients in oncology, cardiovascular, anesthetic/analgesics, anti-inflammatory, gastrointestinal, antiemetic, neurology/psychiatry , and urinary system therapeutic categories. The company was founded in 2009 and is based in Chengdu, China.

name: Wuxi Autowell Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Wuxi Autowell Technology Co.,Ltd. engages in the research, development, and manufacture of automation equipment in China. It offers photovoltaic (PV) equipment, such as wafer inspection systems, PV cell light induced annealing furnaces, PV cell laser cutting machines, high speed multi busbar cell soldering stringers, PV shingling module stringers, LRF applicators, and PV cell string inspection modules; and lithium battery equipment in cylindrical and intelligent pouch cell pack assembly lines. The company was founded in 2010 and is based in Wuxi, China.

name: JinGuan Electric Co., Ltd.
summary: JinGuan Electric Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of power transmission, distribution, and control equipment in China. The company offers lightning arresters, smart distribution network equipment, energy storage systems, and charging piles in China. It also provides metal oxide arresters, pole-mounted switches, transformers, intelligent high-voltage switchgears, primary and secondary fusion ring network cabinets, and primary and secondary fusion column switches. The company provides its products for the construction of strong smart grids. JinGuan Electric Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Nanyang, China.

name: Shenzhen United Winners Laser Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen United Winners Laser Co., Ltd. researches and develops, produces, sells, and services laser welding machine and related automation systems in China and internationally. The company offers YAG series pulse laser machines, CW and QCW fiber laser welding machine series, laser diode series, hybrid laser series, MOPA laser welding machines, and handheld laser heads. Its products are used in auto spare parts, auto white body, cylindrical battery, prismatic power battery, soft pack battery, consumer electronics, sensor, hardware and home appliance, optical communication, solar collectors, mold repair welding machine, and laser welding for plastic applications. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.

name: Nanya New Material Technology Co.,Ltd
summary: Nanya New Material Technology Co.,Ltd is a China-based company that researches, develops, produces, and sells polymer-based composite materials. The company’s products are used across industries such as transportation, construction, and energy. Nanya New Material Technology Co.,Ltd is headquartered in China.

name: Sinocelltech Group Limited
summary: Sinocelltech Group Limited, a biotech company, focuses on the development of technologies for the development and manufacturing of recombinant proteins, monoclonal antibodies, and vaccines in China. The company is based in Beijing, China.

name: VeriSilicon Microelectronics (Shanghai) Co., Ltd.
summary: VeriSilicon Microelectronics (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. provides platform-based custom silicon and semiconductor IP licensing services in China and internationally. Their products are utilized across various sectors including communications, industrial and automotive. Chengdu Zhimingda Electronics Co., Ltd. is headquartered in China.

name: Anhui Huaheng Biotechnology Co., Ltd.
summary: Anhui Huaheng Biotechnology Co., Ltd. is a China-based company specializing in the research, development, production, and sales of microbial fermentation products. Their products include amino acids, organic acids, and other bio-based chemicals used in food, animal feed, and pharmaceuticals. Anhui Huaheng Biotechnology Co., Ltd. is headquartered in China.

name: Shenzhen Xunjiexing Technology Corp. Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Xunjiexing Technology Corp. Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of printed circuit boards (PCB) in China. It offers PCB samples and batch boards, and raw materials. It serves automotive electronics, computer communications, smart consumer devices, smart security, industrial control, medical equipment, new energy, and rail transit industries. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, the People's Republic of China.

name: HOB Biotech Group Corp.,Ltd
summary: HOB Biotech Group Corp.,Ltd. operates as a in vitro diagnostic company in China and internationally. It provides diagnostic tools, such as line immune, enzyme-linked immunosorbent, and chemiluminescent paramagnetic microparticle immuno assays to laboratories and hospitals for the improvement of allergy and autoimmune disease patient care. The company was founded in 2009 and is based in Suzhou, China.

name: Youcare Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Youcare Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd. is a China-based pharmaceutical company that focuses on the research, development, manufacturing, and sales of pharmaceutical products. The company offers a range of prescription and over-the-counter drugs, as well as active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs). Youcare Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd. is headquartered in China.

name: Anhui Yuanchen Environmental Protection Science&Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Anhui Yuanchen Environmental Protection Science&Technology Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sales of filter materials and flue gas purification series environmental protection products in China and internationally. It offers dust removal filter materials and flue gas denitrification catalysts. The company’s products are used in electricity, steel and coking, waste incineration, cement, chemicals, small boilers, and new energy industries. Anhui Yuanchen Environmental Protection Science&Technology Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Hefei, China.

name: Shanghai Electric Wind Power Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Electric Wind Power Group Co., Ltd. specializes in the wind energy sector, designing and manufacturing wind turbines. The company also oversees the operation and maintenance of wind farms situated across China. Boasting a considerable footprint, its collective installed wind power capacity now exceeds 11 gigawatts. Established in 2006 and headquartered in Shanghai, China, the firm operates as an affiliate of Shanghai Electric Group Company Limited.

name: Suzhou UIGreen Micro&Nano Technologies Co.,Ltd
summary: Suzhou UIGreen Micro&Nano Technologies Co.,Ltd is a China-based company that develops and manufactures micro- and nano-scale materials and devices. The company's products are used in a wide range of applications, including electronics, energy, and biomedicine. Suzhou UIGreen Micro&Nano Technologies Co.,Ltd is headquartered in China.

name: Guangdong Fuxin Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Guangdong Fuxin Technology Co., Ltd. is a China-based company specializing in the research, development, production, and sales of precision metal components. name: WindSun Science&Technology Co.,Ltd.

name: Cubic Sensor and Instrument Co., Ltd
summary: Cubic Sensor and Instrument Co., Ltd is a China-based company that develops and manufactures gas sensors and instruments. The company's products are used for environmental monitoring, industrial safety, and medical applications. Cubic Sensor and Instrument Co., Ltd is headquartered in China.

name: Wuhan Lincontrol Automotive Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Wuhan Lincontrol Automotive Electronics Co., Ltd. is a China-based company specializing in the development and manufacturing of automotive electronic components and systems. Their products include engine control units (ECUs), body control modules (BCMs), and other automotive electronic modules. Wuhan Lincontrol Automotive Electronics Co., Ltd. is headquartered in China.

name: Dongguan Dingtong Precision Metal Co., Ltd.

summary: Polyrocks Chemical Co., Ltd researches, produces, and distributes environmental halogen-free flame retardant plastics. It offers environmental halogen-free flame retardant thermoplastic plastics, wire and cable materials, other materials, and compound plastics. It also provides environmental flame-retarded resins, functional master batches, and elastomeric products, which includes household appliances, decorative lighting, wires and cables, OA communication, and electrical and electronics. The company was founded in 2007 and is based in Qingyuan City, China.

name: Jiangsu gdk Biotechnology Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu gdk Biotechnology Co., Ltd. operates as a biotechnology firm specializing in the comprehensive research, development, manufacturing, and commercialization of human vaccines, alongside providing related services. Its current portfolio includes a quadrivalent split-virus influenza vaccine and a lyophilized human rabies vaccine. The company's pipeline is strategically focused on preventing major infectious diseases such as influenza, rabies, chickenpox, shingles, and pneumonia. This enterprise was established in 2008 and is headquartered in Taizhou, China.

name: Hainan Jinpan Smart Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Hainan Jinpan Smart Technology Co., Ltd. is a China-based company specializing in providing smart grid solutions and products. Their offerings include smart meters, power distribution automation systems, and energy management software. Hainan Jinpan Smart Technology Co., Ltd. is headquartered in China.

name: Qingdao NovelBeam Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Qingdao NovelBeam Technology Co.,Ltd. is a China-based company specializing in the development and manufacturing of optical communication devices and modules. Their products are used in high-speed data transmission and optical networking. Qingdao NovelBeam Technology Co.,Ltd. is headquartered in China.

name: Freewon China Co.,Ltd.
summary: Freewon China Co.,Ltd. is a China-based company specializing in the development and manufacturing of power supplies and power electronic products. summary: Anhui Tongyuan Environment Energy Saving Co.,Ltd is a China-based company specializing in providing energy-saving and environmental protection solutions. summary: Shanghai HIUV New Materials Co.,Ltd engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of film materials and products in China. The company also offers technical support and solutions for customers in various fields. Its products are used primarily by power generation group and first-line PV module manufacturers. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.

summary: Shandong Kehui Power Automation Co.,Ltd. is a company that specializes in the manufacturing and global distribution of sophisticated fault location devices for both cables and transmission lines. Established in 1991, the company maintains its headquarters in Zibo, China.

name: Shanghai Hollywave Electronic System Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Hollywave Electronic System Co., Ltd. is a China-based company specializing in the design, development, and manufacturing of microwave and millimeter-wave components and subsystems. Shanghai Hollywave Electronic System Co., Ltd. is headquartered in China.

summary: GuangDong Leary New Material Technology Co.,Ltd is a China-based company specializing in the research, development, production, and sales of high-performance polymer materials.
