name: Jiangsu Maixinlin Aviation Science and Technology Corp.
summary: Jiangsu Maixinlin Aviation Science and Technology Corp. manufactures and sells aircraft, engine, landing gear, medium and large structural, precision steel parts, fasteners, and components in China. The company offers processing and testing equipment. Jiangsu Maixinlin Aviation Science and Technology Corp. was founded in 2010 and is based in Suzhou, China.

name: OPT Machine Vision Tech Co., Ltd.
summary: OPT Machine Vision Tech Co., Ltd. specializes in the research, development, manufacturing, and distribution of fundamental software and hardware components crucial for machine vision systems. Their comprehensive product range includes software development kits (SDKs), central processing units (CPUs), intelligent cameras, various illumination setups, digital current controllers, industrial-grade lenses, specialized industrial cameras, power supply units, high-speed Gigabit Ethernet cards, and an assortment of lens adapters. This firm was established on March 24, 2006, by Zhi Lin Lu and Sheng Lin Lu, with its operational base situated in Dongguan, China.

name: Beijing Kawin Technology Share-Holding Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing Kawin Technology Share-Holding Co., Ltd. is a China-based company specializing in providing software and solutions for the financial industry. Their offerings include core banking systems, risk management software, and payment processing solutions. Beijing Kawin Technology Share-Holding Co., Ltd. is headquartered in China.

name: Changzhou Galaxy Century Microelectronics Co.,Ltd.
summary: Changzhou Galaxy Century Microelectronics Co.,Ltd. is an enterprise actively involved in the research, development, production, sales, and servicing of semiconductor devices, operating across both domestic Chinese and international markets. Its product portfolio encompasses a wide array of microelectronic components, including diodes, transistors, bridge rectifiers, LEDs, photocouplers, and linear integrated circuits. The company also extends its expertise through OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) services. These components find extensive application across various sectors such as home appliances, sustainable lighting solutions, network communication, power supplies and charging systems, the automotive industry, smart metering, and industrial automation. Established in 1994, the company is headquartered in Changzhou, China, and operates as a subsidiary of Action Star International Limited.

name: Suzhou Nanomicro Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Suzhou Nanomicro Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and supply of spherical, mono-disperse particles for various industries and applications worldwide. Its products include chromatography media, solid phase extraction sorbents, particle size standards, magnetic particles, LCD spacers, ACF conductive particles, and various other micro particles. Its products portfolio also includes chromatography resins & pre-packed columns, LCD spacer and conductive particles, silica chromatography, microspheres for life sciences. The company also exports its products to the Americas, Asia, Europe, Africa, and other markets. The company was founded in 2007 and is based in Suzhou, China.

name: Chengdu Xgimi Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Chengdu Xgimi Technology Co.,Ltd. is a China-based company specializing in the design, development, and manufacturing of smart projectors and related accessories. The company's products are known for their innovative design, high image quality, and user-friendly features. Chengdu Xgimi Technology Co.,Ltd. is headquartered in China.

name: Neway CNC Equipment (Suzhou) Co., Ltd.
summary: Neway CNC Equipment (Suzhou) Co., Ltd. operates as a global producer of industrial machinery. The firm's product range includes numerically-controlled machine tools, advanced numerical control systems, various actuating devices, and other related equipment. Additionally, it offers comprehensive after-sales support and a suite of other services. This company was established in 1997 and is headquartered in Suzhou, China.

name: Suzhou Veichi Electric Co., Ltd.
summary: Suzhou Veichi Electric Co., Ltd. is a China-based company specializing in the research, development, manufacturing, and sales of industrial automation products and solutions. Their products include variable frequency drives, servo systems, and programmable logic controllers (PLCs). Suzhou Veichi Electric Co., Ltd. is headquartered in China.

name: Shenzhen Sunmoon Microelectronics Co., Ltd
summary: Shenzhen Sunmoon Microelectronics Co., Ltd is a China-based company specializing in the design, development, and sales of integrated circuits (ICs). They focus on power management ICs and other analog and mixed-signal ICs for various applications. Shenzhen Sunmoon Microelectronics Co., Ltd is headquartered in China.

name: Kunshan Dongwei Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Established in 2005 and headquartered in Kunshan, China, Kunshan Dongwei Technology Co.,Ltd. is primarily engaged in the innovation, production, and distribution of machinery for printed circuit board (PCB) plating across the Chinese market. The company's diverse portfolio extends to include equipment for general metal plating, plastic plating, anodizing lines, and barrel plating, in addition to specialized PCB wet processing systems and associated components. Beyond its product offerings, Dongwei Technology provides extensive technical assistance for surface treatment engineering, encompassing expert consultation, practical application training, and ongoing technical support services.

name: Zhejiang Zone-King Environmental Sci&Tech Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Zone-King Environmental Sci&Tech Co., Ltd. delivers a comprehensive array of services focused on environmental management and protection. Their expertise spans various ecological solutions, including the remediation of contaminated groundwater, mitigation of water pollution, restoration of aquatic ecosystems, purification of gaseous emissions, and treatment of solid waste, among other specialized offerings. This company, established in 2003, maintains its primary operational base in Hangzhou, China.

name: Guizhou Zhenhua New Material Co., Ltd.
summary: Guizhou Zhenhua New Material Co., Ltd. specializes in producing cathode materials crucial for lithium-ion batteries. Its comprehensive product portfolio includes power ternary compounds, lithium cobalt oxide, composite ternary formulations, cobalt-nickel lithium manganese ternary compounds, and high manganese polycrystalline products. These essential materials are widely applied in the consumer electronics and automotive industries. The company, which was founded in 2004 and is based in Shenzhen, China, operated under the name Shenzhen Zhenhua New Material Co., LTD until it officially rebranded to Guizhou Zhenhua New Material Co., Ltd. in May 2018.

name: Macmic Science&Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Founded in 2006 and headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan, Macmic Science & Technology Co., Ltd. is a key player in the power semiconductor industry, focusing on the development, production, and distribution of advanced power semiconductor products and solutions. The company's diverse portfolio encompasses MOSFET modules, fast recovery epitaxial diodes (available as chips, discrete components, and modules), IGBTs (both discrete units and modules), rectifier diode modules (including three-phase bridge configurations), and thyristor modules. These offerings are integral to a wide range of applications, spanning from inverters for general, solar, and wind power, to welding equipment, switched-mode power supplies (SMPS), uninterruptible power supplies (UPS), induction heating, and various transportation products. Furthermore, their components are crucial for modern home appliances, electric vehicles, medical equipment, and motor drive systems.

name: Insight Lifetech Co. Ltd.
summary: Insight Lifetech Co., Ltd. operates as a medtech company. Its products include coronary physiology, coronary imaging, and coronary catheters. The firm also offers exchange fractional flow reserve (FFR) microcatheters, cardiovascular pressure measurement (CPM) systems, intravascular ultrasound systems, and microcatheters for complex percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI). The company was founded by Xiao Yang Fu, Song Liang and Li Li Chen on December 11, 2015 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.

name: Wave Cyber (Shanghai) Co., Ltd.
summary: Operating from its headquarters in Shanghai, China, Wave Cyber (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. is a specialized firm dedicated to the manufacturing and distribution of essential components for environmental water treatment systems. The company's product line features items such as pressure tanks, membrane pressure vessels, brine tanks and cabinets, and reverse osmosis membranes. Established in 2001, it provides these crucial parts for water purification.

name: Beijing Tongyizhong New Material Technology Corporation
summary: Beijing Tongyizhong New Material Technology Corporation, a Chinese company with its headquarters in Beijing, focuses on the innovation, manufacturing, and distribution of ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene (UHMWPE) fibers and their associated composite materials. The company's offerings include high-modulus polyethylene (HMPE) fibers suitable for a wide array of uses, such as specialized ropes and netting, protective gloves, ballistic applications, cut-resistant items, fishing lines, and pre-colored fiber solutions. They also produce various advanced textiles, including soft and hard ballistic fabrics, as well as materials engineered for resistance against cuts and stabs. Additionally, their product range encompasses complete protective gear like ballistic helmets, armor plates, vehicle reinforcement systems, defensive shields, explosion-proof blankets, and personal body armor. Complementary products include cut-resistant bags, innovative cool-touch fabrics, high-performance ropes, diverse fishery-related goods, and cut-protective apparel. This enterprise was founded in 1999.

name: GalaxyCore Inc.
summary: GalaxyCore Inc. operates as an IC design company worldwide. The company researches, designs, develops, manufactures, and sells complementary metal oxide semiconductor (CMOS) image sensors, display driver chips, and chip on module chip technology for use in smartphones, tablets, laptops, wearables, automotive electronics, and industrial applications. The company was formerly known as Galaxycore Shanghai Limited Corporation. GalaxyCore Inc. was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.

name: Anhui Estone Materials Technology Co.,Ltd
summary: Anhui Estone Materials Technology Co.,Ltd, headquartered in Bengbu, China, and established in 2006, specializes in manufacturing advanced material solutions. The company's product range encompasses sophisticated coatings for lithium batteries, specialized functional filling compounds for electronic communication equipment, and eco-friendly, low-smoke, halogen-free flame-retardant materials. These critical components find extensive application across various industries, including new energy vehicles, consumer electronics, semiconductor production (chips), copper clad laminates, and general fire safety systems.

name: SINOTECH Company Limited
summary: SINOTECH Company Limited specializes in the development, production, and marketing of catalytic converters aimed at environmental protection. Its diverse product line features solutions for treating exhaust gases from automobiles, sophisticated catalyst systems for off-road mobile equipment emissions, marine vessel exhaust catalysts, and industrial catalysts designed to purify volatile organic compounds. This company was established on July 15, 2005, and operates from its primary office in Chengdu, China.

name: WinTech Nano (Suzhou) Co Ltd.
summary: Wintech Nano (Suzhou) Co., Ltd. provides commercial laboratory services in the field of electronics and semiconductor in China and internationally. It provides solutions for failure analysis, non-destructive testing, electrical failure analysis, physical failure analysis, surface analysis, trace elemental analysis, chemical analysis, crystal analysis, pull/shear test, burn-in, reliability test, one-stop material analysis, and destructive physical analysis device, as well as R&D services. The company also offers automotive-grade chip testing, material analysis, and other testing services. Wintech Nano (Suzhou) Co., Ltd. was founded in 2004 and is based in Suzhou, China.

name: Puya Semiconductor (Shanghai) Co., Ltd.
summary: Founded in 2012 and based in Shanghai, China, Puya Semiconductor (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. develops and produces a comprehensive range of integrated circuits. Their product portfolio primarily consists of non-volatile and high-security memory devices, as well as analog motor drivers and advanced mixed-signal sensor ICs. Specific offerings from the company include Flash memory, EEPROM, general analog components, known good dies (KGD), and wafer-level chip scale packages (WL-CSP). These sophisticated semiconductor solutions cater to a broad spectrum of industries, such as automotive, industrial applications, telecommunications, mobile devices, consumer electronics, and the Internet of Things (IoT).

name: Hangzhou Biotest Biotech Co.,Ltd.
summary: Hangzhou Biotest Biotech Co., LTD. is an enterprise focused on the research, development, manufacturing, sales, and servicing of in vitro diagnostic (IVD) solutions. Operating both domestically within China and across international markets, the company provides a comprehensive range of medical testing products. Their offerings span crucial health areas including reproductive health, cancer detection, cardiovascular conditions, inflammatory markers, biochemical analysis, and various infectious diseases. This extensive portfolio also encompasses rapid diagnostic tests for COVID-19 (covering both antibody and antigen detection), as well as screening kits for drug use (utilizing urine, saliva, and hair samples) and assessing vitamin D levels. Beyond diagnostic kits and reagents, Hangzhou Biotest Biotech also supplies essential accompanying equipment, such as immunochromatography readers and fluorescence immunoassay quantitative analyzers. The company, established in 2008, is based in Hangzhou, China.

name: Anhui Ronds Science & Technology Incorporated Company
summary: Anhui Ronds Science & Technology Incorporated Company, established in 2007 and headquartered in Hefei, China, specializes in delivering advanced predictive maintenance solutions for machinery condition monitoring. The company's core expertise lies in developing comprehensive condition monitoring and fault diagnosis systems. Its extensive product portfolio includes a variety of hardware components such as sensors, dedicated condition monitoring devices, and sophisticated vibration analyzers. Complementing this, Anhui Ronds offers a robust software suite encompassing professional analysis tools, an intelligent analysis platform, and a specialized mobile application designed for the daily maintenance and management of industrial equipment. Beyond products, the company provides a range of services, including software research and development, intelligent diagnostic support, and cloud-based solutions. Anhui Ronds serves a diverse array of heavy industries, including wind power, petrochemicals, metallurgy, mining, thermal power generation, papermaking, cement production, water treatment, and coal chemical processing. While a significant player in the Chinese market, the company also boasts a substantial international footprint, exporting its technologies to over 30 countries worldwide. Notable export destinations include major economies such as the United States, the United Kingdom, Germany, Brazil, Australia, and Singapore.

name: Zhuhai CosMX Battery Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhuhai CosMX Battery Co., Ltd. specializes in the global production and distribution of polymer lithium-ion batteries, serving markets both within China and internationally. Their diverse product portfolio includes batteries for mobile phones, laptops, miniature electronics, and various other devices. Beyond consumer gadgets, these power solutions are also vital components in sectors such as passenger vehicles, electric motorcycles, broader electric vehicles, telecommunications infrastructure, and electricity grids. The company, which maintains its headquarters in Zhuhai, China, was established in 2007 and formally adopted its current name, Zhuhai CosMX Battery Co., Ltd., in March 2019, having previously operated as Zhuhai Coslight Battery Co., Ltd.

name: Guoguang Electric Co.,Ltd.Chengdu
summary: Guoguang Electric Co.,Ltd.Chengdu, originally known as Guoguang Electron Tube General Factory, was established in Chengdu, China, in 1958. The company is a key player in the manufacturing and global distribution of microwave tubes. Its extensive product portfolio also encompasses a comprehensive array of microwave solid-state solutions, including switching networks, frequency conversion components, radio frequency (RF) front-ends, power amplifiers, multi-function components, and microwave extensions, as well as various other microwave devices and components. Additionally, it supplies traveling wave tubes, magnetrons, and gas-filled microwave switch tubes. Beyond its core microwave offerings, Guoguang Electric Co.,Ltd.Chengdu provides highly specialized equipment for critical sectors. This includes support apparatus for the International Thermonuclear Experimental Reactor (ITER), specialized pumps and valves tailored for the nuclear industry, and thermal helium leak detection systems for ITER shielding modules. The firm also produces a wide range of vacuum-related products, such as pressure vessel vacuum measurement and control components, vacuum switches, arc extinguishing chambers, regulators, gauges, and comprehensive vacuum measurement and control systems. Further offerings in this domain comprise low and high-voltage vacuum contactors, vacuum chambers, and vacuum trigger switches. Rounding out its diverse product line is civil aviation airborne kitchen equipment. Guoguang Electric Co.,Ltd.Chengdu operates as a subsidiary of Xinyu Huanuojin Enterprise Management Co., Ltd.

name: Zhejiang Supcon Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Supcon Technology Co., Ltd. is a China-based company specializing in providing industrial automation and information technology solutions. Their offerings include distributed control systems (DCS), advanced process control (APC) software, and enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems. Zhejiang Supcon Technology Co., Ltd. is headquartered in China.

name: XTC New Energy Materials(Xiamen) Co.,Ltd.
summary: XTC New Energy Materials (Xiamen) Co.,Ltd., alongside its subsidiaries, dedicates itself to the research, manufacturing, and global distribution of cathode materials vital for lithium-ion batteries. The company supplies a diverse range of products, including high-voltage lithium cobalt oxide, as well as high-voltage, high-power, and high-nickel ternary materials. These advanced materials are integral to various applications, notably new energy vehicles, 3C consumer electronic devices, and energy storage solutions. The enterprise was founded in 2016 and is based in Xiamen, China.

name: Minmetals New Energy Materials (Hunan) Co., Ltd. Class A
summary: Minmetals New Energy Materials (Hunan) Co., Ltd. Class A primarily focuses on the development, manufacturing, and distribution of essential materials for various types of batteries. Its comprehensive product portfolio encompasses diverse precursor materials and a range of cathode materials. Specifically, this includes multi-element cathode compounds, cathode materials for lithium-ion batteries (such as lithium cobalt oxide and other related products), and components for nickel-hydrogen batteries. The company also provides advanced ternary materials optimized for both high energy density and power output applications. Established in 2002, its operations are based in Changsha, China.

name: Seeya Technology Corp.
summary: SeeYA Technology Corp. is engaged in the manufacturing of computer, communication and other electronic equipment. Its products include wearable smart devices, electronic devices and OLEDoS display devices. The company was founded on October 13, 2016 and is headquartered in Hefei, China.

name: Shenzhen Csl Vacuum Sci & Tech Co.
summary: Shenzhen CSL Vacuum Science & Technology Co., Ltd. engages in research and development, production and sales of semiconductor grade plasma RF power supplies and matching devices. The company was founded by Le Wei Ping on March 19, 2013 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.

name: Jiangxi Yuean Advanced Materials Co.,Ltd.
summary: Jiangxi Yuean Advanced Materials Co.,Ltd. primarily manufactures sophisticated metal powders and various membrane materials. Its comprehensive activities span the research, development, production, and distribution of a wide array of specialized products. These include crucial components such as carbonyl iron powder, magnetic material powder, atomized alloy powder, metal injection molding (MIM) feed, carbon nanotubes, advanced 3D printing alloy powder, and microwave absorbing materials. This enterprise was established in 2004 and has its headquarters situated in Ganzhou, China.

name: Beijing Haitian Ruisheng Science Technology Ltd.
summary: Beijing Haitian Ruisheng Science Technology Ltd. operates as a leading international provider of artificial intelligence data solutions. The company delivers specialized data products and services to enterprises and academic institutions across the globe. Their offerings encompass crucial AI domains like speech recognition, computer vision, natural language processing, and lexicon, alongside comprehensive data lifecycle services including data design, collection, transcription, and annotation. Their clientele spans a wide range, from technology companies and AI development firms to scientific research organizations. Established in 2005, the company is headquartered in Beijing, China.

name: ShenZhen Consys Science&Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: ShenZhen Consys Science&Technology Co., Ltd. is a China-based company that specializes in providing testing and measurement solutions for various industries. The company’s offerings include testing equipment, software, and services related to compliance, quality, and safety. ShenZhen Consys Science&Technology Co., Ltd. is headquartered in China.

name: Hangzhou Honghua Digital Technology Stock Co., Ltd. Class A
summary: Hangzhou Honghua Digital Technology Stock Company LTD. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of digital printing equipment and consumables in China. It provides solutions for industrial digital printing, digital printing equipment for the textile and printing industries, consumables and software for inkjet printing, and automated sewing equipment. It also exports its products. Hangzhou Honghua Digital Technology Stock Company LTD. was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.

name: Shenzhen Breo Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Operating from China, Shenzhen Breo Technology Co Ltd is dedicated to the innovation and development of health-focused products. The company's core activities involve the entire spectrum of smart portable massagers, from their initial design and research to manufacturing, sales, and after-sales service. Their product offerings predominantly feature intelligent, compact massage devices tailored for four key areas: the eyes, neck, head, and scalp. These items are primarily marketed under their established proprietary brands, "breo" and "Beijiao" series. The majority of the company's commercial operations are concentrated within the Chinese domestic market.

name: Chongqing Genori Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Chongqing Genori Technology Co., Ltd. manufactures core components and materials for the semiconductor and display panel industries. Its products include silicon, quartz, silicon carbide, and aluminum oxide ceramic equipment parts used in semiconductor etching and vapor deposition processes. It also provides surface treatments like spray regeneration, anodization, and precision cleaning for vacuum components.

name: Shanghai Awinic Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Awinic Technology Co.,Ltd. engages in the research, development, and sale of integrated circuit chips in China and internationally. It offers high-performance digital-analog hybrid chips, such as digital intelligent audio amplifier, tactile feedback chips, optical image stabilization chips, motor driver, sensing chips, sound and light synchronous breathing light driver chips, and other products. The company also provides power management chips, which includes backlight driver, breathing light driver, flash/infrared light driver, ToFLD driver, overvoltage protection, overcurrent protection, linear charging chips, high-power fast charging chips, switching power supply, LCD Bias, amoled Power, LDO, load switches, port protection switches, PD protocol chips, logic identification chips, MOSFET, and other products. In addition, it offers signal chain chip that includes antenna tuning switches, low noise amplifiers, low noise amplifiers; hall sensor chips, operational amplifiers, high-speed and analog switches, level conversions, interface chips, reset chip, and other products. Its products are used in consumer electronics, Internet of Things, industry and automotive fields, and in various electronic products. Shanghai Awinic Technology Co.,Ltd. was formerly known as Shanghai Aiwei Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Shanghai Awinic Technology Co.,Ltd. in December 2014. The company was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.

name: Suzhou Recodeal Interconnect System Co.,Ltd
summary: Suzhou Recodeal Interconnect System Co.,Ltd operates on a global scale, specializing in the development, manufacturing, and distribution of connection systems, microwave components, and various related items. Their extensive product range includes connectivity solutions for energy vehicles, telecommunications, industrial applications, and vehicle communications, alongside BUSBAR copper bar systems, cable assemblies, and wiring harnesses. These offerings are predominantly deployed within critical sectors such as data communication, the new energy vehicle industry, industrial control, medical equipment, and rail transportation, among other applications. The company, which established its operations in 2006, is headquartered in Suzhou, China.

name: Semight Instruments Co. Ltd.
summary: Semight Instruments Co.,Ltd. provides test and measurement instruments and equipment. The firm focuses on the research and development and manufacturing of test instruments and equipment in the fields of high-speed communications, optical chips, electronic chips and power wafer chips. It is a supplier with high-performance test instruments, high-precision automation and semiconductor ATE comprehensive capabilities. The firm provides high-end test instruments including broadband sampling oscilloscopes, clock recovery units, high-speed bit error testers, high-precision fast wavelength meters, precision digital source meters, low-leakage matrix switches, as well as high-end test equipment such as semiconductor laser CoC aging, bare chip testing, silicon photonic wafer testing, SiC wafer aging, SiC power bare chip KGD test sorting and WAT wafer semiconductor parameter test systems. The company was founded on March 15, 2017 and is headquartered in Suzhou, China.

name: CETC LANTIAN TECHNOLOGY CO LTD
summary: CETC Lantian Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, sells & service of electric energy products and systems. The company was founded in 1958 and is headquartered in Tianjin, China.

name: Tianneng Battery Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Tianneng Battery Group Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, engages in the research and development, production, sale, and service of lithium batteries for new energy vehicles, start-stop batteries for vehicles, and wind energy and solar energy storage batteries. The company offers lead-acid and lithium-ion power, traction, industrial backup, electric and mobile energy storage, starter, start-stop, on and off-grid, grid-connected, smart microgrid, and composite energy storage batteries. Its products are used in the fields of transportation, tourism and leisure, logistics and express delivery, sanitation cleaning, storage, communications, power, railways, ships, radio and television, UPS, digital and consumer products, and energy storage systems. The company was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in Changxing, China. Tianneng Battery Group Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Tianneng Power International Limited.

name: Sj Semiconductor Corp.
summary: SJ Semiconductor Corp. is engaged in the manufacturing of semiconductor devices. It offers middle segment silicon wafer processing, wafer level packaging, multiple chip integrated packaging and other services. The company was founded on August 19, 2014 and is headquartered in Wuxi, China.

name: CXMT Corp.
summary: CXMT Corp. operates as a semiconductor and storage chip company. It manufactures dynamic random-access memory (DRAM) chips that power mobile phones, PCs, tablets, servers, and other consumer products and applications. The company was founded on June 13, 2016 and is headquartered in Hefei, China.

name: Yushu Technology Co. Ltd.
summary: Yushu Technology Co., Ltd., operating under the brand Unitree Robotics, develops, produces, and sells high-performance quadruped robots and their applications for industrial and consumer use. The company is based in Hangzhou, China, and has subsidiaries in China. The Chinese company offers a range of products including consumer and educational quadruped robots, industrial quadrupeds, humanoid robots, robotic arms, and advanced perception components such as 4D lidar sensors. The company's robots are equipped with advanced sensing systems, AI integration, and versatile operation modes suitable for education, entertainment, industrial inspection, and rescue missions. The company’s solutions address tasks in industries such as power system inspection, fire rescue, agriculture, mining, and public safety, featuring robust, modular designs and advanced navigation capabilities. Unitree Robotics also provides intelligent inspection systems that integrate robots with drones and AI algorithms for autonomous patrols and centralized monitoring. The company was founded in 2016 by Xing Xing Wang. Xing Xing Wang has been the CEO since 2016.

name: Semiconductor Manufacturing International Corporation
summary: SEMICONDUCTOR MAN.INTL is a semiconductor foundry that manufactures integrated circuits for various customers. The company is one of the largest foundries in the world. Semiconductor Manufacturing International Corporation is headquartered in Shanghai, China.

name: Ninebot Limited
summary: Ninebot Limited is a China-based company specializing in the design, development, manufacturing, and sales of personal transportation devices. Their products include electric scooters, self-balancing vehicles, and robotic mobility solutions. Ninebot Limited is headquartered in Beijing, China.

name: INESA Intelligent Tech Inc.
summary: INESA Intelligent Tech Inc. operates as an information technology services company in China. It offers cloud computing and big data solutions that include infrastructure as a service, platform as a service, and software as a service; industry solutions, such as intelligent security, smart government, wisdom detection, smart water, wisdom education, and smart medical; and consumer, security, and special electronic products, as well as electronic detection products. The company was formerly known as INESA Electron Co., Ltd and changed its name to INESA Intelligent Tech Inc. in June 2016. INESA Intelligent Tech Inc. was founded in 1986 and is based in Shanghai, China.

name: Shanghai Shibei Hi-Tech Co.,Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Shibei Hi-Tech Co.,Ltd. invests in, develops, rents, and sells real estate properties in China. The company was founded in 1923 and is based in Shanghai, China.

name: Dazhong Transportation (Group) Co., Ltd.
summary: Dazhong Transportation (Group) Co., Ltd. engages in the passenger transport business in China. It provides taxi and cars rental services; mobile Internet services for travel; taxi pricing devices; various vehicle intelligent dispatching platform; GPS/GPRS vehicle equipment; and call center system, as well as is involved in the research, development, production, sales, and service of traffic information application. The company also offers inter-provincial passenger cars and chartered flights; advertisement services; financial loans; and auction services for real estate, motor vehicles, equity, materials and equipment, art, and other services. In addition, it engages in the real estate and hotel businesses; provides travel and logistics services; operates motor vehicle driving training and conference centers; and trades in used cars, as well as involved in the market management; and repair and maintenance services. The company was formerly known as Shanghai Dazhong Taxi Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Dazhong Transportation (Group) Co., Ltd. in August 1988. The company was founded in 1988 and is based in Shanghai, China.

name: Shanghai Shenqi Pharmaceutical Investment Management Co.,Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Shenqi Pharmaceutical Investment Management Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, researches, develops, produces, and sells pharmaceutical products primarily in China. It specializes in offering anti-tumor, cardio-cerebral vascular, and antifungal drugs, as well as cold and cough drugs under the miraculous brand, and medications for children under the Magic Doll name. The company also provides cantharidin sodium vitamin B6 injection under the Ai Yishu name for the treatment of cancer; Chinese medicines and chemical medicines; respiratory and digestive system medications; ginseng polysaccharide and cantharidin injections; and pediatric phlegm cough particles. In addition, it offers ethnic medicines; raw material medicines; drugs for rheumatic orthopedics, kidney, diarrhea, and gynecological menstruation; drugs under the Anshen Bunao name; sodium candida sulfate injections; Jie Yin Ling lotions; compound coral ginger solutions; and coral decoctions. Further, the company provides urea miconazole ointment complex products; cephalosporins; Yinqi Xinmai dripping pills; Yindan Xintai and Danxin Taidi pills; Metronidazole B6 tablets; Yuan Ye Zhike syrups; anti-particles; compound Shangfuning cream; and pediatric pharyngeal flat particles and clear toxic syrups. Additionally, it offers Keping, Paidui Jiangzhi, Zhizhike, Jinwugutong, Jingwu, and Tianma capsules; and Zhifan Zhike, Phenol yellow, Ganfu, and pediatric aminophenol alkylamine granules, as well as medications for injury, etc. The company also provides products in various other forms, such as sprays, films, tinctures, etc. It also operates under the magic, Guizhou, God, Speed Stop, and Qiang Lulu brand names. The company is based in Shanghai, China.

name: Shanghai Zhongyida Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Zhongyida Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and distribution of textile machineries in the People's Republic of China. It offers various types of rapier and air jet looms, air jet upper supporting structures, fabric supporting structures, and large-tension fabric body attached pressing cloth structures, as well as controlling circuit boards and control software products for electronic selvage and color selecting devices. The company was founded in 1920 and is based in Shanghai, the People's Republic of China.

name: Shanghai Chlor-Alkali Chemical Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Chlor-Alkali Chemical Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells chemical products. It offers caustic soda, polyvinyl chloride, hydrochloride, vinyl chloride, chlorine, fluorine, and other products under the Shen Feng brand name. The company sells its products in China, Southeast Asia, Japan, Korea, Australia, South Africa, Europe, and the Americas. Shanghai Chlor-Alkali Chemical Co., Ltd. was founded in 1992 and is based in Shanghai, China. Shanghai Chlor-Alkali Chemical Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of Shanghai Huayi (Group) Company Ltd.

name: Shanghai Huayi Group Corporation Limited
summary: Shanghai Huayi Group Corporation Limited operates as a chemical company in China and internationally. The company offers methanol, acetic acid, carbon monoxide, syngas and sulfuric acid, air separation products, etc. for the chemical, pharmaceutical, and other industries. It also provides support services for water, electricity, steam, and other public works, as well as special railway lines and dangerous chemical goods terminals; and dangerous chemical goods transport vehicles and other logistics facilities. In addition, the company offers caustic soda and PVC products under the Shenfeng brand; all-steel radial truck, all steel radial light truck, passenger, full-steel radial truck, and semi-steel radial tires; and acrylic, ice crystal acrylic acid, butyl acrylate, ethyl acrylate, isooctyl acrylate, hydroxyethyl acrylate, and other products under the Yaxing brand for use in the coatings, chemical fiber, textile, light, and other industries. Further, it researches, develops, and produces various fluorine-containing chemicals, including fluoropolymer and fluorine fine chemicals; fluorine refrigerants, such as PTFE in polyfluoroethylene, polyperfluoroethylene propylene, polyvinylidene fluoride, and fusible polytetrafluoroethylene; RTC resins for coatings, chlorotrifluoroethylene resins, and powder coating resins; fluorine rubber comprising fluororubber, 246 type fluororubber, tetrapropylene fluoride rubber, fluorosilicone rubber, etc.; various surfactants, chemical and pharmaceutical intermediates, other auxiliaries, etc.; and general-grade, sheet-grade, and alloy body ABS resins. Additionally, the company offers paint and dyes under the Flying Tiger, Bright, Eyes, One Product, Lion Head, and Aircraft brands; and engages in the logistics, engineering, real estate, investment, and finance businesses. The company was formerly known as Double Coin Holdings Ltd. Shanghai Huayi Group Corporation Limited is based in Shanghai, China.

name: Shanghai Highly (Group) Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Highly (Group) Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, researches, develops, produces, and sells air conditioning compressors, electric motors, drive controls, and cooling and heating-related products in China. The company also produces and operates parts of refrigeration compressors, including air cylinders, crankshafts, upper and lower cylinders, etc.; and casting pieces of automotive parts and mechanical machining parts. In addition, it develops, manufactures, sells, and services professional equipment in the field of special refrigeration, including industrial refrigeration equipment, high-temperature special air conditioners, vehicle and vessel air conditioners, and cooling devices for wind power generators used in the pharmaceutical equipment, engineering machinery, railway vehicles, and communication industrial applications. Additionally, the company provides commercial freezers, refrigeration showcases, fabricated cold storages, and supporting equipment; and installation, repair, and technical consultation services. Further, it exports its products to 156 countries. The company was founded in 1954 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.

name: Shanghai Jinqiao Export Processing Zone Development Co.,Ltd
summary: Shanghai Jinqiao Export Processing Zone Development Co.,Ltd engages in the development and construction, investment promotion, industrial development, and carrier operation management in China. Its property portfolio comprises industrial parks, serviced apartments, residential buildings, and office buildings. Shanghai Jinqiao Export Processing Zone Development Co.,Ltd was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.

name: Shanghai Waigaoqiao Free Trade Zone Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Waigaoqiao Free Trade Zone Group Co., Ltd. engages in the trade and logistic, and real estate development business in China. The company is also involved in the investment, construction, operation, and industrial organization of factories, warehouses, and office buildings, as well as urban renewal operation. In addition, it provides trade service solutions, including import and export agency, display sales, warehousing, and distribution services. The company was formerly known as Shanghai Waigaoqiao Free Trade Zone Development Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Shanghai Waigaoqiao Free Trade Zone Group Co., Ltd. in September 2015. Shanghai Waigaoqiao Free Trade Zone Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.

name: Shanxi Guoxin Energy Corporation Limited
summary: Shanxi Guoxin Energy Corporation Limited engages in the energy management business. The company's products primarily include natural gas, coal bed methane, and coal gas. It also provides energy sector related consulting services. The company was formerly known as Shanghai Lianhua Synthetic Fiber Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Shanxi Guoxin Energy Corporation Limited in July 2014. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Taiyuan, China.

name: Zhonglu.Co.,Ltd
summary: Zhonglu.Co.,Ltd manufactures and sells bicycles in the People's Republic of China. It offers bicycles and electric bicycles under the Forever brand; wheelchairs; and bowling equipment; natural latex products; plastic paving materials; and automatic chess and card equipment, as well as public bicycle rental service systems. The company also exports its products to Europe, Asia, and Africa. Zhonglu.Co.,Ltd was founded in 1940 and is based in Shanghai, China.

name: Shanghai Haixin Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Haixin Group Co., Ltd. engages in the medicine, textile and clothing, and finance businesses. It is also involved in the industrial park business. The company was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in Shanghai, the People's Republic of China.

name: Shanghai Yaohua Pilkington Glass Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Yaohua Pilkington Glass Group Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells glass products in China and internationally. It provides float, architectural, and automotive glasses. The company was founded in 1983 and is based in Shanghai, China.

name: Shanghai Greencourt Investment Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Greencourt Investment Group Co., Ltd. provides real estate investment services to high net worth clients and institutional investors in China and internationally. It offers financial advisory, financing services, M&A services, and asset securitization. The company also engages in equity, debt investment, and other businesses. The company was formerly known as Shanghai Dajiang Food Group Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Shanghai Greencourt Investment Group Co., Ltd. in February 2015. Shanghai Greencourt Investment Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 1985 and is based in Shanghai, China.

name: Shanghai Diesel Engine Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Diesel Engine Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells diesel engines in China. The company provides natural gas engines, diesel engines for gensets, engines for construction machinery, truck engines, marine engines, and bus and coach diesel engines. Its products are primarily used in heavy-duty vehicles, passenger cars, engineering machinery, ships, and mobile power stations. The company was founded in 1947 and is based in Shanghai, China.

name: Danhua Chemical Technology Co.,Ltd
summary: Danhua Chemical Technology Co.,Ltd manufactures and sells various chemical products in China. The company offers ethylene glycol for use in the production of polyester fibers, films, packaging resins, antifreeze, and low melting point explosives, as well as auxiliary agents for the dye industry and lubricants for tobacco, cosmetics, and other applications. It also provides oxalic acid for use as an intermediate or reagent in the synthesis of chemicals, including starch hydrolysis to produce pure dextrin and glucose, oxalate reagents, synthetic oxalates, oxalates, etc. for the chemical industry; in the manufacture of chlortetracycline, vitamin B2, and streptomycin for the pharmaceutical industry; in the textile printing and dyeing industry for cotton, wool, and coal dyes, as well as leather tanning and bleaching, and plywood bleaching; and in the metallurgical industry to refine high-purity nickel, rare earth, and other metals, as well as manufacture of carbon rods. In addition, the company offers catalyst products, such as dehydrogenation, synthetic, and hydrogenation catalyst, as well as acetic anhydride. Danhua Chemical Technology Co.,Ltd was founded in 1993 and is based in Shanghai, China.

name: Shanghai Sanmao Enterprise (Group) Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Sanmao Enterprise (Group) Co., Ltd. imports business apparel, wool fabrics, auto parts, and other products in China and internationally. The company invests in, leases, develops, and manages real estate properties; and provides network information technology related products and services, etc. It also offers security equipment, such as user monitoring and anti- theft reported to the police, as well as access control installation and maintenance, repair, and other services. The company was formerly known as Shanghai Sanmao Textile Co., Ltd. Shanghai Sanmao Enterprise (Group) Co., Ltd. was founded in 1993 and is based in Shanghai, China.

name: Shanghai Bailian (Group) Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Bailian (Group) Co., Ltd. owns and operates department stores, shopping malls, outlets, large stores, supermarkets, and convenience stores. It is also involved in the fields of e-commerce, logistics, consumer services, commercial investment, real estate, asset management, and electronic information, as well as trades in non-ferrous and ferrous metals, automotive, light chemical, electrical, timber, fuel, etc. The company was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China. Shanghai Bailian (Group) Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of Bailian (Group) Co., Ltd.

name: Shang Gong Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Shang Gong Group Co., Ltd. researches, develops, produces, and sells industrial sewing equipment and household sewing machines in China and internationally. It offers machines for apparel manufacturing, including lock and chain stitch machines, engineered workstations, sewing automats, and sewing units; and machines for upholstery, automotive, and technical textiles, such as M-type H-type flatbed machines, postbed machines, cylinder arm-machines, and workstations, as well as sewing units. The company also provides sewing machines for the manufacturing of shoes, bags, and suitcases, as well as for aerospace and new materials. In addition, the company offers film materials and office equipment sale, import and export trade, and logistics services. Further, it produces and markets electronic equipment; offers asset and property management services; researches and markets sewing software; and offers campus logistics management and labor services. The company offers its products under the Dürkopp Adler, PFAFF Industrial, KSL, SGGEMSY, Richpeace, SMPIC, Shanggong, and Butterfly brands. The company was formerly known as SGSB Group Co., Ltd. Shang Gong Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.

name: Shanghai Mechanical & Electrical Industry Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Mechanical & Electrical Industry Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells mechanical and electrical equipment in the People's Republic of China. The company offers elevators; and printing and packaging machinery, including printing equipment, special equipment, post press equipment, packing mechanical equipment, etc. It also provides refrigeration and air conditioning equipment, heating and ventilation equipment, and compressors; and welding equipment. In addition, the company manufactures and sells underground constriction equipment; and drilling rigs for pile formation used in highways, railways, subways, bridges, reservoirs, ports, urban construction, industrial facilities, municipal construction, geological exploration, and underground water resources development projects. Further, it offers wood-base panels and equipment; and energy-saving and contract energy management services. The company also exports its products to approximately 40 countries, including Southeast Asia, South America, North Africa, Russia, etc. Shanghai Mechanical & Electrical Industry Co., Ltd. is based in Shanghai, the People's Republic of China.

name: Shanghai Baosight Software Co.,Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Baosight Software Co.,Ltd., a information and automation company, provides industrial solutions in China. The company offers information solutions, including manufacturing execution systems, advanced planning systems, quality management systems, equipment management systems, and logistics management systems; and automation solutions, such as automated solutions for whole metallurgical and automated solutions cold rolling processes, and data acquisition and analysis systems. It also provides process energy-saving solutions; electromechanical equipment comprising marking machines, full-hydrogen bell-type furnaces, and strip steel surface inspection systems; and intelligent manufacturing solutions that include cloud computing, Internet data center, big data, unmanned warehouse, industrial robot, Internet of Things, and car network solutions. The company operates through 12 branches. Shanghai Baosight Software Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.

name: Shanghai Lingang Holdings Co.,Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Lingang Holdings Co.,Ltd. develops, rents, and sells industrial carriers in China. The company's industrial carriers portfolio include technology research and development buildings, headquarters business buildings, bonded logistics warehouses, etc. It is also involved in the park operations and industrial investment activities. The company was formerly known as Shanghai Automation Instrumentation Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Shanghai Lingang Holdings Co.,Ltd in November 2015. Shanghai Lingang Holdings Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1994 and is based in Shanghai, China.

name: Shanghai Jinjiang International Travel Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Jinjiang International Travel Co., Ltd. provides travel agency services. It organizes outbound and domestic tourism for Chinese citizens; and inbound tourism for international travelers; and conferences and exhibitions. The company is based in Shanghai, China. Shanghai Jinjiang International Travel Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of Shanghai Jinjiang International Hotels (Group) Co., Ltd.

name: Shanghai Lujiazui Finance & Trade Zone Development Co.,Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Lujiazui Finance & Trade Zone Development Co.,Ltd. operates as a real estate company in Pudong New Area. The company develops, sells, operates, and leases real estate properties. Its property portfolio includes office, residential, business, exhibition, hotel, regional development, and charitable properties. The company was founded in 1992 and is based in Shanghai, China. Shanghai Lujiazui Finance & Trade Zone Development Co.,Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Shanghai Lujiazui Development (Group) Company Limited.

name: Huaxin Cement Co., Ltd.
summary: Huaxin Cement Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells cement in China and internationally. It also provides RMX products and aggregates, as well as cement technical services. In addition, the company is involved in the research, manufacture, installation, and maintenance of cement equipment; and cement import and export trade activities. Further, it engages in the cement kiln co-processing of waste materials; EPC for cement projects; equipment business; and project contracting business related to cement kiln co-processing technology, cement-based high-tech building materials, etc. The company was founded in 1907 and is based in Wuhan, China.

name: Inner Mongolia Erdos Resources Co.,ltd.
summary: Inner Mongolia Erdos Resources Co.,ltd. engages in garment, energy, chemical, metallurgy, and other businesses in China. The company provides plush products, cashmere yarns, cashmere sweaters, and other seasonal products. It also offers ferrosilicon, silicon manganese alloy, coal, caustic soda, calcium carbide, and PVC resins. The company was formerly known as Inner Mongolia Eerduosi Resources Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to Inner Mongolia Erdos Resources Co.,ltd. in June 2011. Inner Mongolia Erdos Resources Co.,ltd. was incorporated in 2000 and is based in Ordos, China.

name: HNA Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: HNA Technology Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, provides IT distribution and supply chain services. It provides HNA cloud and artificial intelligence platform, as well as technology solutions. The company was formerly known as Tianjin Tianhai Investment Co., Ltd and changed its name to HNA Technology Co., Ltd. in April 2018. HNA Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.

name: Shanghai Huili Building Materials Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Huili Building Materials Co., Ltd. operates as a building materials company in China. It is involved in the production and sale of coatings, PC sheets, wooden products, doors and windows curtain walls, flooring products, floor substrates, and other products under the Huili brand. The company primarily serves real estate companies. Shanghai Huili Building Materials Co., Ltd. is based in Shanghai, China.

name: Greattown Holdings Ltd.
summary: Greattown Holdings Ltd. engages in the real estate development business in China. It develops residential, commercial complex, industrial park, tourism and cultural park, office building, and hotel properties. The company was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.

name: Huangshan Tourism Development Co., Ltd.
summary: Huangshan Tourism Development Co., Ltd. engages in the tourism business in China. It is also involved in the hotel, Huizhou cuisine catering, cableways, garden development, travel agencies, and environmental sanitation and cleaning of scenic spots businesses. The company was founded in 1996 and is based in Huangshan, China.

name: Hunan Tyen Machinery Co., Ltd
summary: Hunan Tyen Machinery Co., Ltd engages in the research, development, production, and sale of turbochargers, high-performance valves, cooling fans, and high-speed rail cooling fans in China. It offers diesel engine superchargers; gasoline engine turbocharger; and other products. The company was founded in 1950 and is based in Hengyang, China.

name: Shanghai Zhenhua Heavy Industries Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Zhenhua Heavy Industries Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells heavy-duty equipment worldwide. The company offers various cranes; quayside container cranes, bulk cargo handling equipment such as ship loaders and ship unloaders; and stackers and reclaimers. It also provides various offshore products, such as floating cranes, pipelay vessels, and other engineering vessels; offshore platforms; DP systems and jacking systems; and goliath cranes. In addition, the company offers steel structures that comprise large and heavy scale steel structures, such as bridges, modules, and sea wind structures, as well as electrical products. Further, it engages in the marine transport and installation; and construction and installation of large-scale port equipment, engineering vessels, offshore heavy equipment, mechanical equipment, gear box for wind power generation equipment, largesized reverse branch, transmission mechanism, dynamic positioning, large-sized anchor windlass, offshore oil platform lifting device and components, and offshore wind turbine. In addition, the company is involved in the software development and integration; investment and financing business; leasing of cranes and engineering vessels; real estate development; and design and manufacturing of accessories. Further, it provides maintenance, consulting, and technical services. It owns a fleet of more than 20 transportation vessels. The company is headquartered in Shanghai, the People's Republic of China.

name: Inner Mongolia Yitai Coal Co., Ltd.
summary: Inner Mongolia Yitai Coal Co., Ltd. engages in the mining, production, transportation, and sale of coal products in the Inner Mongolia autonomous region of the People's Republic of China. It operates through three segments: Coal, Coal-Related Chemical, and Transportation. The company also provides road and railway transportation services to coal companies; coal-related chemical products and oil products; and disaster management, supply chain management, industrial development and consultation, business management consultation, and business information consultation services. In addition, it is involved in the coal mining; international trade; goods storage and loading; coal technology development; consultation; infrastructure municipal administration; research and development; oil and coal testing; fund investment and investment management; and chemical production and sale activities. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Ordos, the People's Republic of China. Inner Mongolia Yitai Coal Co.,Ltd. is a subsidiary of Inner Mongolia Yitai Group Co., Ltd.

name: Jinzhou Port Co., Ltd.
summary: Jinzhou Port Co., Ltd. operates the Jinzhou Port in Liaoning province, China. Its port has 27 berths, including a 300,000-ton oil berth, 100,000-ton bulk cargo berths, and 100,000-ton container specific berths. The company handles oil, grain, building materials, metal ore, steel, coal, and containers. It offers port management, port loading and unloading, water transportation auxiliary industry, road transportation; grain acquisition; grain wholesale; metal materials, mineral powder, coal sales; wholesale oil products; material storage; domestic ship agents, cargo agents; and international trade and re-export trade services. Jinzhou Port Co., Ltd. is based in Jinzhou, China.

name: Shanghai Lingyun Industries Development Co., Ltd
summary: Shanghai Lingyun Industries Development Co., Ltd constructs and operates photovoltaic power generation projects. It operates a 100 megawatts photovoltaic power station in Baiyin, China. The company was incorporated in 1998 and is based in Shanghai, China.
industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers
